qs.s: Crowdtesting: jab logon ka ek group same product ko real world scenarios me test karta hai aur product ke baare me insights aur feedback deta hai. Millions log same app download karke bilkul alag experience pa sakte hain. Hundreds of variables hain: devices aur software, physical locations, user demographics, level of tech savviness. Traditional testing methodologies aaj ke changing digital landscape me sufficient nahi hain; sabse advanced in-house QA department bhi limited hai aur real-world complexities account nahi kar sakta. Solution: Crowdtesting. The platform 2007 se In-the-Wild Crowdtesting ka pioneer aur leader hai. Belief: sirf real people, real devices, real locations, real world scenarios me hi authentic user insights de sakte hain. The platform testers ko digital testing, payment testing aur omnichannel feedback ke liye pay kiya jata hai. Community ki diversity (backgrounds, interests, skills, professions) the platform ki success ka ek reason hai.
qs.b: Crowdtesting is when a group of people test the same product in real-world scenarios and provide insights and feedback. It is needed because users have very different experiences depending on device, software, location, demographics and tech savviness, and even advanced in-house QA teams cannot cover all those real-world combinations. The platform has led in-the-wild crowdtesting since 2007, using real people on real devices in real locations for digital, payment and omnichannel testing.
qs.t: Real people, real devices, real locations, real scenarios = In-the-Wild.

qs.q: What is the Academy and should its learning tracks be done in order?
qs.s: The Academy ek training program hai jo the platform community me tester banne ke basic essentials sikhata hai. Isme kai training tracks hain, har track me courses hain jinke andar text aur video content hota hai. Order: haan, strongly suggest kiya gaya hai ki pehle learning track se start karo aur apni pace pe har track complete karo. Kyun complete karein: jo testers Academy courses complete karte hain aur practice test cycles me excel karte hain unhe real clients ke paid test cycles me invite hone ke chances zyada hote hain.
qs.b: The Academy is a training program that teaches the basic essentials of being a tester in the platform community, organised into training tracks made of courses with text and video content. It is strongly recommended to start with the first track and work through each one in order at your own pace. Testers who complete the courses and excel in the practice test cycles are more likely to be invited to paid test cycles for real clients.
qs.t: Track 1 se shuru, order me chalo; Academy + practice = paid invite ke chances.

qs.q: What will you learn and practice in the Academy?
qs.s: Academy courses aur practice test cycles me ye 13 cheezein sikhte aur practice karte ho: 1) Basic essentials of the platform 2) the platform pe different types of testing 3) High quality tester kaise bane 4) Test cycle accept ya decline kaise karein 5) Bug kaise dhoondhein aur issue report kaise submit karein 6) Testing slot kaise claim karein 7) Test case kaise complete karein 8) Screenshots aur videos kaise capture karein 9) Computer aur device logs kaise record karein 10) Community aur Test Team Lead se chat me kaise communicate karein 11) the platform app kaise use karein 12) Personally Identifiable Information kaise blur karein 13) the platform pe success ke tips and tricks.
qs.b: The Academy covers the platform basics, the different testing types, how to be a high-quality tester, accepting or declining cycles, finding bugs and submitting issue reports, claiming slots and completing test cases. It also teaches capturing screenshots, videos and computer and device logs, communicating with the community and the Test Team Lead in chat, using the platform app, blurring personally identifiable information, and tips for success.
qs.t: Basics, types, quality, accept/decline, bug, slot, test case, media, logs, chat, app, PII blur, tips = 13.

qs.q: What is the Academy Certification program and what are its levels?
qs.s: Haan, Academy me practice test cycles join kar sakte ho. Academy Certification program practice test cycles ki series hai jo Academy team manage karti hai aur weekly launch hoti hai. Levels (6): 1) Introduction to testing - naye the platform members ke liye 2) Computers testing - Desktop aur Laptop machines pe testing 3) Mobile device testing - Mobile aur Tablet devices pe testing 4) Charles proxy testing - computers aur mobile devices pe website traffic decrypt karna 5) Academy Challenge - dusre naye Academy testers se compete karna 6) Academy All Stars - Invitation only - best Academy testers ke liye.
qs.b: The Academy Certification program is a series of practice test cycles managed by the Academy team and launched weekly. Its levels are Introduction to Testing for new members, Computers Testing on desktops and laptops, Mobile Device Testing on phones and tablets, Charles Proxy Testing for decrypting traffic, the Academy Challenge for competing with other new testers, and Academy All Stars, which is invitation-only for the best Academy testers.
qs.t: Intro, Computer, Mobile, Charles, Challenge, All Stars (invite only).

qs.q: Do you get a certificate after the Academy Certification Program, and how many times can you take each level?
qs.s: Late join kiya to bhi chance hai: naye aur motivated testers jo extra effort karte hain unhe project teams dhoondhti hain; platform pe active raho, cycles me contribute karo; zyadatar project team members pehle tester hi the. Certificate: Nahi, formal certification nahi milta. Har level complete karne pe congratulatory email aata hai, aur saare levels successfully finish karne pe graduation email. Academy completion internal team (TSMs, TEs, etc.) ke liye Green flag hai ki tum crowdtesting methods aur best practices samajhte ho, jisse paid cycles me work reject hone ke chances kam ho sakte hain. Attempts: har Academy certificate level (practice test cycle) sirf ek baar complete kar sakte ho; lekin the Academy Challenge level 10 baar tak complete kar sakte ho.
qs.b: No formal certificate is issued; testers get a congratulatory email after each level and a graduation email after finishing all levels. Completing the Academy acts as a green flag for internal staff such as TSMs and TEs, showing you understand crowdtesting best practices, which can reduce rejections in paid cycles. Each level can be completed once, except the Academy Challenge, which can be completed up to 10 times.
qs.t: No certificate, sirf emails; har level 1 baar, Challenge 10 baar.

qs.q: Explain the main roles in a the platform testing team: Client, Tester, TTL, TE, TSM, SDM, CM and CE.
qs.s: Client or Customer: company jisne the company aur the platform Community ko apna product test karne ke liye engage kiya. Tester: the platform community member jo test cycles me bugs dhoondh ke, feedback de ke ya test cases perform karke participate karta hai. TTL (Test Team Lead): testers ka primary point of contact; test cycles me testers ki help karta hai aur saare submitted bug reports aur test cases review karta hai. TE (Test Engineer): test cycle build karta hai, testing team assemble karta hai, test cycle ke overall execution ka responsible; test team ko cycle completion tak le jata hai taaki request ke goals achieve hon. TSM (Testing Services Manager): Test Architect (TA) title ko TSM se replace kiya gaya; client ke saath directly kaam karta hai, TTLs aur TEs ki team manage karta hai taaki client ki testing, feedback ya research needs ke solutions mile. SDM (Solution Delivery Manager): customer ka primary point of contact, customer ke saath directly kaam karta hai. CM (Community Manager): Community Management Team ke members; goal: global community ko excellent tester banna sikhana, paid projects ke opportunities dilana, aur testers ko connect karna. CE (Community Engineers): CM team ke saath closely kaam karte hain aur unke tasks me help karte hain.
qs.b: The client is the company that engages the company and the platform to test its product, and testers are community members who find bugs, give feedback or run test cases. The TTL is the testers' primary point of contact and reviews all submitted bugs and test cases, while the TE builds the cycle, assembles the team and owns overall execution. The TSM, which replaced the Test Architect title, works directly with the client and manages TTLs and TEs; the SDM is the customer's primary contact. Community Managers help testers learn, find paid work and connect, supported by Community Engineers.
qs.t: TTL = tester ka dost (review), TE = cycle ka builder, TSM = client + TTL/TE ka boss, SDM = customer ka contact.

qs.q: What are the specialist roles DT, ACE, ACA and TCW at the platform?
qs.s: DT (Dedicated Testers): team ko speed, specialized expertise aur quality control dete hain. Ye normal community testers se alag role hai; inka singular focus hota hai aur deep dive karte hain. Community peers inhe experts maanein aur ye TTL ko chat management me expert ki tarah support karein. Jin testers ki quality work ki strong history hoti hai unhe TSM/TE DT banne ke liye approach kar sakte hain. ACE (Accessibility Expert): ek saath kai audits lead karta hai, team ke dusre members ko mentor karta hai aur final audit results clients ko present karta hai. ACA (Accessibility Auditor): audits me accessibility bugs report karke aur test cases complete karke participate karta hai; testing aur bug reports likhne me abhi bhi team se kuch direction aur assistance chahiye ho sakti hai. TCW (Test Case Writer): test cases likhne ka responsible; har test case me detailed, clear, easy to follow steps aur expected results ho; customer ke documentation aur test cases valid aur usable hain ye verify karna aur zaroori adjustments karna.
qs.b: Dedicated Testers bring speed, specialised expertise and quality control, focus deeply on one area and support the TTL in chat; testers with a strong quality history may be approached by a TSM or TE for the role. An Accessibility Expert leads multiple audits, mentors others and presents results to clients, while an Accessibility Auditor reports accessibility bugs and completes test cases with some guidance. A Test Case Writer writes clear test cases with steps and expected results and validates the customer's documentation.
qs.t: DT = deep expert, ACE leads, ACA audits, TCW writes cases.

qs.q: Define test cycle, test case, slot, exploratory slot and issue/bug report in the platform terms.
qs.s: Project or Test Cycle: company ke product ka ek specific test. Har test cycle me numerous testers hote hain, aur cycle setting, type, etc. ke hisaab se cycles kaafi alag ho sakte hain. Test cycle me testers ko cycle overview ke instructions carefully follow karne hote hain: in scope product pe bugs dhoondhna, test cases execute karna, reviews submit karna, ya usability studies (agar available ho). Test Case: predefined steps ka set jo tester ko follow aur execute karna hai taaki product ke specific features aur functionalities test hon, jaise ek particular program path exercise karna ya kisi specific requirement ka compliance verify karna. Slot: test cycle me ek reserved position, specific requirements (location, device, OS, etc.) wale tester ke liye. Slot test cases se linked ho bhi sakta hai aur nahi bhi; agar test case se linked nahi hai to use Exploratory slot kehte hain, jisme tester freely product test karke in scope areas ke bugs report kar sakta hai. Issue/Bug report: product ke features ya functionality me specific error ya defect (bug) ka written summary; isme bug samajhne, reproduce karne aur fix karne ki saari required information honi chahiye.
qs.b: A test cycle is one specific test of a company's product with many testers, who must follow the cycle overview to find in-scope bugs, execute test cases, submit reviews or run usability studies. A test case is a set of predefined steps to test a specific feature or requirement. A slot is a reserved position in a cycle for a tester with specific requirements such as location, device or OS; a slot not linked to test cases is an exploratory slot. A bug report is a written summary of a defect with all the information needed to understand, reproduce and fix it.
qs.t: Slot = kursi reserved; test case nahi to Exploratory slot.

qs.q: List the platform testing types Fn, Ln, Ux, Security, Automation, PT/PI and AC.
qs.s: Fn - Functional: product ke features/functionality test karna issues locate karne ke intent se. Ln - Localization: product ki quality ek particular target culture/locale ke terms me verify karna. Ux - Usability: real users ke saath test karke measure karna ki product kitna easy to use aur user-friendly hai. Security Testing: product ke security mechanisms me flaws reveal karne ka process. Automation Testing: automation testing tool se repetitive testing steps execute karna jo manually karna mushkil ho. PT / PI - Payment Testing / Payment Instruments: core me, koi bhi test jise complete karne ke liye payment instrument use karna pade. AC - Accessibility: ensure karta hai ki product disabilities wale logon (hearing, color blindness, old age, aur dusre disadvantaged groups) ke liye usable ho.
qs.b: Functional testing checks features and functionality for issues, localization verifies quality for a target culture or locale, and usability measures how easy and user-friendly a product is with real users. Security testing reveals flaws in security mechanisms, automation testing uses tools to run repetitive steps, and payment testing is any test that needs a payment instrument to complete. Accessibility testing ensures the product is usable by people with disabilities such as hearing loss, color blindness or old age.
qs.t: Fn kaam karta?, Ln locale, Ux aasaan?, PT paisa lagta, AC sabke liye.

qs.q: Explain API testing, voice testing, bug hunt, on-site testing, live testing and exploratory testing as defined by the platform.
qs.s: API Testing: Application Programming Interfaces validate karna; purpose: programming interfaces ki functionality, reliability, performance aur security check karna. Voice testing: voice-enabled products ko native speakers ke saath test karna; isme functional testing, dialogue verification, usability testing aur payment testing combine hote hain taaki companies achhe voice experiences de sakein. Bug Hunt Testing: robust exploratory test; goal sirf ek specific bug, ya specific device pe specific bug, ya specific type ka bug dhoondhna jo testing scope me ho. Invited testers ko overview aur requirements carefully padhne chahiye aur out of scope issues report nahi karne chahiye. On-site testing: physical location visit karke service ki quality evaluate karna aur feedback collect karna. Live Testing: specific time pe testing; testers ko usi time test karna hai, late ya pehle test nahi kar sakte. ET - Exploratory Testing: learning, test design aur test execution ek saath (simultaneous). Tester tests design aur execute ek saath karta hai; next action pichhle actions, product behavior ke observations aur apne thought process se influence hota hai. Key aspect technique ya product nahi, balki individual testers ki skills aur experience hai.
qs.b: API testing validates interfaces for functionality, reliability, performance and security, and voice testing checks voice-enabled products with native speakers by combining functional, dialogue, usability and payment testing. A bug hunt is a focused exploratory test aimed at a specific bug or bug type within scope, on-site testing means visiting a physical location to evaluate a service, and live testing must happen at an exact scheduled time. Exploratory testing is simultaneous learning, test design and execution, where each next test is shaped by what you observed, so the tester's skill matters most.
qs.t: ET = seekho + design + execute ek saath; Live = time pe hi; Bug Hunt = sirf target bug.

qs.q: What do SRS, KI, BFV and NDA mean at the platform?
qs.s: SRS - Special Requirement Survey: tool jo Testing Services aur Community Management widely use karte hain un test cycles ke liye testers recruit karne ke liye jahan aise data points chahiye jo platform abhi capture nahi karta. KI - Known Issue: wo issues jo pichhle Test Cycles me mil chuke hain ya jinke baare me customer already jaanta hai. Duplicate submissions rokne me helpful; rejections se bachne ke liye testing start karne se pehle hamesha check karo. Known issues cycle me spreadsheet jaisi form me add ho sakte hain, ya issues page ke title column me issue ke paas blue 'bookmark' tag se pehchaan sakte ho. BFV - Bug Fix Verification: jab product ka fix ya new build release ho to verify karna ki reported bug fix hua ya nahi. The company customers ko new build available hone pe re-test run karne deta hai. NDA - Non Disclosure Agreement: Tester aur the company App Quality ke beech binding contract; sign karke tester agreement me covered koi information disclose na karne ke liye agree karta hai; confidential aur proprietary information protect karne ke liye.
qs.b: An SRS, or Special Requirement Survey, is used to recruit testers when a cycle needs data points the platform does not capture. Known Issues are bugs already found in earlier cycles or already known to the customer; they appear in a spreadsheet in the cycle or with a blue bookmark tag, and testers should check them first to avoid duplicates. BFV, Bug Fix Verification, confirms a reported bug is fixed in a new build, and the NDA is a binding contract with the company App Quality not to disclose confidential information.
qs.t: KI = blue bookmark, pehle check karo warna DUP.

qs.q: What do IR, environment, triage, placeholder, reproduction, turnaround time and PB mean?
qs.s: IR - Info Request: bug report ya test case pe aur information maangi gayi hai, ya tester ko report/test case fix karna hai. Environment: device, OS, OS version, browser, ya koi specific setup jo testing ke liye use hua. Triage/Triaging: bug report ya test case review karke info request bhejna, ya approval ya rejection ke liye recommend karna. Placeholder: incomplete information ya required attachments ke bina submit kiya gaya bug report, sirf position reserve karne ke liye taaki baad me edit/complete kar sako ya kisi dusre bug me change kar sako. (the platform Basics ke Terms of Use me placeholder bug reports banana mana hai.) Reproduction: bug report ke action performed steps follow karke bug ko recreate karna. Turnaround Time: time limit jisme testing work submit karna hai; example: 6 hours turnaround wala slot ya test case claim karne ke 6 hours ke andar submit karna hai. PB: Projects Board.
qs.b: An Info Request means more information or a fix is needed on a bug report or test case, and the environment is the device, OS, version, browser or setup used. Triage is reviewing a report and either sending an info request or recommending approval or rejection, while reproduction is recreating a bug by following its steps. A placeholder is an incomplete report submitted only to reserve a position, which the Terms of Use forbid. Turnaround time is the deadline to submit work after claiming, for example within 6 hours, and PB stands for Projects Board.
qs.t: IR = aur info do; TAT 6h = claim ke 6 ghante me submit; placeholder = mana hai.

qs.q: What are the bug rejection types at the platform?
qs.s: 6 rejection types: 1) WAD - Working As Designed: reported issue design ke hisaab se hi kaam kar raha hai, behavior bilkul waisa hi hai jaisa product design kiya gaya. 2) DUP - Duplicate issue: bug pehle hi kisi dusre tester ne report kiya hai, ya cycle me add kiya hua Known Issue hai. 3) OOS - Out Of Scope: reported bug testing product ke scope me nahi hai; jaise sirf website ke kuch areas test ho rahe hain aur bug kisi non-scope area me mila; same agar issue kisi aise product me mila jo test nahi ho raha (jaise external website). 4) DNFI - Did Not Follow Instructions: tester ne clear instructions ignore kiye jisse outcome affect hua ya report unusable ho gayi. 5) INF - Need more info: info request bhejne pe tester ne requested information nahi di. 6) Other: saare rejection reasons upar wale se cover hone chahiye; agar customer ka reason alag hai to Other use kar sakta hai.
qs.b: The platform uses six rejection types. Working As Designed means the behavior is exactly how the product is meant to work, Duplicate means another tester already reported it or it is a Known Issue, and Out of Scope means the bug is in an area or product not being tested, such as an external website. Did Not Follow Instructions applies when ignoring clear instructions made the report unusable, Need More Info applies when the tester did not answer an info request, and Other is used when the customer has a different reason.
qs.t: WAD DUP OOS DNFI INF Other = 'Wo Dup Oos Dekh, Info nahi, Other'.

qs.q: What are the bug approval types or bug values at the platform?
qs.s: Bug Approval Types (4): 1) Somewhat Valuable: bug ka product pe kuch impact hai aur customer ke liye kuch value hai. 2) Very Valuable: bug ka significant impact hai aur customer ke liye bahut valuable. 3) Exceptionally Valuable: bug ka critical impact hai aur fix hona hi chahiye; customer ke liye exceptional value. 4) WNF - Won't Fix: bug valid aur approved hai lekin customer ko usme interest nahi ya fix karne ka plan nahi.
qs.b: Approved bugs are rated Somewhat Valuable when they have some impact and value, Very Valuable when the impact is significant, and Exceptionally Valuable when the impact is critical and the bug must be fixed. There is also Won't Fix, where the bug is valid and approved but the customer does not plan to fix it.
qs.t: Somewhat, Very, Exceptionally + WNF (valid par fix nahi).

qs.q: What are the tester rating abbreviations and profile badges on the platform?
qs.s: Tester Ratings: G = Gold, S = Silver, B = Bronze, P = Proven, R = Rated, U = Unrated. Badges: U (profile pic ke top right me blue orb) = the platform Employee; M (profile pic ke top right me orange 'M' orb) = Moderator; TTL = the platform cycles ka Test Team Lead.
qs.b: Tester ratings are abbreviated G for Gold, S for Silver, B for Bronze, P for Proven, R for Rated and U for Unrated. On profiles, a blue U orb marks a the platform employee, an orange M orb marks a moderator, and a TTL badge marks a Test Team Lead.
qs.t: GSBPRU upar se neeche; blue U = employee, orange M = moderator.

qs.q: Define SDLC and expand the common testing acronyms from the platform glossary.
qs.s: SDLC - Software Development Lifecycle: software organization me software project ke liye follow kiya jane wala process; detailed plan jo batata hai specific software kaise develop, maintain, replace, alter ya enhance karna hai; lifecycle software ki quality aur overall development process improve karne ki methodology define karta hai. Baaki acronyms: STLC = Software Testing Life Cycle; QA = Quality Assurance; SUT = System Under Test; SPA = Single Page Application; BAT = Business Analysis Testing; API = Application Programming Interface; TF = TestFlight; BTS = Bug Tracking System; UAT = User Acceptance Testing (aka Beta Testing ya End User Testing); RAD (model) = Rapid Application Development; ISTQB = International Software Testing Qualifications Board; SDET = Software Development Engineer in Test; BBST = Black Box Software Testing; UX bug = Usability Bug; UI bug = User Interface Bug; AUT = Application Under Test; SIT = System Integration Testing; CMS = Content Management System.
qs.b: SDLC, the Software Development Lifecycle, is the process an organisation follows with a detailed plan for developing, maintaining, replacing and enhancing software, and it defines a methodology for improving quality. Related acronyms include STLC for Software Testing Life Cycle, SUT and AUT for System and Application Under Test, UAT for User Acceptance Testing, also called beta or end-user testing, SIT for System Integration Testing, BTS for Bug Tracking System and SDET for Software Development Engineer in Test.
qs.t: SUT/AUT = jo test ho raha; UAT = beta / end user.

qs.q: Expand the networking and IT acronyms in the platform glossary.
qs.s: Networks and Protocols: FTP = File Transfer Protocol; HTML = Hyper Text Markup Language; HTTPS = Secure Hypertext Transfer Protocol; VPN = Virtual private network; E2E = End to End; IP = Internet Protocol. IT, Developer and Programming: OS = Operating System; URL = Uniform Resource Locator; WWW = World Wide Web; IE = Internet Explorer; XML = Extensible Markup Language; AWS = Amazon Web Services; VM = Virtual Machine; SEO = Search Engine Optimization; SDK = Software Development Kit; I/O = Input & Output; IDE = Integrated Development Environment.
qs.b: In networking, FTP is File Transfer Protocol, HTTPS is Secure Hypertext Transfer Protocol, VPN is Virtual Private Network, E2E is End to End and IP is Internet Protocol. In IT and development, common terms are OS, URL, XML, AWS, VM for Virtual Machine, SEO, SDK for Software Development Kit, I/O for Input and Output, and IDE for Integrated Development Environment.
qs.t: Network: FTP HTML HTTPS VPN E2E IP; Dev: OS URL WWW IE XML AWS VM SEO SDK I/O IDE.

qs.q: Expand the miscellaneous acronyms in the platform glossary such as PLP, PDP, STB, CTV and SSO.
qs.s: Miscellaneous: SMB = Small Medium Business; GUI = Graphical User Interface; ROI = Return on Investment; AI = Artificial Intelligence; POS = Point Of Sale; CTA = Call To Action; PLP = Product listing page; PDP = Product detail page; STB = Set-top box; PIP = Picture In Picture; CC = Closed Captions; VOD = Video On Demand; CTV = Connected TV; OTP = One Time Password; MFA = Multi-Factor Authentication; 2FA = Two-Factor Authentication; SSO = Single Sign ON; CVV / CVC / CSC / CVN = Card Verification Value / Card Verification Code / Card Security Code / Card Verification Number; PM = Private Message; FAQ = Frequently Asked Question; DMCA = Digital Millennium Copyright Act.
qs.b: In e-commerce, PLP is the product listing page, PDP is the product detail page, CTA is call to action and POS is point of sale. In streaming, STB is set-top box, PIP is picture in picture, CC is closed captions, VOD is video on demand and CTV is connected TV. For security, OTP, MFA, 2FA and SSO cover one-time passwords, multi-factor and two-factor authentication and single sign-on, and CVV, CVC, CSC and CVN are the card verification codes.
qs.t: PLP list, PDP detail; STB/PIP/CC/VOD/CTV = TV wale.

topics.intro: platform kya hai, parent company, crowdtesting, Academy aur saari important terminology (roles, rejection/approval types, ratings).

topics.name: Platform Navigation

qs.q: What can you search for using the platform top navigation bar?
qs.s: Navigation bar ke top left me Search field hai jahan testers the platform website pe specific information dhoondh sakte hain, jaise Users, Articles, Forums, Projects, Courses. Ye course naye testers ko the platform Navigation bar ke basics sikhata hai.
qs.b: The Search field at the top left of the navigation bar lets testers look up specific information on the platform, such as users, articles, forums, projects and courses.
qs.t: Search me 5: Users, Articles, Forums, Projects, Courses.

qs.q: How does the platform Test Cycle Chat work and what rooms does it have?
qs.s: Test Cycle Chat testers ka main communication method hai the platform project se related questions puchne aur answers lene ke liye. Access: top navigation ke right side chat icon pe click karo, ya the platform chat site kholo. Chat new window me khulta hai. Options: 1) Active, Locked and Pending Test Cycles Chats - yahan test cycle chats ke beech navigate karte ho; unread messages ka number green icon me dikhta hai. 2) Test Cycle Rooms - har cycle chat me multiple rooms: Announcements (TTLs aur TEs important announcements post karte hain; hamesha padho aur is room me message mat likho), Questions (testers cycle ke questions puchte hain; dusre cycles ke questions mat pucho, sahi room use karo, the platform Terms of Use aur guidelines follow karo), Other rooms (TTLs aur TEs kisi bhi purpose ke liye extra rooms bana sakte hain, room ke naam me ya unke dwara explain kiya jata hai). 3) Text Field - room ke neeche; Send button ya Enter/Return se message bhejo, Shift + Enter/Return se new line. 4) Test Cycle Participants List - right side In Room section me testers, TTLs aur TEs dikhte hain. 5) Projects Chat - jin project chat channels me invite ho; Testing Services third-party tools ya test cycles ke bina testers se baat kar sakein; invite nahi ho to ye section nahi dikhta. 6) Footer - Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, AI Guidelines, Cookie Settings ke links aur Sign Out option.
qs.b: The Test Cycle Chat is the main way testers ask questions about a project; it opens from the chat icon in the top navigation or at the platform chat site. It lists active, locked and pending cycle chats with unread counts in a green icon, and each cycle has an Announcements room that testers read but never post in, a Questions room for that cycle only, and any extra rooms the TTL or TE creates. Enter sends a message and Shift plus Enter adds a new line, the In Room list shows participants, and a Projects Chat section appears only if you are invited to a project channel.
qs.t: Announcements = sirf padho; Questions = isi cycle ka sawal; Shift+Enter = new line.

qs.q: What appears in the platform Notifications and how do you open them?
qs.s: Notifications page top navigation bar ke right side bell icon pe click karke khulta hai, chat icon ke bilkul paas. Notifications window me dikhta hai: saari test cycle invitations, issue reports aur test cases ke info requests, issue reports aur test cases ke discussion tab me bheje gaye messages, statuses, survey invitations, aur community ke chats.
qs.b: Notifications open from the bell icon next to the chat icon in the top navigation. They show test cycle invitations, info requests on issue reports and test cases, messages in their discussion tabs, statuses, survey invitations and community chats.
qs.t: Bell = invites, IR, discussion messages, status, surveys, chats.

qs.q: What options are in the platform Account window?
qs.s: Profile photo pe click karne se pop-up khulta hai jisme top pe full name aur tester ID hota hai; copy button se tester ID copy kar sakte ho. Options: 1) Account Settings - name, email address, username, avatar, about me aur social media links change karo. 2) Access & Security - account password update karo aur MFA configure ya reset karo. 3) Advanced Settings - SRS, test cycles, chat digest, etc. ke email preferences; issue report ya survey response update karne ke baad automatically next pe move hone ka option; issue report form pe environment preselect karna; Cookies Settings change karna; the platform Terms of Use, Privacy Policy aur AI Guidelines padhna; yahan se account close bhi kar sakte ho. 4) Knowledge Base - Tester Support page kholta hai; knowledge base browse karo, articles aur FAQs search karo; missing device ya environment add karne ki request, platform issue ya log in help ke liye support request. Support ticket submit karte waqt sahi request category select karo aur kaafi information do. 5) Support - AI powered the platform Tester Support agent kholta hai; window band karke bottom right ke question mark button se reopen kar sakte ho; details the platform AI Agent course me. 6) Sign out - account se log out.
qs.b: Clicking the profile photo shows your full name and a copyable tester ID. Account Settings edits name, email, username, avatar and links; Access and Security changes the password and configures or resets MFA; Advanced Settings covers email preferences, auto-advance after updating a report, preselecting the environment on the issue form, cookies, policies and closing the account. Knowledge Base opens Tester Support for articles and tickets, such as adding a missing device, Support opens the AI support agent, and Sign Out logs you out.
qs.t: Account = Settings, Security(MFA), Advanced, Knowledge Base, Support(AI), Sign out.

qs.q: What is the platform Help page used for?
qs.s: Help page top navigation bar ke right side question mark icon pe click karke milta hai, Notifications icon ke bilkul paas. Is page pe knowledge base browse kar sakte ho, articles aur frequently asked questions ke answers search kar sakte ho. Testers question puch sakte hain, tester support se contact karke help le sakte hain, ya support se missing device ya environment add karwa sakte hain.
qs.b: The Help page opens from the question mark icon next to Notifications. It lets testers browse the knowledge base and FAQs, ask questions, contact tester support, and request that a missing device or environment be added.
qs.t: Question mark = Help + missing device request.

qs.q: What sections are in the platform Tester Profile?
qs.s: Profile menu ek dropdown hai jisme naam, tester id, functional testing badge aur ye sections hain. Tester Profile sections: 1) Personal - profile image, first aur last name, birth date, email, gender, mobile number, location; sirf accurate information do. 2) Language & Voice - max 5 languages, har ek ki Proficiency; kuch languages ke liye Accent/Dialect; max 2 languages Native. 3) Devices - testing ke liye ready saare devices add karo; device tumhara apna ho, kisi se temporary borrow kiya hua nahi, taaki info request aaye to turant de sako; list regularly update karo; invitation tabhi milega jab project requirements match hon. 4) Payment Testing - payment instruments (credit/debit cards, e-wallets, etc.) batao; confirm karo ki purchases karne aur passive payment testing me participate karne ko willing ho. 5) Subscriptions - services ya programs jinke subscribed ho; kuch projects me ye chahiye; profile up to date rakho. 6) Interests - hobbies aur fitness & sports; gambling ya casino games related testing ke liye willing ho ya nahi confirm karo. 7) Statistics - the platform ke general statistics, tumhari tester rating aur activity, rating history aur test cycle history.
qs.b: The Tester Profile has seven sections: Personal for accurate personal details, Language and Voice for up to five languages with proficiency and accent, and Devices for every device you own and can test on. Payment Testing lists payment instruments and willingness to make purchases, Subscriptions lists services you subscribe to, Interests covers hobbies, sports and willingness to test gambling, and Statistics shows your rating, rating history and cycle history. Keeping it accurate and current matters because invitations are only sent when you match project requirements.
qs.t: Personal, Language, Devices, Payment, Subscriptions, Interests, Statistics = 7.

qs.q: What are the language proficiency levels in the platform profile and what are the limits?
qs.s: Language & Voice me max 5 languages select kar sakte ho, har ek ki Proficiency specify karo; kai languages ke liye Accent/Dialect bhi configure kar sakte ho. Max 2 languages Native label ho sakti hain. Proficiency options: 1) Native Speaker - bachpan se ye language bolte aa rahe ho, slang samet sab samajhte ho; max 2. 2) Fluent - high knowledge, business setting me professional speaking, reading, writing. 3) Proficient - general writing aur grammar knowledge, par bolne aur likhne me kuch difficulty. 4) Basic - phrases aur vocabulary ka basic knowledge, dictionaries aur dusre resources pe depend.
qs.b: Testers can list up to five languages with a proficiency level for each, and at most two can be marked Native. The levels are Native Speaker, meaning you grew up with it and understand slang; Fluent, meaning professional speaking, reading and writing; Proficient, meaning general grammar knowledge with some difficulty; and Basic, meaning you rely on dictionaries.
qs.t: 5 languages max, 2 Native max; Native > Fluent > Proficient > Basic.

qs.q: What does the platform Community Profile contain?
qs.s: Community Profile me tum apni community member wali profile dekhte ho. Sections: top pe avatar, banner, username configure, profile data edit, community side ke stats, aur referral link. About me - top pe tester badges (ye community se related nahi, tester work pe depend), join date, last login attempt, last comment, activity stats, aur community member badges. Articles - tumhare likhe articles ki list. Status Updates - register hone se ab tak ke statuses ki history. Comments - comments ki history. Mentions - comments, statuses, forum posts ya articles jahan tumhe mention kiya gaya. Topics - community forum me start kiye topics ki history. Likes - community pe like kiye saare posts.
qs.b: The Community Profile shows your avatar, banner, username, community stats and referral link at the top. Its tabs are About Me with tester badges, join date, last login and community badges, then Articles, Status Updates, Comments, Mentions, Topics you started in the forum, and Likes.
qs.t: About me, Articles, Status, Comments, Mentions, Topics, Likes.

qs.q: What can you see and set up on the platform Payments page in the profile menu?
qs.s: Payments page me saare payment statistics: lifetime earnings, pending payout, payment summary, payment history. Yahan payment method set up karte ho, payout display personalize karte ho, aur dashboard pe payment widget show/hide select karte ho. Payment receive karne ke liye Payment Method text ke paas Setup button pe click karke method set karo. Is lesson ke hisaab se the platform abhi sirf do options deta hai: PayPal ya Payoneer. (Note: the platform Basics ka Payments lesson teesra option Direct To Bank Transfer (powered by Wise) bhi batata hai.) Page ke bottom pe payout ka display local currency me change kar sakte ho aur payments widget hide/show. Note: PayPal aur Payoneer har country me supported nahi ho sakte.
qs.b: The Payments page shows lifetime earnings, pending payout, payment summary and history. You set up the payment method with the Setup button next to Payment Method; this lesson lists PayPal and Payoneer, while the platform Basics course also lists Direct to Bank Transfer powered by Wise. You can also show payouts in local currency and show or hide the payments widget on the dashboard.
qs.t: Payments = lifetime, pending, summary, history + Setup button.

qs.q: What can you configure on the Advanced Settings page from the profile menu?
qs.s: Advanced Settings page pe configure kar sakte ho: 1) Items kaise navigate hote hain 2) Attachments kaise display hote hain 3) Issue report form pe environment preselect karna 4) SRS, test cycle status, chat digest, etc. ke email preferences 5) Yahan se account close bhi kar sakte ho. Sign Out button se account se sign out karte ho.
qs.b: Advanced Settings controls how items are navigated, how attachments are displayed, preselecting the environment on the issue report form, and email preferences for SRS, cycle status and chat digest. It is also where you can close your account.
qs.t: Navigate, attachments, env preselect, email prefs, close account.

qs.q: What are the four tabs in the My Activity section of the platform Home page?
qs.s: Home login ke baad pehla page hai; Active ya Pending Test Cycles, Invitations, SRS aur community activity (tumhari ya jinhe follow karte ho) ke notifications. My Activity ke 4 tabs: 1) All - static historical feed, 10 most recent notifications (Projects, Invitations, Community); 'View More Activity' se saari notifications. 2) Projects - dynamic filtered view, tumhare 5 Active aur Pending Test Cycles jo sabse jaldi lock hone wale hain; 'View All Projects' se Projects page. 3) Invitations - dynamic filtered view, 5 Invitations aur SRS requests jo sabse jaldi lock hone wale hain; 'View All Invitations' se Projects page; invitations nahi to Projects Board browse karo. 4) Community - static historical feed, 10 most recent Community notifications; 'View All Activity' se saari community notifications.
qs.b: My Activity has four tabs. All shows your 10 most recent notifications, Projects shows the 5 active or pending cycles locking soonest, Invitations shows the 5 invitations or SRS requests locking soonest, and Community shows your 10 most recent community notifications. All and Community are static historical feeds, while Projects and Invitations are dynamic filtered views.
qs.t: All 10, Projects 5, Invitations 5, Community 10.

qs.q: What are the New Joiner Checklist, Profile Completion card and My Devices card on the Home page?
qs.s: New Joiner Checklist: Home page pe dikhta hai, naye members ko the platform ke important areas se start karne me guide karta hai. 30 days ke baad hata diya jata hai; agar user pehle complete kar le to tabhi hat jata hai. Profile Completion card: profile completion percentage dikhata hai. Agar koi device, service ya subscription nahi hai to 'I don't have any' checkboxes use karo, isse profile complete hoti hai. 'Complete my profile' se aur details do. Ye card har mahine pehli baar login pe dikhta hai. My Devices card: tumhare devices aur subscriptions list karta hai; device list accurate hogi to Projects se match hone me help; '+ Add Devices' button se naye devices add karo.
qs.b: The New Joiner Checklist guides new members through key areas and disappears after 30 days or once completed. The Profile Completion card shows your completion percentage, appears on your first login each month, and offers 'I don't have any' checkboxes for items you do not own. The My Devices card lists your devices and subscriptions and has an Add Devices button, since an accurate list helps match you to projects.
qs.t: Checklist 30 din; Completion card har mahine pehla login.

qs.q: How is the Academy course catalog and course page organised?
qs.s: Academy page community members ko platform, testing aur skills improve karne ke courses deta hai. Course Catalog (Academy homepage): courses structured Learning Tracks me; har track me multiple courses, har course me lessons, aur track ka brief overview; visual progress bar poore track ka completion dikhata hai. Start Course button se course khulta hai; lesson shuru kar diya to button Resume Course ban jata hai; course complete hone pe Review Course. Har course ka status top-right corner me; finish hone pe green Completed tag. Same track ke courses ke beech Learning Track section ke bottom-left arrows. Filtering/sorting options top pe: Availability, Progress, Recent Content, Sort by. Aur tracks ke liye bottom pe pagination. Course Page: right side me total lessons, estimated completion time, difficulty level; lesson list se navigate; incomplete lessons pe lesson number, completed pe green checkmark. Quiz tab tak locked jab tak saare lessons complete na hon; phir Take the Quiz button available.
qs.b: The Academy catalog groups courses into Learning Tracks with a progress bar, and each course's button changes from Start Course to Resume Course to Review Course, with a green Completed tag when done. You can filter by Availability, Progress, Recent Content and Sort by, and page through tracks. The course page shows lesson count, estimated time, difficulty and a lesson list with green checkmarks, and the quiz stays locked until every lesson is complete.
qs.t: Start, Resume, Review; quiz locked jab tak saare lessons na hon.

qs.q: How do you enrol in an Academy practice test cycle and when are testers invited?
qs.s: Academy Certification Program me courses hain jo practice cycles ke liye prepare karte hain. Saare lessons complete aur quiz pass karne ke baad Sign Up button aata hai; click karne se corresponding practice test cycle me automatically enroll ho jaate ho. Practice Test Cycle section dynamically update hota hai: kab sign up kiya, cycle pass ya fail. Upcoming release me Certification Program ek dedicated page pe move hoga. Invitation timing: Monday - Wednesday: is hafte ke cycle me automatically invite; Thursday - Sunday: pending cycles me add, jo agle hafte Monday ko activate honge. Quiz pass karne pe course pass maana jata hai; lekin agar course me practice test cycle hai to wo cycle bhi pass karni hogi. Har practice cycle pass karne pe congratulatory email; Challenge Testing practice cycle pass karne pe graduation email. Academy practice cycle pass karne se approved issue reports aur test cases pe tester rating badha sakte ho; rating badhegi to paid cycles ke invitations zyada milne ke chances.
qs.b: After finishing all lessons and passing the quiz, a Sign Up button enrols you automatically in the matching practice cycle. Sign-ups from Monday to Wednesday join the current week's cycle, while sign-ups from Thursday to Sunday go into a pending cycle that activates the next Monday. A course with a practice cycle is only passed once that cycle is passed too; each pass brings a congratulatory email, passing the Challenge brings a graduation email, and approved work there can raise your rating.
qs.t: Mon-Wed = isi hafte; Thu-Sun = agle Monday.

qs.q: What are the Academy grading rules for practice test cycles?
qs.s: Rules: 1) Agar pichhla Academy practice cycle pass nahi kiya to agle ke liye sign up nahi kar sakte; example: Introduction to Testing pass aur complete nahi kiya to Computers Testing ke liye sign up nahi. 2) Grades do tarike se assign hote hain: (a) Active aur locked academy cycles ke dauraan, tester ko Pass grade tabhi milta hai jab cycle me uska approved issue AUR approved test case dono hon. Ye pass grade issue aur test case approve hone ke 12 se 24 hours me assign hota hai; uske baad next practice cycle ke liye sign up kar sakte ho, cycle close hone ka wait kiye bina. (b) Cycle close hone ke baad baaki testers ko Pass ya Fail grades assign hote hain. 3) Pass hue to next Academy level ke liye sign up. 4) Fail hue to same level ke liye dobara sign up. Cycle overview me har practice cycle pass karne ki requirements likhi hoti hain; instructions carefully follow karo. Customer Operations team ko dikhta hai ki Academy kisne finish ki, isliye saare practice cycles complete karo.
qs.b: You cannot sign up for the next practice cycle until you pass the previous one, for example Introduction to Testing before Computers Testing. During an active or locked cycle, you get a Pass once you have both an approved issue and an approved test case, assigned within 12 to 24 hours, so you can move on without waiting for closure; everyone else is graded Pass or Fail after the cycle closes. Passing lets you move to the next level, failing lets you retry the same level, and the Customer Operations team can see who finished the Academy.
qs.t: Pass = approved issue + approved test case; 12-24 ghante.

qs.q: What are the test cycle tabs on the platform Projects page?
qs.s: Projects page tumhare saare Test Cycles, Test Cases aur Bug activity ki central location hai, jahan kaam karke earn karte ho. Projects dropdown pe click karke khulta hai. Top right corner me pending payment info: amount aur date jab wallet me transfer hoga (agar payment method set hai). Beech me Test Cycles section ke tabs: 1) Invited - jin cycles me invite hue par accept nahi kiya. 2) Pending - abhi active nahi, baad me start hone ke liye scheduled; Pending Activation status me saari information padh sakte ho par Issues/Test Cases submit nahi kar sakte. 3) Active - accept kiye cycles jisme abhi participate kar sakte ho. 4) Locked - locked cycles jisme bugs report ya test cases submit nahi kar sakte, par apne bug reports, test cases edit kar sakte ho aur chats me baat kar sakte ho. Left side cycles list ke neeche recently open paid projects jinke liye apply kar sakte ho; View All Projects button se saare. Right side invited test cycles aur surveys (invited cycles Invited tab me bhi). Unsubmitted test cases, info requests ya test cases/issue reports pe new messages bhi yahan reminder ki tarah dikhte hain jab tak action na lo. Bottom-right me devices up to date rakhne ka reminder.
qs.b: The Projects page is the central place for your cycles, test cases and bugs, with pending payment amount and transfer date at the top right. Its cycle tabs are Invited for invitations not yet accepted, Pending for scheduled cycles where you can read everything but cannot submit, Active for cycles you can work in, and Locked where you cannot submit new bugs or test cases but can still edit your submissions and chat. It also shows open paid projects, invitations and surveys, and reminders for unsubmitted test cases, info requests and new messages.
qs.t: Invited, Pending (padho, submit nahi), Active, Locked (edit + chat only).

qs.q: What can you do on the Test Cycles, Issues and Test Cases pages?
qs.s: Test Cycles page: saare cycles jinme participate kiya aur jinme invite hue (jab tak wo active ya locked status me hain). Status se filter, cycle name ya ID se search, table headers (e.g. ID, Test Cycle, Planned Start) se ascending/descending sort; click karke detail dekho. Issues page: jin cycles me participate kiya unke saare reported issues. Status se filter, title ya ID se search, headers (e.g. ID, Value) se sort. Checkboxes: sirf titles me search, closed cycles ke issues include, sirf apne reported issues, aur resolved ya fixed issues include. Issue link pe click karke detail. Test Cases page: tumhare claim kiye saare test cases; status se filter, test case name ya ID se search, headers se sort; link pe click karke test case page.
qs.b: The Test Cycles page lists cycles you joined or were invited to while they are active or locked, with filters by status, search by name or ID, and sortable columns such as Planned Start. The Issues page lists issues from your cycles and can filter by status, search titles only, include closed cycles, show only your own issues, and include resolved or fixed ones. The Test Cases page lists every test case you claimed, with the same filter, search and sort options.
qs.t: Issues page checkboxes: titles only, closed cycles, mine only, resolved/fixed.

qs.q: What is the platform Projects Board?
qs.s: Projects Board page the platform ke paid project opportunities ka sirf chhota sa hissa dikhata hai. Default me wo projects dikhte hain jo tumhari tester profile ke hisaab se sabse appropriate hain. Dusre tabs se urgent projects filter kar sakte ho ya saare projects dikha sakte ho. Country aur Operating Systems se bhi filter. Recommendation: Tester Profile complete aur up-to-date rakho taaki paid projects se match hone ke chances badhein.
qs.b: The Projects Board shows a small fraction of the platform's paid project opportunities, defaulting to those best suited to your tester profile. Other tabs show urgent projects or all projects, and you can filter by country and operating system. Keeping your profile complete and current increases your chances of being matched.
qs.t: Projects Board = default 'mere liye', phir Urgent / All, filter Country + OS.

qs.q: What are the parts of the platform Community Feed?
qs.s: Community part the platform members ke saath communication ke liye hai. Feed me community ke saare posts. Windows: 1) Featured - saare posts: articles, statuses, forum posts, apply karne ke projects, etc. 2) Trending - jo posts recently popular ho rahe hain; scroll karke Show More. 3) Sharing Status - text box se apna text, photo ya video share karo. 4) Main List of All Posts - Share Status button ke neeche date se sorted saare posts; sirf follow kiye members ke ya poori community ke posts dikhane ke liye configure kar sakte ho. 5) Publishing an Article - bottom right corner ka Publish an Article button article form pe le jata hai.
qs.b: The Community Feed has Featured posts covering articles, statuses, forum posts and projects, a Trending list of rising posts, and a Sharing Status box for text, photos or video. Below that is the main list of posts sorted by date, which can show only people you follow or the whole community, and a Publish an Article button at the bottom right.
qs.t: Featured, Trending, Share Status, Main List, Publish Article.

qs.q: How do you use Articles and the Forum on the platform community, and when should you use the Flag feature?
qs.s: Articles tab: community ke saare articles; top pe Write an Article button; neeche categories me grouped articles. Article page pe: article like karo ya social networks pe share karo; padho aur images enlarge karo; comments padho aur like karo; Write a Comment button se comment; flag feature offensive, harmful ya CM guidelines violate karne wala content flag karne ke liye. Forum tab: saare forum topics. New topic banane ke steps: 1) Pehle search se check karo ki similar topic already discuss hua ya nahi 2) Nahi hai to top pe Create a New Topic button 3) Topic editor khulega 4) Category select karo, title aur body likho, Create click karo 5) Baad me check karo kisi ne answer kiya ya nahi. Neeche topics list, category dropdown se filter. Topic ke title pe click karke detail; comment karke discussion me join; like ya share. Flag feature sirf tab use karo jab comments ya content offensive, harmful ho ya the platform Terms of Use violate kare; CM team review karke action leti hai; wisely use karo, misuse mat karo.
qs.b: The Articles tab lists community articles by category, and on an article you can like, share, comment, enlarge images and flag content. To start a forum topic, first search for an existing similar topic, then use Create a New Topic, pick a category, write a title and body, click Create and check back for replies. The Flag feature should only be used for offensive or harmful content or Terms of Use violations, and the CM team reviews flags, so it must not be misused.
qs.t: Forum: pehle search, phir Create; Flag sirf galat content pe.

qs.q: What links are in the platform footer and why do they matter?
qs.s: Terms of Use: platform aur community violations se bachne ke liye padho; follow na karne pe account pe strikes lag sakte hain, account termination bhi. Privacy Policy: kaunsi personal information collect hoti hai aur kaise. AI Guidelines: third-party Generative AI tools ke acceptable use pe guidance poori the platform community ke liye. Cookie Settings: cookies ke form me the platform kya information collect karta hai samjho, aur kaunse cookies allow karne hain wo privacy preferences set karo.
qs.b: The footer links to the Terms of Use, which you must follow because violations can lead to strikes or account termination, and the Privacy Policy, which explains what personal data is collected. It also links to the AI Guidelines on acceptable use of third-party generative AI tools and to Cookie Settings, where you choose which cookies to allow.
qs.t: Footer = Terms, Privacy, AI Guidelines, Cookies; Terms todo = strike.

qs.q: What is the platform AI Support Agent, how do you open it, and what options does it offer?
qs.s: The platform Support Agent ek AI-powered assistant hai jo platform me integrated hai; standard platform questions, how-to issues aur general troubleshooting pe immediate, 24/7 help deta hai. Koi special skill nahi chahiye, normal human support agent jaise chat karo. Steps: 1) the platform Platform me log in karo 2) Top right corner me profile icon pe click (mobile devices pe top right menu tap karo, phir bottom pe profile icon tap) 3) Support select karo 4) Question type karo ya available option select karo. Agent abhi sirf the platform website pe desktop aur mobile browsers me available hai; the platform Mobile App me nahi. Options (7): Get help with a feature (platform features ka step-by-step guidance); Get help with a Test Cycle (cycle-related issues aur navigation); Get help with the Academy (courses, quizzes, practice cycles); Fix login or MFA issues (login aur authentication problems); Report a bug or problem in the platform (bugs report karna aur best practices); Resolve an Onsite Testing issue (onsite/field testing projects); Ask about payments (payment status, history, methods). Inactivity ke baad conversation automatically end hoti hai, phir feedback section aata hai.
qs.b: The platform Support Agent is an AI assistant built into the website that gives 24/7 help with platform questions, how-to issues and troubleshooting. You open it by logging in, clicking your profile icon and selecting Support; it works in desktop and mobile browsers but not in the platform mobile app. Its options cover features, test cycles, the Academy, login or MFA issues, reporting a bug in the platform, onsite testing and payments, and the chat ends after inactivity with a feedback prompt.
qs.t: Profile icon > Support; website only, app me nahi; 7 options.

qs.q: What topics can the platform AI Support Agent help with?
qs.s: General Features: the platform ya mobile app ke features ka step-by-step guidance; features ke errors troubleshoot karna; navigation aur account management; profile setup aur device management. Test Cycles: cycle features samajhna (Overview, Scope, Setup Instructions, Issue Reporting, Test Cases, Payouts); cycle status aur lifecycle (Invited, Active, Locked, Closed); work submit karne ka guidance (bugs, test cases, feedback); submissions edit karna; cycle information aur team contact details kaise access karein. Academy: quiz questions aur course topics; the practice bug site guidance; practice cycles aur requirements; tester ratings aur compensation. Login & MFA Issues: password kaam nahi kar raha ya 406 'Not Acceptable' error; new device pe MFA setup; MFA device ka access kho gaya to kya karein; mobile app MFA issues; MFA reset ya reconfigure ki information. Bug Reporting: the platform app ya website se bug report karne ka step-by-step; bug report me kya information; reported issue edit ya discard kaise karein; high-quality bug reports ki best practices; har field sahi kaise bharein (title, type, frequency, severity, etc.); kaunse attachments (screenshots, videos, etc.); common mistakes se bachne ke tips. Onsite Testing: onsite testing kaise kaam karta hai; kya expect karein aur moderator roles; logistics information kahan; sahi support path. Payments: payment status (amount, status, provider); payment history aur lifetime earnings; upcoming payments aur expected dates; payment method confirmation (PayPal, Payoneer, Wise, etc.); failed ya stuck payments troubleshoot.
qs.b: The agent helps with general features, navigation, profile and device management, and with understanding cycle sections, the Invited, Active, Locked and Closed lifecycle, submitting and editing work and finding team contacts. It covers Academy quizzes, the practice bug site, practice cycles and ratings, and login issues such as a 406 Not Acceptable error or MFA setup on a new device. It also guides bug reporting, including fields like title, type, frequency and severity and which attachments to add, plus onsite testing basics and payment status, history, methods and failed payments.
qs.t: Agent = general info + how-to, account pe action nahi.

qs.q: What can the platform AI Support Agent not do?
qs.s: 14 areas jo agent nahi kar sakta: 1) Account Actions - account access, modify ya uspe action. 2) MFA - Multi-Factor Authentication disable ya reset; sirf human support agent kar sakta hai. 3) Cycle-Specific Data - tumhare specific cycles, bugs, test cases ya results ki information access/retrieve. 4) Closed/Locked Cycles - completed cycles ke reimbursements, bug approvals ya payment details ka status. 5) Active Cycle Concerns - active cycles ke questions; ye TTL ya TE ko bhejo. 6) Onsite Logistics - location details, scheduling, NDAs ya site-specific information. 7) Onsite Payments - gift card, virtual card ya appointment scheduling issues. 8) Bug/Test Case Reviews - submitted bugs/test cases review karna ya rejection ka reason batana. 9) Disputing Bug Rejections - bugs approve ya rejections reverse; issue pe Dispute function use karo. 10) Triage Timing - bugs/test cases abhi tak review kyun nahi hue. 11) Removing Yourself from a Cycle - accept karne ke baad cycle se withdraw. 12) Payment Disputes - payment amount disputes, missing payments, payment breakdowns, tax documents, fee comparisons, payment methods share karna, ya specific provider issues. 13) Grade Status - Academy grades assign hue ya delay kyun. 14) Policy Violations - aise questions jo the platform guidelines ya Terms of Use violate kar sakte hain. Agent ki aur limitations bhi ho sakti hain; resolve na kar sake to human agent ke liye support ticket banane ko direct karega.
qs.b: The agent cannot act on your account, reset or disable MFA, or retrieve data about your specific cycles, bugs, test cases or results. It cannot answer active-cycle questions, which go to the TTL or TE, give status on closed-cycle approvals or payments, handle onsite logistics or onsite payments, review or explain rejections, reverse rejections, which is done with the Dispute function, or explain triage timing. It also cannot remove you from a cycle, handle payment disputes, check Academy grade status, or help with anything that violates the guidelines.
qs.t: MFA reset = human; rejection = Dispute button; active cycle = TTL/TE.

qs.q: When and how should you escalate beyond the AI agent at the platform?
qs.s: Complex matters, MFA issues, payment disputes, ya koi bhi case jo agent solve na kar sake, unke liye turant tester support platform pe redirect hone ka option milta hai taaki support ticket khol sako. Cycle-specific questions ke liye Test Team Lead (TTL) ya Test Engineer (TE) se contact karo: test cycle ki Chat se, ya Email se (Team Contact Information me diya hua; escalation rules follow karo). Academy-specific issues ke liye contact support form use karo aur request category me 'Academy On-boarding & Training' select karo.
qs.b: For complex issues, MFA problems, payment disputes or anything the agent cannot solve, you are offered a redirect to the tester support platform to open a ticket. Cycle-specific questions go to the TTL or TE through the cycle chat or by email using the Team Contact Information and its escalation rules. Academy issues go through the support form under the Academy On-boarding and Training category.
qs.t: Cycle = TTL/TE (chat/email); Academy = 'Academy On-boarding & Training'.

topics.intro: platform website ka har section: chat, notifications, profile, Home, Academy, Projects, Community, footer aur AI Support Agent.

topics.name: Platform Basics

qs.q: What are the platform Terms of Use and what happens if you violate them?
qs.s: The platform Terms of Use and Guidelines platform ki policy aur rules hain jo principles, standards, moral aur ethical expectations batate hain jo testers ko the platform platform ke andar aur bahar follow karne hain. Kyun padhna: community the platform ka vital part hai; ye guidelines level playing field banati hain aur customers aur testers dono ke liye experience better karti hain. Violations seriously liye jaate hain; investigation ke dauraan account suspend karne ka right reserve hai. Violations ka result: warnings, test cycle se removal, ya permanent ya temporary account suspension. The platform Terms of Use aur the platform AI Guidelines padho.
qs.b: The platform Terms of Use and Guidelines are the platform's rules and ethical standards that testers must follow both on and off the platform. They keep a level playing field for customers and testers, and violations are taken seriously: the platform may suspend an account during an investigation, and violations can lead to warnings, removal from a cycle, or temporary or permanent suspension.
qs.t: Violation = warning, cycle se bahar, ya suspension.

qs.q: What are the first eight most important the platform Terms of Use rules?
qs.s: Poore Terms of Use follow karne hain; most important rules (16 me se pehle 8): 1) English primary working language hai; community posts aur the platform work English me submit karo. 2) the platform project payment information publicly ya privately dusre community members se share mat karo. 3) Ek se zyada account mat banao, kabhi dusre member ka account use mat karo; isme payment accounts share karna bhi shamil hai. 4) the platform profile me information falsify mat karo: name, location, hardware, software, payment instrument information aur koi bhi profile information. 5) Community me sexually implied ya explicit content post mat karo, ya unwanted aur inappropriate chat messages mat bhejo. 6) Customer information ya names Test Cycle ke bahar kabhi publicize mat karo. 7) Infringing content the platform site pe post mat karo. 8) Unauthorized commercial advertising the platform site pe kahin bhi post mat karo, profile pe bhi nahi.
qs.b: Key rules include working and posting in English, never sharing project payment information with other members, and never creating more than one account, using someone else's account or sharing payment accounts. Testers must not falsify any profile information, post sexual content or send inappropriate messages, or publicise customer names or information outside a test cycle. Infringing content and unauthorised commercial advertising, including on your profile, are also prohibited.
qs.t: English, pay secret, ek account, sach profile, no adult, customer secret, no infringe, no ads.

qs.q: What are the remaining most important the platform Terms of Use rules about testing conduct?
qs.s: Rules 9-16: 9) Testing sessions ki koi information host karne ke liye file sharing sites kabhi use mat karo. 10) Customers ya Test Team Leads se the platform platform ke bahar kabhi contact mat karo. 11) Dusre testers, project managers aur khaas kar customers ke saath hamesha professional aur polite raho (chat, reports, disputes, Tester Messenger). 12) Hamesha test cycle instructions follow karo: Cycle Overview thoroughly padho aur Platform aur Chat me TTL/PM ke announcements. 13) Emulators, simulators, remote machines, beta software ya 'jailbroken' devices testing ke liye kabhi use mat karo, jab tak the platform employee ne instruct na kiya ho. Testing ke waqt saare third party VPNs, SSH tunnels, proxy server connections, IPSec connections aur aisi software/connections jo sensitive information track ya transmit kar sakein, completely disable ya test environment/device se remove hone chahiye. 14) Customer ya project manager se kabhi apna work approve karne, cycle se remove karne, ya favorite tester banane ke liye mat bolo. 15) Har assigned task thoroughly aur honestly complete karo, one-time aur recurring cycles ke test cases bhi; bugs aur test cases ke liye saari required documentation submit karo; apne pichhle submissions ka work recycle ya dusron ka poach mat karo; baad me edit karne ke liye placeholder bug reports kabhi mat banao. 16) Jin projects me the platform/the company device ya hardware ship kare, testing complete hone pe turant wapas karo, jab tak express permission na mile rakhne ki.
qs.b: Testers must never use file-sharing sites for testing data or contact customers or TTLs outside the platform, and must stay professional in chat, reports and disputes while following the cycle overview and TTL announcements. Emulators, simulators, remote machines, beta software and jailbroken devices are not allowed unless a the platform employee says so, and VPNs, SSH tunnels and proxies must be disabled or removed. Testers must not ask for approvals or favourite status, must complete work honestly without recycling, poaching or creating placeholder bug reports, and must return any shipped hardware unless told they can keep it.
qs.t: No emulator/jailbreak/VPN, no placeholder, no begging, hardware wapas.

qs.q: How are testers selected for the platform cycles?
qs.s: Manual Tester Selection Criteria - common requirements: 1) Device aur software specifications 2) Tester ki geographic location 3) Tester characteristics aur demographics 4) Available payment instruments & subscriptions. Profile complete aur updated rakho; incomplete hai to eligible paid cycles ke invitations miss ho sakte hain. Profile parameters se aage selection (jo requirements Tester Profile me capture nahi hoti): 1) Projects Board - the platform project details post karta hai, matching testers directly apply kar sakte hain. 2) Special Requirement Survey - the platform email se testers ko SRS me invite karta hai taaki extra profile information collect ho.
qs.b: Testers are matched on device and software specifications, location, characteristics and demographics, and available payment instruments and subscriptions, so an incomplete profile can mean missed paid invitations. When a project needs something the profile does not capture, the platform posts it on the Projects Board for qualifying testers to apply, or sends a Special Requirement Survey by email to gather extra information.
qs.t: Device, location, demographics, payment/subscriptions; extra = Projects Board ya SRS.

qs.q: What is a Special Requirement Survey (SRS) and how does it work?
qs.s: SRS difficult test cycles fill karne ka primary tool hai. Isme questions/answers hote hain jo profile karte hain ki tester project ke liye fit hai ya nahi. Platform surveys large batches me bhejta hai, Product environment, location requirements aur TE ya TSM ke set kiye existing platform criteria ke basis pe. Email ke link se ya platform dashboard se SRS access karo. Submit karne ke baad Platform TE/TSM ko automatically batata hai kaun criteria match karta hai aur kaun nahi; TE/TSM decide karte hain kise cycle me add karna. Ek baar survey submit kiya to dobara nahi le sakte. Main points: 1) Test cycle shuru hone se pehle bheja jata hai 2) Har SRS us test cycle ke liye unique 3) Cycle ki special requirements address karne ke liye likha jata hai 4) Potential testers se additional information gather karta hai 5) Test Engineer saare SRS responses review karta hai 6) Invitations un testers ko jinka match best hai. Note: SRS ki saari information verify hoti hai; falsify karna Terms of Use violation hai.
qs.b: The SRS is the platform's main tool for filling difficult cycles: it asks questions to judge whether a tester fits, and is sent in large batches based on environment, location and criteria set by the TE or TSM. It is sent before a cycle starts, is unique to that cycle, and the platform tells the TE or TSM who matches, after which the Test Engineer reviews responses and invites the best matches. You can submit each survey only once, and all answers are verified, so falsifying them violates the Terms of Use.
qs.t: SRS = cycle se pehle, ek baar, sach bolo (verify hota hai).

qs.q: Why does the platform need accurate location information, and how can you improve your chances of paid projects?
qs.s: Accurate information do taaki zyada range ke projects ke liye eligible bano, jaise hardware testing aur in-person testing. Name, birthdate, phone number aur street address ek internationally trusted third party platform se verify kiye jaate hain; isse protection milti hai jab tester ko hardware bhejna ho. The platform staff ki note - paid opportunities ke chances badhane ke liye: 1) Tester Profile accurate, complete aur up-to-date rakho 2) SRS surveys me participate karo 3) Projects Board pe jin projects ke qualified ho unke liye apply karo.
qs.b: Accurate location details make you eligible for more projects, such as hardware and in-person testing, because your name, birthdate, phone number and street address are verified through a trusted third-party platform before hardware is shipped. To improve your chances of paid work, keep your profile accurate and current, take part in SRS surveys, and apply to Projects Board projects you qualify for.
qs.t: Profile sahi + SRS bharo + Board pe apply = zyada paid kaam.

qs.q: How do testers earn money on the platform and what affects the amount?
qs.s: Earning ke tareeke (6): 1) Issues - paid test cycle me har approved issue ka payment. 2) Test Case - paid cycle me har approved test case ka payment. 3) Reviews - kuch cycles me customer app/website ka 'write a review' option; approved reviews ka payment. 4) Usability studies - usability cycles me feedback dekar payment. 5) On-site testing - specific location visit karke approved work ka payment. 6) Referrals - naye testers refer karke; valid referrals ka payment sirf tab jab the platform referral program announce kare. Amount kis pe depend: 1) Payout Rate - project ki complexity pe; har cycle me same nahi. 2) Value - valuable issues ke zyada paise. 3) Testing Tier - high rated testers ko low rated se zyada; quality hi rating improve karne ki key.
qs.b: Testers earn from approved issues, approved test cases and approved reviews in paid cycles, plus usability studies, on-site testing, and referrals when the platform announces a referral program. The amount depends on the cycle's payout rate, which reflects project complexity, the value of each issue, and the tester's rating tier, since higher-rated testers are paid more.
qs.t: Kamai = approved kaam; amount = rate x value x tier.

qs.q: When does the platform pay testers?
qs.s: Testers ko mahine me do baar pay kiya jata hai: 15th ko aur mahine ke last day ko. Agar 15th ya last day weekend ya US holiday pe pade, to agle business day pe payment.
qs.b: Testers are paid twice a month, on the 15th and on the last day of the month. If either date falls on a weekend or a US holiday, payment is made on the next business day.
qs.t: 15 aur last date; weekend/US holiday = next business day.

qs.q: What payment methods does the platform offer and how do you set up PayPal or Payoneer?
qs.s: Teen choices: 1) PayPal 2) Payoneer 3) Direct To Bank Transfer (powered by Wise) - bank account me local currency me seedha, Wise account banane ki zaroorat nahi. PayPal/Payoneer setup: 1) In me se ek vendor pe account banao 2) Use the platform account se connect karo 3) Left side profile menu ke Payments section me jao 4) Payment Method option me Setup click karo 5) PayPal ya Payoneer choose karo 6) Account connect karne ki information daalo. Note: PayPal aur Payoneer har country me supported nahi; register karte waqt unke terms and conditions, especially supported countries aur restrictions, dhyan se padho.
qs.b: The platform pays through PayPal, Payoneer, or Direct to Bank Transfer powered by Wise, which pays into your bank in local currency without a Wise account. For PayPal or Payoneer, you create an account with the vendor, then go to Payments in the profile menu, click Setup under Payment Method, choose the vendor and enter your details. PayPal and Payoneer are not supported in every country, so check their country terms first.
qs.t: PayPal, Payoneer, Wise (bank direct).

qs.q: How do you set up Direct to Bank Transfer powered by Wise on the platform?
qs.s: Kuch ya saari information chahiye: Full Name (bank account ke naam se match), Bank Account Number ya IBAN (payment route karne ke liye), Bank ka SWIFT/BIC Code (branch ka apna SWIFT nahi to country me bank ke head office ka SWIFT), Bank ka Name aur Address, Tumhara Address (kuch countries me compliance ke liye). Country ke hisaab se fields alag ho sakte hain; example: country India ho to SWIFT ki jagah IFSC code maanga ja sakta hai. Steps: 1) Information gather karke the platform me log in 2) Left side profile menu me Payments section 3) Payment Method section me Change ya Set Up button 4) Direct To Bank Transfer (powered by Wise) select karke Next 5) Wise aur currency conversion rates ke liye Wise ki official website 6) Information double-check karke Submit & Verify. The platform apne servers pe sirf full name, currency aur country store karta hai; baaki sensitive banking info securely Wise.com ko jaati hai. Important notes: bank details change hon to form update karna zaroori; ye method har country me available nahi, option nahi dikhe to tumhari country me abhi available nahi (aur countries add hongi); payments ke liye support knowledge base dekho.
qs.b: You may need your full name matching the bank account, account number or IBAN, the bank's SWIFT or BIC code, or the head office's code if your branch has none, the bank's name and address, and your own address; in India an IFSC code may be asked instead of SWIFT. Then go to Payments, click Change or Set Up under Payment Method, choose Direct to Bank Transfer powered by Wise, verify the details and click Submit and Verify. The platform stores only your name, currency and country, sends the rest securely to Wise, and you must update the form if your bank details change.
qs.t: India = IFSC; the platform rakhta sirf naam, currency, country.

qs.q: Does the platform deduct taxes from tester earnings?
qs.s: The platform earnings se taxes withdraw nahi karta. Agar US me rehte ho aur earnings $5000 se zyada hain, to third party payment provider se W-9 ke baare me information milegi. Kahin bhi raho, local laws ke hisaab se earnings report karna aur tax pay karna tumhari responsibility hai; taxes file karne se pehle tax adviser se consult karo.
qs.b: The platform does not withhold taxes from earnings. US testers earning over 5,000 dollars receive W-9 information from the third-party payment provider, and every tester is responsible for reporting earnings and paying taxes under local law, ideally with advice from a tax adviser.
qs.t: Tax tumhara; US > $5000 = W-9.

qs.q: How does the platform tester rating system work?
qs.s: Rating System testers ko test cycles me activity aur quality of work ke liye reward karta hai. Rated tester ke roop me activity points aur quality points banate ho jo tester rating me badalte hain. Rating 0 se 100 ke beech ek number hai jo batata hai ki tum dusre active rated testers ke comparison me kahan rank karte ho. Rating se tier assign hota hai: Rated, Proven, Bronze, Silver, Gold. Sab testers unrated tester ke roop me start karte hain; Unrated testers rated ya graded nahi hote aur rank me upar nahi ja sakte jab tak minimum Activity Points na kama lein (usually 2 ya 3 cycles ke baad). Kaafi activity points ke baad Rated tester bante ho aur tester rating generate hone lagti hai. Notes me likha hai '6 the platform rating tiers' aur naam Rated, Proven, Bronze, Silver, Gold diye hain; table me Unrated ko milakar 6 rows hain.
qs.b: The platform's rating system rewards activity and quality: you earn activity and quality points that become a rating from 0 to 100 showing your rank against other active rated testers. Everyone starts Unrated and moves to Rated after earning a minimum number of activity points, usually after 2 or 3 cycles. The rating then places you in a tier: Rated, Proven, Bronze, Silver or Gold, with Unrated as the starting level, making six levels in the table.
qs.t: Unrated se start, 2-3 cycles me Rated; rating 0-100.

qs.q: What are the platform rating tiers and their thresholds?
qs.s: Tier table: Unrated - testers jinke 25 points se kam hain. Rated - jo saare testers me 0-49.99% ke andar rank karte hain aur kam se kam 25 points hain. Proven - top 50-74.99%. Bronze - top 75-84.99%. Silver - top 85-92.99%. Gold - Rated Testers ke top 7%. Tester tier Tester Rating se determine hota hai.
qs.b: Unrated testers have fewer than 25 points. Rated testers have at least 25 points and rank in the 0 to 49.99 percent range, Proven in the 50 to 74.99 percent range, Bronze in 75 to 84.99, Silver in 85 to 92.99, and Gold is the top 7 percent of rated testers.
qs.t: 25 points se Rated; 50 Proven, 75 Bronze, 85 Silver, top 7 Gold.

qs.q: What actions increase or decrease a the platform tester's rating points?
qs.s: Badhate hain (5): 1) Participation - invitation accept karke cycle me participate karna 2) Declining Cycle - participate nahi kar sakte to invitation jaldi decline karna; good practice kyunki jagah block nahi hoti aur available testers participate kar sakte hain 3) Issue reports - approved issue reports; high quality aur high value reports rating significantly improve karte hain 4) Test Case - approved test cases 5) Reproductions - attachment ke saath +1 reproductions.
