Ghataate hain (4): 1) No Participation - invitation accept karke participate na karna 2) Rejected work - rejected bug reports ya test cases (sirf 'Working As Designed' rejections ko chhod ke; WAD rating ko negatively impact nahi karta) 3) Low quality - low quality issue reports pe low integrity rating milna 4) No response - cycle me TTL ya TE ko respond na karna.
qs.b: Points go up for participating in accepted cycles, declining invitations early when you cannot take part, approved issue reports, especially high-quality, high-value ones, approved test cases, and +1 reproductions with attachments. Points go down for accepting and not participating, rejected bugs or test cases, except Working As Designed rejections, which do not hurt your rating, low integrity ratings for poor reports, and not responding to the TTL or TE.
qs.t: WAD reject = rating safe; accept karke gayab = minus.

qs.q: Why can a the platform rating change without explanation, and what does a rating ending in .2643% mean?
qs.s: Rating tiers har raat (nightly) recalculate hote hain, isliye tier bina exact reason jaane upar-neeche ho sakta hai. Calculation ek time period me tumhare Activity aur Quality scores ko baaki saare rated testers se compare karke hoti hai; isliye dusre testers ki activity aur quality bhi tumhare tier ko affect karti hai; tier up, down ya stagnant reh sakta hai. Rating lambe time se change nahi hui to shayad next tier ke liye kaafi activity points nahi hain. Har tier ke liye recent time me minimum activity points chahiye. Aksar tester ke quality scores higher tier wale hote hain par minimum activity points nahi hote. Agar rating .2643% pe end hoti hai (49.2643%, 74.2643%, 84.2643%, 92.2643%), to iska matlab quality score higher tier ke layak hai par minimum activity points abhi collect nahi hue.
qs.b: Rating tiers are recalculated nightly by comparing your recent activity and quality scores with all other rated testers, so your tier can move even if you did nothing different. Each tier also needs a minimum number of recent activity points. A rating ending in .2643 percent, such as 49.2643 or 92.2643, means your quality would qualify for a higher tier but you have not yet earned enough activity points.
qs.t: .2643 = quality hai, activity kam.

qs.q: What are the benefits of a higher the platform rating and how do rating premiums work per testing type?
qs.s: Benefits: 1) Increased payout - Bronze, Silver aur Gold testers ko bug report payouts me bonus 2) More Invitations - higher tiers ko zyada cycle invitations. Testers ko har testing type ki alag rating milti hai; example: Functional me Gold aur Usability me Proven, us type ke cycles ki activity aur quality ke basis pe. Tester ratings ke thresholds testing types me alag hote hain. Premiums: Gold - saare approved reports pe 10% premium; Silver - 5%; Bronze - 2.5%. Payout increase us rating se decide hota hai jo cycle ke testing type pe apply hoti hai. Example: Silver Functional tester par Rated Usability tester ho to Functional bugs pe 5% extra milega, Usability pe nahi. Tester Profile ke Statistics section me rating, historical activity aur rated status ki details.
qs.b: Higher tiers bring more invitations and higher payouts: Gold testers get a 10 percent premium on approved reports, Silver 5 percent and Bronze 2.5 percent. Ratings are separate for each testing type with different thresholds, so the premium follows the rating for that cycle's type; a Silver functional tester who is only Rated in usability gets 5 percent extra on functional bugs but not on usability work. The Statistics section of the Tester Profile shows rating details and history.
qs.t: Gold 10, Silver 5, Bronze 2.5; type ke hisaab se alag.

qs.q: What security measures should the platform testers follow?
qs.s: The platform account safe aur secure rakhna zaroori. Measures (6): 1) Kisi aur ko apne the platform account ka access mat do 2) Passwords share mat karo 3) Sirf secure networks use karo 4) Computer security programs updated rakho 5) Sirf known aur trusted websites se download karo 6) Email security maintain karo.
qs.b: Testers must keep their account secure by never giving anyone else access, never sharing passwords, using only secure networks, keeping security software updated, downloading only from known and trusted sites, and maintaining email security.
qs.t: Account, password, network, antivirus, download, email = 6.

qs.q: Which email domains does the platform send emails from, and what should you do with a suspicious email?
qs.s: Phishing scams aam hain; email legitimate dikhe phir bhi ho sakta hai na ho. 'From' email address pe cursor hover karne se domain dikhta hai ('at' sign ke baad wala part). The platform sirf in domains se email bhejta hai: the platform website; m.the platform website (community / project email domain); the company's domain; the company's email domain (testing services ke members). Saath hi Dropbox aur Hello Sign kuch projects ke trusted tester agreements sign karne ki email requests bhej sakte hain, ye valid domains hain. Agar koi email the platform ka claim kare par na ho, to the platform support site support form pe ticket submit karo aur category Potential Cheating/Fraud/Misbehavior use karo.
qs.b: The platform emails only come from the platform website, m.the platform website for community and project mail, the company's domain, and the company's email domain for testing services staff, and you can check the domain by hovering over the sender address. Dropbox and Hello Sign may also legitimately send tester agreements to sign. Any fake the platform email should be reported through the support form under the Potential Cheating, Fraud or Misbehavior category.
qs.t: 4 domains: the platform's main domain, its mail subdomain, the company's domain and the company's mail domain; + Dropbox/Hello Sign.

qs.q: What is the platform Favorite Tester feature and what are its benefits?
qs.s: Favorite Tester feature se customer apne valued testers designate karta hai. Recurring test cycles (jo the platform projects ka majority hain) ke liye khaas important, taaki customer future cycles/projects ke liye valued testers retain kar sake. 1) Select hone pe Tester Snapshot, Testing History page aur cycle-level pe 'Favorite' badge/ribbon dikhta hai; example: 5 customers ne favorite banaya to Tester Snapshot ke badge me number '5'. 2) Kisi company ke favorite tester ko us customer ke future cycles me invite hone ke chances zyada; aur us company ke cycles me submit kiye saare future issues pe additional 5% payout uplift, jab tak favorite rahe. 3) Har customer ke paas limited favorite testers ka allotment; tester ke favorite designations ki koi limit nahi. Customer kabhi bhi favorite status hata sakta hai.
qs.b: The Favorite Tester feature lets a customer mark testers it values, which matters most for recurring cycles, the majority of the platform work. A favourite badge appears on the Tester Snapshot, Testing History and at cycle level with a count of customers, and favourites are more likely to be invited back and earn a 5 percent payout uplift on future issues for that company while the status lasts. Customers have a limited number of favourites and can remove the status at any time, but a tester can be favourited by any number of customers.
qs.t: Favorite = +5% us customer ke issues pe; customer kabhi bhi hata sakta.

qs.q: What is GDPR and what personal data does it protect?
qs.s: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) European Union me data protection aur privacy ka standardized law hai. Ye personal data ki processing regulate karta hai taaki use protect kiya ja sake. 'Personal data' matlab koi bhi information jo insaan ko identifiable banaye (PII ya personally identifiable information bhi kehte hain). 'Processing' matlab koi bhi operation jaise storing, sharing, collecting, etc. GDPR protected personal data ke examples (13): Name; Bank details; IP-address; ID ya passport number; Email address (jaise agar usme tumhara naam ho); Photos; Race; Ethnic origin; Political opinions; Religious ya philosophical beliefs; Genetic data jaise DNA; Biometric data jaise fingerprints; Sexual orientation. Sirf tumhara nahi, dusron ka personal data bhi (friends, family, colleagues, third parties) GDPR ke under aata hai.
qs.b: GDPR is the European Union's data protection and privacy law that regulates the processing of personal data, meaning any information that makes a person identifiable, also called PII, and processing means operations such as storing, sharing or collecting it. Protected examples include name, bank details, IP address, ID or passport number, an email address containing your name, photos, race, ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs, genetic data, biometric data and sexual orientation. It covers other people's data too, such as friends, family and colleagues.
qs.t: PII = jo bhi pehchaan karwaye, apna ho ya dusre ka.

qs.q: What are the common GDPR violations testers make in video recordings?
qs.s: The platform ne video recordings me ye common violations dekhe (10): 1) the platform platform record karna 2) the platform chat record karna jisme dusre customers aur testers ke naam video me dikhte hain 3) Recording ke waqt messages aur notifications aana, jaise WhatsApp, Facebook, emails, dusre projects aur customers ki the platform notifications 4) Recording ke dauraan calls aana jisme naam aur phone number dikhe 5) Email inbox dikhana jisme tumhara email address, received emails aur senders dikhein 6) Webcam se khud ko record karna 7) Apna naam, address, ID-number aur dusra sensitive data bol dena 8) Device ke background image me relatives ki pictures 9) Browser autofill se addresses, names, phone numbers, etc. dikhna 10) Video me mobile keyboard blur kiye bina passwords ya Personal Identification Information type karna.
qs.b: Common GDPR violations in recordings include capturing the platform platform or chat with other customers' and testers' names, and notifications from WhatsApp, Facebook, email or other the platform projects. Others are incoming calls showing names and numbers, visible email inboxes, recording yourself on webcam, speaking your name, address or ID number aloud, family photos as wallpaper, browser autofill showing personal details, and typing passwords or PII without blurring the mobile keyboard.
qs.t: Platform, chat, notifications, calls, inbox, webcam, bolna, wallpaper, autofill, keyboard = 10.

qs.q: How can testers avoid GDPR violations when recording videos?
qs.s: The company online privacy respect karta hai; test cycle accept karke tum agree karte ho ki the company tumhari information test cycle recruitment aur execution ke liye use kare; test environments ke access ke liye ye data third party se share ho sakta hai. Video record karte waqt guidelines (8): 1) Sirf testing ke liye email address banao jisme tumhara naam na ho, jaise testing@gmail.com 2) Webcam se khud ko record mat karo, jab tak specifically na kaha jaye 3) the platform platform, chat ya apni aur dusron ki koi PII record mat karo, kyunki wahan dusre customers aur testers ke full names dikhte hain 4) Apni the platform profile naam, dusre projects ya payment info ke saath mat dikhao 5) Recording ke waqt notifications off karo, warna names, emails aur private messages dikhte hain 6) Tabs ke beech unnecessary switching avoid karo; kuch review karna ho to second device use karo 7) Browser ka autofill disable karo 8) Video me full names, passwords, PINs ya koi PII type karte waqt mobile keyboard blur karo. Note: kuch cycles registration process real data (name, address, email, phone, credit card info, password etc.) ke saath record karne ko bol sakte hain; tab cycle ka TTL saare videos review karke client ko dene se pehle sensitive information edit/blur karta hai. Aur jaanne ke liye Academy ka Personally Identifiable Information (PII) course.
qs.b: Use a testing-only email address without your name, do not record yourself on webcam unless asked, and never record the platform platform, chat, your profile, other projects or payment details. Turn off notifications, avoid unnecessary tab switching by using a second device, disable browser autofill, and blur the mobile keyboard when typing names, passwords, PINs or other PII. If a cycle requires recording a registration with real data, the TTL reviews and blurs the videos before they reach the client.
qs.t: Test email, no webcam, no platform, notifications off, autofill off, keyboard blur.

topics.name: Testing Basics

qs.q: What is testing?
qs.s: Notes ke hisaab se testing ek process hai jisme product ko evaluate karte hain taaki actual requirements ke against koi gaps, errors, improvements ya missing requirements mil sake. Product sirf software nahi hota - hardware ya physical service bhi ho sakta hai.
qs.b: Testing is the process of evaluating a product to identify gaps, errors, improvements or missing requirements compared to the actual requirements. The product is not limited to software; it can also be hardware or a physical service.
qs.t: Testing = requirement vs reality ka gap dhundhna.

qs.q: What are the four benefits of software testing?
qs.s: Notes me 4 benefits diye hain: 1) Product Quality - high quality zaroori hai, testing quality product deliver karne me help karta hai. 2) Customer Satisfaction - product customer needs meet kare, testing ye ensure karta hai. 3) Security - log trusted product chahte hain, testing vulnerabilities pehle hi hata deta hai. 4) Cost-Effectiveness - issues jaldi milte hain to fix karna sasta aur fast hota hai; baad ki stages me wahi fix bahut mehenga padta hai.
qs.b: Testing ensures product quality, customer satisfaction, security and cost-effectiveness. It helps deliver a quality product that meets customer needs, removes vulnerabilities before release, and finds issues early when they are cheaper and faster to fix than in later stages of development.
qs.t: QCSC - Quality, Customer, Security, Cost.

qs.q: Explain Functional, Exploratory, Regression and Smoke testing as described for the platform.
qs.s: Functional: product ke features/functionality ko issues dhundhne ke intent se test karna. Exploratory: tester apna knowledge aur experience use karke woh areas dhundhta hai jo fail ho sakte hain; out of the box sochne aur alag approaches try karne deta hai. Regression: verify karta hai ki system me changes/modifications se unintended outcomes na aaye; changes ke baad kiya jata hai ki system ab bhi sahi chale. Smoke: kuch basic tests chala ke check karta hai ki core functions abhi bhi kaam kar rahe hain. Difference: Regression zyada in-depth hai - saare features test karta hai ki changes ka koi unintended effect na ho; Smoke sirf core functions ka quick check.
qs.b: Functional testing checks features with the intent of finding issues. Exploratory testing lets testers use their knowledge and experience to find vulnerable areas and try different approaches. Regression testing verifies that changes did not cause unintended outcomes, testing all features in depth, while smoke testing runs a few basic tests to confirm the core functions still work.
qs.t: Smoke = core ka quick check, Regression = poora system deep check.

qs.q: What other testing types does the platform conduct?
qs.s: Usability: real users ke saath test karke product kitna easy aur user-friendly hai ye measure karna (dedicated track). Localization: kisi target culture/locale ke hisaab se quality verify karna (Academy track). Security: product ke security mechanisms me flaws reveal karna (Academy track). Automation: automation tool se repetitive steps execute karna jo manually mushkil ho. Payment: koi bhi test jisme complete karne ke liye payment instrument chahiye (dedicated track). Accessibility: disabilities wale logon ke liye usable ho - hearing, color blindness, old age aur other disadvantaged groups. API: APIs ki functionality, reliability, performance aur security check karna; the platform pe sabse challenging types me se ek (dedicated track). Voice: native speakers ke saath voice-enabled products test karna; functional, dialogue verification, usability aur payment testing combine karta hai. On-site: physical location visit karke service quality evaluate karna aur feedback lena. Note: sab types the platform pe hote hain par sabse common Functional hai, isliye ye track sirf functional discuss karta hai. Dedicated tracks: Usability, Payment, API, Localization, Security aur Amazon Alexa Testing.
qs.b: Besides functional, exploratory, regression and smoke, the platform runs usability, localization, security, automation, payment, accessibility, API, voice, bug hunt and on-site testing. Functional testing is the most common at the platform. There are dedicated Academy tracks for Usability, Payment, API, Localization, Security and Amazon Alexa testing.
qs.t: Sabse common Functional; baaki ke liye alag tracks.

qs.q: What is Bug Hunt testing and what rules apply to it?
qs.s: Bug Hunt ek robust exploratory test hai. Goal sirf ek specific bug, ya specific device pe specific bug, ya scope ke andar specific type ka bug dhundhna hai. Invited testers ko overview aur requirements dhyan se padhni chahiye aur out of scope issues report nahi karne chahiye. Doosre areas test mat karo kyunki requirement bahut specific hai aur customer sirf usi cheez me interested hai; scope ke bahar report karoge to OOS ya DNFI reject hoga, jiska tester rating pe bada negative impact hai. Examples: 1) specific game khelte ya app use karte crash bug pakadna, 2) specific device wale testers specific bug reproduce kar paate hain ya nahi, 3) specific page/section kholte ya game khelte freeze/slow loading pakadna, 4) first-time install ya app update ke baad launch pe app 60 seconds se zyada freeze hona.
qs.b: Bug Hunt is a focused exploratory test whose goal is to find only a specific bug, a specific bug on a specific device, or a specific type of bug within scope. Testers must read the overview carefully and avoid testing other areas, because out-of-scope reports are rejected as OOS or DNFI and heavily hurt the tester rating. Examples include catching a crash in a specific game, or an app freezing for more than 60 seconds on first launch after install or update.
qs.t: Bug Hunt = sniper mode, sirf target bug; bahar gaye to OOS/DNFI.

qs.q: What is a bug or an issue?
qs.s: Issue ya bug ek error, flaw ya fault hai product (website, app etc.) me jo incorrect ya unexpected result deta hai, ya unintended tarike se behave karta hai. Simple words me: bug woh cheez hai jo application ya website me sahi kaam nahi kar rahi.
qs.b: A bug is an error, flaw or fault in a product such as a website or app that causes it to produce an incorrect or unexpected result, or to behave in unintended ways. Simply put, it is something that is not working correctly.
qs.t: Bug = expected kuch, mila kuch aur.

qs.q: What are the five issue types at the platform? Explain Functional issues.
qs.s: The platform issues ko 5 types me categorize karta hai: Functional, Visual, Content, Performance, Crash. Functional: workflow failures jahan test app ka koi hissa design ke hisaab se kaam nahi karta; unexpected ya illogical behavior jisme end result expected result se alag hota hai. Examples: broken page links, search aur filters galat results dete hain, button click karne pe respond nahi karta.
qs.b: The platform categorizes issues into five types: Functional, Visual, Content, Performance and Crash. Functional issues are workflow failures where something did not work as designed, producing a result that differs from the expected one, such as broken links, wrong search or filter results, or a button that does not respond.
qs.t: 5 types = F V C P C (Functional, Visual, Content, Performance, Crash).

qs.q: What is a Visual issue?
qs.s: Visual issues layout ko affect karte hain aur UI distortion laate hain jaise page pe elements ya images missing. Examples: page elements ya content misaligned, content apne area me fit nahi hota, link/button/menu pe inconsistent colors, picture missing.
qs.b: Visual issues affect the layout and cause user interface distortion. Examples are misaligned elements or content, content that does not fit its area, inconsistent colors on a link, button or menu, and missing pictures.
qs.t: Visual = aankh ko galat dikhe (layout, color, image).

qs.q: What is a Content issue?
qs.s: Content issues page ke text ko affect karte hain - spelling, grammar aur localization errors. Examples: page translation me galat word (localization issue), spelling aur capitalization errors jaise the platform, text me punctuation ( , . : ; ' ) galat use.
qs.b: Content issues affect the text of a page, such as spelling, grammar and localization errors. Examples include wrong words in translations, spelling and capitalization errors, and incorrect punctuation.
qs.t: Content = text ki galti (spelling, grammar, translation).

qs.q: What is a Performance issue?
qs.s: Problematic slowness ya hanging, sluggish interface; features expected se zyada time me load hote hain, navigation slow. Examples: features ke beech navigate karte waqt app slow react karta hai, app ya pages load hone me bahut time lete hain, app freeze ya unresponsive ho jata hai 10 seconds se zyada.
qs.b: Performance issues are problematic slowness, hanging or a sluggish interface, where features take longer to load than they should. Examples include slow navigation, pages that take too long to load, or the application freezing or becoming unresponsive for more than 10 seconds.
qs.t: Performance = slow; 10 second se zyada freeze.

qs.q: What is a Crash issue?
qs.s: Features use karte waqt application unexpectedly quit ya close ho jata hai. Examples: Web - page hang hota hai, respond nahi karta, aakhir me error aata hai ya browser band ho jata hai. Computer - app device freeze kar deta hai, lambe time hang hota hai ya abruptly close. Mobile - app error ke saath abruptly close.
qs.b: A crash is when the application quits or closes unexpectedly while using its features. On web the page hangs and ends in an error or the browser closes; on a computer the app freezes the device or closes abruptly; on mobile the app closes abruptly with an error.
qs.t: Crash = app band ho gaya bina pooche.

qs.q: What is an issue report?
qs.s: Issue report woh report hai jisme issue ko samajhne, reproduce karne aur fix karne ke liye saari required information hoti hai. Hamesha well-written issue report submit karo saari required information ke saath.
qs.b: An issue report is a report containing all the information required to understand, reproduce and fix the issue. It should always be well written and complete.
qs.t: Report ka kaam: samjho, reproduce karo, fix karo.

qs.q: What makes an issue valid, and what is a WAD issue?
qs.s: Sirf woh issues valid hain jo saari cycle requirements fulfil karte hain; har mila hua issue valid nahi hota, requirements dekh ke sirf valid report karo. Working as Designed (WAD): aapko lagta hai issue hai par system aise hi kaam karta hai - ye invalid hai. Product samajhne se WAD avoid hota hai. WAD rejection ka rating pe koi effect nahi hota; experienced testers ko bhi tricky lagta hai, best judgment use karo. Example 1: sign-out button homepage pe nahi dikha, report kiya, par woh dropdown menu me hidden tha - WAD; easily accessible banana achha feedback hai par issue nahi. Example 2: shopping site pe price low to high sort, product ke actual aur discounted price dono hain, site actual price se sort karti hai - ye WAD hai; discounted price se sort karna suggestion hai, issue nahi.
qs.b: Only issues that fulfill all cycle requirements are valid. If the reported behavior is simply how the system is meant to work, it is classified as Working as Designed, or WAD, and is invalid. WAD rejections do not affect the tester's rating, and understanding the product first helps avoid them.
qs.t: WAD = developer ne jaan-boojh ke aisa banaya; rating safe.

qs.q: How do Out of Scope areas and Do Not Report criteria make an issue invalid?
qs.s: Out of Scope: issue cycle ke scope me hona chahiye. Har cycle ke overview me in scope aur out of scope areas hote hain; scope ke bahar report kiya issue invalid. Example: Out Of Scope section me Help page out of scope likha hai, to Help page ka koi bhi issue reject. Do not report criteria: cycle me ye requirement ho sakti hai ki kaunse type ke issues submit kar sakte ho; ye bhi overview ke Out Of Scope section me hota hai. Example: visual aur localization issues out of scope likhe hain, to unhe report karoge to reject.
qs.b: Every cycle overview defines in-scope and out-of-scope areas, and any issue reported outside the scope is invalid, for example issues on a Help page listed as out of scope. Cycles can also restrict which issue types may be submitted, such as excluding visual or localization issues, and those are stated in the Out Of Scope section too.
qs.t: Scope ke bahar = seedha reject.

qs.q: What are Duplicate issues and Known Issues?
qs.s: Duplicate: koi bhi issue ek tester sirf ek baar report kar sakta hai; same issue dobara report karne pe rejection. Naya report karne se pehle existing reported issues review karo. Known Issues: woh issues jo customer ko pehle se pata hain; inhe report karna duplicate maana jayega. Cycle me known issues list ho bhi sakti hai aur nahi bhi. Known issues overview me ya Issues tab me milte hain; agar list hai to naya report karne se pehle review karo.
qs.b: An issue can be reported only once, so reporting the same issue again is rejected as a duplicate, and testers should review existing reports first. Known issues are already known to the customer and reporting them is also treated as a duplicate; they can be found in the cycle overview or the Issues tab.
qs.t: Report se pehle Issues tab + known list dekho.

qs.q: What does DNFI mean?
qs.s: Testing aur reporting me hamesha instructions follow karo. Agar instructions follow nahi kiye, chahe issue valid ho, to bhi DNFI (Did not follow instructions) se reject ho sakta hai. Examples: unclear issue report, placeholder issues report karna, the platform VPN use nahi karna jab use karna tha. Note: ye main requirements hain; cycle ke hisaab se aur requirements ho sakti hain, isliye overview padho aur instructions follow karo.
qs.b: DNFI stands for Did Not Follow Instructions. Even a valid issue can be rejected as DNFI if the tester ignored instructions, for example by submitting an unclear report, a placeholder issue, or not using the platform VPN when required.
qs.t: DNFI = issue sahi, tareeka galat.

qs.q: What steps should you follow to test a website or an app?
qs.s: 5 steps: 1) Read the instructions - sabse important; overview padho aur samjho, skip karoge to kaam reject ho sakta hai. Overview kyun zaroori: product samajhne me help, customer kaunse bugs chahta hai, often testing site/app access karne ki info, In Scope aur Out Scope sections, often known issues (dobara report karne pe reject), issue reporting instructions, koi bhi additional important info. 2) Understand the product - kya test kar rahe ho aur woh kya karta hai; important areas pehle; overview me focus areas milte hain. 3) Use the product - site kholo ya app install karo, real users ki tarah use karo, saare features test karo; naye tester ko bugs dhundhna mushkil lagega par hope mat chhodo. 4) Report the bug - pehle confirm karo bug valid hai, attachments banao, issue report form saari details ke saath bharo. 5) Respond to requests - report ke baad TTL, TE ya customer aur info maang sakte hain; time pe respond karo.
qs.b: First read the overview and instructions, which explain the product, the bugs the customer wants, access details, scope, known issues and reporting rules. Then understand the product and its focus areas, use it like a real user across all features, confirm a bug is valid before reporting it with all details and attachments, and finally respond on time to any requests from the TTL, TE or customer.
qs.t: Padho, Samjho, Use karo, Report karo, Reply karo.

qs.q: What is the difference between 'not working as designed' and 'not designed as it should work'?
qs.s: Rule: issue = something not working as designed (clear defect). 'Not designed as it should work' zyada tar feedback hota hai - ek broken cheez batata hai, doosra improvement. Usse bhi door hai 'not designed how I like it'. Developer ke hisaab se ek ise flaw maane, doosra WAD bole. Same page ke 3 examples: 1) Clear Issue - back button expected tarike se kaam nahi karta; intended function broken, valid, approval aur payment. 2) Gray Area (poor design but functional) - search engine minor typo handle nahi karta, jaise 'Bryan' search pe 'Bryant' suggest/return nahi karta; search specified tarike se kaam karta hai, approve hoga ya nahi client pe depend karta hai ki woh aisa feedback value karta hai ya nahi. 3) Works as Designed (no functional impact) - empty search submit karne pe page bina error message reload hota hai; major search engines me common hai, user interaction disrupt nahi karta, ye user expectation issue hai, functional defect nahi.
qs.b: An issue is something not working as designed, which is a clear defect. Something not designed as it should work is usually feedback about a possible improvement, and something not designed how I like it is even further from a real issue. For example, a broken back button is a clear issue, a search that does not handle minor typos is a gray area depending on the client, and an empty search simply reloading the page is working as designed.
qs.t: Toota hua = bug; behtar ho sakta = feedback; mujhe pasand nahi = skip.

qs.q: How do the customer's priorities affect whether a finding is approved?
qs.s: Har cycle ki instructions batati hain client kya value karta hai; reports ko stated goals se align karo. Sample advice: 'Please make sure that all the links and functionality of the website are working by testing as a regular user. Let us know if anything interferes with the user experience on the site.' Do submissions: 1) Excessive Character Input in a Form - sau characters daalne se page toot gaya, par ye 'testing as a regular user' se align nahi; aise negative testing findings usually reject hote hain jab tak significant malfunction na ho. 2) Broken Navigation Link - 'Back to NBA.com' jaisa key link kaam nahi karta to user experience pe seedha asar; clear defect, approve hona chahiye. Kuch cycles limits push karke todne ko encourage karte hain, par zyada tar real-world user experience aur practical issues pe focus karte hain.
qs.b: Each cycle states what the client values, and reports should align with those goals. If the client asks for testing as a regular user, a negative-testing finding like breaking a form with hundreds of characters is usually rejected unless it causes a significant malfunction, while a broken key navigation link is a clear defect that should be approved. Most cycles focus on real-world user experience rather than breaking the product.
qs.t: Client ka goal = tumhara goal.

qs.q: What is a 'Once Upon a Time' issue and how should you handle it?
qs.s: Aisa issue jo ek baar dikha par consistently reproduce nahi hota; inhe rarely priority milti hai jab tak critical failure na ho. Submit karne se pehle: browser cache clear karo, browser restart karo, issue reproduce karo. Agar problem persist kare aur tangible negative impact ho to report karo; warna isolated occurrence maan ke dismiss ho sakta hai.
qs.b: A once-upon-a-time issue appears once but cannot be reproduced consistently, and is rarely prioritized unless it causes a critical failure. Before submitting, clear the browser cache, restart the browser and try to reproduce it; report it only if it persists and has a tangible negative impact.
qs.t: Ek baar dikha? Cache clear, restart, phir try.

qs.q: What key questions should you ask yourself before reporting something?
qs.s: 9 questions: 1) Kya kuch design ke hisaab se kaam nahi kar raha? 2) Kya client ne ise key test area bataya? 3) Kya ye user ki site use karne ki ability me interfere karta hai? 4) Kya issue consistently reproduce hota hai? 5) Agar sirf ek baar, kya significant negative outcome hai? 6) Kya user enjoyment ya satisfaction kam hota hai? 7) Kya implementation unconventional ya inconsistent hai? 8) Kya function achieve karne ka zyada optimal tareeka hai? 9) Kya ye personal preference pe based hai, functional flaw nahi? List me jitna upar, utna zyada valid issue; neeche wale zyada tar feedback. Final thoughts: in principles se approval rate badhega, rejections kam; zyada tar cycles me TTL, TE aur customer reps discussion monitor karte hain, doubt ho to poocho. Rejection ka matlab ye nahi ki tum galat ho - bas finding customer ki current priorities se align nahi.
qs.b: I ask whether it is not working as designed, whether the client highlighted the area, whether it blocks the user, whether it reproduces consistently or causes a significant outcome if seen once, whether it reduces satisfaction, whether the implementation is unconventional, whether there is a more optimal approach, and whether it is just personal preference. The closer a finding is to the top of this list, the more likely it is a valid issue; findings near the bottom are usually feedback. A rejection simply means the finding does not match the customer's current priorities.
qs.t: List me upar = bug, neeche = feedback.

qs.q: Why does test case execution matter, and what are testing breadth and depth?
qs.s: SDLC me testing phase quality management ka crucial part hai; testing jitna jaldi shuru ho aur implementation tak chale utna achha. Bugs jitna jaldi mile, company ka risk aur cost utna kam. Proper test case execution project success ke liye essential; best practices rework kam karte hain aur time to market ghatate hain. Trained, informed, engaged tester quality mishaps ke against best defense hai. Customers ka common challenge: breadth aur depth. Breadth = application me coverage, jaise naye features kaam kar rahe hain, uninstall executable sahi files hata raha hai, mobile app ke actions web app se sync ho rahe hain. Depth = ek feature ki exhaustive testing, jaise checkout form me timing out conditions, mobile pe back button dabana, cart me product add karne ke baad online promo code daalne me issues. Har customer ka approach alag hai to test case documentation ke styles bhi alag; har step ko instructions ke hisaab se completely aur accurately bharo kyunki pata nahi customer data kaise analyze karega. Product se familiar bano, customer ka material review karo, required tutorials complete karo. Scope ke bahar time lagane se pehle in scope/out of scope samjho - ye cycle overview, slot instructions ya test case instructions me hota hai; doubt ho to TTL ya TE se contact karo.
qs.b: Testing should start as early as possible because the earlier bugs are found, the lower the risk and cost, and proper test case execution reduces rework and time to market. Breadth means coverage across the application, such as new features, uninstall behavior and mobile-to-web sync, while depth means exhaustive testing of one feature, such as timeouts, the back button and promo codes in a checkout form. Testers should fill every step completely and accurately, study the product and materials, and confirm scope with the TTL or TE when unsure.
qs.t: Breadth = chauda (poori app), Depth = gehra (ek feature).

qs.q: What fields does a typical test case contain?
qs.s: Common fields: Step Description - purpose, kaunsa feature/behavior validate ho raha hai aur kyun. Preconditions - shuru karne se pehle setup, jaise 'User account exists with email test@example.com and password Pass123!', 'Application is launched and on login screen'. Steps - numbered step-by-step instructions. Expected Result - system sahi ho to kya hona chahiye. Actual Result - execute karne pe asal me kya hua. Status - Pass, Fail, Blocked, Not Executed, Skipped, etc. Observations/Comments - notes, linked bugs, evidence (screenshots/videos). Bug ID - table ke end me ya har step ke liye. The platform platform pe bane test case me: Steps, Expected Results, Status, Comment aur Attachments. (Sample test case image me tha - skip.)
qs.b: A typical test case has a step description, preconditions, numbered steps, expected result, actual result, a status such as Pass, Fail, Blocked, Not Executed or Skipped, observations or comments with evidence, and sometimes a Bug ID field. Test cases created on the platform platform contain Steps, Expected Results, Status, Comment and Attachments.
qs.t: the platform TC = Steps, Expected, Status, Comment, Attachments.

qs.q: What is the right approach to executing a test case on the platform?
qs.s: Test case submissions me usually guaranteed compensation hota hai, isliye pure exploratory se zyada appealing lag sakte hain. Key: test case closely follow karo aur saare steps karo; TTLs, TEs aur Customers saare test cases review karte hain aur dishonest, inaccurate ya incomplete results pakad lete hain. Preconditions: shuru karne se pehle saari preconditions fulfil karo, warna test case sahi execute nahi hoga. Completing steps in order: steps specified order me chalao; har step pichhle pe dependent hota hai, jaise step 2 ke liye step 1 pehle. Verification: har step aur har verification point expected results ke hisaab se dhyan se verify karo.
qs.b: Test cases usually come with guaranteed compensation, and the key is to follow every step closely because TTLs, TEs and customers review results for honesty and accuracy. I make sure all preconditions are met first, run the steps in the specified order since each depends on the previous one, and verify every verification point against the expected results.
qs.t: Precondition, Order, Verify - POV.

qs.q: How do you set step status and handle a failed step?
qs.s: Actual result Expected Result se match kare to Status PASS, warna FAIL. PASS: next step pe jao. FAIL: check karo bug pehle se report hua hai ya known issue hai; nahi to report karo. Report ke baad aage ke steps continue karo. Agar aage ke steps failed step pe depend hain aur koi workaround nahi, to cycle ke TTL ya TE se guidance lo.
qs.b: If the actual result matches the expected result the step is marked PASS and I move on; otherwise it is FAIL. For a failed step I check whether the bug is already reported or known, report it if not, and continue with the remaining steps. If later steps depend on the failed step and there is no workaround, I ask the TTL or TE for guidance.
qs.t: Fail mila? Duplicate check, report, aage badho.

qs.q: What should observations contain and how do you complete a test case thoroughly?
qs.s: Observations test case me essential hain; tester step complete karte waqt mili insight highlight karta hai. Ye customer ko issue troubleshoot karne ya end users ke liye potential confusion samajhne me help karta hai. Observations PASS aur FAIL dono steps ke liye de sakte ho. Thorough completion: saare steps fill karo; koi step complete nahi kar pa rahe to TTL ya TE se contact karo; har step pe dhyan do.
qs.b: Observations capture the insight gathered during a step, helping the customer troubleshoot or spot potential user confusion, and they can be added to both passed and failed steps. To complete a test case thoroughly I fill in every step, pay close attention to each one, and contact the TTL or TE if I cannot complete a step.
qs.t: Pass ho ya Fail - observation likh sakte ho.

qs.q: How should bugs found during test case execution be reported?
qs.s: Failed step pe bug mile to pehle reproduce karo aur root cause samjho. Check karo cycle me pehle report hua hai ya nahi; previously submitted bugs aur known issues list review karo taaki duplicate rejection na ho. Bug report me step-by-step details aur required attachments do. Har failed step ke saath ek bug attached hona chahiye; Bug ID column me Bug ID daalo, jaise step 2 ke liye Bug ID #451178. Ye assume mat karo ki reviewer product se familiar hai; observations aise likho jaise audience app ka user nahi hai, taaki koi bhi reproduce kar sake aur bug approve ho. Root cause: is analysis method ko effectively karne ke liye additional instructions chahiye.
qs.b: When a step fails, I reproduce the bug, try to understand the root cause, and check reported bugs and known issues to avoid duplicates. Each failed step should have a bug attached, with its Bug ID entered in the Bug ID column, for example Bug ID #451178 for step 2. I write observations as if the reader has never used the application, so anyone can reproduce the issue.
qs.t: Har Fail step = ek Bug ID.

qs.q: How should you name a test case file and when can you do exploratory testing alongside test cases?
qs.s: Kuch cycles me test case file aise save karni padti hai ki pata chale kaunsa test case aur kisne kiya. Good practice: customer ka naam ya test case naam rakho aur apna OS aur browser add karo, jaise Registration_macOS_Safari. Same OS aur Browser wale multiple testers ho to apna last name add karna helpful. Har cycle ki instructions follow karo. Exploratory testing test cases ke saath chal sakti hai; in scope focus areas ya in scope areas pe depth me karo. Usually pehle test case complete karna hota hai, isliye test case complete aur submit karke phir extensive exploratory karo. Note: ye course background hai, har cycle ki instructions follow karo.
qs.b: A good file name keeps the customer or test case name and adds the operating system and browser, for example Registration_macOS_Safari, plus the tester's last name if several testers share the same setup. Exploratory testing can be done alongside test cases, but usually the test case should be completed and submitted first, and exploratory work should go in depth on in-scope focus areas.
qs.t: Naam = TC_OS_Browser (+ last name).

qs.q: How do you install a test app from the Google Play Store, and what problems can occur?
qs.s: Steps: 1) Android device pe test cycle overview kholo, Attachments section tak scroll karo. 2) Google Play store link tap karo. 3) Play store khulne pe Install tap karo. 4) Install ke baad verify karo app version overview me diye version se match karta hai. 5) Settings > Apps page > installed app kholke version dekho. Common problems: app specific country me available nahi, device app ke saath compatible nahi, installed version overview wale version se match nahi. Aisi problem pe test cycle chat me TTL se contact karo.
qs.b: Open the cycle overview on the Android device, tap the Google Play link in the Attachments section, install the app, and verify in Settings under Apps that the version matches the overview. If the app is unavailable in your country, incompatible with your device, or the version does not match, contact the TTL through the test cycle chat.
qs.t: Install ke baad version match karo.

qs.q: How do you install an APK file directly and via a QR code?
qs.s: Direct APK: 1) Android browser me test cycle overview kholo. 2) Attachments se APK download karo. 3) Download complete hone pe file kholo. 4) Android default me unknown apps allow nahi karta, popup aayega - Settings tap karo. 5) Allow from this source toggle enable karo aur wapas jao. 6) Install tap karo, install hone tak wait. QR code se: 1) PC browser me overview kholo. 2) Attachments me APK ke neeche QR code icon ya Open Scannable QR code button click karo. 3) Android 8 aur upar: Camera app kholo, rear camera select karo. 4) Google Lens bhi use kar sakte ho; pre-installed nahi to Play Store se install karo. 5) Camera QR code pe point karo, download link dikhega. 6) Link tap karke APK download. 7) Downloaded APK tap karke install. 8) Unknown apps popup pe Settings tap. 9) Allow from this source enable karke wapas. 10) Install tap karke wait. Note: Android 7 aur neeche pe koi QR scanner install karo jaise Google Lens ya QR Code Reader.
qs.b: To install an APK directly, download it from the overview's Attachments section on the Android device, open it, tap Settings on the unknown-apps prompt, enable Allow from this source, then tap Install. Alternatively, open the overview on a PC, show the QR code under the APK, scan it with the camera on Android 8 and above or a scanner app like Google Lens on Android 7 and below, download the APK and install it the same way.
qs.t: APK = download, Allow from this source, Install.

qs.q: How do you install a test app on iOS from the App Store or TestFlight?
qs.s: App Store: 1) iOS device pe overview kholo, Attachments tak scroll. 2) Download link tap. 3) App Store khulne pe Install tap. 4) Install ke baad version overview se match verify karo. 5) Settings > General > iPhone Storage > app select karke version dekho. TestFlight (customers aksar testing version TestFlight se share karte hain): 1) App Store se TestFlight app download karo. 2) Overview me TestFlight link tap karke app TestFlight me kholo. 3) Sahi version select karke install karo.
qs.b: For the App Store, tap the link in the overview's Attachments section, install the app, and confirm the version under Settings, General, iPhone Storage. For TestFlight, install the TestFlight app from the App Store, open the TestFlight link from the overview, select the correct version and install it.
qs.t: iOS version check = Settings > General > iPhone Storage.

qs.q: How do you install an IPA file directly on an iOS device?
qs.s: Zyada tar cycles me IPA install karni hoti hai. Steps: 1) iOS device pe overview kholo, Attachments tak scroll. 2) Download on Mobile Device button dhundho. Alternative: Open Scannable QR code click karke iOS device se scan karo. Kuch cycles me ye buttons nahi hote, tab iTunes use karna padta hai. 3) Install tap karke wait. 4) Install ke baad Settings > General > VPN and Device Management (iOS 15 aur newer) ya Profiles and Device Management (older iOS). 5) Installed app select karke trust karo; ab app khul jayega.
qs.b: Open the overview on the iOS device and use the Download on Mobile Device button, or scan the Open Scannable QR code, then install the app. Afterwards go to Settings, General, VPN and Device Management on iOS 15 and newer, or Profiles and Device Management on older versions, and trust the app so it can be opened. If these buttons are missing, iTunes is used instead.
qs.t: IPA ke baad app ko Trust karna mat bhoolo.

qs.q: How do you install an IPA file using iTunes or iMazing?
qs.s: iTunes (jab Download on Mobile Device button nahi ho): 1) Windows ke liye iTunes download/install. macOS 10.15 se neeche: iTunes default installed. macOS 10.15 aur upar: iTunes ki jagah Apple Configurator 2 install karke IPA drag and drop. 2) Computer pe overview se IPA download. 3) File explorer me IPA copy (Ctrl+C Windows, Command+C macOS). 4) iOS device connect karo, computer trust karo. 5) iTunes kholo, device visible ho, device name pe right-click > paste. macOS 10.15+: Apple Configurator 2 me IPA device pe drag and drop, install confirm. 6) Process khatam hone tak wait. 7) Settings > General > VPN and Device Management (iOS 15+) ya Profiles and Device Management (older). 8) App select karke trust. Note: iTunes me Library section select karke phir paste karo. iMazing: 1) iMazing download/install. 2) Overview se IPA download. 3) iMazing kholo. 4) Device connect, computer trust. 5) Manage Apps click. 6) Bottom right drop-down arrow. 7) Install .IPA File. 8) IPA select karke open. 9) Wait. 10) Settings > General > VPN and Device Management / Profiles and Device Management. 11) App trust karo.
qs.b: When there is no Download on Mobile Device button, download the IPA on a computer, connect and trust the device, and paste the IPA onto the device in iTunes with the Library section selected, or drag and drop it in Apple Configurator 2 on macOS 10.15 and above. With iMazing, open Manage Apps, use the drop-down arrow to choose Install .IPA File and select the file. In every case, finish by trusting the app under Device Management in Settings.
qs.t: macOS 10.15+ = Apple Configurator 2; iMazing = Manage Apps > Install .IPA File.

qs.q: Name common website elements you should use in bug reports.
qs.s: Bug report me sahi term use karo. Hero: website ke top pe oversized banner image, visitor ka pehla visual, important content ka overview. Banner: header, footer ya sidebar me digital advertisement. Carousel: images ya visual content cycle karne ka slideshow. Navigation: ek section se doosre section jaane deta hai. Hamburger Menu: screen space bachata hai, hidden menu denote karta hai. Breadcrumb: navigation type jo website pe user ki location dikhata hai. Pop-up: web page ke upar khulne wali chhoti window. Toggle Button: setting ko do states ke beech badalta hai. Checkbox: chhota interactive box, positive ya negative choice. Textbox/Text Field: text enter karne ka section. Drop-down menu/list: options ki list, ek value choose. Radio Button: set of options me se ek, ek time pe sirf ek select. Tabs: ek window me multiple views. Footer: har page ke bottom pe, main body ke neeche. Note: aur bhi elements hote hain, hamesha sahi term use karo.
qs.b: Common elements include the hero image, banner, carousel, navigation, hamburger menu, breadcrumb, pop-up, toggle button, checkbox, text field, drop-down list, radio button, tabs and footer. For example, a breadcrumb shows the user's location on the site and a radio button allows only one option from a set. Using the correct term makes bug reports clear.
qs.t: Radio = sirf ek; Checkbox = haan/na; Breadcrumb = tum kahan ho.

qs.q: Name common website pages and how they are abbreviated.
qs.s: Homepage: website ka main page, URL load karne pe pehla page, jaise https://www.the platform website. Product List Page (PLP): website ke products list, often sort aur filter, jaise https://academybugs.com/store/all-items/. Product Detail Page (PDP): ek specific product ki info, jaise https://academybugs.com/store/flamingo-tshirt/. Cart: jo kharidna hai woh jama karne ka page, jaise https://academybugs.com/my-cart/. About us: business me kaun hai aur kya karta hai, jaise https://www.the platform website/about-us. Note: zyada tar pages websites me alag hote hain, sahi naam use karo.
qs.b: Common pages are the Homepage, the Product List Page or PLP that lists products with sorting and filtering, the Product Detail Page or PDP for a single product, the Cart where users collect items to buy, and the About us page. Using the correct page name makes a bug report easier to understand.
qs.t: PLP = list, PDP = detail.

qs.q: What best practices should you follow before and during testing on the platform?
qs.s: Always read the overview: testing se pehle overview kai baar padho; confusion ho to test cycle chat me TTL (Test team lead) se poocho. System prepare karo: browser extensions disable karo jaise ad-blockers, browser cookies aur cache clear, VPN on ho to disable, unnecessary apps ya tabs band. Real user ki tarah use karo, bug hunter ki tarah nahi - real user wale bugs milenge, zyada valuable. Bug ko kai baar reproduce karo; report ki jaldi mat karo; agar specifically nahi kaha gaya to non-reproducible bugs reject hone ke chances.
qs.b: Always read the overview several times and ask the TTL in the cycle chat if anything is unclear. Prepare the system by disabling extensions like ad-blockers, clearing cookies and cache, turning off VPNs and closing unnecessary apps or tabs. Use the product like a real user, and reproduce a bug multiple times before reporting it, since non-reproducible bugs are likely to be rejected.
qs.t: Padho, saaf karo, user bano, dobara karo.

qs.q: How do you report high-quality bugs and why reproduce other testers' issues?
qs.s: Quality bug me avoid karo: spelling aur grammar mistakes; placeholder issues kabhi report mat karo - ye the platform Terms of Use ke against hai; enough information ya attachments na dena. Doosre testers ke reported bugs reproduce karna ya attachments ke saath +1 karna aapke aur customer dono ke liye beneficial: +1 se pata chalta hai kaunse bugs already reported hain, +1 se rating boost hoti hai, customers ko pata chalta hai issue doosre devices pe reproduce hota hai.
qs.b: A high-quality bug report avoids spelling and grammar mistakes and missing information or attachments, and placeholder issues are never allowed because they violate the platform Terms of Use. Reproducing other testers' issues with a +1 and attachments helps me learn what is already reported, boosts my rating, and shows the customer the issue reproduces on other devices.
qs.t: +1 = rating boost + customer ko device coverage.

qs.q: What does being professional on the platform involve?
qs.s: Tips: sab kuch dhyan se padho, samjho, phir action lo. Chat me noise mat karo - same, already asked ya irrelevant questions mat poocho. Messages reply karte, issues dispute karte ya team member ko email karte waqt professionally likho. Fellow testers se respect se baat karo. The platform Terms of Use rules ka set hai jo follow karna zaroori hai; Terms of Use aur AI Guidelines padho aur hamesha follow karo.
qs.b: Being professional means reading carefully before acting, not adding noise to the chat with repeated or irrelevant questions, writing professionally when replying, disputing or emailing, and treating fellow testers with respect. Testers must also read and always follow the platform Terms of Use and AI Guidelines.
qs.t: Padho, chup raho jab zaroorat na ho, respect do.

topics.intro: Testing kya hai, bug kya hai, valid bug kaise pehchane, test case kaise execute kare, app kaise install kare aur platform best practices - sab ek jagah.

topics.name: Test Cycle Process

qs.q: What are a Client and a Test Cycle in the platform?
qs.s: Client ya Customer: woh company jisne the company aur the platform Community ko apna product test karne ke liye engage kiya. Test Cycle: company ke product ka ek specific test. Har cycle me kai testers hote hain aur setting, type etc. ke hisaab se cycles bahut alag ho sakti hain. Cycle me testers ko overview ki instructions dhyan se follow karni hoti hain - in scope product pe bugs dhundhna, test cases execute karna, reviews submit karna, ya usability studies (agar available). Note: har cycle me slots, test cases, reviews ya usability surveys nahi hote; cycle to cycle alag.
qs.b: The client or customer is the company that engaged the company and the platform Community to test its product. A test cycle is one specific test of that product with many testers, where testers follow the overview to find bugs in scope, execute test cases, submit reviews or run usability studies. Not every cycle includes slots, test cases, reviews or usability surveys.
qs.t: Client = the company ko hire karne wali company; Cycle = ek specific test.

qs.q: How do the notes define a Bug Report and a Test Case?
qs.s: Bug Report: product ke features ya functionality me specific error/defect ka written summary; isme bug samajhne, reproduce aur fix karne ki saari info honi chahiye. Submit karne ke liye test cycle header me blue Report Issue button click karo; form ke fields cycle ke issue reporting instructions ke hisaab se bharo (Bug Reports course me detail). Test Case: predefined steps ka set jo tester ko follow aur execute karna hai specific features test karne ke liye, jaise particular program path exercise karna ya specific requirement compliance verify karna. Do stages me use: 1) development ke andar ensure karne ke liye ki feature design ke hisaab se bana, 2) general QA process ka regular hissa, wanted test coverage ensure karne ke liye.
qs.b: A bug report is a written summary of a specific defect that contains everything needed to understand, reproduce and fix it, submitted through the blue Report Issue button in the test cycle header. A test case is a set of predefined steps used to test specific features or requirements, used during development to confirm a feature is built as designed and regularly in QA to ensure test coverage.
qs.t: Bug report = blue Report Issue button.

qs.q: What are the roles of the Tester, TTL and TE?
qs.s: Tester: the platform community member jo test cycles me bugs dhundhta hai, feedback deta hai, ya test cases perform karta hai. Test Team Lead (TTL): testers ka primary point of contact; cycles me testers ki help karta hai aur saare submitted bug reports aur test cases review karta hai. Test Engineer (TE): test cycle build karta hai, testing team assemble karta hai, aur cycle ke overall execution ke liye responsible.
qs.b: A tester is a community member who finds bugs, gives feedback or performs test cases. The Test Team Lead, or TTL, is the testers' primary point of contact, helps them during the cycle and reviews all submitted bug reports and test cases. The Test Engineer, or TE, builds the test cycle, assembles the team and is responsible for the overall execution of the cycle.
qs.t: TTL = tester ka dost + reviewer; TE = cycle ka builder.

qs.q: What are the TSM and the Community Manager?
qs.s: Testing Service Manager (TSM): Test Architect (TA) title ab TSM se replace ho gaya hai. TSM client ke saath directly kaam karta hai; TTLs aur TEs ki team manage karta hai taaki client ki testing, feedback ya research needs ke liye appropriate solutions de. Community Manager (CM): Community Management Team ke members. Team ka goal: global community ko excellent testers banna sikhana, paid projects ke opportunities dilana, aur testers ko community aur duniya bhar ke fellow testers se connect karna.
qs.b: The Testing Service Manager, which replaced the Test Architect title, works directly with the client and manages a team of TTLs and TEs to meet the client's testing, feedback or research needs. Community Managers belong to the Community Management Team, whose goal is to help testers become excellent, find paid opportunities and connect with each other.
qs.t: TA ab TSM hai; TSM client se baat karta hai.

qs.q: Describe the general test cycle process at the platform.
qs.s: Invitation: naya cycle ready hone pe the platform matching testers ko invitations bhejta hai; testers overview dhyan se padhke invitation accept karte hain. Testing and Reporting: requirements samajhke testing shuru; cycle usually 2-3 din chalti hai, is phase me bugs submit aur test cases complete karte hain. End of the test cycle: testing phase khatam hone pe cycle lock ho jati hai; aur bug reports ya test cases submit nahi ho sakte; team aur customer submitted bugs aur test cases review karte rehte hain.
qs.b: The platform sends invitations to matching testers, who read the overview and accept. During the testing phase, which usually runs for 2-3 days, testers submit bugs and complete test cases. When the phase ends the cycle is locked, no more submissions are allowed, and the team and customer continue reviewing the submitted work.
qs.t: Invite, Test 2-3 din, Lock.

qs.q: What are the four test cycle statuses and what can a tester do in each?
qs.s: 4 statuses: 1) Pending Activation - cycle activate hone ke liye scheduled; tester overview padh sakta hai, slot claim kar sakta hai; par product test, bugs report, test cases execute ya reviews submit nahi kar sakta. 2) Active - tester product test kar sakta hai, bugs report/edit, test cases execute aur reviews submit. 3) Locked - aur bugs report ya test cases submit nahi; bug reports aur test cases edit ho sakte hain agar Info Requested status me hain; chats me communicate kar sakte ho; submitted kaam review hoga. 4) Closed - cycle complete aur saara kaam reviewed; cycle me kuch nahi kar sakte; sirf cycle details aur apna submitted kaam dekh sakte ho.
qs.b: A cycle has four statuses: Pending Activation, Active, Locked and Closed. In Pending Activation testers can read the overview and claim slots but cannot test; in Active they can test, report and edit bugs, execute test cases and submit reviews. In Locked no new bugs or test cases can be submitted, items in Info Requested status can be edited, chat still works and work is reviewed; in Closed everything is reviewed and testers can only view details.
qs.t: PALC - Pending, Active, Locked, Closed.

qs.q: What is MFA and why is it required on the platform?
qs.s: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) security process hai jisme login ke waqt do ya zyada verification factors chahiye; username password ke upar extra security layer. MFA ensure karta hai ki sirf aap, apne device ke saath, account access kar sako; the platform customer data protect karta hai aur tester accounts secure karta hai. Enable karne ke liye mobile pe app install karna hota hai jaise Google Authenticator ya Microsoft Authenticator; configuration me app ko the platform account se link karte ho. Login pe linked app se numerical code - One-Time Password (OTP), jaise 987654 - daalna hota hai. Saare the platform members ke liye MFA enabled hona required hai. Enable nahi kiya to MFA wale projects ke eligible nahi. MFA wali cycles ke liye: invitation redacted hoga - cycle name, Company, Product, Scope, Instructions etc. nahi dikhenge; MFA enable aur configure kiye bina invitation accept nahi kar sakte; cycle emails aur app push notifications redacted honge (messages, cycle/product/company names, scope aur details hidden).
qs.b: Multi-factor authentication requires two or more verification factors at login, such as a one-time password from an authenticator app, adding security beyond username and password. All the platform members are required to enable MFA to protect customer data and secure their accounts. Without it, invitations to MFA cycles are redacted, they cannot be accepted, and cycle emails and push notifications hide the cycle details.
qs.t: MFA nahi = invitation dhundhla, accept bhi nahi.

qs.q: What are the steps to enable MFA on the platform?
qs.s: 1) the platform platform website kholke sign in. 2) Tester name ke paas drop-down click. 3) Account Security tab click. 4) Is page pe MFA information padho aur samjho. 5) Enable MFA button click. 6) Enable MFA and Sign Out button click. 7) Sign In click karke dobara sign in. 8) Sign in ke baad MFA setup page pe redirect. 9) Mobile pe ek Authenticator app install karo: Google Authenticator (Android ya iOS), Microsoft Authenticator (Android ya iOS), FreeOTP (Android ya iOS). 10) App kholke naya MFA entry setup shuru karo.
qs.b: Sign in to the platform website, open the drop-down next to your name and go to the Account Security tab. Read the MFA information, click Enable MFA and then Enable MFA and Sign Out, sign in again, and you are taken to the MFA setup page. Install Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or FreeOTP on your phone and create a new entry.
qs.t: Account Security > Enable MFA > Sign Out > Sign In > app.

qs.q: How do you set up MFA with Google Authenticator?
qs.s: Camera se: 1) Google Authenticator kholo. 2) Plus + tap. 3) Scan a QR Code select. 4) Camera permission do. 5) MFA Setup page ke QR Code pe camera point. 6) App me the company: your email address naam se entry dikhegi. 7) MFA Setup page pe app ka code One-time code field me daalo. 8) Device Name field me naam. 9) Submit click. Setup Key se: 1) MFA Setup page pe My device is unable to scan QR codes link click. 2) Google Authenticator kholo. 3) Plus +. 4) Enter a Setup Key. 5) Account Name daalo. 6) Setup page ke step 2 wali key Your key field me. 7) Type of Key me Time based select. 8) Add tap. 9) the company: your email address entry dikhegi. 10) Code One-time code field me. 11) Device Name. 12) Submit.
qs.b: With the camera, tap the plus button, choose Scan a QR Code, scan the code on the MFA Setup page, then enter the generated code in the One-time code field, add a Device Name and submit. Without a camera, click My device is unable to scan QR codes, choose Enter a Setup Key in the app, enter the account name and key, select Time based, tap Add, and then complete the same One-time code and Device Name fields.
qs.t: Setup key me Type = Time based.

qs.q: How do you set up MFA with Microsoft Authenticator?
qs.s: Camera se: 1) Microsoft Authenticator kholo. 2) Microsoft account se sign in ya skip. 3) Add account tap. 4) Personal account select. 5) Scan a QR Code. 6) Camera permission. 7) Setup page ke QR pe point. 8) the company: your email address entry. 9) App lock notification acknowledge. 10) the company option (email wala) tap karke OTP dekho. 11) Code One-time code field me. 12) Device Name. 13) Submit. Setup Key se: 1) My device is unable to scan QR codes link. 2) App kholo. 3) Plus +. 4) Other account select. 5) Neeche OR ENTER CODE MANUALLY tap. 6) Account Name. 7) Step 2 wali key Your key field me. 8) Finish tap. 9) the company: your email address entry. 10) Entry tap karke OTP. 11) One-time code field. 12) Device Name. 13) Submit.
qs.b: With the camera, add a Personal account, choose Scan a QR Code, scan the setup page code, acknowledge the app lock notification, tap the company entry to see the OTP, and enter it with a Device Name before submitting. With a setup key, choose Other account, tap OR ENTER CODE MANUALLY, enter the account name and key, tap Finish, and complete the One-time code and Device Name fields.
qs.t: Microsoft camera = Personal account; manual = Other account.

qs.q: How do you set up MFA with FreeOTP and what setup recommendations are given?
qs.s: FreeOTP camera se: 1) FreeOTP kholo. 2) Welcome information padho. 3) Get Started tap. 4) Initial password banao aur yaad rakho. 5) Plus +. 6) QR Code icon tap. 7) Camera permission. 8) Setup page QR pe point. 9) the company: your email address entry. 10) Entry tap karke OTP. 11) One-time code field me code. 12) Device Name. 13) MFA enable complete. Recommendations: Authenticator app me apne email se login karo taaki MFA account se linked rahe aur device kho jaye ya app reinstall ho to retrieve kar sako. Device switch karna ho, current device band karna ho, ya ek se zyada devices se access chahiye to MFA account doosre device pe export karo.
qs.b: In FreeOTP, tap Get Started, create and remember an initial password, tap the plus and QR Code icon, scan the setup page code, then enter the OTP and a Device Name to finish. It is recommended to log in to the authenticator app with your email so MFA can be recovered if you lose the device or reinstall, and to export the MFA account when switching devices or using more than one.
qs.t: FreeOTP = pehle apna password banao.

qs.q: How do you log in after enabling MFA?
qs.s: 1) the platform platform ya Mobile app kholo. 2) Email aur password daalo. 3) Sign In click. 4) OTP enter karne ka prompt. 5) Authenticator app kholke OTP note karo. 6) the platform website pe OTP bina spaces ke daalo. One-time codes time-sensitive hote hain aur badalte rehte hain (jaise har 30 seconds); expire hone se pehle jaldi daalo. Google Authenticator countdown image dikhata hai ki code kitni der chalega; expire ho jaye to app me latest code dekho.
qs.b: Enter your email and password, click Sign In, and when prompted open the authenticator app and enter the OTP without spaces. Codes are time-sensitive and change, for example every 30 seconds, so enter them quickly and use the latest code if one expires.
qs.t: OTP bina space, 30 second ke andar.

qs.q: Can MFA be disabled, and what do you do if you change or lose your device?
qs.s: MFA ek baar enable hone ke baad disable nahi ho sakta, taaki saare testers projects ke eligible rahein (projects me MFA required hai). Doosre device pe setup: pehle check karo ki naye device pe same OTP app install karne se existing the platform MFA config automatically import hota hai ya nahi. Nahi hota to Reset MFA button use karo ya Tester Support se reset karwao. Reset ke baad, dobara setup se pehle, OTP app se purani the platform MFA config hata do taaki similar names se confusion na ho. Agli login pe naye device pe configure karo. Device access kho gaya to the platform Tester Support ki Login Help (the platform support site) se contact karo, the platform Tester ID include karo; identity ki additional validation ho sakti hai. Reset steps: 1) the platform website login. 2) Top left me tester name ke paas down arrow. 3) Account Security tab. 4) Reset MFA button. 5) Popup me Reset MFA confirm. 6) Naye device pe MFA configure. 7) OTP/MFA app se purani configuration hatao (recommended).
qs.b: Once enabled, MFA cannot be disabled, because it is required to participate in the platform projects. To move to a new device, first check whether the same OTP app imports the configuration automatically; otherwise use the Reset MFA button under Account Security or ask Tester Support, remove the old entry from the app, and configure MFA again at the next login. If the device is lost, contact Tester Support's Login Help with your the platform Tester ID.
qs.t: MFA on = hamesha on; device badla to Reset MFA.

qs.q: What are the important notes and support rules for MFA?
qs.s: Important notes: MFA sirf the platform website pe enable ho sakta hai. MFA enable ke baad the platform Mobile app latest version pe update karo, warna mobile app pe login nahi hoga. MFA wali cycle me participate karne ke liye MFA enable karna hoga taaki invitation details dekh sako, accept aur test kar sako; pehle se enable karna delay se bachata hai. MFA wali cycle ka invitation access/accept nahi kar sakte - MFA enable karke accept karo ya decline karo. Agar accepted cycle me baad me MFA requirement enable ho aur aapka MFA enabled nahi, to cycle, submitted issue reports aur test cases ka access chala jayega jab tak MFA enable na karo. Support: MFA setup ya login issues ke liye the platform support site pe Login Help category, the platform ID ke saath. The platform aur the company kabhi aapke one-time codes nahi maangenge; koi maange to Tester Support ko report karo. FAQs Tester Knowledge Base me.
qs.b: MFA can only be enabled on the platform website, and the mobile app must be updated to the latest version afterwards to log in. Without MFA you cannot see or accept invitations for MFA cycles, and if an accepted cycle later requires MFA you lose access to it and your submissions until you enable it. For problems, contact Tester Support's Login Help with your the platform ID; the platform and the company will never ask for your one-time codes.
qs.t: OTP kisi ko mat do - the platform kabhi nahi maangta.

qs.q: How do you receive and open a test cycle invitation?
qs.s: Invitations test cycles me participate karne ka mauka hain. Matching opportunity pe the platform email aur the platform mobile app ki push notification se invitation bhejta hai. Access kahan se: email me 'Review this test cycle' link; the platform platform pe Invited tab ya Test Cycle Invites section; the platform Mobile App me invites check karo.
qs.b: When there is a matching opportunity, the platform sends an invitation by email and by push notification in the mobile app. It can be opened from the Review this test cycle link in the email, from the Invited tab or Test Cycle Invites section on the platform, or from the platform mobile app.
qs.t: Invite 3 jagah: email, platform, app.

qs.q: What must you do with the cycle NDA?
qs.s: Overview details dekhne ke liye invitation kholne ke baad cycle NDA accept karna zaroori. Accept se pehle: attached NDA padho aur samjho; tester information aur mailing address sahi hai confirm karo - ye profile se aata hai, galat ho to pehle update karo; profile me address na ho to NDA accept nahi kar sakte, pehle address add karo. Accept karne ke liye Accept & Proceed button. Mobile App pe confirm karo ki NDA padha aur samjha, phir Accept NDA tap. Participate nahi karna to Decline invitation button aur reason select. NDA page cancel karne se page band hota hai aur invitation pending rehta hai; dobara khol ke accept ya decline kar sakte ho.
qs.b: Before seeing the overview, you must read and accept the cycle NDA with the Accept & Proceed button, or Accept NDA in the mobile app. Your tester information and mailing address come from your profile and must be correct, and you cannot accept an NDA without an address in your profile. Cancelling the NDA page keeps the invitation pending, and you can decline with a reason if you do not want to participate.
qs.t: Address nahi = NDA nahi.

qs.q: What should you consider before accepting a test cycle?
qs.s: NDA accept karne ke baad invitation turant aur jaldbazi me accept NAHI karna. Pehle overview poora padho aur samjho - usme cycle ki saari info hai. Phir decide karo: cycle complete karne ka time hai ya nahi, requirements meet karte ho ya nahi, cycle me interest hai ya nahi, accept karna chahte ho ya nahi.
qs.b: After accepting the NDA, I do not accept the invitation instantly. I read the whole overview and then decide whether I have time to complete the cycle, whether I meet its requirements, whether I am interested, and whether I want to accept it.
qs.t: Time, Requirement, Interest - phir accept.

qs.q: How do accepting a cycle and slot waitlists work?
qs.s: Accepting: 1) Special Requirements ke neeche checkbox click (agar required). 2) Overview page ke bottom pe Accept Cycle ya Accept Cycle & Claim a Slot button. Agar slot waitlist feature enabled hai to max claim limit tak pahunche Test Case slots ke liye waitlist join kar sakte ho. Waitlist join karna officially cycle accept karna nahi hai; waitlist chhod ke decline bhi kar sakte ho. Do scenarios: a) jab join karne ke liye slot claim karna required hai - slot claim karna padega; saare Test case slots full hon to waitlist join karo aur applicable ho to Exploratory slot claim karke join karo; Exploratory slots bhi na bache to Test Case slot khulne tak wait. b) jab slot claim required nahi - invitation accept karke waitlist join kar sakte ho agar Test Case slots full hain. 3) Accept Cycle & Claim a Slot button click. Test Case slot claim kiya hai to test case sahi complete karke deadline ke andar submit karna zaroori.
qs.b: To accept, tick the Special Requirements checkbox if needed and click Accept Cycle or Accept Cycle & Claim a Slot. If the slot waitlist feature is enabled, you can join a waitlist for full Test Case slots, but joining a waitlist is not the same as accepting the cycle. If a slot is required to join and all Test Case slots are full, you can take an Exploratory slot if available or wait; once you claim a Test Case slot you must complete it correctly within the deadline.
qs.t: Waitlist = abhi accept nahi hua.

qs.q: How do you decline a cycle and is there a penalty?
qs.s: Decline: 1) Overview page ke bottom pe Decline Cycle button. 2) Decline karne ka reason select. Note: invitation decline karne pe koi penalty nahi. Participate nahi kar sakte ya nahi chahte to jaldi decline karo.
qs.b: Click Decline Cycle at the bottom of the Overview page and select a reason. There is no penalty for declining, so if you cannot or do not want to participate, you should decline early.
qs.t: Decline = no penalty, bas jaldi karo.

qs.q: What sections does the cycle Overview tab contain?
qs.s: Sections: Description - product ka short description. In Scope - kaunse devices aur environments in scope hain, kya test karna hai, customer kya dhundh raha hai, additional info. Out Of Scope - kya test nahi karna, customer kya nahi chahta. Setup Instructions - product setup/access kaise karein. Issue Reporting Instructions - report formatting jaise title format, kaunse attachments required. Test Case Instructions - turnaround time, claiming instructions. Special Instructions - extra bahut important instructions. Attachments - product build, screenshots, videos. Team Contact Information - TTL, TE aur TA ki info, contact kaise karein, availability hours. Payouts - Test Cases, Bugs, Tester Review ke payout rates. Specified Environment - is cycle me kaunse environments use kar sakte ho. Special Requirements - participate karne ke liye requirements, fulfil karna zaroori. Bonus Instructions - bonus requirements aur bonus kaise milega. Note: cycle setting/type ke hisaab se kuch sections nahi dikhte.
qs.b: The Overview tab includes the Description, In Scope, Out Of Scope, Setup Instructions, Issue Reporting Instructions such as the title format and required attachments, Test Case Instructions, Special Instructions, Attachments, Team Contact Information, Payouts, Specified Environment, Special Requirements and Bonus Instructions. Some sections may not appear depending on the cycle type and settings.
qs.t: Title format Issue Reporting Instructions me milta hai.

qs.q: What are the Slots, Announcements and Builds tabs?
qs.s: Slots: cycle ke saare available slots; slots testing team me position guarantee karte hain; yahan se claim ya unclaim; claim se pehle slot description padho aur saari requirements meet karo. Announcements: TTL, TE ya TSM dwara accepted aur/ya invited testers ko bheje important messages; samjho aur follow karo; ignore karne pe kaam reject ho sakta hai. Kuch announcements acknowledge karne padte hain warna testing continue nahi kar sakte - announcement pe Acknowledge button click. Builds: test ho rahe product build ka version aur new changes info.
qs.b: The Slots tab lists available slots, which guarantee a position in the testing team, and lets testers claim or unclaim them after reading the slot description. Announcements are important messages from the TTL, TE or TSM; ignoring them can lead to rejected work, and some must be acknowledged before testing can continue. The Builds tab shows the version and changes of the build under test.
qs.t: Announcement ignore = kaam reject.

qs.q: What do the Issues, Test Cases, Reviews, My Earnings and Tester Scorecard tabs show?
qs.s: Issues: cycle me reported bugs ki list; search, sort, filter. Kuch cycles me known issues bhi Issues tab me hote hain - unpe blue bookmark icon. Test Cases: available aur claimed test cases; individual test case kholke complete karo; search, sort, filter. Reviews: submit karne ka review form; cycle ke hisaab se ho bhi sakta hai nahi bhi. My Earnings: us cycle me aapki earnings. Tester Scorecard: participating testers cycle me rank ke order me; rank tester ko kaam ke liye mile total points se calculate hota hai.
qs.b: The Issues tab lists bugs reported in the cycle with search, sort and filter, and known issues are marked with a blue bookmark icon. The Test Cases tab holds available and claimed test cases, Reviews holds a review form when the cycle has one, My Earnings shows your earnings in the cycle, and the Tester Scorecard ranks testers by the total points received for their work.
qs.t: Blue bookmark = known issue.

qs.q: What is the Cycle Feedback feature?
qs.s: Testers cycle pe feedback de sakte hain. Survey me 5 rating-based questions aur additional info ke liye open comment field. Testers apne views share karte hain aur TSMs ko insight milti hai ki cycles kaise set up aur run ho rahe hain. Ye survey the platform Mobile App me bhi hai. Note: reports sirf TSMs access kar sakte hain.
qs.b: Cycle Feedback is a survey with five rating-based questions and an open comment field that lets testers share their views on how a cycle was set up and run. It is also available in the mobile app, and only TSMs can access the reports.
qs.t: Feedback = 5 ratings + 1 comment, sirf TSM dekhe.

qs.q: What are the four reporting methods and the steps to submit a bug report?
qs.s: Reporting = testers cycle me app, website ya product ke baare me info submit karte hain. 4 methods: Bug Reports, Test Cases, App Reviews, Usability Studies. Bug report steps: 1) Verification ke liye bug recreate karo. 2) Reported issues check karke confirm karo bug unique hai. 3) Specific reporting instructions ke liye overview dekho. 4) Required attachments prepare karo (screenshots, browser logs, Charles Proxy log, etc.). 5) Test cycle header me Report Issue icon click. 6) Bug report form bharo, review karo aur submit.
qs.b: Testers report through bug reports, test cases, app reviews and usability studies.
