To submit a bug report, recreate the bug, confirm it is unique against reported issues, check the overview for reporting instructions, prepare attachments such as screenshots, browser logs or a Charles Proxy log, click Report Issue in the cycle header, then fill in, review and submit the form.
qs.t: Recreate, Unique, Overview, Attach, Report, Review.

qs.q: What are the steps to submit a test case in a cycle?
qs.s: 1) Saare test case steps karo aur required attachments upload karo. 2) Step me bug nahi mila to Pass click. 3) Bug mila to Fail click. Agar bug pehle doosre tester ne report kiya hai to uska id Actual Result field me daalo aur Fail click. Agar report nahi hua to Fail & Report Issue click, issue report form bharo aur submit. 4) Steps review karo, sab sahi hai ensure karo. 5) Submit Results click, spent time specify karo aur Finish click. 6) Test case pe TTL ka message aaya ho to padho aur jaldi respond karo.
qs.b: Execute every step and upload the required attachments, clicking Pass when no bug is found and Fail when one is. If the bug is already reported, put its ID in the Actual Result field and click Fail; otherwise click Fail & Report Issue and submit a report. Then review the steps, click Submit Results, enter the time spent, click Finish, and respond quickly to any TTL messages.
qs.t: Already reported = ID Actual Result me; naya = Fail & Report Issue.

qs.q: How do you submit a review and a usability study?
qs.s: Review: 1) Bugs report karne ke baad Review tab kholke product ka review likho. 2) Feedback complete ho, saare fields me full, clear sentences hon taaki customer ke liye helpful ho. Usability Study: 1) Requirements dhyan se padho - overview, slots tab ya slot description me. 2) Saare survey questions ke robust answers do. 3) Saare videos me complete narration do. 4) Khatam hone pe Study Complete button click karke submit. 5) Required screenshots ya videos upload karo.
qs.b: After reporting bugs, open the Review tab and write a complete review with full, clear sentences in every field. For a usability study, read the requirements in the overview, slots tab or slot description, give robust answers to all survey questions, fully narrate all videos, click Study Complete, and upload the required screenshots or videos.
qs.t: Usability = robust answers + full narration.

qs.q: What are the communication channels in a test cycle and how should the Test Cycle Chat be used?
qs.s: 4 main types: Test Cycle Chat, the platform Project Chat Channel, Tester Messenger, E-mail. Test Cycle Chat: the platform project se related questions ka key method; Top Navigation Bar me chat icon ya the platform chat site. Karna hai: sirf us cycle se related questions - cycle scope, test case steps, cycle related problems, blockers; professional tone (customers chat dekh sakte hain); naya message bhejne se pehle previous messages me answer dekho; sirf English; message se pehle the platform Terms of Use aur Guidelines follow karo. Nahi karna: payouts ke baare me poochhna; TTL/TE ya customer ko issues review/approve karne bolna; rejected issues dispute karna; rejected issues discuss karna; rude/unprofessional hona; attention ke liye All caps. Privacy ya complicated question ho to TTL se private message bhejne bolo; TE ko escalate karna ho to Team Contact Information me escalation rules dekho.
qs.b: The four channels are the Test Cycle Chat, the platform Project Chat Channel, the Tester Messenger and email. In the cycle chat, ask only cycle-related questions about scope, test case steps, problems or blockers, keep a professional tone because customers can see it, check earlier messages first and use English only. Do not ask about payouts, request approvals, dispute or discuss rejected issues, be rude, or write in all caps.
qs.t: Chat me payout aur dispute nahi.

qs.q: How do tagging, mention notifications and search work in the cycle chat?
qs.s: Tagging: tester aur TTL @testername se kisi ko mention kar sakte hain; sirf us person ko naam highlighted dikhega aur notification milega. Tester @ttl use karke TTLs ko mention kar sakta hai; sirf us cycle ke assigned TTLs ko highlight aur notification. TTL @all use karke sabko mention kar sakta hai; sirf cycle join kiye users ko highlight aur notification. Red notification: @yourname mention hone pe red dot me number dikhega. Search: 1) cycle chat room kholo. 2) Header me cycle name ke paas Search textbox. 3) Word/phrase type karke Enter ya Search button. 4) Kam se kam 2 matching results hon to results ka number dikhega. 5) Matching results chat me orange highlight. 6) Next/Previous buttons se move. 7) Koi match nahi to 'No messages found'. Note: sirf exact matches orange highlight aur next/previous se scroll; partial matches bold dikhte hain, orange nahi.
qs.b: Testers and TTLs can mention someone with @testername, testers can notify the cycle's TTLs with @ttl, and only TTLs can use @all to notify everyone who joined the cycle; mentions appear as a number in a red dot. Chat search highlights exact matches in orange with next and previous buttons, shows partial matches in bold, displays a count when there are at least two matches, and shows No messages found when nothing matches.
qs.t: @all sirf TTL; exact = orange, partial = bold.

qs.q: How do threaded messages and chat reactions work?
qs.s: Threaded messages: chat me kisi message ka direct reply. Three dots icon > reply; thread section chat ke right side; reply field me type karke Enter ya Reply button; message ke neeche Reply/Replies link dikhega; link click karke thread kholo. Chat Reactions: preset reactions - thumbs up, thumbs down, check mark, cross mark, eyes, +1. Bina full response type kiye confirm/acknowledge, quick survey, aur same messages repeat karne se bachne ke liye. Use: 1) message pe right side three dots. 2) reaction select. 3) aapka reaction blue bubble me, doosron ka gray. 4) menu se dobara select karne pe hat jata hai. 5) kisi aur ke reaction pe click karne se count 1 badhta hai, dobara click se hat jata hai. Kitne logon ne react kiya dikhta hai par naam nahi; sirf TTL, TE ya TSM naam aur timestamp dekh sakte hain. Main benefit: chat ka clutter kam.
qs.b: Threaded messages let you reply directly to a message through the three-dots menu, opening a thread on the right with a Reply or Replies link under the original. Chat reactions offer thumbs up, thumbs down, check mark, cross mark, eyes and +1 to acknowledge messages without typing; your reaction shows in blue and others in gray. Testers see only the count, while the TTL, TE or TSM can see names and timestamps, and the main benefit is less chat clutter.
qs.t: Apna reaction blue, doosron ka gray; naam sirf staff dekhe.

qs.q: When and how should you send a private message to the TTL?
qs.s: Private message feature TTLs aur testers ko cycle chat me privately baat karne deta hai; online users list me top pe green power icon ke saath. Mainly testers TTL ko issues escalate karne ke liye use karte hain. Pehle permission maango - questions/general room me TTL ko message karo, TTL conversation initiate karega. Questions hamesha general room me poocho; PM sirf sensitive matters ke liye jo chat room me discuss nahi ho sakte. Examples: doosre tester ka misbehavior report karna - placeholder issue report karna, doosre tester ka issue copy karna, jaan-boojh ke saare required attachments na lagana, slots preserve karne ke liye sheet ke saare cells me apna naam bharna, customer ka naam cycle ke bahar expose karna, aur the platform Guidelines ke against conduct. Steps: 1) cycle chat room kholo. 2) @TTL tag karke PM ki permission maango. 3) TTL confirm kare to woh aapko contact me add karne ki request bhejega. 4) Accept: Pending Test Cycles section ke neeche Contacts section kholo, TTL ke naam ke paas green checkmark click. 5) TTL ke conversation initiate karne ka wait. 6) Contacts section ya In Room section me TTL ke naam pe click karke PM kholo. 7) Message type karke Enter ya Send. 8) Recipient online hona chahiye.
qs.b: Private messages are mainly for escalating sensitive matters to the TTL, such as another tester submitting placeholder issues, copying issues, withholding attachments, filling a sheet with their name to hold slots or exposing the customer's name. Ask permission first by tagging @TTL in the general room; the TTL sends a contact request, which you accept with the green checkmark in the Contacts section, and then waits to initiate the conversation. The recipient must be online for the message to be sent.
qs.t: PM = pehle permission, sirf sensitive baat.

qs.q: What are the Project Chat Channel and the Messages tab?
qs.s: Project Chat Channel: Customer Operations team ko third-party tools ke bina community testers se project work pe baat karne deta hai. Purpose: projects aksar multiple cycles me chalte hain ya launch se pehle coordination chahiye; ye kisi specific cycle ke bahar project communication facilitate karta hai. Kahan: invited testers ko the platform chat left navigation me Active Test Cycle section ke upar Projects section me milta hai. Messages Tab: issue reports, test cases aur reviews ke andar TTLs, TEs, TSMs ya customers se baat karne ke liye. TTL, TE, TSM ya customer message bhejke initiate karta hai; tester ko email notification milta hai. Professional raho. Galat reject hua issue dispute karna ho to Dispute feature use karo - Messages tab se kabhi dispute ya customer ko approve karne mat bolo. Reply steps: 1) the platform platform sign in. 2) Message wala issue report, test case ya review kholo. 3) Messages tab click (reviews ke liye Messages section). 4) New Message button. 5) Reply likho. 6) Add button click karke bhejo.
qs.b: The Project Chat Channel lets the Customer Operations team talk to testers about a project outside any single cycle, and invited testers find it in the Projects section above Active Test Cycles in the chat navigation. The Messages tab is used inside issue reports, test cases and reviews when a TTL, TE, TSM or customer starts a conversation; testers reply with New Message and Add. Disputes must go through the Dispute feature, never the Messages tab.
qs.t: Dispute = Dispute feature, Messages tab nahi.

qs.q: When should you use email and when should you contact the TE or TSM?
qs.s: Email sirf tab: urgent (jaise chat access nahi ho raha ya slot claim karte waqt error), sensitive (doosre tester ka misbehavior ya payout issues), ya cycle chat me timely response nahi mila aur Team Contact Information me TE/TSM ko email escalate karna mentioned hai. TEs aur TSMs busy hote hain, reply me time lag sakta hai. Cycle related questions pehle TE ko; mentioned timeframe me reply na mile to message forward karke TSM ko escalate. Emails Team Contact Information section me. TE/TSM ko contact karo jab: tester misconduct ka shak - doosre ka kaam copy karna, placeholder issues, multiple accounts; payout issue; customer se communication problem (customer issue reports me messages bheje); active cycle ka sensitive question; chat me question 24 hours se zyada unanswered; Team Contact Information ke timeframe me reply nahi mila. Contact MAT karo jab: issue reject hua aur explanation chahiye (valid lage ya reason se disagree ho to Dispute Rejection use karo); cycle scope/instructions ka question (cycle chat use karo); general the platform question jaise issue report kaise submit (Academy courses dekho). Email format: subject me test cycle ID + short description; body me issue brief aur precise, saari info; professional aur polite.
qs.b: Email is only for urgent matters like chat access or slot errors, sensitive matters like misconduct or payouts, or when chat gets no timely reply and the Team Contact Information allows escalation. Cycle questions go to the TE first and to the TSM if there is no reply in the stated timeframe, for example misconduct, payout problems, customer communication problems, or a chat question unanswered for more than 24 hours. Do not email them about rejections, which use Dispute Rejection, scope questions, which go to the cycle chat, or general the platform questions; put the cycle ID and a short description in the subject.
qs.t: Pehle TE, phir TSM; subject me Cycle ID.

qs.q: What are the communication best practices in a cycle?
qs.s: Cycle ki saari instructions padho aur cycle se related doubts cycle chat me poocho. Message bhejne se pehle the platform Terms of Use follow karo, Terms of Use aur Guidelines rules mat todo. Noise mat karo - query bhejne se pehle saare threads check karo taaki same question repeat na ho. Payout related questions cycle chat ya message tab me mat poocho - project managers ko direct karo. Hamesha professional raho aur sabki respect karo.
qs.b: Read all cycle instructions and ask cycle-related doubts in the cycle chat, follow the platform Terms of Use and Guidelines, and check existing threads before asking to avoid noise. Payout questions should not go in the cycle chat or Messages tab but to the project managers, and communication should always be professional and respectful.
qs.t: Payout ka sawaal = project managers ko.

qs.q: What are Tester Emails and how do you reply to them?
qs.s: Internal emailing functionality jisse Testing Services aur Community Management members bina aapka email address expose kiye directly baat karte hain - upcoming/active invited cycle, Special Requirements Survey (SRS), ya aur cheezon ke liye. Email me banner: DIRECT MESSAGE FROM THE TESTING SERVICES TEAM. From field me sender Tester Emails, address tester-emails@the platform website. Reply ke 2 options: Reply Directly - email me Reply button, response seedha sender ko, same thread me rehta hai, zyada efficient. Contact via Email - naya email compose karo, TE/TSM ya CM ka email signature se (agar diya ho) ya header ke Reply-to field se; naya thread banega, isliye subject me related cycle ya SRS info daalo. (Example image me tha - skip.) Advanced Settings: aise emails nahi chahiye to Advanced Settings > Email Preferences > Emails from Testing Services ko Off. Off karne se Tester Emails functionality se bahar ho jaoge aur project related communication aur naye projects ki recruitment nahi milegi.
qs.b: Tester Emails let Testing Services and Community Management contact testers about cycles or Special Requirements Surveys without exposing email addresses; they carry a DIRECT MESSAGE FROM THE TESTING SERVICES TEAM banner and come from tester-emails@the platform website. You can reply directly to keep the same thread, or write a new email to the TE, TSM or CM with the cycle or SRS info in the subject. Turning off Emails from Testing Services in Advanced Settings stops project communication and recruitment for new projects.
qs.t: tester-emails@the platform website; Off kiya to naye projects ka recruitment band.

qs.q: What happens at the end of a test cycle?
qs.s: Test Cycle Lock: cycle ka time limit poora hone pe cycle end aur lock hoti hai; lock ke baad naye bug reports ya test cases submit nahi ho sakte. Lock ke baad bhi testers kar sakte hain: apne submitted bug reports edit, submitted test cases edit, test cycle chat me questions poochna. Review: submitted bug reports, test cases aur reviews cycle lock hone ke 15 din ke andar review hote hain. 15 din se zyada ho gaye aur review nahi hua to overview ki contact information se cycle staff se contact karo. Test Cycle Close: saari submissions review ho jayein aur results customer ko bhej diye jayein to cycle close; closed cycle me kuch nahi kar sakte, sirf details dekh sakte ho.
qs.b: When the time limit is reached the cycle locks, and no new bug reports or test cases can be submitted, though testers can still edit their submitted bug reports and test cases and ask questions in the chat. Submissions are reviewed within 15 days of the lock, and if not, testers should contact the cycle staff using the overview's contact information. Once everything is reviewed and results are sent to the customer the cycle closes and can only be viewed.
qs.t: Lock ke baad 15 din me review; Close = sirf dekho.

topics.intro: Test cycle ke terms, roles, statuses, MFA, invitation, tabs, reporting, communication aur cycle ke end tak ka poora flow.

topics.name: Slots, Test Cases and Reviews

qs.q: What is a slot in a the platform test cycle?
qs.s: Slot ek testing reservation hai test cycle ke andar, jiske saath specific requirements aati hain - jaise location, language, device, OS, payment method, ya koi particular setup. Jab tester slot claim karta hai, to use testing exactly un requirements ke hisaab se karni hoti hai jo slot me listed hain. Important: slot claim karne se pehle uski requirements hamesha padho; agar sab meet nahi kar sakte to slot claim mat karo. Zyada tar test cycles slots use karte hain. Simple bhasha me - slot batata hai ki cycle me testing ya linked test case execute karte waqt kaunsa environment aur conditions use karni hain.
qs.b: A slot is a testing reservation within a test cycle that comes with specific requirements such as location, language, device, OS, payment method or a particular setup. Once I claim a slot, I must test exactly according to those requirements. I always review the slot requirements before claiming, and if I cannot meet all of them, I do not claim it.
qs.t: Slot = reservation + requirements; meet nahi kar sakte to claim nahi.

qs.q: What is the difference between a slot and a test case?
qs.s: Slot define karta hai testing ke liye requirements aur environment. Test case ek series of steps aur instructions hai jo tester follow karta hai ye verify karne ke liye ki app/website expected tarike se kaam kar rahi hai ya nahi. Example: agar slot me likha hai - tester US me located ho aur iOS 17 device use kare - to sirf wahi tester claim kare jo dono conditions meet karta ho, aur testing strictly iOS 17 device pe hi ho. Cycle ke hisaab se slot me Exploratory Testing ho sakti hai ya Test Case Testing (agar slot ek ya zyada test cases se linked hai).
qs.b: A slot defines the requirements and environment for testing, while a test case is a series of steps and instructions used to verify that the app or website works as expected. For example, if a slot requires a US-based tester on an iOS 17 device, only testers meeting both conditions should claim it and the testing must be done strictly on iOS 17. Depending on the cycle, a slot may involve exploratory testing or test case testing.
qs.t: Slot = kahan/kis pe test karna; Test case = kya steps karne.

qs.q: What are the types of slots on the platform?
qs.s: Teen types: (1) Test Case slots - ek ya zyada test cases se linked. Isme do variants: Single Test Case linked to a single slot (claim karoge to ek test case milega) aur Multiple Test Cases linked to a single slot (claim karoge to saare linked test cases assign honge aur sab allotted time me finish aur submit karne honge). (2) Exploratory slots - jab koi matching Test Case slot available na ho tab cycle join karne dete hain; koi test case nahi milta, sirf exploratory testing karni hoti hai. Inhe do cheezon se pehchano: Test Case column me 'Exploratory' likha hota hai, aur Payout column me fixed payout nahi balki 'Per Bug' dikhta hai - matlab sirf approved issues ka paisa milega. (3) Usability Studies - Usability cycle me participate karne ke liye slots.
qs.b: There are three types of slots. Test Case slots are linked to one or more test cases, and if multiple test cases are linked, I must finish and submit all of them within the allotted time. Exploratory slots let me join a cycle when no matching test case slot is available; they show 'Exploratory' in the Test Case column and 'Per Bug' in the Payout column, so I am paid only for approved issues. Usability Studies slots are used to participate in Usability cycles.
qs.t: TEU: Test Case, Exploratory (Per Bug), Usability.

qs.q: What are the important rules regarding slots?
qs.s: Slots ke important points: (1) Slots limited hain aur first come first serve basis pe milte hain. (2) Slots ki alag requirements hoti hain jaise specific devices, location, language, payment method etc. (3) Claim se pehle poora slot description expand karke padho aur confirm karo ki requirements meet karte ho aur specified environment use karoge. (4) Matching environment nahi hai to claim mat karo, aur slot claim karne ke liye fake environment add mat karo. (5) Test cases wala slot claim kiya to us slot ke saare test cases time pe complete karne honge - warna agar zyada tar submit kar diye par ek bhi miss hua to slot approve nahi hoga, aur isliye koi bhi test case approve nahi hoga. (6) Agar test case slots available nahi hain to Exploratory slot claim karke exploratory testing kar sakte ho.
qs.b: Slots are limited and first come, first served, and each has its own requirements such as device, location, language or payment method. I must read the full slot description, never claim without a matching environment, and never add fake environments. If I claim a slot with test cases, all of them must be completed on time, because missing even one means the slot and none of its test cases get approved. If no test case slots are available, I can claim an exploratory slot.
qs.t: Ek test case miss = poora slot reject.

qs.q: How do you access the Slots page and what sections does it have?
qs.s: Test cycle invite milne ke baad pehle cycle invitation accept karni padti hai: (1) cycle overview padho, (2) neeche scroll karke 'Accept Cycle & Claim a Slot' button click karo, (3) Slots page automatically khul jayega. Agar invitation accept kiye bina Slots tab pe gaye to slot claim nahi kar paoge - wapas overview pe jaake instructions padh ke accept karna hoga. Pehle se accept kiya hai to cycle ke Slots tab se page khulega. Sections: Slot Instructions (poore cycle ke general slotting instructions - claim se pehle padho aur samjho), Available Slots (jo claim ho sakte hain), Claimed Slots (jo tumne claim kiye), Unclaimed Slots (jo pehle claim kiye the aur ab unclaimed hain). Sections heading pe click karke expand/collapse hote hain. Search field se slot ko description se filter kar sakte ho.
qs.b: After being invited, I read the cycle overview and click 'Accept Cycle & Claim a Slot', which opens the Slots page; without accepting the invitation I cannot claim a slot. The Slots page has Slot Instructions for the whole cycle, Available Slots, Claimed Slots and Unclaimed Slots, each expandable by clicking its heading. There is also a Search field to filter slots by description.
qs.t: Pehle Accept, phir Claim; 4 sections - Instructions, Available, Claimed, Unclaimed.

qs.q: What columns are shown in the slots table?
qs.s: Slots table ke columns: (1) Slot Description - slot ki info; click karke full description aur linked test cases dekho. Isme Preview link hota hai jisse test case pehle se review kar sakte ho taaki confirm ho ki requirements samajh aaye aur allocated time me realistically complete kar paoge. (2) Deadline - slot ke saare test cases complete aur submit karne ki time limit. (3) Test Case(s) - kitne test cases linked hain; Exploratory slots me koi test case nahi, sirf '0 Exploratory' dikhta hai. (4) Payout - slot ke saare test cases ka payout sum; Exploratory slots me payout nahi, 'Per Bug' caption dikhta hai (approved bug reports ke hisaab se pay). (5) Effort - saare linked test cases complete karne ka required time. (6) Slots Remaining - total claims me se kitne free slots bache hain. (7) Waitlist Available - jo slots claim limit pe pahunch gaye unke liye kitni waitlist available hai allowed me se; waitlist sirf tab hai jab cycle me feature enabled ho.
qs.b: The slots table shows Slot Description with a Preview link, Deadline for completing and submitting all test cases, Test Case(s) count, Payout as the sum across the slot's test cases, Effort as the time required, Slots Remaining, and Waitlist Available. Exploratory slots show '0 Exploratory' in the Test Case column and 'Per Bug' in the Payout column. The waitlist column only applies when the feature is enabled in the cycle.
qs.t: D-D-T-P-E-S-W: Description, Deadline, Test cases, Payout, Effort, Slots remaining, Waitlist.

qs.q: What do you see in the Claimed Slots table?
qs.s: Slot claim karne ke baad Claimed Slots section expand ho jata hai; har slot pe click karke details dekho. Start Testing button - matlab linked test case me abhi koi progress nahi; click karne se test case (ya multiple ho to pehla test case) khulta hai. Progress hone ke baad button 'Resume Testing' ban jata hai aur jis test case pe kaam chal raha hai wo khulta hai. Test cases complete aur submit ho gaye to button gray out aur disabled ho jata hai. Credentials column - testing account ke credentials jo tumhe diye gaye; na diye hon to field empty. Environments - jo environment slot claim karte waqt select kiya tha.
qs.b: In the Claimed Slots table, the Start Testing button means no progress has been made yet; it changes to Resume Testing once I have progress, and becomes grayed out and disabled after all test cases are submitted. The Credentials column shows any test account credentials provided, or is empty if none. The Environments column shows the environment I selected when claiming the slot.
qs.t: Start -> Resume -> Grey (submitted).

qs.q: How do you claim a slot?
qs.s: Steps: (1) Cycle invitation kholo aur overview dhyan se padho. (2) Neeche scroll karke 'Accept Cycle & Claim a Slot' click karo. (3) Slot pe click karke expand karo aur claim se pehle poora description padho. Preview link se test case pehle se review karo - ye option sirf test case linked slots me hai, exploratory slots me nahi dikhta. (4) Claim button click karo us available slot ke liye jiske liye tum qualify karte ho aur sure ho ki time pe complete kar loge. Slots tab pe Slot Instructions aur har slot ka description dono review karo. Agar cycle ek se zyada slot claim karne deti hai to pehle claimed slot finish karo, phir doosra claim karo (jiski requirement meet karte ho) Slots tab se.
qs.b: I open the invitation, read the overview, click 'Accept Cycle & Claim a Slot', expand the slot and read its entire description, using the Preview link for test case slots to confirm I can finish in time. Then I click Claim only for a slot I qualify for and can complete on time. If the cycle allows multiple slots, I finish the first claimed slot before claiming another.
qs.t: Read -> Accept -> Expand+Preview -> Claim; ek khatam phir agla.

qs.q: What are the additional notes on claiming and keeping slots, including native apps and unclaim rules?
qs.s: Claiming notes (Lesson 3): Mobile native app products (scope Android ya iOS app) me slot claim ya issue report karte waqt environment me 'Native (No mobile browser)' wala option chuno; browser wala mat chuno kyunki website test nahi kar rahe. Website test kar rahe ho to sahi browser chuno. Test case slot claim karne pe test case page automatically khulta hai; claimed slot Slots tab ke Claimed Slots me aur assigned test case Test Cases tab me milega. Slot ke saare test cases time pe complete karne hain - ek bhi submit nahi kiya to slot approve nahi, koi test case approve nahi. Time pe sab submit nahi kar sakte to slot unclaim karna hoga. Agar koi linked test case submit ho chuka hai to unclaim impossible - pehle saare submitted cases unsubmit karo. Agar slot ka ek test case time ki wajah se auto unclaim hua to us slot ke saare test cases unclaim ho jayenge. Exploratory slot claim karne se koi test case assign nahi hota. Time pe complete nahi kar sakte to claim mat karo, warna unclaim ho jayega.
qs.b: For native mobile apps I select the environment ending in 'Native (No mobile browser)', and for websites I select the correct browser. Claiming a test case slot opens the test case automatically, and it appears in the Test Cases tab. If I cannot submit all test cases on time I must unclaim the slot, but I first need to unsubmit any submitted case, and if one linked test case is auto-unclaimed for time, all of them are unclaimed.
qs.t: App = Native (No mobile browser); submitted hai to pehle unsubmit, phir unclaim.

qs.q: What is a test case and how do you start executing one?
qs.s: Test case required steps ki series hai jo testers product test karne ke liye follow karte hain; har step me instructions aur expected results ho sakte hain - isse bina prior knowledge ke bhi product properly test hota hai. Execution: Step 1 - test case kholo aur instructions samjho. Unclear ho to cycle chat room me TTLs se poocho aur unke confirmation ka wait karo; guess karke ya randomly pass/fail karke aage mat badho. Good communication key hai, TTLs madad ke liye ready hain. Step 2 - preconditions check karo. Agar diye hain to 'Test Case Preconditions' section Slot Description ke neeche dikhega, warna nahi. Preconditions me device setup, initial instructions ya specific setup ho sakta hai; ignore kiya to results invalid ho sakte hain aur steps dobara karne padenge. Step 3 - pehle step se shuru karo (top to bottom), koi step skip mat karo. Step 4 - Slot Description me specified correct environment pe instructions follow karo.
qs.b: A test case is a series of required steps, each possibly with instructions and expected results, that lets testers properly test a product without prior knowledge of it. I start by understanding the instructions and asking the TTLs in the cycle chat if anything is unclear rather than guessing. I then check the Test Case Preconditions section under the Slot Description, and execute steps from top to bottom without skipping, in the environment specified in the slot.
qs.t: Samjho -> Preconditions -> Top to bottom -> Sahi environment.

qs.q: How do you mark test case steps as Pass, Fail or Done?
qs.s: Step 5: dekho step me expected results hain ya nahi. Hain to instructions follow karke actual vs expected compare karo. Match ho to step 'Pass'. Koi deviation ho to 'Fail' - Fail click karne pe pop-up khulta hai: agar issue pehle se reported hai to us issue ko confirm (+1) karo, issue ID Actual Result field me daalo aur 'Fail Step' select karo. Agar reported nahi hai to Actual Result field me chhota explanation likho aur 'Fail & Report Issue' button se issue report karo. Action Performed, Expected Result aur Actual Result fields ka prefilled text hata do. Saare required fields issue ke hisaab se sahi bharo aur cycle overview ke Issue Reporting Instructions section ko follow karo. Is tarike se report hue issues test case se linked ho jaate hain - test case steps se related unreported issues ke liye ye feature use karo. Step me expected results nahi hain to instructions follow karke step ko 'Done' mark karo.
qs.b: If a step has expected results, I mark it Pass when actual matches expected and Fail when there is any deviation. On Fail, if the issue is already reported I +1 it, add its issue ID to the Actual Result field and select Fail Step; otherwise I describe it briefly and use Fail & Report Issue, clearing the prefilled text and following the cycle's Issue Reporting Instructions, so the issue is linked to the test case. If a step has no expected results, I mark it Done.
qs.t: Expected hai: Pass/Fail; expected nahi: Done. Fail = reported hai to +1 + ID, nahi to Fail & Report Issue.

qs.q: How do you handle attachments and submission when executing a test case?
qs.s: Step 6: saare steps ek ek karke complete karo aur required attachments upload karo. Koi step incomplete ho to test case submit nahi hota. Har step me kya attachment chahiye check karo. Step screenshot maange to screenshot hi daalo, video nahi. Attachments me dikh rahi PII (Personally Identifiable Information) blur karo (PII course dekho). Video upload me file size error aaye to Handbrake se size kam karo. Har step me attachment zaroori nahi - step instructions aur 'Result Attachments' field ki instructions padho. Minimum required attachments 'Result Attachments' field ke neeche dikhte hain (e.g. Minimum 1). Ye nahi dikhta to attachments optional hain; relevant ho to daal sakte ho, par specific instruction nahi to zaroorat nahi. Step 7: sab complete hone pe 'Submit Results' click karo, time spent daalo, phir 'Finished' click karo. Step 8: edit karna ho to 'Undo Submission' se un-submit karo, galti fix karo, phir 'Submit Results' se wapas submit karo.
qs.b: I complete every step and upload only the required attachments, since a test case cannot be submitted with incomplete steps. If a step asks for a screenshot I upload a screenshot, I blur any PII, compress large videos with Handbrake, and check the minimum shown under Result Attachments; if no minimum is shown, attachments are optional. I submit with Submit Results, enter time spent and click Finished, and I can use Undo Submission to fix mistakes and resubmit.
qs.t: Minimum X dikhe to zaroori; Submit Results -> time -> Finished; galti ho to Undo Submission.

qs.q: What are the important points regarding test cases on the platform?
qs.s: Important points: (1) Test cases ka fixed payout hota hai; amount project, requirements, complexity aur lagne wale time pe depend karta hai. Note: Academy test cases ka payout nahi hota, wo training ke liye hain. (2) Test case steps specified environment (Device, OS aur browser combination) me hi execute karo, warna test case reject hoga. (3) Har failed step ke saath ek issue ID associated honi chahiye. (4) Test case tabhi claim karo jab turant execute karke specified time me complete kar sako. (5) Ek hi naam se multiple attachments upload mat karo; har attachment ka clear title ho jaise tested area, feature ya bug location. Cycle overview/test case me naming convention di ho to wahi follow karo. (6) Testers test cases likhte nahi, sirf execute karte hain.
qs.b: Test cases have a fixed payout that depends on the project, requirements, complexity and time, while Academy test cases have no payout. They must be executed in the specified device, OS and browser combination or they will be rejected, and every failed step must have an issue ID. I only claim test cases I can start right away, I give each attachment a clear unique name, and testers execute test cases rather than write them.
qs.t: Fixed pay, sahi env, fail = issue ID, unique attachment names, likhna nahi sirf chalana.

qs.q: What are the test case results on the platform platform?
qs.s: Test case result progress (submit se pehle) ya result (submit ke baad) batata hai. New - koi progress nahi, kisi step me Pass/Fail/Done select nahi hua. Started - progress hua par submit nahi; kisi bhi step me status select hua. Complete karke submit karo warna isi state me rahega aur compensation nahi milega, kyunki is state ke test cases ko TTL Pending/Approved/Rejected set nahi kar sakta; TTL messages ignore kiye to unclaim ho sakta hai. Passed - submit hua aur saare steps Pass; matlab koi issue nahi mila. Failed - submit hua aur ek ya zyada steps Fail; iska matlab ye nahi ki tum fail hue ya reject hoga, sirf result reflect karta hai. Completed - submit hua aur saare steps Done (koi step me expected results nahi the). Unclaimed - tester ya TTL ne unclaim kiya; brackets me reason category, jaise Unclaimed (Time) jab 'Cannot complete in time' chuna, ya Unclaimed (Blocked) jab 'Blocked' chuna. Deadline cross hone pe system ne auto unclaim kiya to sirf 'Unclaimed' dikhta hai. Unclaim reason Comments field me dikhta hai; clear reason do taaki TTL ya TE follow up kar sake. Unclear reason ya deadline miss karna future invitations ko affect kar sakta hai; urgent ho to chat room me batao. Closed By TestCycle - submit nahi hua aur cycle close ho gayi, to system ne unclaim kiya.
qs.b: The test case results are New, Started, Passed, Failed, Completed, Unclaimed and Closed By TestCycle. New means no step status selected, Started means progress but not submitted, Passed means all steps passed, Failed means one or more steps failed, which does not mean rejection, and Completed means all steps were Done. Unclaimed shows a reason such as Unclaimed (Time) or Unclaimed (Blocked), or just Unclaimed when the system auto-unclaims after the deadline, and Closed By TestCycle means it was never submitted before the cycle closed.
qs.t: N-S-P-F-C-U-C: New, Started, Passed, Failed, Completed, Unclaimed, Closed By TestCycle.

qs.q: What are the test case statuses on the platform?
qs.s: Status batata hai results pe kya decide hua; ye Test Cases tab ke Approval column me ya test case kholne pe Status section me dikhta hai. Pending - abhi approve ya reject nahi hua. Unclaimed test cases bhi Pending hote hain kyunki wo aage submit nahi ho sakte. Agar submitted test case edit nahi ho raha to matlab TTL ne review karke Pending (approval ya rejection ke liye) set kiya - final hone ka wait karo. Info Requested - TTL ne review kiya aur extra info chahiye ya galtiyan theek karni hain. Fix karo aur info do; ignore kiya to rejection aur compensation nahi. Time pe respond karo. Corrections ke baad 'Confirm all requested info is added' link click karo - status wapas Pending hoga aur TTLs ko notify hoga. Approved - review hua aur approve; payout milega (Academy test cases ka payout nahi). Rejected - review hua aur reject; compensation nahi milta. Comments field me rejection comment padho aur galti repeat mat karo.
qs.b: Test case statuses are Pending, Info Requested, Approved and Rejected, shown in the Approval column. Pending means not yet approved or rejected, and unclaimed test cases also show Pending. Info Requested means I must fix the test case, then click 'Confirm all requested info is added' to return it to Pending; ignoring it can lead to rejection. Approved test cases receive the payout, and Rejected test cases are not compensated, so I read the rejection comment to avoid repeating the mistake.
qs.t: PIAR: Pending, Info Requested, Approved, Rejected.

qs.q: What are the rules for attachments in a test case?
qs.s: Lesson 5: Test case step me attachment proof of testing ke liye lagta hai jab required ho. Common attachments: screenshots, videos aur logs. Sirf tab upload karo jab requirement ho; requirement nahi to kuch mat daalo. Step me jitna required hai utna hi daalo - kitne attachments chahiye ye step title ke paas dikhta hai. Best practices: video file badi ho to utility se compress karo - sabse aasaan Handbrake jaisa app. Hamesha check karo ki saare attachments successfully upload hue - har attachment kholo aur dekho kuch broken nahi.
qs.b: Attachments in test cases serve as proof of testing, commonly screenshots, videos and logs. I upload only what the step requires, and the required number is shown next to the step title. I compress large videos with a tool like Handbrake and open every attachment after upload to confirm nothing is broken.
qs.t: Jitna maanga utna; upload ke baad khol ke check.

qs.q: When and how can a test case be edited, including a Pending test case?
qs.s: Edit karne ke reasons: tester ko submit ke baad pata chala ki kuch miss hua, galat attachments diye ya galat step statuses chune; ya TTL/TE/customer ne more info maangi ya galti fix karne bola. Test case sirf in statuses me edit ho sakta hai: Pending aur Info Requested. Pending Test Case (jo TTL ne review/approve/reject nahi kiya) edit karne ke steps: (1) submitted test case kholo, (2) 'Undo Submission' click karo, (3) test case correct karo, (4) 'Submit Results' se resubmit karo. Unsubmitted chhoda to TTL ko pata nahi chalega ki test case complete, submitted aur TTL/customer review ke liye ready hai.
qs.b: A test case may need editing if I missed something, attached the wrong files or chose incorrect step statuses, or if the TTL, TE or customer asks for more information. It can be edited only in Pending or Info Requested status. For a Pending test case, I open it, click Undo Submission, correct it and resubmit with Submit Results, because leaving it unsubmitted means the TTL does not know it is ready.
qs.t: Edit sirf Pending/Info Requested me; Undo -> Fix -> Submit Results.

qs.q: How do you fix an Info Requested test case?
qs.s: Steps (Lesson 6): (1) TTL ya customer info maange to platform tester ko email bhejta hai. The platform Dashboard pe 'More Information Requested on Test Case' dialog box dikhta hai; 'View test case' button seedha us test case pe le jata hai. Alternatively Dashboard se cycle kholo, Test Cases tab, test case kholo. (2) Test case Description tab pe khulega; wahan 'Info Requested' panel (left me red bar) me TTL ka message hota hai ki kya correct karna hai. (3) Instructions dhyan se padho. (4) 'Undo Submission' click karo. (5) Test fix karo aur required info do. (6) 'Submit Results' se resubmit karo - unsubmitted chhoda to TTL ko pata nahi chalega aur approve nahi ho payega. (7) Total time spent do. (8) 'Finished' click karo. (9) Test case dobara kholo aur Info Requested section ke neeche 'Confirm all requested information is added' link click karo - isse TTL aur customer alert hote hain aur status Info Requested se Pending ho jata hai.
qs.b: I get an email and a 'More Information Requested on Test Case' box on the Dashboard, and the View test case button takes me to it. I read the Info Requested panel with the red bar, click Undo Submission, make the fixes, click Submit Results, enter the time spent and click Finished. Finally I reopen the test case and click 'Confirm all requested information is added', which alerts the TTL and customer and moves the status back to Pending.
qs.t: Red bar padho -> Undo -> Fix -> Submit -> Time -> Finished -> Confirm link.

qs.q: When can a test case NOT be edited?
qs.s: Test case edit nahi ho sakta jab: (1) Unclaimed - tester ya TTL ne kisi reason se slot unclaim kiya, ya time pe complete aur submit na karne pe slot automatically unclaim hua. (2) Pending for approval or rejection - TTL ne review karke pending approval ya rejection set kar diya. (3) Rejected - review hokar reject ho gaya. (4) Approved - review hokar approve ho gaya.
qs.b: A test case cannot be edited when it is Unclaimed, whether by the tester, the TTL or automatically after missing the deadline, when it has been reviewed and set to pending approval or rejection by the TTL, or when it has been Rejected or Approved.
qs.t: UPRA: Unclaimed, Pended by TTL, Rejected, Approved = lock.

qs.q: How do you see and reply to messages on a test case?
qs.s: TTL, TE ya customer test case pe seedha message bhej sakte hain sawal ya clarification ke liye. Notification: email aata hai, the platform Dashboard pe 'New Message on Test Case' section/pop-up me message content dikhta hai, aur the platform App installed hai to app notification. Email me 'Sign in to respond to the message' link test case kholta hai. Dashboard pe 'Reply' button test case pe le jata hai aur Messages tab automatically khulta hai. 'Discard' button dashboard se notification hata deta hai; Messages tab kholne se bhi notification hat jata hai. Reply steps (Lesson 7): (1) Dashboard se cycle kholo, Test Cases tab select karo. (2) Test case kholo aur Messages tab pe jao - Messages tab nahi dikh raha to matlab TTL ne koi message nahi bheja. (3) 'New Message' click karo. (4) Reply type karo - correct, professional aur mistake-free. (5) 'Add' button click karke bhejo.
qs.b: When a TTL, TE or customer messages a test case, I get an email, a 'New Message on Test Case' notification on the Dashboard and an app notification if I use the platform app. The Reply button opens the test case directly on the Messages tab, and Discard removes the notification. To reply, I open the test case, go to the Messages tab, click New Message, write a professional reply and click Add.
qs.t: Messages tab -> New Message -> Add; tab nahi dikha = koi message nahi.

qs.q: What are the steps to respond to an info request on a test case (Lesson 8)?
qs.s: Info request ki notification: email, the platform Dashboard pe Test Cases ke 'More Information Requested' section me message, aur mobile app notification (agar app installed). Email me 'Sign in to the platform to add the requested information to the test case result' link test case kholta hai; Dashboard pe 'View test case' button bhi. 13 steps: (1) Dashboard se cycle kholo, Test Cases tab. (2) Jis test case pe info maangi wo kholo. (3) Upar padho kya info chahiye. (4) Instructions dhyan se samjho. (5) 'Undo Submission' click karo. (6) Us step tak scroll karo jo fix karna hai. (7) Step(s) update karo. (8) 'Submit Results' click karo. (9) Total time spent do. (10) 'Finished' click karo. (11) Test case dobara kholo, Info Requested section ke neeche 'Confirm all requested information is added' link click karo - TTL aur customer alert, status Info Requested se Pending. (12) Comment field me info request message ka response likho. (13) 'Send Response' click karo. Info Requested panel Description tab me left side red bar ke saath dikhta hai.
qs.b: I am notified by email, the 'More Information Requested' section on the Dashboard and the mobile app. I open the test case, read what is required, click Undo Submission, update the relevant steps, click Submit Results, enter time spent and click Finished. Then I reopen it, click 'Confirm all requested information is added' to move it back to Pending, write a reply in the comment field and click Send Response.
qs.t: Fix + Submit + Confirm link + Send Response - char cheezein.

qs.q: How do you unclaim a slot?
qs.s: Steps: (1) Cycle ke Test Cases tab pe jao. (2) Jis slot ko unclaim karna hai uska test case kholo. (3) Agar submit kiya hai to Unsubmit button click karo - slot multiple test cases se linked hai to saare linked test cases unsubmit karo. (4) Cycle ke Slots tab pe jao. (5) 'Unclaim' button click karo. (6) Unclaim ka reason batao. (7) Confirm karne ke liye 'Unclaim' button click karo. Notes: slot unclaim karne se uske saare linked test cases bhi unclaim ho jaate hain. Koi linked test case submitted hai to unclaim possible nahi - pehle sab unsubmit karo. Ek linked test case time ki wajah se auto unclaim hua to saare linked test cases unclaim ho jayenge.
qs.b: To unclaim a slot I open its test cases, unsubmit any that were submitted, go to the Slots tab, click Unclaim, specify the reason and confirm. Unclaiming a slot unclaims all its linked test cases, it is not possible while any linked test case is submitted, and if one linked test case is auto-unclaimed for time, all of them are unclaimed.
qs.t: Unsubmit sab -> Slots tab -> Unclaim + reason.

qs.q: What are the best practices for completing slots and test cases on time?
qs.s: Completing test cases on time: cycle aur slot instructions claim se pehle review karo. Sirf tab claim karo jab requirements meet karte ho - galat setup/environment wale slots reject ya TTL dwara unclaim ho sakte hain. Sirf tab claim karo jab complete karne ka time ho; baad ke liye test case 'save' karne ke liye claim mat karo. Linked test cases specified time me finish karo warna slot unclaim hoga aur doosre tester ke liye khul jayega. Kuch unexpected ho ya time pe complete na ho sake to turant unclaim karo aur cycle chat me TTL ko batao. Time pe complete na karna tester rating ko negatively affect karta hai aur future invitations pe asar dalta hai - jaise test case bahut der hold karke cycle end se pehle unclaim karna, ya TTL ko unclaim karna pade kyunki tester ne lambe time se shuru nahi kiya. Do not keep your test case idle: jaldi shuru karo; technical difficulties ya clarification ke liye time milta hai; kabhi results customers ko jaldi deliver karne hote hain - der se delivery aur customer ka trust kam hota hai.
qs.b: I review the cycle and slot instructions, claim only slots I meet the requirements for and have time to complete, and never claim to save a test case for later. If something unexpected happens I unclaim immediately and notify the TTL in the cycle chat. Not completing on time hurts my tester rating and future invitations, so I start test cases as soon as possible, which also leaves time for technical issues and clarifications.
qs.t: Claim = abhi karna hai; idle mat chhodo.

qs.q: What are the best practices on environment, execution and other details for test cases?
qs.s: Always use the correct environment: matching environment ho tabhi slot/test case claim karo; claim karte waqt sahi environment chuno; matching environment nahi to claim mat karo aur fake environment add mat karo; test case sirf specified environment pe execute karo; galat environment me execute kiya to test case reject hoga. Execution: har step fairly karo aur required attachments do; kisi step ke baare me kuch batana ho to comments use karo; har failed step ke saath bug associated ho. Additional Information: info request messages ka jaldi jawab do; bahut badi attachments mat lagao, pehle compress karo; complete hone ke baad hamesha 'Submit Results' se submit karo - submit nahi hue test cases TTL Pending/Approved/Rejected set nahi kar sakta aur sirf approved test cases payout ke eligible hain; time spent ki accurate info do.
qs.b: I only claim with a matching environment, select it correctly and execute only in it, since the wrong environment leads to rejection. I perform every step fairly, add comments where needed and ensure each failed step has an associated bug. I respond to info requests quickly, compress large attachments, always click Submit Results because unsubmitted test cases cannot be reviewed and only approved ones are paid, and report accurate time spent.
qs.t: Sahi env, fail = bug, submit zaroor, time sach.

qs.q: How does the Slot Waitlist feature work?
qs.s: Slot waitlist se testers un slots ki waitlist join kar sakte hain jo claim limit pe pahunch gaye. Slot dobara khulne pe notification: email, the platform mobile app pe push notification, aur tester platform pe notification. 'Join Waitlist' button se join karo. Ek tester kitni waitlists join kar sakta hai uski limit hai - limit pe button disabled/grayed out ho jata hai aur naya join karne pe message aata hai. Chhodna ho to 'Leave Waitlist'. Har waitlist me testers ki bhi limit hai - full hone pe 'Join Waitlist' disabled; koi chhode to spot khulta hai aur koi bhi eligible tester join kar sakta hai. Sirf wo testers join kar sakte hain jinke paas test case slot nahi hai - test case slot claim kiya hai to button disabled. Waitlist join karke test case slot claim kiya to saari joined waitlists se remove ho jaoge. Exploratory slot wale testers join kar sakte hain kyunki Exploratory slot test case se linked nahi. Claim khulne pe waitlist walon ko limited time milta hai claim karne ka (exclusivity period); us dauraan the platform pe aane pe slot row highlighted dikhti hai. Is period me waitlist se kisi ne claim nahi kiya to cycle ka koi bhi eligible tester claim kar sakta hai, waitlist se bahar wale bhi.
qs.b: The Slot Waitlist lets testers join a waitlist for slots that have reached their claim limit, and they are notified by email, mobile push and on the platform when a claim opens. There are limits on how many waitlists a tester can join and how many testers each waitlist holds. Only testers without a test case slot can join, exploratory slot holders are still eligible, and claiming a test case slot removes me from all waitlists. Waitlisted testers get a limited exclusivity period with a highlighted row, after which any eligible tester can claim.
qs.t: Test case slot hai to waitlist nahi; Exploratory chalega; pehle waitlist ko exclusive time.

qs.q: What other notes apply to the Slot Waitlist feature?
qs.s: Other notes: (1) Waitlist settings cycle ke saare slots pe apply hoti hain, kisi specific slot ke liye customize nahi hoti. (2) Jo tester waitlist join karta hai par koi aur slot claim nahi karta, wo officially cycle join hua nahi maana jata jab cycle join karne ke liye slot claim zaroori ho - isliye Exploratory slots hain to cycle join karne ke liye Exploratory slot claim karo. (3) Fairness ke liye ye dekhna impossible hai ki waitlist me kaun testers hain; sirf Available slots se kitne testers join hue ye dikhta hai. (4) Testing Services team waitlist se specific tester choose nahi kar sakti - isse fairness khatam hogi. (5) Waitlist eligibility me slot criteria consider hote hain; criteria badle to jo waitlisted testers ab match nahi karte wo remove honge aur notify kiye jayenge.
qs.b: Waitlist settings apply to all slots in a cycle and cannot be customized per slot. Joining a waitlist alone does not count as officially joining a cycle that requires a slot, so I would claim an exploratory slot if available. For fairness, nobody can see who is on a waitlist, only how many, and the Testing Services team cannot pick a tester from it. If slot criteria change, testers who no longer match are removed and notified.
qs.t: Waitlist = join cycle nahi; kaun hai dikhta nahi, kitne dikhte hain.

qs.q: What is the Slot Claim Criteria feature?
qs.s: Slot criteria ensure karte hain ki sirf requirement meet karne wale testers hi slot claim kar sakein. Jo tester requirement meet nahi karta use 'Available Slots' section me wo slot dikhega hi nahi. Tester Profile updated aur sahi info ke saath rakho; profile me koi info falsify mat karo jaise location, ya aise devices/services add mat karo jo tumhare paas nahi. Criteria cycle ke dauraan badal sakte hain - jo testers ab match nahi karte unhe slot Available Slots me nahi dikhega; jo updated criteria match karte hain unhe dikhega agar claims bache hain.
qs.b: Slot claim criteria ensure only testers who meet the requirements can claim a slot, and others will not even see it in Available Slots. That is why my Tester Profile must be accurate, without falsified location or devices I do not own. Criteria can change during a cycle, so testers who no longer match lose visibility while newly matching testers see it if claims remain.
qs.t: Profile sach = sahi slots dikhenge.

qs.q: What is the Slot Credentials feature?
qs.s: Slot Credentials feature se TEs slots me test credentials add karte hain jab har tester ko unique ya specific test account use karna ho. Sirf wahi tester jisne slot claim kiya credentials dekh sakta hai. Visibility: claim se pehle credentials nahi dikhte; claim ke baad Slots page ke Credentials column me aur test case page ke Credentials section me dikhte hain, aur sirf jab test cycle active ho. Slot ya test case unclaim ho ya cycle lock ho to credentials nahi dikhenge. Lekin jab slot se linked test case info requested ho to credentials wapas dikhte hain, cycle active ho ya locked. Har slot ke credentials alag ho sakte hain - multiple slots claimed hain to jis slot pe kaam kar rahe ho uske hi credentials use karo.
qs.b: Slot Credentials let TEs attach unique test accounts to slots, visible only to the tester who claimed the slot. They appear in the Credentials column on the Slots page and in the test case page only while the cycle is active, and disappear when the slot is unclaimed or the cycle is locked. They reappear if a linked test case is info requested, even in a locked cycle, and I must use the right credentials for each slot.
qs.t: Claim ke baad + active cycle = credentials; info request pe wapas.

qs.q: What is Bug Fix Verification (BFV) and how do you perform it?
qs.s: BFV ek process hai jisme verify karte hain ki reported bug (issue) fix hua ya nahi jab product ka fix ya naya build release hota hai. The company customers ko re-test chalane deta hai jab fixes wala naya build available ho. Jab verify karne ki request mile: BFV test case same environment ke saath claim aur execute karo; BFV instructions aur available attachments review karo; validate karo ki naye build version me bug abhi bhi hai ya fix ho gaya. Fix ho gaya to step Pass karo aur proof ke liye attachment do. Abhi bhi reproducible hai to step Fail karo, clear explanation likho aur required attachment do. BFV claim kaise karein: (1) cycle overview padho aur invitation accept karo, (2) Test Cases tab click karo, (3) Available Test Cases section tak scroll karo, (4) jis BFV ko claim karna hai uska Claim link click karo.
qs.b: Bug Fix Verification is the process of checking whether a reported issue has been fixed once a new build is released, allowing customers to re-test fixes. I claim the BFV test case in the same environment, review its instructions and attachments, and pass the step with proof if fixed, or fail it with a clear explanation and attachment if it still reproduces. To claim one, I accept the cycle, open the Test Cases tab, scroll to Available Test Cases and click Claim.
qs.t: BFV = same env, fixed to Pass + proof, nahi to Fail + explanation.

qs.q: What notes and rules apply to BFV test cases?
qs.s: Notes: claim se pehle Preview link se BFV preview kar sakte ho. Test Cases tab ya usme BFV nahi dikh raha to tum qualified nahi ho - unexpected lage to TTL/TE se check karo. Jab customer BFV feature se issue verify karwata hai, issues list page me naya 'Verification' column add hota hai; 'Requested' status ka matlab issue verify ke liye select hua, BFV test case bana aur Test Cases tab me available hai. BFV test cases slots se linked ho sakte hain - tab Slots tab se claim karo agar requirements meet karte ho. Tester BFV claim kare to Verification column 'Started' ho jata hai. Things to remember: zyada tar BFV test cases ka naam 'Fix Verification for bug: ____' jaisa hota hai jisme already reported bug ID hoti hai. Claimed BFV test cases 2 hours me submit nahi hue to automatically unclaim ho jaate hain aur koi bhi qualified tester claim kar sakta hai. Failed BFV test cases submit karne se pehle comment zaroori hai - bina comment submit nahi hoga; isse TTLs/TEs ko failure reason samajh aata hai.
qs.b: BFV test cases can be previewed before claiming and may also be linked to slots. When a customer requests verification, the issues list shows a Verification column with 'Requested', which changes to 'Started' once a tester claims the BFV. BFV test cases are usually named 'Fix Verification for bug:' with the bug ID, are auto-unclaimed if not submitted within 2 hours, and a failed BFV cannot be submitted without a comment.
qs.t: BFV: Requested -> Started; 2 ghante; fail = comment must.

qs.q: What is a Tester Review and how do you write one?
qs.s: Tester Review Functional Test Cycle me test ho rahe product ke baare me feedback collect karne ka method hai. Customer ke liye important kyunki real world feedback alag perspectives se milta hai - isliye honestly likho aur useful info do. Important: Reviews har cycle me nahi hote. Jis cycle me reviews hain usme top right corner me 'Write a Review' button hota hai. Har cycle me reviews ki limit hai - limit pe button disabled aur reviews submit nahi ho sakte. Steps: (1) cycle overview padho aur product thoroughly test karo, (2) 'Write a Review' click karo, (3) answers honestly likho, (4) 'Submit' click karo, (5) edit ke liye Review tab dobara kholo, changes karo, 'Save changes' click karo, (6) discard ke liye Review tab kholo aur 'Discard' click karo. Note: cycle lock hone ke baad review likh/submit nahi kar sakte aur submitted reviews edit nahi hote.
qs.b: A Tester Review collects feedback about the product within a Functional Test Cycle, giving customers real-world perspectives. Not every cycle has reviews; those that do show a 'Write a Review' button, and each cycle has a limit after which the button is disabled. I test thoroughly first, write honest answers and Submit, and I can edit with Save changes or Discard from the Review tab until the cycle is locked.
qs.t: Review = Functional cycle, button top right, lock ke baad freeze.

qs.q: What are the best practices for writing a Tester Review?
qs.s: Best practices: (1) Product thoroughly test karne ke baad hi review likhna shuru karo. (2) Honest raho, negative feedback dene se mat daro. (3) Review questions ke answers full sentences me do jisme customer ke liye useful info ho; 'The app is good' ya 'The app is bad' jaise chhote bekaar answers avoid karo. (4) Star rating aur descriptive feedback match hone chahiye - jaise 2-star diya to clearly batao us category me product ko 2-star kyun milna chahiye. (5) Review likhne ke liye AI use mat karo - tumne test kiya hai to feedback tumhare apne experience ka ho; the platform AI Guidelines dekho ki genuine feedback kyun important hai.
qs.b: I start the review only after testing thoroughly, I am honest even when feedback is negative, and I answer in full sentences with useful details rather than 'The app is good'. My star rating must match my written feedback, so a 2-star rating needs a clear reason. I never use AI to write a review, because it must reflect my own experience as per the platform AI Guidelines.
qs.t: Honest + full sentences + stars match + no AI.

qs.q: What is TestRail and what are its result statuses?
qs.s: TestRail web-based test case management tool hai jo software testing efforts ko real time me track aur organize karta hai. Kuch the company customers ise test suites manage, tests execute aur results track karne ke liye use karte hain, isliye basic samajh zaroori hai. Execution the platform platform jaisa hi hai, par result statuses alag hain: Passed - test steps ke results expected jaise. Failed - ek ya zyada steps ke results expected se alag. Blocked - external reasons se test execute nahi ho sakta, jaise broken feature jo user ko feature test complete karne se rokta hai. Retest - test case dobara test karna hai, jaise bug ki wajah se fail hua tha aur bug fix ho gaya. Untested - abhi test nahi hua aur koi result assign nahi.
qs.b: TestRail is a web-based test case management tool used by some the company customers to manage suites, execute tests and track results in real time. Its result statuses are Passed, Failed, Blocked when the test cannot run due to external reasons like a broken feature, Retest when a test needs to be run again for example after a bug fix, and Untested when no result has been assigned yet.
qs.t: TestRail 5: Passed, Failed, Blocked, Retest, Untested.

qs.q: What are the common TestRail terminologies?
qs.s: Dashboard - TestRail login ke baad pehla page; project Admin ise koi bhi project info dikhane ke liye customize kar sakta hai. Test Case - product pe perform kiye defined steps ka set yeh check karne ke liye ki sahi function karta hai. Test Suite - test cases ka group jo product ke specific feature ya section ko test karta hai. Test Run - defined environment me test case execute karne ka action; ek test case ke alag environments aur product versions me multiple test runs ho sakte hain. Test Plan - alag environments me multiple test runs ka collection. Milestone - TestRail project me stage ya target, jaise planned software release ya upcoming features ki internal testing complete karna. Project - top-level organizational unit; saara testing data jaise test runs, results, milestones ek specific project se associated hota hai.
qs.b: In TestRail, the Dashboard is the first page after login and can be customized by the project admin. A Test Case is a set of defined steps, a Test Suite groups test cases for a feature, a Test Run is executing a test case in a defined environment, and a Test Plan contains multiple test runs across environments. A Milestone is a stage or target such as a release, and a Project is the top-level unit holding all runs, results and milestones.
qs.t: Project > Milestone; Suite > Case; Plan > Runs.

qs.q: What guidelines and steps do you follow to execute test cases on TestRail?
qs.s: Guidelines: TestRail account customer ka hai, bahut careful raho; testing ke baad log out karo; baar baar login try mat karo - issue ho to TTL se baat karo; password ya account settings change mat karo; sirf wahi test case(s) execute karo jinke liye sign up kiya; doubts ho to cycle TTL se poocho. Steps: (1) TestRail link kholo aur cycle me diye credentials se login karo. (2) Left navigation me apne assigned test cases ka folder click karo (link seedha test case khole to skip). (3) Pehla step kholo aur instructions follow karo. (4) 'Add Result' button click karo. (5) 'Status' dropdown se status chuno: Passed (obtained result expected meet kare), Failed (meet na kare), Blocked (feature available nahi ya existing failure ki wajah se test complete nahi ho sakta). (6) Zaroorat ho to comment field ke upar image icon se screenshot add karo. (7) 'Comment' field me results ka description ya cycle ke instruction ke hisaab se info likho - har customer attachments/comments nahi maangta; dono required nahi to mat daalo. (8) Bug ki wajah se step fail ho to 'Defects' field me cycle instructions ke hisaab se issue ID daalo; IDs ki zaroorat nahi to empty chhodo. (9) 'Add Result' click karke result add karo. (10) Agle steps pe jao jab tak sab complete na ho. (11) Execute karke results add karne ke baad the platform platform pe wapas aao aur Test Case submit karo.
qs.b: On TestRail I treat the customer's account carefully: I log out after testing, never retry logins repeatedly or change passwords and settings, execute only my assigned test cases and ask the TTL when in doubt. I log in, open my folder, execute each step, click Add Result, choose Passed, Failed or Blocked, add a screenshot or comment only if required, and add the issue ID in the Defects field for failures if instructed. After all steps, I return to the platform and submit the test case there.
qs.t: Customer ka account - careful; Add Result har step; end me the platform pe submit.

topics.intro: Slot claim karna, test case execute karna, statuses, BFV, waitlist, credentials, tester review aur TestRail - sab yahan hai.

topics.name: Issue Reports

qs.q: What is an issue report and how do you start one on the platform?
qs.s: Issue Report bug ka written summary hai jisme bug ko samajhne, reproduce karne aur fix karne ki saari required info hoti hai. Shuru karne ke liye test cycle header me blue 'Report Issue' button click karo - issue report form khul jayega. Saare fields properly bharne ke baad report ek baar aur review karo aur 'Submit' click karo.
qs.b: An issue report is a written summary of a bug that contains all the information needed to understand, reproduce and fix it. On the platform I start one by clicking the blue Report Issue button in the test cycle header, fill in every field properly, review it once more and submit.
qs.t: Report = samjho + reproduce + fix ki poori info.

qs.q: What are the common fields in a the platform issue report?
qs.s: Common fields (Lesson 1): (1) Issue Title - issue ka clear description; cycle overview me diya title format follow karo. (2) Issue Type - kis type ka issue report kar rahe ho. (3) Frequency - kitni baar reproduce hota hai: Everytime, sometimes, etc. (4) Priority - issue ki severity chuno (Severity vs Value course); kabhi customer overview me batata hai kya critical, high, medium ya low hai, isliye overview dhyan se padho. (5) Source - issue Exploratory testing se aaya ya test case execution ke andar Structured testing se. (6) Environment - jahan issue produce hua; sahi device, browser aur OS combination chuno. (7) Actions Performed - issue produce karne ke saare actions, numbered steps me, site ya app kholne se shuru. (8) Expected Results - steps karne pe user kya expect karega exactly. (9) Actual Results - steps karne pe exactly kya hota hai. (10) Error Messages - koi error message mila ho to. (11) Additional Environment Info - extra info; kuch nahi to empty chhodo. (12) Attachments - saare required attachments jaise screenshots, screen recordings, logs.
qs.b: The common fields are Issue Title, Issue Type, Frequency, Priority, Source, Environment, Actions Performed, Expected Results, Actual Results, Error Messages, Additional Environment Info and Attachments. The title follows the format in the cycle overview, Source is Exploratory or Structured, the environment must be the exact device, browser and OS combination, and steps are numbered starting from opening the site or app. Additional Environment Info stays empty when there is nothing extra to add.
qs.t: T-T-F-P-S-E + A-E-A-E-A-A: Title, Type, Frequency, Priority, Source, Environment, Actions, Expected, Actual, Error, Additional info, Attachments (12).

qs.q: Is there a limit on how many issues a tester can report, and on issues per cycle?
qs.s: Tester limit: Unrated aur Rated testers 5 unapproved issues per test cycle ki limit se shuru karte hain. Jab ek issue approve hota hai to ek aur submit kar sakte ho, aise hi aage. Ye restriction tab hat jati hai jab tester rating badh kar higher rating ho jaye jaise Gold, Silver, Bronze ya Proven rated tester. Cycle limit: haan, har cycle me submit hone wale issues ki limit hoti hai; har cycle ki apni configuration hai aur customer ki requirements ke hisaab se adjust hoti hai. Limit reach hone pe 'Report Issue' button disabled ho jata hai aur aur issues submit nahi ho sakte.
qs.b: Unrated and Rated testers start with a limit of 5 unapproved issues per test cycle, and each approval frees up one more submission. This restriction is lifted once the tester rating rises to a higher level such as Gold, Silver, Bronze or Proven. Separately, every cycle has its own configurable limit on total issues, and when it is reached the Report Issue button is disabled.
qs.t: Unrated/Rated = 5 unapproved; Proven/Bronze/Silver/Gold = no limit; cycle limit pe button band.

qs.q: What are the basic steps to write and submit an issue report?
qs.s: Lesson 2 steps: (1) Test ho rahe product me bug dhoondo aur confirm karo ki valid hai. (2) Test cycle header me 'Report Issue' button click karo. (3) Saare issue report fields sahi bharo. (4) Saare required attachments lagao. (5) Ho jaane pe saare fields aur attachments dobara check karo ki issue ke hisaab se sahi hain. (6) 'Submit Issue' button click karke submit karo. (7) Uske baad uploaded attachments check karo ki khul rahe hain. Aadat padne pe reporting aasaan aur fast ho jati hai.
qs.b: I first find a bug and make sure it is valid, then click Report Issue in the cycle header, fill in all fields correctly and attach all required attachments. I recheck every field and attachment, click Submit Issue, and finally verify that the uploaded attachments open correctly.
qs.t: Valid -> Report Issue -> Fill -> Attach -> Recheck -> Submit -> Attachments khol ke dekho.

qs.q: What are the rules for writing an issue title on the platform?
qs.s: Title rules (Lesson 2 aur Lesson 4 dono): (1) Title cycle overview me diye format se match kare - koi bhi report submit karne se pehle overview padho. (2) Issue jis area me mila use sahi describe karo - examples: Homepage, My Profile, Cart, Search, Checkout. (3) Report ho raha issue accurately describe karo - example: 'The app crashes after a photo is uploaded'. (4) Paid cycle me verify karo ki issue kisi aur tester ne pehle report nahi kiya. (5) Title ALL CAPS me mat likho. (6) Browser name title me mat likho, jab tak overview me specifically instruct na ho - ye cycle to cycle badalta hai, har cycle ka exact title format follow karo. (7) Har sentence capital letter se shuru karo - ye saare fields pe apply hota hai; Lesson 4 ke hisaab se report ki har line (Title, Action Performed, Expected aur Actual results) capital se shuru ho.
qs.b: The title must follow the exact format given in the cycle overview, name the area where the issue occurs, such as Search or Checkout, and accurately describe the issue, for example 'The app crashes after a photo is uploaded'. I check that it has not already been reported in a paid cycle, never write it in all caps, and do not include the browser name unless the overview asks for it. Every line in the report starts with a capital letter.
qs.t: Format + Area + Issue; no CAPS, no browser (jab tak na bole).

qs.q: What issue types, frequency options and severity options does a the platform issue report use?
qs.s: Issue Classifications batate hain kis type ka issue hai, kitni baar hota hai, kaunsa environment use hua aur user pe impact kya hai. Issue Type: Functional, Visual, Content, Performance ya Crash (Lesson 2 me 'such as Functional, Visual, Content, Performance, etc.' - detail ke liye What is a Bug? course). Frequency: Every time, Hardly ever, Occasionally ya Once - reproduce karte waqt kitni baar hota hai. Severity/Priority: Critical, High, Medium, Low - user pe impact ke hisaab se sahi priority chuno; overview me dekho customer ke liye kaunse issues priority hain aur koi specific priority criteria hai kya (detail Severity vs Value course me).
qs.b: Issue types are Functional, Visual, Content, Performance or Crash. Frequency options are Every time, Hardly ever, Occasionally or Once, based on how often the issue occurs when reproduced. Severity, selected in the Priority field, is Critical, High, Medium or Low based on the impact on the user, unless the cycle overview defines its own priority criteria.
qs.t: Type FVCPC; Frequency E-H-O-O; Severity C-H-M-L.

qs.q: What is the Source field and when do you choose Exploratory vs Structured?
qs.s: Source: chuno ki issue Exploratory testing se aaya ya test case execution ke andar Structured testing se. Exploratory - un issues ke liye jo test case steps se related nahi aur exploratory testing karte waqt mile. Structured - jo test case steps execute karte waqt mile; ye tab bhi chun sakte ho jab issue test case steps se related ho, chahe test case execute karne ke baad mila ho. 'Fail & Report Issue' feature (test case step se) use karoge to Structured by default select hota hai aur Exploratory me change nahi kar sakte; aise issues us test case step se linked hote hain. Agar test case submit karne ke baad step se related issue mile aur test case abhi pended/approved/rejected nahi hai, to submission undo karke us step se 'Fail & Report Issue' se report karo, phir test case resubmit karo.
qs.b: Source is Exploratory for issues found through exploratory testing that are unrelated to test case steps, and Structured for issues found while executing test case steps or related to them, even if found afterwards. Using Fail & Report Issue from a test case step sets Structured by default and links the issue to that step. If I find a step-related issue after submitting and the test case is not yet pended, approved or rejected, I undo the submission, report via Fail & Report Issue and resubmit.
qs.t: Test case step se juda = Structured; baaki = Exploratory.

qs.q: How do you choose the correct environment for an issue report?
qs.s: Environment wo chuno jahan issue mila aur reproduce hua, aur ye title se match kare. Lesson 4 (2.3): sahi device, browser aur OS chuno aur ye uploaded attachments aur title ke device name se match kare. Issue ek se zyada environments me reproduce hua to additional environments bhi select kar sakte ho. Mobile native app (iOS ya Android) test kar rahe ho to slot claim aur issue report dono me 'Native (No mobile browser)' wala environment chuno, browser wala nahi kyunki website test nahi kar rahe (2.7). Website ya browser use kar rahe ho to 'Native (No mobile browser)' mat chuno; jis device aur browser me issue mila wo chuno (2.6).
qs.b: I select the environment where I found and reproduced the issue, making sure the device, browser and OS match the attachments and the device name in the title, and I can add extra environments if it reproduces in more than one. For native iOS or Android apps I select the option ending in 'Native (No mobile browser)'. For websites I never select Native and instead choose the exact device and browser used.
qs.t: App = Native; Website = browser; title + attachment se match.

qs.q: What are the rules for the Actions Performed field?
qs.s: Rules (Lesson 2 + Lesson 4): (1) Issue reproduce karne ke saare necessary steps do. (2) Numbered steps use karo, sequence me. (3) Har step me sirf ek task. (4) Steps overview me diye testing website URL (homepage) ya app kholne se shuru karo (app ka naam include karo) - example: '1. Open the testing website the platform website ya '1. Open the "Type the app name here" testing app'. (5) Steps me (khaas kar last step me) 'Observe / Check / View results / Find / See / Pay attention' mat likho. (6) Expected ya actual results ko step ke roop me mat likho. (7) Baad ke steps me URL mat likho, sirf pehle step me (jab tak specifically request na ho). (8) Computer pe test karte waqt 'Click' aur mobile devices pe 'Tap' word use karo. (9) Doosri language ke products test kar rahe ho to har non-English word ka English translation brackets me do. (10) Issue reproduce karne ke liye zaroori conditions step 1 se pehle precondition me likho - example: 'Precondition: The user has logged in'.
qs.b: Actions Performed must list every step needed to reproduce the issue as numbered, sequential steps with one task each, starting with opening the test website URL or the named app from the overview. I never write 'observe', 'check', 'see' or similar steps, never include expected or actual results as steps, and only put the URL in step 1. I use 'Click' for computers and 'Tap' for mobile, add English translations for non-English words, and put setup conditions in a precondition before step 1.
qs.t: Numbered, ek step ek kaam, URL sirf step 1, Click vs Tap, no 'Observe'.

qs.q: What goes into Expected Results, Actual Results, Error Message and Additional Environment Info?
qs.s: Expected Results: actions performed ke steps karne ke baad user exactly kya expect karega wo likho. Actual Results: steps karne ke baad exactly kya hota hai wo likho. Error Message: sirf tab use karo jab steps karne ke baad error message dikhe, warna empty chhodo. Possible ho to poora error message likho jo screen pe dikha. Error message na ho to 'None', 'N/A' ya hyphen '-' mat likho. Additional Environment Info (optional): issue se affected devices aur environment ke baare me extra info. Zaroori nahi hota - cycle overview check karo ki requirement hai ya nahi. Koi extra info nahi aur overview me instruction nahi to field empty chhodo.
qs.b: Expected Results describe exactly what the user would expect after the steps, and Actual Results describe exactly what happens. The Error Message field is used only when an error appears, with the full message, and is left empty otherwise rather than writing None, N/A or a hyphen. Additional Environment Info is optional for details about affected devices and environments and stays empty unless there is relevant information or the overview requires it.
qs.t: Error nahi to khali chhodo - N/A bhi nahi.

qs.q: What are the rules for screenshots in an issue report?
qs.s: Screenshot rules: har issue report me screenshot include karo aur issue screen pe clearly highlight karo. (1) .jpg ya .png format me upload karo. (2) Mouse drawing tool se highlight mat karo - red ya yellow square, circle ya arrow lagao. (3) Website test kar rahe ho to poori screen dikhao, URL bar samet. (4) Submit ke baad check karo ki screenshot platform me khul raha hai aur broken nahi. (5) Ek issue report me 2 se zyada screenshots mat daalo. (6) External devices se screen capture mat karo, jab tak website/app DRM-protected na ho aur screenshots required hon, ya external device use karne ko kaha gaya ho. (7) Screenshot me dikh rahi PII blur ya redact karo.
qs.b: Screenshots must be .jpg or .png, highlight the issue with a red or yellow square, circle or arrow rather than freehand mouse drawing, and show the entire screen including the URL bar for websites. I upload no more than two per report, verify they open after submission, blur or redact PII, and never capture with an external device unless the product is DRM-protected or it is explicitly requested.
qs.t: JPG/PNG, max 2, red/yellow shape, URL bar, PII blur.

qs.q: What are the rules for videos in an issue report?
qs.s: Video rules (Lesson 2 + Lesson 4): (1) .mp4 format me upload karo. (2) Video actions performed ke steps se match kare aur issue clearly dikhe - report ho raha issue video me zaroor dikhna chahiye. (3) Website test kar rahe ho to poori screen URL bar samet dikhao. (4) Background noise exclude karo - microphone mute karo, jab tak narration required na ho. (5) Submit ke baad check karo ki video platform me play ho raha hai.
