(6) External devices se record mat karo jab tak website/app DRM-protected na ho aur video required ho, ya external device use karne ko kaha ho; computer screen ko mobile phone se record mat karo, software use karo. (7) Ek report me ek se zyada video nahi - saare reproduction steps ek video me, jab tak alag na kaha jaye. (8) the platform platform, customer cycles ya other projects video me mat dikhao jab tak request na ho. (9) Badi videos upload mat karo, pehle compress karo. (10) Video me dikh rahi PII blur ya redact karo.
qs.b: Videos must be .mp4, follow the Actions Performed steps and clearly show the issue, and show the full screen with the URL bar for web testing. I mute background noise unless narration is required, record with software rather than filming a screen with a phone, upload only one video per report, compress large files, avoid showing the platform platform or other projects, blur PII and verify the video plays after submitting.
qs.t: MP4, ek video, steps match, mic mute, phone se screen record nahi.

qs.q: What are the rules for logs, including desktop browser and mobile logs?
qs.s: General logs (Lesson 2): overview me bataye correct format me upload karo; issue reproduce karte waqt log collect karo; submit ke baad check karo log khul raha hai aur corrupted nahi; overview ki saari requirements follow karo. Computer (Lesson 4, 9): har issue report ke saath browser console log include karo. 9.1 logs .txt ya .log format me save karo aur verify karo platform me khulte hain. 9.2 issue create karte waqt log capture karo aur verify karo test URL log ki data entry lines me dikh raha hai. 9.3 Chrome, Firefox aur new Edge me 'Preserve or Persist log and Show Timestamp' enable karo. 9.4 links se seekho kaise capture karein (Desktop browser logs). Mobile Logs (10): har report ke saath device log ya chrome ke saath android console log. 10.1 .txt ya .log format, platform me khulna chahiye. 10.2 issue create karte waqt capture karo aur test app ka naam/test URL data entry lines me dikhna chahiye. 10.3 Mobile website test kar rahe ho to Android mobile browser log Chromium-based browsers aur Firefox ke saath, aur iOS mobile browser log Safari ke saath (sirf agar Mac bhi ho) capture karna hai. 10.4 Android device logs aur iOS device logs ke links. 10.5 mobile browser ke developer tools me 'Preserve (or Persist) Log' aur 'Show Timestamps' enable karo.
qs.b: Logs must be in the format stated in the overview, collected while reproducing the issue, and verified to open after submission. Browser console logs and mobile device or console logs are saved as .txt or .log, captured during the reproduction so the test URL or app name appears in the entries, with Preserve or Persist log and Show Timestamps enabled. For mobile websites, Android logs are captured with Chromium-based browsers or Firefox, and iOS logs with Safari if I also have a Mac.
qs.t: Log = .txt/.log + Preserve + Timestamp + URL dikhe.

qs.q: What are the rules for Charles Proxy logs in an issue report?
qs.s: Charles Proxy Logs (Lesson 4, 11): jab request kiya jaye tab har issue report ke saath decrypted Charles proxy log include karo. 11.1 Charles logs me saara data decrypted ho (Charles logs collect karte waqt sirf test website access karo). 11.2 Root certificate computer aur mobile device dono pe sahi install ho - sahi install nahi hua to expanded items me '< unknown >' message dikhega. 11.3 Required SSL settings configure karo (host * aur port 443), add karo ya empty chhodo. 11.4 Poora Charles log upload karo - issue reproduce karne ke baad File, phir 'Save session as' click karo. 11.5 Verify karo test website URL Charles log ki data entry lines me dikh raha hai. 11.6 Charles log .chls ya .chlz extension me upload karo. 11.7 Charles logs usi device se capture karo jis pe issue reproduce kar rahe ho.
qs.b: When requested, I attach a fully decrypted Charles proxy log, accessing only the test website while capturing. The root certificate must be correctly installed on the computer and mobile device, otherwise items show '< unknown >', and SSL settings use host * and port 443. I save the full session with File then Save session as, confirm the test URL appears in the entries, upload it as .chls or .chlz, and capture it from the same device I reproduced the issue on.
qs.t: Charles = decrypted, host * port 443, .chls/.chlz, same device.

qs.q: What is the Attachment Visibility feature?
qs.s: Attachment Visibility feature se tester (issue reporter) apne attachments cycle ke other testers se hide kar sakta hai. Useful jab attachments me aisi info ho jo publicly visible nahi honi chahiye ya sensitive ho. Feature Test Cycle ka Test Engineer 'TE' enable/disable karta hai; enable hone pe har attachment ke neeche toggle hota hai. Pehle cycle ki nature aur required attachments samjho. Feature enabled: attachments me sensitive info hai to upload ke baad 'Visible to testers' toggle off karke hide karo; sensitive info nahi hai to visible rakh sakte ho. Feature disabled: saare attachments cycle ke saare testers ko visible hain, hide karne ka option nahi.
qs.b: Attachment Visibility lets the reporter hide their attachments from other testers when they contain sensitive information. The TE enables or disables it per cycle, and when enabled each attachment has a 'Visible to testers' toggle that I turn off only for sensitive content. When it is disabled, all attachments are visible to all testers with no option to hide them.
qs.t: Sensitive = toggle off; feature off = sab visible.

qs.q: What are the notes and role permissions for Attachment Visibility?
qs.s: Notes: (1) Har attachment wali cycle me ye functionality enabled nahi hoti; ye sirf PII wale attachments protect karne ke liye bani hai. (2) Visibility option tabhi dikhega jab cycle me feature enabled ho. (3) Upload ke baad kabhi bhi hide ya show kar sakte ho. (4) Sirf tab hide karo jab sensitive info ho. (5) Community Reproductions section me upload kiye attachments is feature se supported nahi. (6) Known Issues aur BFV test cases attachments nahi dikhayenge agar original issue report ke attachments hidden hain. (7) Hidden attachments cycle me TTL, TE, TSM, CM aur Customers ko phir bhi dikhte hain. (8) Cycle TTLs attachments hide kar sakte hain par unhide nahi. (9) Zaroorat pe TE, TSM aur CM attachment ka status 'Private' se 'Visible' ya 'Visible' se 'Private' kar sakte hain.
qs.b: The feature exists to protect PII and only appears when enabled, and I can hide or show an attachment at any time but should only hide sensitive ones. It does not cover Community Reproductions, and Known Issues and BFV test cases will not show attachments hidden on the original report. Hidden attachments remain visible to the TTL, TE, TSM, CM and customers; TTLs can hide but not unhide, while the TE, TSM and CM can switch between Private and Visible.
qs.t: TTL sirf hide; TE/TSM/CM dono taraf; hidden phir bhi staff + customer dekhte.

qs.q: How do the Save as Template and Configure Template features work?
qs.s: Issue report form ke upar aur neeche 'Configure Template' aur 'Save as Template' buttons hain - cycle ke andar issue reports ka template banane ke liye. Save as Template: click karne pe 'Issue Report Template' popup khulta hai jisme current form ki details bhari hoti hain. 'Save Template' click karne se save hota hai aur agla Issue Report form same details se pre-filled aata hai. Configure Template: pehle se saved template popup me khulta hai, edit kar sakte ho; editing ke baad 'Save Template' click karo changes apply karne ke liye. Agar cycle me pehle koi template save nahi kiya to ye button Save as Template jaisa kaam karta hai. Template useful hai jab customer common title prefix wala specific title format maange, issues ke common preconditions ho, actual issue se pehle common steps hon, ya Additional Environment Info ya custom fields me same info chahiye - save karne ke baad agle form me automatically fill hote hain.
qs.b: The issue form has Save as Template and Configure Template buttons. Save as Template opens the Issue Report Template popup with the current details, and Save Template pre-fills future reports in that cycle; Configure Template opens the saved template for editing, or acts like Save as Template if none exists. Templates help when reports share a title prefix, preconditions, common steps, Additional Environment Info or custom fields.
qs.t: Save as = naya; Configure = purana edit; dono ke end me Save Template.

qs.q: What are the important notes to follow when submitting issue reports, including placeholder issues?
qs.s: Important Notes (Lesson 2): (1) Submit se pehle saare fields sahi bhare hon aur cycle se match karein; multiple projects me ho to sahi cycle me report karo, warna rejection. (2) Placeholder issues mat report karo - shuru se hi saare required fields issue ke hisaab se bharo; fields me sirf '1. 2. 3.' ya '...' jaisa placeholder text mat daalo. Placeholder issues the platform me prohibited hain; Terms of Use aur Guidelines ka violation account suspension ya termination tak le ja sakta hai. (3) Saare required attachments collect kiye bina submit mat karo, aur doosron se jaldi report karne ke liye unrelated attachments mat lagao - ye placeholder maana jayega aur reject hoga. (4) Issue Reporting Instructions unclear ho to cycle chat me TTL ko batao; assumptions mat banao. (5) Errors ya file size ki wajah se attachment upload fail ho (compress ke baad bhi badi screen recording) to turant cycle chat me TTL ko batao. (6) Report karne ke baad Issues list recheck karo - errors se duplicate report ban gayi ho to turant discard karo; discard karte waqt attachments check karo aur attachments wali report rakho. (7) Duplicates ke liye bhi list check karo - koi aur tester pehle report kar chuka ho to apna discard karo taaki rejection na ho. (8) Doosre tester ki report copy mat karo. (9) Reported issue ko kisi different issue me edit mat karo - Terms of Use aur Guidelines violation; issue invalid nikla to discard karo, edit nahi.
qs.b: I make sure every field is correct and that I am in the right cycle, and I never submit placeholder issues with text like '1. 2. 3.' or unrelated attachments, since that violates the Terms of Use and can lead to suspension or termination. I ask the TTL in chat when instructions are unclear or uploads fail, recheck the issues list to discard accidental duplicates or issues someone else reported first, never copy another tester's report, and discard rather than edit an invalid issue into a different one.
qs.t: Placeholder = ban ka raasta; duplicate dikhe to discard; issue badlo mat.

qs.q: When can an issue report be edited and when can it not?
qs.s: Edit karne ke reasons: report karne ke baad pata chala kuch miss hua ya galat type hua; ya TTL ne galti/miss fix karne ko kaha. Edit ho sakta hai in statuses me: New - naya report hua, TTL ne check nahi kiya. Info Requested - TTL ne review karke tester se more info maangi; TTL ya Customer ke check karne ke baad poora issue naye issue me mat badlo, ye placeholder maana ja sakta hai. Rejected - review hokar reject; sirf tab edit karo jab dispute karne wale ho (lagta hai galti se reject hua ya reason se disagree) - tab report clearer karo aur dispute support ke liye additional info ya attachments do. Edit nahi ho sakta: Pending - TTL ne review kiya aur TE ya Customer ke finalize ka wait. Approved - review hokar approve.
qs.b: An issue report can be edited when it is New, Info Requested, or Rejected, the last only when I am preparing a dispute and want to clarify the report or add evidence. It cannot be edited when it is Pending, meaning the TTL reviewed it and it awaits the TE or customer, or when it is Approved. Even in editable statuses, I must not change it into a completely different issue.
qs.t: Edit: New, Info Requested, Rejected (dispute ke liye). Lock: Pending, Approved.

qs.q: How do you edit an issue report and complete an info request?
qs.s: Steps: (1) Apni issue report kholo, review karo aur Messages tab me TTL ka message check karo agar aaya ho. (2) Samjho kya changes karne hain. (3) 'Actions' click karke 'Edit Issue' select karo. (4) Report fix karo aur 'Submit Issue' click karo. Important: agar TTL ne info request bhej ke fix karne bola to finish karne ke baad 'Confirm all requested info is added' ya 'Actions > Send Requested Info' click karna zaroori hai - isse report status wapas 'New' ho jata hai aur TTL ko notify hota hai ki report recheck ke liye ready hai. Lesson 4 me bhi: info request ke baad requested items fix karo, changes save karo, phir 'Confirm all requested info was added' button click karke info request complete karo.
qs.b: I open the report, read the TTL's message in the Messages tab, then use Actions and Edit Issue, make the fixes and click Submit Issue. If it was an info request, I must then click 'Confirm all requested info is added' or Actions then Send Requested Info, which returns the status to New and notifies the TTL that it is ready for recheck.
qs.t: Actions > Edit Issue > Submit Issue > Confirm (status New).

qs.q: How do you update attachments on an issue report?
qs.s: Steps: (1) Issue report kholo. (2) Attachments section tak scroll karo - naye attachments ke liye 'Actions > Edit Issue' click karne ki zaroorat nahi. (3) 'Choose Files' button se upload karo ya drag and drop karo. (4) 'Upload Complete' message aane tak wait karo. (5) Naya attachment click karke check karo corrupted nahi hai. Note: naya attachment add karne ke baad unnecessary attachments remove karo - jaise video me personal info cover karne bola gaya, to fix karke naya video upload karne ke baad purana delete kar sakte ho. Edit Issue page (Actions > Edit Issue) pe uploaded attachments edit nahi hote - sirf issue report page ke Attachments section me.
qs.b: Attachments are updated directly in the Attachments section of the issue report page, not through Actions and Edit Issue. I upload with Choose Files or drag and drop, wait for 'Upload Complete', open the new file to confirm it is not corrupted, and then remove outdated attachments, for example an old video that exposed personal information.
qs.t: Attachment = report page ka Attachments section, Edit Issue nahi.

qs.q: How and when can you discard (delete) an issue report?
qs.s: Report karne ke baad pata chale issue invalid hai to delete kar sakte ho agar TTL ne review nahi kiya. Steps: (1) issue report kholo, (2) 'Actions' click karke 'Discard' select karo, (3) selection confirm karo. Notes: agar issue ab reproduce nahi ho raha aur overview me instruction hai ki sirf every time reproduce hone wale issues report karo, to rejection se bachne ke liye discard kar sakte ho, jab tak pehle check nahi hua. Same agar pata chale issue OOS section me aata hai - jaise OOS area me hai, ya usability issue hai jabki scope me nahi - to discard kar sakte ho. Agar report TTL review kar chuka (pehle pend kiya ya info request bheji) to status New hone pe bhi discard nahi kar paoge - try karne pe error message aayega. Isliye report se pehle issue valid hai ye ensure karo.
qs.b: If I realize an issue is invalid and the TTL has not reviewed it, I open it and select Actions then Discard and confirm. This is appropriate when it no longer reproduces in a cycle requiring every-time reproduction, or when it turns out to be out of scope. Once the TTL has reviewed it, by pending it or sending an info request, I cannot discard it even if it shows New, so I validate issues before reporting.
qs.t: TTL ne chhua = discard band.

qs.q: What are the important notes regarding editing an issue report?
qs.s: Notes: (1) Hamesha overview ke Issue Reporting Instructions ke hisaab se report karo aur well written report submit karo. (2) Saare required attachments aur sahi info wale required fields ke bina report kabhi submit mat karo - ye placeholder issue hai. (3) Submitted issue ko kabhi doosre issue me mat badlo, chahe New ho ya Info Requested - ye bhi placeholder maana jayega, Terms of Use aur Guidelines ke against. (4) TTL ke message se samajh nahi aaya kya badalna hai to reply karke clarification maango. (5) Uploaded attachments Edit Issue page pe edit nahi hote, sirf report page ke Attachments section me. (6) Report karte waqt saare required attachments lagao; bina attachments ya incomplete report placeholder ho sakti hai. TTL kahe to attachments edit/renew kar sakte ho. Placeholder ya unrelated attachments daal ke baad me sahi wale lagana bhi Terms of Use ke against hai - pehle saare attachments ready karo. (7) TTL renew/edit karne ko kahe to purane attachments remove kar sakte ho.
qs.b: I always follow the Issue Reporting Instructions, and never submit a report missing required attachments or correct field information, or change a submitted issue into another issue, because both count as placeholder issues. If the TTL's request is unclear I reply to ask for clarification. Attachments are only edited in the report's Attachments section, I never upload placeholder attachments to swap later, and I can remove old attachments when the TTL asks me to renew them.
qs.t: Pehle sab ready, phir submit; baad me swap = violation.

qs.q: What are the four severity levels for bugs on the platform?
qs.s: Severity/priority bug ka product pe impact batati hai. Agar cycle overview me na diya ho to tester sahi severity chun sakta hai. Four levels: Low - minor incident jo product ki usability pe asar dalta hai par core features/functionality me interfere nahi karta; examples: page ya image misalignment, content, spelling, grammatical ya punctuation errors. Medium - minor incident medium impact ke saath jo core features me interfere kar sakta hai par workaround hai aur further testing ya product release nahi rokta; examples: noticeable performance degradation, customers ko minor inconvenience jiska workaround available hai. High - major incident significant impact ke saath jo core features me interfere karta hai aur further testing rok sakta hai ya release delay kar sakta hai; examples: core functionality significantly impacted, service subset of customers ke liye unavailable. Critical - critical incident very high impact ke saath jo core features me interfere karta hai, further testing rokta hai aur release se pehle fix hona must; examples: app crashes ya freezes, confidentiality ya privacy breach.
qs.b: The platform uses four severity levels. Low covers minor usability issues like misalignment or spelling errors, and Medium affects core features but has a workaround, such as noticeable performance degradation. High significantly impacts core functionality or makes a service unavailable for some customers and may delay release, while Critical stops further testing and must be fixed before release, such as crashes, freezes or privacy breaches.
qs.t: Low = typo, Medium = workaround, High = core hit, Critical = crash/privacy.

qs.q: What is bug value and what are the four value levels?
qs.s: Bug value batata hai bug customer ke liye kitna valuable hai. Value customer decide karta hai. Bug payout rates value pe depend karte hain, severity pe nahi. Four value levels: (1) Somewhat Valuable (Won't Fix) - bug valid hai par customer interested nahi ya fix karne ka plan nahi. (2) Somewhat Valuable - product pe kuch impact aur customer ke liye kuch value. (3) Very Valuable - product pe significant impact, customer ke liye bahut valuable. (4) Exceptionally Valuable - product pe critical impact aur fix hona must; customer ke liye exceptional value.
qs.b: Bug value reflects how valuable the bug is to the customer and is decided by the customer, and payout rates depend on value, not severity. The four levels are Somewhat Valuable (Won't Fix) for valid bugs the customer will not fix, Somewhat Valuable, Very Valuable, and Exceptionally Valuable for bugs with critical impact that must be fixed.
qs.t: Value customer deta hai, paisa value se: Won't Fix < Somewhat < Very < Exceptionally.

qs.q: Why is severity not the same as value?
qs.s: Important Notes: severity aur value same nahi; value customer decide karta hai. Example: tester ne jo bug Low categorize kiya wo customer ke liye valuable ho sakta hai. Jo bugs tester critical ya high samjhe, zaroori nahi customer ke liye critical hon. Examples: (1) bug jo test cycle ke scope me nahi, (2) bug jo end user kabhi encounter nahi karega, (3) bug jo development ya stage environments me hota hai par production ya live environments me nahi, (4) kisi stress test ya monkey test ka result.
qs.b: Severity is the tester's assessment of impact, while value is the customer's decision, so a Low bug can be valuable and a Critical or High bug may not matter to the customer. Examples are bugs outside the cycle scope, bugs end users would never encounter, bugs only in development or staging environments, and results of stress or monkey tests.
qs.t: Severity tester ki raay, Value customer ka faisla.

qs.q: When is a bug rejected and what are the rejection reasons?
qs.s: Submitted bug test cycle requirements meet na kare to invalid maana jata hai aur TTL, TE ya customer reject karte hain. Har rejected bug me clear rejection reason hota hai. WAD ke alawa kisi bhi reason se rejection tester rating ko negatively affect karta hai. Reasons: (1) Working as Designed (WAD) - product ki functionality/design me expected behavior; WAD rejections rating affect nahi karte. (2) Duplicate (DUP) - bug pehle kisi aur tester ne report kiya ya known issue hai. (3) Out of Scope (OOS) - bug clearly cycle overview ke Out Of Scope area me explicitly stated cheez me aata hai. (4) Did Not Follow Instructions (DNFI) - bug ne cycle overview ke instructions follow nahi kiye; is rejection ka tester rating pe double negative impact hota hai. (5) Need more info (INF) - info request bhejne pe tester ne requested info nahi di. (6) Other - baaki categories me nahi aata; ho sakta hai ab reproducible na ho.
qs.b: A bug is rejected by the TTL, TE or customer when it does not meet the cycle requirements, and every rejection includes a reason. The reasons are Working as Designed (WAD), Duplicate (DUP), Out of Scope (OOS), Did Not Follow Instructions (DNFI), Need more info (INF) and Other, for example when it is no longer reproducible. Any rejection other than WAD hurts the tester rating, and DNFI has a double negative impact.
qs.t: WAD-DUP-OOS-DNFI-INF-Other; WAD free, DNFI double.

qs.q: When should you dispute a rejected bug, and when should you not?
qs.s: Sirf tab dispute karo jab appropriate ho - double rejection (disputed bug dobara reject) rating ko negatively affect karta hai. Rejection message dhyan se padho, reason samjho. Dispute kar sakte ho jab: (1) tum certain ho ki sahi ho, (2) cycle ke saare instructions follow kiye, (3) scope ke misunderstanding cycle chat me clarify kiye (rejected issue ko chat me discuss mat karo), (4) pehli baar enough info nahi di thi, (5) duplicate ke roop me reject hua aur batana hai ki tumhara alag kaise hai - similar hone se galti se reject ho sakta hai; unique kyun hai explain karo aur additional attachments do. Note: dispute sirf tab ho sakta hai jab cycle active ya locked ho. Dispute appropriate nahi jab: duplicate bug ho, out of scope ho, reproducible na ho, instructions follow nahi kiye, ya work as designed reject hua.
qs.b: I dispute only when I am certain I am right, I followed all instructions, I clarified scope in the cycle chat, I had not provided enough information initially, or my bug was wrongly marked as a duplicate and I can show why it is unique with extra attachments. Disputes are possible only while the cycle is active or locked. I do not dispute genuine duplicates, out-of-scope bugs, non-reproducible bugs, cases where I did not follow instructions, or Working as Designed rejections, because a double rejection hurts my rating.
qs.t: Dispute = sure + instructions follow kiye; double rejection = rating down.

qs.q: How do you dispute a rejected bug and what rules apply?
qs.s: Steps: (1) Rejected bug report kholo, 'Actions' click karke 'Dispute Rejection' button select karo. (2) Customer ko further review ke liye extra info dene ka ek chance milega. (3) Dispute clearly explain karo aur evidence upload karo. (4) Dispute review karke bhejo. Situation aur evidence ke hisaab se bug accept ya dobara reject ho sakta hai. Important points: saare disputes dispute feature se hi submit karo. Customer ya TTL se reject na karne ki request ya kisi bhi tarah negotiate mat karo - saare disputes aur discussions monitored hain, violation pe further review aur account suspension ho sakta hai. Har tester ko per bug sirf ek dispute opportunity. Testers ko per month limited total disputes milte hain - sparingly use karo.
qs.b: I open the rejected report, select Actions then Dispute Rejection, explain clearly with any evidence and send it, knowing I get only one chance per bug and the result may be approval or another rejection. All disputes must go through the dispute feature, and negotiating with the customer or TTL is monitored and can lead to suspension. Testers also have a limited number of disputes per month, so I use them sparingly.
qs.t: Ek bug = ek dispute; month me limited; negotiate = suspension risk.

qs.q: What does the course recommend for newbie testers or when facing a newbie customer?
qs.s: Newbie tester: higher rating wale testers bhi kabhi newbie hote hain - essential testing experience ki kami ya us app/website ka specific experience nahi. Bug submit karne me jaldi mat karo, slow pace rakho, dekho doosre testers kya report kar rahe hain aur kaunse approve/reject ho rahe hain. Test cycle chat dekho, poochne me sharmao mat - clarification ka time aur jagah cycle chat hai aur submission se pehle. Customer new hai: best tester bhi newbie customer se mil sakta hai. Shayad customer the platform platform se familiar nahi, ya sirf specific bug types chahta hai par Out Of Scope me nahi likha. Shayad naya customer internal known issues list share karna bhool gaya, isliye unknown reasons se reject kar raha hai. Controversy karne ki bajaye cycle ke TE se contact karna zyada appropriate hai. Shayad bugs approve na hon, par TTL, TE aur TSM tumhara troubleshooting approach yaad rakhenge aur shayad time/effort ka reward dein.
qs.b: As a newer tester, I slow down, study which reports get approved or rejected, and ask questions in the cycle chat before submitting. If the customer is new, they may be unfamiliar with the platform, may want specific bug types not listed in Out of Scope, or may have forgotten to share known issues. In that case I contact the cycle's TE rather than creating controversy, because the TTL, TE and TSM may remember and reward a constructive approach.
qs.t: Naya tester = slow + chat; naya customer = TE se baat, jhagda nahi.

qs.q: What are the best practices when disputing a bug?
qs.s: Best practices: (1) dispute ke reasons clearly batao. (2) Rejection reason padho aur samjho, decide karo dispute appropriate hai ya nahi. (3) Professional raho. (4) In scope, out of scope aur cycle instructions check karo ki bug scope me hai. (5) Known issues list (agar applicable) aur previously submitted bugs list duplicates ke liye check karo - rejection ka sabse common reason duplicate hona hai. (6) Chat aur Announcement messages check karo ki issue discuss/clarify hua ya nahi - ho sakta hai TTL/TE ne pehle hi bata diya ho ki kuch issues scope me nahi. (7) Rejected bug thoroughly check karo - clear, concise description diya jisse customer reproduce kar sake aur screenshots, video, logs ka evidence diya? Nahi to samajh aayega kyun reject hua; dispute me saari necessary info aur supporting evidence add karo.
qs.b: I state my reasons clearly and professionally, and first decide whether a dispute is appropriate after understanding the rejection reason. I recheck scope, the known issues list, previously submitted bugs, and chat and announcement messages, since duplicates are the most common rejection reason. I also review my own report for a clear description and evidence such as screenshots, video and logs, and add any missing information in the dispute.
qs.t: Duplicate sabse common rejection - pehle list check.

qs.q: What is the +1 Confirm Issue feature and how do you use it?
qs.s: +1 ya confirm issue feature se tester kisi doosre tester ka reported bug confirm karta hai agar wo reproduce kar sake. Kab use karo: doosre ka bug reproduce kar sakte ho aur sure ho report sahi aur in scope hai; ya tumhe bug mila par kisi aur ne pehle report kar diya - tab confirm karo. Benefits: confirm kiya bug approve hua to rating me small boost; customers ki help hoti hai. Steps: (1) cycle page kholo, Issues tab pe jao, (2) bug dhoondo, (3) '+1' button click karo, (4) apna environment select karo, comment do aur attachment upload karo - visual bug me usually sirf screenshot; jo bug sirf screenshot se nahi dikh sakta usme video, (5) '+1 Confirm Issue Reproduction' click karo aur confirmation message ka wait karo. Note: reproduce nahi kar sakte to +1 mat karo. Har +1 me attachment ho jo bug clearly dikhaye. Misuse mat karo, TTL saari activity monitor karta hai.
qs.b: The +1 Confirm Issue feature lets me confirm another tester's bug that I can reproduce, including when they reported the same bug before me. If the confirmed bug is approved, I get a small rating boost and it helps the customer. I open the Issues tab, click +1, select my environment, add a comment and an attachment, a screenshot for visual bugs or a video otherwise, then click '+1 Confirm Issue Reproduction'. I never +1 a bug I cannot reproduce, as the TTL monitors this.
qs.t: +1 = reproduce kiya + attachment; boost milta hai approve pe.

qs.q: What is the Issue Quality Review feature and how does it evaluate reports?
qs.s: Issue Quality Review feature submit hote hi issue reports ko automatically check karta hai, agar cycle me enabled ho. Iska purpose overall report quality aur consistency improve karna aur testers aur TTLs dono ke manual edits kam karna hai. Evaluation criteria: (1) Language - typing errors, grammar mistakes aur unprofessional language. (2) the platform Best Practices - the Academy courses ke hisaab se issue reports ke best practices. (3) Cycle Instructions - overview me diye instructions. Result: koi mistake nahi to report unchanged rehti hai. Kuch (few) mistakes hon to feature automatically report adjust karke galtiyan correct kar deta hai - status New hi rehta hai aur changes ka notification nahi milta. Multiple mistakes hon to feature report pe info request bhejta hai - notify hoge aur kisi bhi info request ki tarah fix karna padega.
qs.b: Issue Quality Review automatically checks issue reports on submission when enabled in the cycle, to improve quality and consistency and reduce manual edits. It evaluates language, including typos, grammar and unprofessional wording, the Academy best practices, and the cycle instructions. If there are no mistakes the report is unchanged, if there are a few it silently corrects them and the status stays New, and if there are multiple mistakes it sends an info request that I must address.
qs.t: IQR: 0 galti = same, kuch = chupchap fix (New), zyada = Info Request.

qs.q: How do you resolve an Info Request raised by the Issue Quality Review?
qs.s: Steps: (1) Issue report kholo aur Info Request message review karo. (2) 'Edit Issue' link click karo. (3) Har field ka side-by-side comparison dikhega - left side current version, right side Issue Quality Review ke suggested changes. Har field me suggestion ho zaroori nahi - jin fields me suggested fixes hain wo bold hote hain, baaki bold nahi. (4) Options: saare suggested changes accept karo - bina change kiye 'Submit New Version' click karo; ya kuch suggestions modify karke 'Submit New Version' click karo; ya saare suggestions reject karke original rakho - 'Re-Submit Original Version' click karo. (5) Uske baad report status wapas New ho jata hai aur TTLs notify hote hain.
qs.b: I open the report, read the Info Request and click Edit Issue, which shows a side-by-side view with my current version on the left and suggestions on the right, with suggested fields in bold. I can accept all suggestions with Submit New Version, modify some and then click Submit New Version, or reject them all with Re-Submit Original Version. The status then returns to New and the TTLs are notified.
qs.t: Left = mera, Right = IQR; Submit New Version ya Re-Submit Original Version.

qs.q: Can you discard a report after Issue Quality Review, and what are the important notes about the feature?
qs.s: Discard: IQR ke info request bhejne ke baad bhi report discard kar sakte ho - steps How to Edit an Issue Report course jaise: (1) issue report kholo, (2) 'Actions' button click karo, (3) 'Discard' select karo, (4) selection confirm karo. Ye tab bhi possible hai jab tumne report edit karke suggestions accept, modify ya reject kar diye hon. Important notes: (1) Evaluation sirf ek baar hota hai - edit karke dobara submit karoge to feature phir evaluate nahi karega. (2) Agar TTL, TE ya Customer report edit kare to feature ke suggestions invalid ho jaate hain aur report kholne pe suggested changes nahi dikhenge. (3) Info request address nahi kiya to cycle close hone pe report automatically reject ho jayegi. (4) Issue Quality Review ki limitations hain aur ye report quality kharab bhi kar sakta hai - apply karne se pehle suggested changes dhyan se check karo.
qs.b: I can still discard a report after an Issue Quality Review info request, using Actions then Discard and confirming, even after accepting, modifying or rejecting the suggestions. The evaluation runs only once, and any edit by the TTL, TE or customer invalidates its suggestions. If I ignore its info request, the report is automatically rejected when the cycle closes, and because the feature can sometimes worsen a report, I review its suggestions carefully before applying them.
qs.t: IQR ek hi baar; ignore = cycle close pe auto reject; suggestions aankh band karke mat lo.

qs.q: What is a Known Issue and where can you find Known Issues in a cycle?
qs.s: Known Issue (KI) aisa issue/defect hai jo customer ko pehle se pata hai - ya pichli cycle me report hua tha ya testing se pehle customer ne notice kiya. Known Issues cycle me report nahi karne chahiye kyunki customer aware hai; dobara report karoge to rejection. Teen jagah add hote hain: (1) Out of Scope Section - agar pichli cycles me report nahi hue aur kuch hi issues customer ko pata hain, to overview ke Out of Scope section me list hote hain. (2) External Known Issue Sheet - agar bahut saare KIs hain jo pichli cycles me report nahi hue, to external Known Issues file me add hote hain; file overview me attachment ke roop me ya external file ka link diya jata hai, aur Out of Scope section me Known Issues ke baare me ek point add hota hai. (3) Issues list - agar KIs pichli cycles me report hue the to cycle ke Issues tab ki Issues list me add hote hain; aise KI ke title ke right side pe blue flag hota hai.
qs.b: A Known Issue is a defect the customer already knows about, either reported in a previous cycle or noticed before testing, so it should not be reported again or it will be rejected. Known Issues appear in the Out of Scope section when there are only a few, in an external Known Issues sheet attached or linked in the overview when there are many, or in the cycle's Issues tab marked with a blue flag when they were reported in previous cycles.
qs.t: KI 3 jagah: OOS, External sheet, Issues list (blue flag).

qs.q: What should you remember about Known Issues?
qs.s: Things to Remember: (1) testing shuru karne se pehle cycle overview dhyan se padho. (2) Har cycle me Known Issues nahi hote - cycle requirements review karke samjho. (3) Cycle me issue report karne se pehle Known Issues review karo. (4) Known Issues dobara report kiye to reject honge. (5) Koi Known Issue samajh nahi aaya to TTL se contact karo.
qs.b: I read the overview carefully before testing, remember that not every cycle has Known Issues, and review any Known Issues before reporting. Reporting a Known Issue again leads to rejection, and if I do not understand one, I ask the TTL.
qs.t: KI dobara = reject; samajh na aaye = TTL.

qs.q: What are the general best practices for issue reporting on the platform?
qs.s: Lesson 10 best practices: (1) Hamesha 'Issue Reporting Instructions' follow karo - ye overview me milte hain; bug report se pehle padho aur follow karo. (2) Bug report field rules hamesha follow karo. (3) Valid bugs report karo - ensure karo bug valid hai, saari cycle requirements meet karta hai aur duplicate nahi; isse rejections se bachoge. (4) Time pe respond karo - TTL, TE ya customer extra info maange ya kuch fix karne bole to jaldi reply karo; report update na karna rejection tak le ja sakta hai. (5) High-quality bug report submit karo - matlab saari info, saare required attachments aur bina errors.
qs.b: I always read and follow the Issue Reporting Instructions in the overview and the field rules, and I only report valid, in-scope, non-duplicate bugs. I respond quickly when the TTL, TE or customer asks for more information, since failing to update can cause rejection. A high-quality report includes all information and required attachments without errors.
qs.t: Instructions + valid + jaldi reply + complete report.

qs.q: What is Bug Report Integrity?
qs.s: Bug Report Integrity optional feature hai jo TTL/TE/TSM bug reports ki quality ke liye testers ko reward ya warn karne ke liye use karte hain. Teen types: High Integrity, Low Integrity, aur Unrated (default option, saare bugs ke liye). High Integrity: bug report tabhi high rate hogi jab bahut valuable bug ho aur/ya bahut well-written report ho jisme saari required info aur attachments hon; tester rating pe positive impact. Low Integrity: high ka opposite; most likely low rate hogi agar cycle ke bug report instructions follow nahi kiye, poorly written report di, TTL/TE ya customer ne baar baar more info maangi, ya unprofessional tarike se respond kiya; tester rating pe negative impact. Note: saari bug reports unrated rehti hain jab tak TTL/TE ya TSM high ya low rate karne ka decide na karein.
qs.b: Bug Report Integrity is an optional rating the TTL, TE or TSM uses to reward or warn testers about report quality, with three values: High, Low and Unrated, which is the default. High Integrity is for very valuable bugs or very well-written, complete reports and improves the tester rating. Low Integrity results from ignoring instructions, poor writing, repeated info requests or unprofessional responses, and lowers the rating.
qs.t: Integrity: High (+), Low (-), Unrated (default).

qs.q: What does 'do not report placeholder bugs' mean and why is professionalism important?
qs.s: Placeholder bugs: Submit click karne se pehle report ka saara content finalize karo. Baad me minor edits kar sakte ho, par major edits nahi - including bug title, actions performed, expected results aur actual results. Full attachments ke bina aur required fields me sahi info bhare bina kabhi submit mat karo - ye placeholder bug hai, aur placeholder bugs report karna the platform Terms of Use ke against hai. Be professional: hamesha professional aur polite raho. Saare disputes aur tester messenger messages the platform aur customer monitor karte hain, isliye communication me hamesha professional aur polite rehna important hai.
qs.b: A placeholder bug is one submitted without full attachments or correct required fields, or one whose title, steps, expected or actual results are majorly changed later; only minor edits are acceptable, and placeholders violate the platform Terms of Use. Professionalism matters because all disputes and tester messenger messages are monitored by the platform and the customer, so I always communicate politely.
qs.t: Minor edit OK, major edit = placeholder.

qs.q: What do good and poor dispute messages look like?
qs.s: Good dispute Example 1: 'Hi TTL, Thank you for reviewing the report. However, I still believe the issue is valid and in scope because (short, clear detailed explanation). I have edited/improved the steps and provided new attachments to clearly show the issue. Could you please review the issue again? Thank you.' Good Example 2: 'Dear TTL, I always look to see if there is any duplicate issue before submitting any issue report. Also, I have already checked the issue #... you referred to as a duplicate before reporting this issue. However, your decision is not clear, because (short, clear explanation aur dono issues ka difference). I have also added a new video showing the difference between the two reports. Is it possible to recheck both issues and reevaluate this issue report again? Best regards.' Poor (is tone ko community me use mat karo) Example 1: 'Are you kidding me? I do not agree with this rejection, can someone else with more experience review the issue?' Example 2: 'Well that's not cool. Are you blind? My issue is totally different than the issue #..... Check it again and approve my issue report.' Ye unprofessional hain aur bhejne se pehle edit karne chahiye.
qs.b: A good dispute thanks the TTL, explains briefly and clearly why the issue is valid and in scope, or how it differs from the referenced duplicate, mentions improved steps or new attachments, and politely asks for a re-review. Poor disputes are sarcastic or insulting, such as 'Are you kidding me?' or 'Are you blind?', and demand approval, which shows a lack of professionalism.
qs.t: Thank + reason + naya evidence + please review; taana nahi.

topics.intro: Issue report ke saare fields, title/steps/attachments ke rules, editing, severity vs value, rejections, dispute, +1, Issue Quality Review, Known Issues aur integrity - poora course.

topics.name: Platform Mobile App

qs.q: What is the platform mobile app and what can you do with it?
qs.s: 2020 me the platform ne Android aur iOS devices ke liye official mobile app release kiya - experience flexible banata hai aur testing on the go allow karta hai. Features: (1) test cycle invitations receive aur accept karna, (2) slots aur test cases claim karna, (3) test cases execute karna aur issues report karna, (4) test case unclaim ya un-submit (Undo Submission) karna, (5) TTL messages dekhna ya issues aur test cases pe info requests ka response dena, (6) test cycle invitations aur in-cycle announcements ki push notifications, (7) basic user profile maintenance, (8) survey invitations (SRS) receive, accept aur decline karna, (9) cycle chat rooms ya project chat rooms me testers aur TTLs se chat, (10) tum ya @all mention hone pe push notifications. App improve hota rehta hai - automatic updates on rakho. Note: mobile app se the platform community access nahi kar sakte.
qs.b: The platform released its official Android and iOS app in 2020 to enable testing on the go. It lets me accept invitations, claim slots and test cases, execute test cases, report issues, unclaim or undo submissions, respond to TTL messages and info requests, get push notifications, maintain my profile, handle SRS surveys and chat in cycle or project rooms. The platform community itself cannot be accessed from the app.
qs.t: App 2020; sab kuch hota hai bas community nahi.

qs.q: What are the main navigation sections of the platform mobile app?
qs.s: Login page: app install ke baad pehle dikhta hai, existing the platform credentials se login; 'Forgot your password?' link se password reset. Login ke baad app chaar main sections me divided: Home, Projects, Chat aur Profile. Home: current test cycle invites aur accepted cycles/cases jo jaldi end ho rahe hain (24 hours ke andar). Projects ya test cases cards me dikhte hain, ek se zyada ho to horizontally scroll. Title tap karke project invitation, ending soon cycle ya test case kholo. Received SRS (Special Requirement Survey) bhi yahan. Top left Bell icon issue reports aur test cases se related saari unread notifications kholta hai, jaise test case pe info request. Projects: saari accepted test cycles - teen tabs Active, Pending aur Locked. Har cycle card me title, start aur end date, reported issues ki sankhya, cycle me testers ki sankhya aur cycle type (Functional, Usability, etc.).
qs.b: After logging in with the platform credentials, the app has four sections: Home, Projects, Chat and Profile. Home shows current invitations, accepted cycles or test cases ending within 24 hours, SRS surveys and a bell icon for unread notifications. Projects lists accepted cycles under Active, Pending and Locked tabs, with each card showing the title, dates, issue count, tester count and cycle type.
qs.t: 4 tabs: Home, Projects, Chat, Profile; Home = 24 ghante me ending.

qs.q: What do the Chat and Profile sections of the app offer?
qs.s: Chat tab: cycle chat rooms ka access. Chat room cycle status ke hisaab se Active, Locked ya Pending classify hota hai. Jin chat projects me invite kiya gaya aur jin testers ko contacts me add kiya, wo bhi access kar sakte ho. Category name tap karke expand karo. Ek se zyada cycle me ho to Search field se cycle ka naam search karo. My Account section me 'Permanently Delete Account' link tap karke account permanently delete karne ki request kar sakte ho. Profile tab: basic profile info change karo - pencil button tap karke edit; device se avatar upload. Settings: Profile tab ke top left corner pe settings button; push notifications adjust karo; legal docs padho - About the platform, Terms and Conditions, Privacy Policy aur End User License Agreement. Sign out ke liye 'Log Out' button.
qs.b: The Chat tab gives access to cycle chat rooms grouped as Active, Locked or Pending, plus chat projects and contacts, with a search field to find a cycle by name, and a 'Permanently Delete Account' link under My Account. The Profile tab lets me edit basic information with the pencil button and upload an avatar. Settings, at the top left of Profile, covers push notifications, legal documents and Log Out.
qs.t: Chat = rooms + delete account; Profile = pencil + Settings (Log Out).

qs.q: What tabs are available on a test cycle page in the platform app?
qs.s: Projects tab se cycle title tap karke details kholo. Accept na ki hui cycle khologe to sirf Overview aur Slots tab access hote hain; invitation accept karne ke baad additional tabs aate hain jo horizontally scroll hote hain. Overview: In Scope, Out of Scope, Bug Payout jaise sections; mobile viewing ke liye expand/collapse. Testing se pehle overview dhyan se padho. Slots: cycle slots use karti ho to dikhta hai; available aur claimed slots; 'Claim' button se claim; claim limit pe pahunche slots ke liye 'Join Waitlist'. Search field se specific slot dhoondo. Claim ke baad Available aur Claimed dono dikhte hain. Test Cases: available ya claimed test cases; yahan se claim bhi; tap karke steps review/complete. Issues: cycle me ab tak reported issues; search aur filter; tap karke samjho. Bottom right green bug icon tap karke issue report. Attachments: builds ya supplemental info wale attachments; tap karke view/download. Announcements: TTL ya TE ke cycle announcements; kuch ko acknowledge karna hota hai 'Acknowledge' button se. Announcements pe dhyan do, important info hoti hai.
qs.b: Before accepting a cycle I can only see the Overview and Slots tabs; after accepting, more tabs appear. Overview has collapsible sections like In Scope, Out of Scope and Bug Payout; Slots lets me claim or join a waitlist; Test Cases lists available and claimed test cases; Issues lists reported issues with search, filters and a green bug icon to report. Attachments holds builds and supplemental files, and Announcements shows TTL or TE announcements, some of which need the Acknowledge button.
qs.t: O-S-T-I-A-A: Overview, Slots, Test Cases, Issues, Attachments, Announcements.

qs.q: How do you accept or decline a test cycle invitation in the platform app?
qs.s: Naye invitation pe the platform app ki push notification aur email aata hai. Steps: (1) notification tap karo (app ka home tab khulega) ya app kholo. (2) 'Projects Invite' section me cycle invitations dekho. (3) Cycle title tap karo. (4) Checkbox select karke 'Accept NDA' button se cycle NDA accept karo. (5) Cycle page pe overview dhyan se padho, saare sections (In Scope, Out of Scope) expand karke padho, phir decide karo accept ya decline. (6) Accept ke liye 'Accept Cycle' tap karo. (7) Decline ke liye 'Decline Cycle' tap karo, decline reason batao, comment add karo aur 'Decline' tap karo. Notes: cycle me special requirements hon to 'Accept Cycle' button disabled rahega - checkbox tap karke confirm karo ki saari requirements meet karte ho, phir accept. Mandatory slotting enabled ho to 'Accept & Claim Slot' tap karne pe slots tab khulega, cycle join karne ke liye slot claim karna hoga. Claim limit wale slot ki waitlist join kar sakte ho, par waitlist join karna matlab officially invitation accept karna nahi; waitlist chhod kar decline bhi kar sakte ho. Cycle join karne ke liye Exploratory slot claim karo agar applicable.
qs.b: I get a push notification and an email for new invitations, open it under Projects Invite, accept the NDA with the checkbox and Accept NDA, read the full overview, then tap Accept Cycle or Decline Cycle with a reason and comment. If the cycle has special requirements I must tick a checkbox confirming them before accepting, and with mandatory slotting, Accept & Claim Slot takes me to the slots tab. Joining a waitlist does not count as accepting the cycle, so I claim an exploratory slot to join if one exists.
qs.t: NDA -> Overview -> Accept/Decline; waitlist != accepted.

qs.q: How do you claim and unclaim slots and test cases in the platform app?
qs.s: The platform slots se tester participation manage karta hai; slot claim karne se cycle me position guaranteed hoti hai. App lesson me 2 types: Test Case linked slots - ek ya zyada test cases se linked, claim karne pe test cases bhi assign. Exploratory slots - testing team me jagah guarantee par koi test case nahi; exploratory testing karo. Claim: cycle page kholo, slots tab, available slots dekho aur jiske liye qualify karte ho uska 'Claim' tap karo. Test Case linked slot claim kiya to Test Cases tab me test case(s) dekho. Free Test Case linked slots na hon to 'Join Waitlist' tap karo; 'Leave Waitlist' se chhodo. Test Cases tab se bhi available test cases claim kar sakte ho - BFV test cases ke case me ya jab slot feature disabled ho. Unclaim steps: (1) the platform app kholo, (2) Projects tab se cycle kholo, (3) Slots tab, Claimed section me 'Unclaim' button click karo.
qs.b: In the app, claiming a slot guarantees a position in the cycle; Test Case linked slots assign test cases, while Exploratory slots give a place without a test case. I claim from the Slots tab with the Claim button, can Join or Leave a waitlist when no test case slots are free, and can claim directly from the Test Cases tab for BFV test cases or when slots are disabled. To unclaim, I open the cycle from Projects, go to Slots, and tap Unclaim in the Claimed section.
qs.t: Slots tab -> Claim; Claimed section -> Unclaim.

qs.q: How do you report, edit and discard issues in the platform app?
qs.s: Issue ya bug product ke design ya functionality me unexpected behavior ya malfunction hai. App se seedha mobile device se issues report aur attachments add kar sakte ho. Reporting process 4-5 steps me divided; cycle step 5 me additional info maang sakti hai. Steps: (1) kisi bhi cycle page se Issues tab pe jao. (2) Screen ke bottom right me 'Report Bug' button tap karo, form khulega. (3) Har step me required details do aur 'Next' tap karke aage badho. (4) Saare steps complete hone pe 'Submit' click karke report karo. Edit: Issues tab se issue kholo, top right corner ka three dots button tap karo, 'Edit Issue' tap karo, changes karke submit. Discard: issue kholo, three dots, 'Discard Issue' tap karo.
qs.b: In the app I go to the Issues tab, tap Report Bug at the bottom right, fill each of the 4 to 5 steps with Next, the fifth being any additional information the cycle requires, and tap Submit. To edit or discard, I open the issue, tap the three dots at the top right, and choose Edit Issue or Discard Issue.
qs.t: Report Bug -> Next x4/5 -> Submit; three dots = Edit/Discard.

qs.q: How do you view messages and respond to info requests on issues in the app?
qs.s: Steps (Reporting Issues lesson): (1) the platform app kholo. (2) Home ya Projects tab pe top right Notifications icon press karo. (3) Jis message ka response dena hai uspe press karo - notifications page pe saari notifications dikhti hain, message ho ya more information ki request. (4) Report ya test case requested ke hisaab se fix karo, phir 'Send Confirmation' press karo confirm karne ke liye ki required info de di. (5) Agar message hai to dekho, zaroorat ho to changes karo aur respond karo. (6) Ye issue ya test case page se bhi ho sakta hai jis pe TTL ne message/info request bheji - use kholo aur top right Notifications icon press karo.
qs.b: I open the app and tap the Notifications icon at the top right of Home or Projects, which lists both messages and info requests. For an info request, I fix the report or test case and press Send Confirmation; for a message, I make any needed changes and reply. The same can be done from the issue or test case page via its Notifications icon.
qs.t: Notifications icon -> fix -> Send Confirmation.

qs.q: How do you execute and submit test cases in the platform app?
qs.s: Test case product test karne ke steps ki series hai; app se view, execute aur submit kar sakte ho. Viewing: cycle page pe Test Cases tab - available aur claimed test cases. Test case title tap karke steps dekho. Upar progress bar, tester, build aur environment details; neeche instructions aur saare steps. Claimed environment pe hi execute karna bahut important hai. Executing: (1) test case page kholo aur kisi step pe tap karo - step 1 se shuru karo. (2) Instructions padho aur step ko Done ya Pass/Fail mark karo. Attachment upload ke liye 'Results attachments' ke neeche '+' button tap karo. Horizontally swipe karke steps ke beech move karo. (3) Pass ya Fail mark karne pe comment maanga jata hai - Pass pe comment optional, Fail pe mandatory. (4) Fail karne pe issue report karne ko kaha jayega - naya report karne se pehle existing reported issues review karo; issue pehle se reported hai to pop-up pe 'Cancel' tap karo. (5) Saare steps ke baad 'Submit Test Case' tap karo. (6) Time spent details aur comments do, phir dobara 'Submit' tap karo.
qs.b: In the app's Test Cases tab, I open a test case to see the progress bar, tester, build, environment and steps, and I must execute it on the environment I claimed. I start from step 1, mark each step Done, Pass or Fail, add attachments with the plus button, and swipe between steps; comments are optional on Pass but mandatory on Fail. On a fail I check existing issues before reporting, tapping Cancel if it already exists, then tap Submit Test Case, enter time spent and submit.
qs.t: Fail pe comment must; already reported = Cancel; Submit Test Case -> time -> Submit.

qs.q: How do you un-submit a test case and respond to an info request on it in the app?
qs.s: App se test case unclaim ya un-submit (Undo Submission) kar sakte ho aur messages/info requests ka response de sakte ho. Steps: (1) app kholo. (2) Home ya Projects tab pe top right Notifications icon press karo. (3) Jis message ka response dena hai uspe press karo - notifications page pe messages aur info requests dono. (4) Message hai to dekho, zaroorat ho to changes karo aur respond karo. (5) Request for more information hai to aage ke steps. (6) Message kholo aur TTL ka message dhyan se padho. (7) '<' icon tap karke test case page pe wapas jao, scroll down karke 'Unsubmit Test Case' button tap karo aur edit karne ke liye message confirm karo. (8) Requested ke hisaab se fix karo. (9) Saare changes ke baad '<' icon se test case page pe wapas jao, scroll karke 'Submit Test Case' tap karo. (10) Time spent do aur koi valuable comment (optional). (11) 'Submit' tap karo. (12) Phir top right Notification icon tap karke 'Send Confirmation' button tap karo ye confirm karne ke liye ki saari requested info de di. (13) Ye test case page se bhi ho sakta hai - kholo aur top right Notifications icon press karo.
qs.b: For a test case info request in the app, I open it from the Notifications icon, read the TTL's message, go back to the test case and tap Unsubmit Test Case, then fix what was requested. I tap Submit Test Case, enter the time spent and optional comments, tap Submit, and finally tap Send Confirmation from the Notifications icon to confirm all requested information was provided.
qs.t: Unsubmit -> Fix -> Submit -> Send Confirmation.

qs.q: What is a Special Requirements Survey (SRS) and how do you handle it in the app?
qs.s: SRS ek tool hai jo widely un projects ke liye testers recruit karne me use hota hai jinki unique requirements tester profile se capture nahi hoti. Ye surveys the platform ko tumhare baare me zyada jaanne me madad karte hain taaki unique testing projects se better match ho. App me survey invitations dekh, accept, decline aur complete kar sakte ho. Answer karne ke steps: (1) the platform App kholo, (2) Home tab pe 'Requirement Survey Requested' section se SRS kholo, (3) 'Take Survey' button tap karo, (4) saare questions honestly answer karo, (5) 'Next' tap karke agle question pe jao, (6) response review karo ki sab sahi hai, (7) finish hone pe 'Submit Survey' tap karo. Decline: (1) app kholo, (2) Home tab ke 'Requirement Survey Requested' section se SRS kholo, (3) eligible nahi ho to 'Decline' button tap karo. Note: Decline tap karte hi bina confirmation ke SRS decline ho jata hai - galti se tap mat karna.
qs.b: A Special Requirements Survey recruits testers for projects with unique requirements that the tester profile cannot capture, helping the platform match me to suitable projects. In the app I open it from the 'Requirement Survey Requested' section on Home, tap Take Survey, answer honestly, review and tap Submit Survey. If I am not eligible I tap Decline, which happens immediately without confirmation, so I must avoid tapping it by accident.
qs.t: SRS Decline = bina confirmation, seedha gaya.

qs.q: How does chat work in the platform mobile app, including tagging?
qs.s: Access: Chat tab pe jao, option chuno - Projects, active test cycles, pending test cycles, locked test cycles ya contacts - phir cycle, project ya contact name tap karo. Cycle chat ke do default rooms: Announcements aur Questions; top right user icon saare users dikhata hai. Announcements tab me TTL/TE ke saare chat announcements. Questions room me testers cycle ke sawal pooch sakte hain, help maang sakte hain aur doosre testers, TTLs aur TEs ke messages dekh sakte hain. Messages web version jaise bhejo, @ tag feature samet. Tagging: tester aur TTL '@testername' mention kar sakte hain - sirf us tester/TTL ko apna naam highlighted dikhta hai aur push notification milti hai. Tester '@ttl' mention kar sakta hai - sirf us cycle ke assigned TTLs ko highlighted dikhta hai aur unhe push notification milti hai. TTL '@all' mention kar sakta hai - chat room ke saare users ke liye highlighted, sabka attention, saare testers ko push notification.
qs.b: In the app's Chat tab I can open project, active, pending or locked cycle chats, or contacts. Each cycle chat has two default rooms, Announcements for TTL and TE announcements and Questions for asking for help. I can mention @testername, which highlights and notifies only that person, or @ttl to notify the cycle's assigned TTLs, while only a TTL can use @all to notify everyone in the room.
qs.t: 2 rooms: Announcements + Questions; @ttl tester ka, @all TTL ka.

qs.q: How do you reply, react, search and enable chat notifications in the platform app?
qs.s: Message Reply: message ke right side three dots tap karo, 'reply' tap karo, message type karo aur 'send' tap karo. Message ka thread kholne ke liye message ke neeche 'replies' link tap karo. Reacting: message ke paas three dots tap karke reaction icon select karo. Search: chat room ke top right corner me search icon; tap karo, keyword type karo aur search tap karo; results me left aur right arrows (search field ke neeche) se navigate karo. Notifications: @all, @testername ya @ttl tags use hone pe notifications mil sakti hain. Enable steps: (1) 'Profile' tab pe jao, (2) 'Settings' select karo, (3) Push notifications tap karo, (4) 'Chat @ Mentions' toggle enable karo. Note: chat rooms me the platform Terms of use follow karo, aur Academy Communications course review karo.
qs.b: To reply in app chat I tap the three dots next to a message and choose reply, and the replies link opens the thread; reactions are also added through the three dots. The search icon at the top right finds messages, with arrows to move between results. To get mention notifications, I go to Profile, Settings, Push notifications and enable the Chat @ Mentions toggle, and I always follow the platform Terms of Use in chat.
qs.t: Three dots = reply/react; Profile > Settings > Push > Chat @ Mentions.

topics.intro: platform ka official mobile app - navigation, cycle tabs, invitations, slots, issues, test cases, SRS aur chat, sab phone se.

topics.name: Practice Bug Site

qs.q: What is the practice bug site and why was it created?
qs.s: The practice bug site naye testers ko simple aur effective tarike se samjhane ke liye bani hai ki bugs kya hote hain aur unhe kaise dhoondein. Academy courses improve karne ke efforts me banayi gayi. Purpose: Academy practice cycles ya paid cycles me participate karne se pehle bugs ki better understanding. Website ke 4 sections hain jo bugs kya hain, unke types aur kaise dhoondein - iski basic knowledge dete hain. Use karna simple hai: https://www.academybugs.com kholo aur question mark '?' icon click karke 'Tutorial' use karo - guide website ka tour deta hai aur use karna sikhata hai.
qs.b: The practice bug site is a practice website built to help new testers understand what bugs are and how to find them, as part of improving the Academy courses, before they join Academy practice cycles or paid cycles. It has four sections covering what bugs are, their types and how to find them, and a Tutorial opened through the question mark icon gives a guided tour.
qs.t: AcademyBugs = practice ground; '?' = Tutorial.

qs.q: What are the sections of the practice bug site?
qs.s: Sections: (1) Examples of Bugs - 6 tiles; har tile ek bug ke example pe le jati hai; tile click karke bug reveal karo. (2) Types of Bugs - 5 tiles; har tile alag type ke bug ka example; click karke reveal. (3) Find Bugs - practice site jisme 25 bugs planted hain; pages thoroughly explore karo aur 20 bugs dhoondne ki koshish karo; aur practice chahiye to saare 25 dhoondo. (4) Report Bugs - 5 tabs; har tab me high quality bug reports banane ki practice. Tutorial: website navigate karna mushkil lage to top right corner ka '?' icon click karo - Tutorial features me guide karega.
qs.b: The practice bug site has four sections: Examples of Bugs with 6 tiles, Types of Bugs with 5 tiles each showing a different bug type, Find Bugs with a practice site containing 25 planted bugs where the goal is to find 20, and Report Bugs with 5 tabs for practising high-quality bug reports. A Tutorial is available from the question mark icon in the top right corner.
qs.t: 6 examples, 5 types, 25 planted (20 dhoondo), 5 report tabs.

qs.q: What should a new tester do on the practice bug site?
qs.s: Understand bugs and bug types: (1) the practice bug site website kholo, (2) Examples of Bugs aur Types of Bugs sections explore karo, (3) examples dekh kar samjho bugs kya hain aur unke different types. Find bugs on your own: (1) samajh aane ke baad Find Bugs section pe jao, (2) Find Bugs page explore karke kam se kam 20 hidden bugs dhoondo, (3) kam se kam 20 bugs milne ke baad quiz attempt karo. Create bug reports: (1) Report Bugs page pe jao, (2) sahi choices select karke pehli bug report banao, (3) 'Submit Issue' button click karke results dekho, (4) agli pe jao aur saari 5 bug reports complete karo.
qs.b: I first explore the Examples of Bugs and Types of Bugs sections to understand bugs and their types. Then I use the Find Bugs page to locate at least 20 hidden bugs before attempting the quiz. Finally, on the Report Bugs page I build each of the 5 bug reports by selecting the correct choices and clicking Submit Issue to see my results.
qs.t: Samjho -> 20 dhoondo -> Quiz -> 5 reports.

topics.intro: AcademyBugs.com naye testers ki practice site hai - bugs ke examples, types, 25 planted bugs aur report banane ki practice.

topics.name: Tips and Tricks

qs.q: What are the main roles and team acronyms used on the platform projects?
qs.s: Lesson 1 (Terms and Acronyms) me the platform Terms ki list hai, roles wale terms ye hain: ACA (Accessibility Auditor) = tester jo audits me accessibility bugs report karta hai aur test cases complete karta hai, abhi bhi team se kuch direction/help chahiye hoti hai. ACE (Accessibility Expert) = team member jo ek saath kai audits lead karta hai, dusre accessibility members ko mentor karta hai aur client ko final audit results present karta hai. Client or Customer = company jisne the company aur the platform Community ko apna product test karne ke liye engage kiya. CE (Community Engineer) = members jo CM team ke saath close kaam karte hain aur unke tasks me help karte hain. CM (Community Manager) = Community Management Team ke members; goal hai global community ko excellent tester banna sikhana, paid projects ke opportunities dilana, aur testers ko connect karna. DT (Dedicated Tester) = team ko speed, specialized expertise aur quality control deta hai; singular focus, deep dive; peers ke liye expert, TTL ko chat management me support karta hai. Strong quality history wale testers ko TSM/TE DT banne ke liye approach kar sakte hain. Moderator = live instructor; individuals ko product criteria ke hisaab se use karwata hai, questions answer karta hai, issues resolve karta hai, feedback collect karta hai. SDM (Solution Delivery Manager) = customer ka primary point of contact, customer ke saath directly kaam karta hai. TCW (Test Case Writer) = test cases likhta hai (clear, detailed steps aur expected results), customer ke documents/test cases valid hain ya nahi verify karta hai aur adjust karta hai. TE (Test Engineer) = test cycle build karta hai, testing team assemble karta hai, cycle ke overall execution ka responsible; team ko completion tak 'marshal' karta hai. TTL (Test Team Lead) = testers ka primary point of contact; cycle me testers ki help karta hai aur sab submitted bug reports aur test cases review karta hai. TSM (Testing Service Manager) = client ke saath directly kaam karta hai; TTLs aur TEs ki team manage karta hai taaki client ki testing, feedback ya research needs ka solution mile.
qs.b: On the platform the tester's first contact is the Test Team Lead (TTL), who helps testers and reviews all bug reports and test cases. The Test Engineer (TE) builds the cycle, assembles the team and owns execution, while the Testing Service Manager (TSM) works directly with the client and manages TEs and TTLs. Other roles include Dedicated Testers (DT), Test Case Writers (TCW), Community Managers (CM) and Engineers (CE), the Solution Delivery Manager (SDM) and accessibility roles ACA and ACE.
qs.t: Ladder yaad rakho: Tester -> TTL -> TE -> TSM; SDM = customer ka contact.

qs.q: Explain the platform process terms like BFV, IR, Triage, Placeholder, Turnaround Time and SRS.
qs.s: The platform Terms list ke process wale terms: BFV (Bug Fix Verification) = jab fix ya new build release ho to check karna ki reported bug fix hua ya nahi; the company customers ko new build aane par re-test chalane deta hai. Environment = device, OS, OS version, browser ya koi specific setup jo testing me use hota hai. KB (Knowledge Base) = kisi product/service/department/topic ki self-serve online library. NDA (Non Disclosure Agreement) = legal binding agreement jisme parties confidential info disclose na karne ka agree karti hain. IR (Info Request) = bug report ya test case par aur info maangi jaati hai, ya tester ko report/test case fix karna hota hai. Placeholder = incomplete info ya required attachments ke bina submit kiya gaya issue report, sirf position reserve karne ke liye, baad me edit/complete karne ya kisi aur bug me badalne ke liye. Reproduction = bug report ke action performed steps follow karke bug dobara create karna. SRS (Special Requirement Survey) = tool jo Testing Services aur Community Management testers recruit karne ke liye use karte hain jab aise data points chahiye jo platform abhi capture nahi karta. Triage/Triaging = bug report ya test case review karna, phir info request bhejna ya approval/rejection recommend karna. Turnaround Time = time limit jisme kaam submit karna hai; example: 6 hours turnaround wala slot/test case claim karne ke 6 ghante ke andar submit karna hai.
qs.b: Triage is reviewing a bug report or test case and then sending an info request or recommending approval or rejection. An Info Request (IR) asks the tester for more information or to fix the report. Turnaround time is the deadline after claiming a slot or test case, for example 6 hours. A placeholder is an incomplete report submitted only to reserve position, BFV verifies a fix on a new build, and an SRS is a survey used to recruit testers for data points the platform does not capture.
qs.t: Triage = review + IR ya approve/reject recommend; Turnaround 6h = claim ke 6 ghante.

qs.q: What do DNFI, DUP, KI, INF, OOS, WNF and WAD mean on the platform?
qs.s: Ye bug outcome/rejection wale terms hain (Lesson 1 the platform Terms): DNFI (Did Not Follow Instructions) = reported bug ne test cycle overview ke instructions follow nahi kiye. DUP (Duplicate) = issue current cycle me already reported issue jaisa hai ya known issue hai. KI (Known Issue) = pichle test cycles me mile issues ya jo customer ko already pata hain. Duplicates rokne me help karte hain; rejection se bachne ke liye testing start karne se pehle hamesha check karo. Cycle me spreadsheet jaisa add ho sakte hain, ya issues page ke title column me issue ke paas blue 'bookmark' tag se pehchano. INF (Need more info) = rejection type jab tester ne info request bhejne par requested info nahi di. OOS (Out of Scope) = bug us cheez me aata hai jo cycle overview ke Out Of Scope section me explicitly likhi hai. WNF (Won't Fix) = issue valid aur approved hai lekin customer interested nahi ya fix karne ka plan nahi. WAD (Work as Designed) = product ki functionality ya design ka expected behavior.
qs.b: DNFI means the report did not follow the cycle overview instructions, DUP means it duplicates an issue already reported in the cycle or a known issue, OOS means it falls in the Out of Scope section, and INF means the tester did not provide information after an info request. WAD means the behaviour is as designed. WNF is different: the issue is valid and approved, but the customer does not plan to fix it. Known Issues are marked with a blue bookmark tag and should be checked before testing.
qs.t: WNF = approved but no fix; WAD = design hi aisa hai; KI = blue bookmark.

qs.q: What is a slot on the platform and what is the rule before claiming one?
qs.s: Testing Terms me Slot ki definition: slot ek reserved position hai tester ke liye specific requirements ke saath, jaise location, language, device, OS, payment method, specific setup jo use karna hai, etc. Bahut important: slot claim karne se pehle har slot me dikhaye gaye saare requirements meet karo, warna slot claim mat karo. Lesson 2 bhi kehta hai: slot claim karne se pehle slotting instructions aur us slot ka description padho; claim se pehle slot description ko click karke expand karo. Lesson 3 (Testers should not do): maximum limit tak slots claim karna taaki dusre claim na kar sakein, aur slot claim karke bina progress ke baithe rehna, dono galat hai. Testers should do: apne environment se match karne wale slots claim karo. Lesson 6: galat slot galti se claim ho jaye to unclaim karna zaroori hai kyunki wo invalid results dega.
qs.b: A slot is a reserved position for a tester with specific requirements such as location, language, device, OS, payment method or setup. Before claiming, I read the slotting instructions and expand the slot description, and I only claim it if I meet every requirement. I never hoard slots up to the maximum or sit on a claimed slot without progress, and if I claim a wrong slot by mistake I unclaim it.
qs.t: Slot = reserved seat; requirement match nahi to claim mat karo.

qs.q: Define the general testing types listed in the platform glossary (A/B to DVT).
qs.s: Testing Terms (part 1): A/B Testing = webpage element ke 2 ya zyada versions alag user segments ko dikha kar compare karna, specific metrics par kaun better perform karta hai. Accessibility (A11Y) = products ko sabke liye usable banana including disabilities wale log; inclusive user experience. Alpha Testing = initial phase, usually internal team release se pehle karti hai; bugs early pakadna, functionality, performance, usability evaluate karna. API Testing = APIs validate karna: functionality, reliability, performance, security; the platform par sabse challenging testing types me se ek. Beta Testing = public release se pehle real products ko real environments me test karna; controlled reporting environment me usability ya functional problems dhundhna. Black Box Testing = internal workings ki knowledge ke bina testing; user perspective se inputs dekar outputs observe karna. Bug Hunt Testing = robust exploratory test; goal sirf specific bug, ya specific device par specific bug, ya specific type ka bug dhundhna; overview aur requirements dhyan se padho, scope ke bahar ke issues report mat karo. Customer Experience (CE) = usability/UX se aage; digital aur physical products aur services ko customer journey ke online aur offline touch points par test karna. Customer Journey Testing (CJT) = product access karne se lekar ek task complete karne tak customer journey evaluate karna. Design Verification Testing (DVT) = verify karna ki product ka design specified requirements meet karta hai aur intended tarah kaam karta hai.
qs.b: A/B testing compares two or more versions of an element across user segments using metrics. Alpha testing is done internally before release, while beta testing uses real products in real environments before public release. Black box testing means testing only through inputs and outputs without knowing the internals. A Bug Hunt is a focused exploratory test looking for a specific bug or bug type, so out-of-scope reports must be avoided; API testing checks functionality, reliability, performance and security of APIs.
qs.t: Alpha = andar wale, Beta = asli users; Bug Hunt = sirf target bug.

qs.q: Explain exploratory, functional, live, load, localization, regression, sanity and smoke testing as defined in the platform glossary.
qs.s: Testing Terms (part 2): Exploratory Testing (ET) = tester apni knowledge aur experience se product ke vulnerable areas dhundhta hai; out of the box sochna aur alag approaches try karna. Functional (FN) = product ke features/functionality ki testing issues locate karne ke liye. Live Testing = specific time par testing; na late, na pehle. Load Testing = performance testing ka type; specific workload me system behavior aur performance check karna, deployment se pehle realistic user loads me kitna achha perform karega. Localization (LN) = target culture/locale ke hisaab se product quality verify karna. On-site Testing = physical location visit karke service quality evaluate karna aur feedback collect karna. Penetration Testing (PEN Testing) = product par authorized simulated attack, security evaluate karne ke liye. Regression Testing = ensure karna ki pehle fixed bugs wapas na aayein aur new changes naye issues na laayen; modified version par test cases re-run karna aur regression/new issues address karna. Sanity Testing = chhota change ya bug fix ke baad check ki change sahi implement hua aur naye issues nahi aaye, further testing se pehle. Smoke Testing = preliminary testing; deployed build ke core functions stable hain ya nahi; critical issues early pakadne ke liye. Test Case = product par kiye jaane wale actions ka set, check karne ke liye ki software requirements satisfy hote hain aur sahi kaam karta hai. User Experience (UX) = product ke saath poore interaction ka overall experience; expectations, satisfaction, usability, accessibility etc. Voice Testing = voice-enabled products ko native speakers ke saath test karna; functional testing, dialogue verification, usability testing aur payment testing combine karta hai.
qs.b: Smoke testing is a preliminary check that the core functions of a new build are stable. Sanity testing is done after a small change or fix to confirm it was implemented correctly without new issues. Regression testing re-runs test cases on the modified version to make sure fixed bugs do not resurface and changes do not introduce new issues. Exploratory testing uses the tester's knowledge to find vulnerable areas, and live testing must be done exactly at the scheduled time.
qs.t: Smoke = build zinda hai?; Sanity = fix sahi hua?; Regression = purana wapas to nahi aaya?

qs.q: List common website and app layout/navigation elements from the platform glossary.
qs.s: Website/App Elements Terms (part 1, general web elements): About Us = page jo batata hai business me kaun hai aur kya karta hai. Address Bar (URL Bar/Location Bar) = browser ke top par text field jo current URL dikhata hai, type karke Enter se navigate. Backend = server-side engine jo data storage, processing, management handle karta hai aur processed data front end ko bhejta hai. Bandwidth = network par ek time me kitna data transmit ho sakta hai. Banner = header, footer ya sidebar me digital advertisement. Breadcrumb = links se previous pages se current page tak ka path dikhane wala navigation feature. CTA (Call to Action) = button/link jo user ko specific action ke liye encourage kare; streaming examples: Subscribe, Watch Now, Start Your Free Trial. Carousel = images ya visual content ka slideshow. Cart/Bag/Basket = page jahan user kharidne wali cheezein jama karta hai. Captcha = challenge-response test, human hai ya bot; distorted text, image recognition, audio verification. Checkbox = chhota interactive box, positive/negative choice toggle. Cookie = website ka chhota data piece jo user ke device par store hota hai; cookies accept karne ko kaha ja sakta hai. Drop-down menu/list = hidden list jo button/icon click par khulti hai, ek value choose. Favicon = browser tab, search results ya bookmark me chhota icon. Field Validation = form accept hone se pehle har field me correct value hai ya nahi check karna. Footer = har page ke bottom ka area. FAQ = common questions aur answers ka section. Frontend = website/app ka wo part jo user dekhta aur interact karta hai. Hamburger Menu = screen space bachane ke liye hidden menu. Hero = website ke top par oversized banner image, sabse important content ka overview. Homepage = main page, URL load karne par pehla page. In-app notification = app open hone par app ke andar dikhne wale messages. Landing Page = ad, email link ya campaign click karne par khulne wala standalone page; purchase, newsletter signup ya download jaisa action karwana. LHN (Left-Hand Navigation) = left side ka vertical menu. Navigation bar = horizontal ya vertical menu bar, main sections tak quick access.
qs.b: Common elements include the address bar, breadcrumb navigation showing the path to the current page, the hamburger menu for hidden navigation, the hero banner at the top, the footer, and left-hand navigation.
