qs.b: On Android I press and hold Power and Volume Down together for a few seconds, or hold Power and tap Screenshot if that does not work. If neither works I check the manufacturer's support site; the image is saved in the gallery's screenshots folder.
qs.t: Android: Power + Volume Down.

qs.q: How do you highlight an Android screenshot?
qs.s: Method 1 app se, example iMarkup: 1) Google Play se iMarkup install karke kholo. 2) Import photo button tap karke Photo select. 3) Photos access allow karo aur screenshot chuno. 4) Neeche Draw button. 5) Neeche left swipe karke rectangle/circle chuno. 6) Bug ke around shape draw karke tick (check) button. 7) Satisfied ho to top right Export. 8) Sab as is chhodo, OK tap karke gallery me save. Method 2 computer se: screenshot computer par transfer karo, Windows par Paint ya macOS par Preview se highlight karo.
qs.b: I can annotate on the phone with an app such as iMarkup: import the screenshot, use Draw to add a rectangle or circle, confirm, then Export and save to the gallery. Alternatively I transfer it to a computer and highlight it in Paint on Windows or Preview on macOS.
qs.t: Phone par iMarkup, PC par Paint/Preview.

qs.q: How do you take a screenshot on iOS?
qs.s: Old iPhone models: Home + power/side button ek saath. New iPhone models: Power + Volume Up ek saath. Process Apple website par bhi hai (iPhone, iPad links).
qs.b: On older iPhones you press the Home and power or side buttons together; on newer iPhones you press Power and Volume Up together.
qs.t: Purana: Home+Power; Naya: Power+Volume Up.

qs.q: How do you highlight an iOS screenshot using the built-in Markup tool?
qs.s: Method 1 Markup: 1) Photos app kholke screenshot select. 2) Edit icon, phir upar Markup icon. 3) Bottom right plus button, Add Shape: rectangle ya circle. 4) Options panel ke left side Fill tap karke No Fill. 5) Uske bagal Stroke tap karke Red ya Yellow. 6) Bug ke around shape draw. 7) Top right Done do baar tap karke save. Method 2: computer par transfer karke Paint (Windows) ya Preview (macOS) se highlight.
qs.b: In Photos I open the screenshot, tap Edit then Markup, add a rectangle or circle shape, set Fill to No Fill and Stroke to red or yellow, draw it around the bug and tap Done twice. I can also transfer it to a computer and use Paint or Preview.
qs.t: iOS Markup: No Fill + Red Stroke, Done x2.

topics.intro: Bug report ke liye sahi screenshot lena aur highlight karna, har OS aur device par, rules ke saath.

topics.name: Screen Recordings

qs.q: What is a screen recording and what is the cloud-storage rule?
qs.s: Screen recording (screencast) computer ya mobile screen output ki digital recording hai. Isse kiye gaye actions dikhte hain aur bug samajhne aur reproduce karne me help milti hai. Important note: attachments upload karna ya koi bhi info cloud me store karna the platform Terms of Use ka violation hai, isliye ScreenPal me upload to ScreenPal select mat karo; yahi rule baaki methods par bhi lagta hai.
qs.b: A screen recording, or screencast, is a digital recording of a computer or mobile screen that shows the actions performed so the bug can be understood and reproduced. Storing recordings or any information in the cloud, such as uploading to ScreenPal, violates the platform Terms of Use.
qs.t: Video local rakho, cloud = violation.

qs.q: What rules must a screen recording follow?
qs.s: 5 rules: (1) No noise: microphone mute karo, apni voice sirf tab record karo jab test cycle specifically maange. (2) Entire screen: screenshot ki tarah poori screen, website test kar rahe ho to browser URL bar bhi. (3) Must match actions performed: video Actions Performed ke steps se match kare aur testing website ya app open hone se start ho. (4) Only mp4 format: sab recordings .mp4 me save aur upload, koi aur format nahi. (5) Keep it short: koshish karo 1 minute se kam; lekin 1 minute se lamba ho sakta hai agar sirf required reproduce steps dikha rahe ho.
qs.b: A screen recording must have no background noise unless the cycle asks for voice, show the entire screen including the URL bar, match the actions performed starting from opening the site or app, be in .mp4 format only, and be kept short, ideally under one minute unless more time is needed for the required steps.
qs.t: N-E-M-M-S: No noise, Entire screen, Match steps, Mp4, Short.

qs.q: What else should you remember about screen recordings on the platform?
qs.s: 6 points: (1) One recording per bug report: zaroorat na ho to ek se zyada recording upload mat karo. (2) Compress large files: badi video ko upload se pehle compress karo (HandBrake se, aage course me). (3) External camera: camera ya doosra mobile se screen record sirf tab jab test cycle specifically maange ya software recording possible na ho. (4) Confirm video is playable: upload ke baad platform ke andar play hoti hai check karo. (5) Do not save in the cloud: sirf tester ki local machine par save, phir test cycle ke bug report me upload. (6) Blur PII: GDPR violation se bachne ke liye PII mat dikhao, jab tak instruct na kiya ho; PII course dekho.
qs.b: Upload only one recording per bug report unless necessary, compress large files with a tool like HandBrake, use an external camera only if requested or software recording is impossible, confirm the uploaded video plays on the platform, never save recordings in the cloud, and blur any personally identifiable information to avoid GDPR violations.
qs.t: 1 video, chhota, playable, local, PII blur.

qs.q: How do you record the screen on Windows with ScreenPal?
qs.s: Windows me built-in tool nahi (notes ke Lesson 2 intro ke hisaab se), third-party options: ScreenPal (pehle ScreenCast-O-Matic), BandiCam. ScreenPal steps: 1) https://screenpal.com/screen-recorder par Launch Free Recorder. 2) .exe download hone ke baad run/install. 3) Install ke baad recorder khud khulega. 4) Record se pehle: microphone (Narration) off, jab tak narrate na kar rahe ho; fullscreen recording (Size > Fullscreen). 5) Rec click. 6) Khatam par stop, Done, phir Save/Upload. 7) Video file ki tarah save. 8) File type MP4. 9) Agli baar web page se sirf Launch Free Recorder click. Yaad rahe: upload to ScreenPal mat chuno.
qs.b: With ScreenPal I launch the free recorder from screenpal.com, install the exe, turn off narration and set Size to Fullscreen, click Rec, then stop and choose Done and Save/Upload, saving it locally as an MP4 video file. I never choose the upload to ScreenPal cloud option.
qs.t: ScreenPal: Narration off, Fullscreen, MP4, cloud nahi.

qs.q: How do you configure and record with BandiCam on Windows?
qs.s: Steps: 1) https://www.bandicam.com/downloads se Download Bandicam. 2) Install karke kholo. 3) Configure: Video tab me Show mouse cursor aur Add mouse click effects check; Video tab me Record section ke Settings me Record sound uncheck karke OK; Video tab me Format section ke Settings me File Type MP4 karke OK. 4) Fullscreen record (top left down arrow > Fullscreen). 5) Rec. 6) Stop button se stop. 7) Home > Videos tab me recorded video. 8) Video title ke upar folder path click karke output folder kholo.
qs.b: In BandiCam I enable Show mouse cursor and Add mouse click effects, uncheck Record sound, set the file type to MP4 and choose Fullscreen mode. Then I click Rec, stop when done and find the file under Home > Videos.
qs.t: Bandicam: cursor ON, sound OFF, MP4.

qs.q: How do you record the screen using the Xbox Game Bar on Windows, and what are its downsides?
qs.s: Windows 10 aur upar me built-in recorder Xbox Game Bar se milta hai. Steps: 1) Windows Key + G. 2) Record se pehle mute button on karo taaki device aur mic sound na aaye. 3) Record icon se start. 4) Stop icon se stop aur save. 5) Recording automatic Videos > Captures folder me save hoti hai. 6) Ya Game Bar ke gallery icon se dekho. Downsides (3): video size comparatively bada hota hai (Handbrake se kam kar sakte ho); pause button nahi hai; sirf active application window record hoti hai, desktop record nahi hota, desktop par switch ya app minimize karte hi recording bina confirmation ke end ho jaati hai.
qs.b: On Windows 10 and above I press Windows + G, mute audio, click Record and then Stop; the file is saved in Videos > Captures. Its downsides are larger file sizes, no pause button, and it only records the active app window, so switching to the desktop or minimizing ends the recording.
qs.t: Game Bar: bada size, no pause, sirf active window.

qs.q: How do you record the screen on macOS with QuickTime Player?
qs.s: Steps: 1) QuickTime Player kholo. 2) File > New Screen Recording. 3) Settings panel aayega. 4) Record Entire Screen chuno. 5) Options me: Microphone ke neeche None; Capture ke neeche Show Mouse Clicks; Save to ke neeche Desktop. 6) Record button. 7) Menu bar ya touch bar ke stop button se stop. 8) Recording desktop par save hogi; file rename karke extension .mov se .mp4 karo. Note: QuickTime recordings kaafi badi hoti hain, upload se pehle compress karo (Handbrake).
qs.b: In QuickTime I choose File > New Screen Recording, select Record Entire Screen, set Microphone to None, enable Show Mouse Clicks and save to the desktop. After stopping, I rename the file from .mov to .mp4 and compress it because QuickTime files are large.
qs.t: QuickTime: Mic None, clicks ON, .mov -> .mp4.

qs.q: How do you set up and use ScreenPal on macOS?
qs.s: Steps: 1) https://screenpal.com/screen-recorder par Launch free recorder aur Download app link. 2) File install karo, web page par wapas Launch Free Recorder. 3) Saari permissions do aur Test Screen Recording. 4) Open System Settings me recorder ko screen recording permission do, Quit & Reopen. 5) Website par phir Launch Free Recorder, recorder khulega. 6) Record se pehle narration off (jab tak narrate na karo) aur fullscreen (Size > Fullscreen). 7) Rec. 8) Bug reproduce. 9) Khatam par pause, Done, phir Save/Upload. 10) Video file ki tarah save. Har baar record karne ke liye steps 6 se 10 follow karo.
qs.b: On macOS I download and install ScreenPal, grant screen recording permission in System Settings and relaunch it. Each time I record, I turn narration off, choose Fullscreen, click Rec, reproduce the bug, then click Done and Save/Upload to save it as a video file locally.
qs.t: Mac ScreenPal: permission do, phir 6-10 har baar.

qs.q: How do you record the screen on Linux?
qs.s: Suggested tool Kazam. Steps: 1) Terminal me: sudo apt install kazam -y. 2) sudo password do aur install hone do. 3) Kazam kholke ensure karo: Sound from speakers aur Sound from microphone dono selected nahi; Mouse cursor selected; Fullscreen selected. 4) Capture button se start. 5) Taskbar me Kazam icon par click karke Finish recording. 6) Recording save karo.
qs.b: On Linux I install Kazam with sudo apt install kazam -y, make sure both speaker and microphone sound are off, the mouse cursor is on and Fullscreen is selected, then click Capture and stop with Finish recording from the taskbar icon before saving.
qs.t: Kazam: sound OFF, cursor ON, Fullscreen.

qs.q: How do you record the screen on Android?
qs.s: Android 11 aur baad me built-in screen recorder hai; Samsung, Xiaomi jaise manufacturers ke apne tools bhi notification panel ya settings me mil sakte hain. Built-in use karo to ensure: videos .mp4 me hon aur background noise na ho. Built-in na ho to apps: AZ Screen Recorder, Mobizen Screen Recorder. AZ Screen Recorder steps: 1) Google Play se install. 2) App kholo, permissions allow. 3) App settings me Record audio off. 4) Wapas aakar record icon tap. 5) Stop recording button se stop. 6) File manager me AZRecorderFree folder me recordings. Note: recording badi ho to app settings me resolution aur frame rate adjust karo; AZ available na ho to koi aur recorder, steps similar.
qs.b: Android 11 and later have a built-in recorder, which is fine as long as the video is .mp4 with no background noise. Otherwise I use an app like AZ Screen Recorder: turn off Record audio in settings, tap record, stop when done, and find the file in the AZRecorderFree folder.
qs.t: Android 11+ built-in; warna AZ, audio OFF.

qs.q: How do you show taps in Android screen recordings?
qs.s: Tip: Developer options se Show Taps enable karna recommended hai. Steps: 1) Settings me Build number dhundo, usually About device ke andar. 2) Build number 7 baar tap karke Developer Options enable karo; maange to device passcode do. 3) Developer Options kholke Show Taps on karo.
qs.b: I enable Developer Options by tapping Build number seven times under About device, then turn on Show Taps so every touch is visible in the recording.
qs.t: Build number x7 -> Show Taps.

qs.q: How do you record the screen on iOS using built-in tools?
qs.s: iOS 11 ya baad ke device me built-in recording hai. Steps: 1) Top-right edge se swipe down karke Control Center kholo, top left + button, neeche Add a Control, Controls Gallery se Screen Recording chuno. 2) Control Center me Screen Recording button tap and hold. 3) Microphone off karo (audio nahi chahiye). 4) Start Recording, 3 seconds wait, phir recording shuru. 5) Stop: screen ke top par Screen Recording button tap karke Stop, ya Control Centre me red Record button. 6) Video Photos me save hoti hai. Apple website par bhi process hai.
qs.b: On iOS 11 or later I add Screen Recording to Control Center, long-press the button, turn the microphone off and tap Start Recording, which begins after three seconds. I stop it from the status bar or Control Center, and the video is saved to Photos.
qs.t: iOS: Control Center, Mic OFF, 3 sec countdown.

qs.q: How do you show touches on an iPhone screen recording?
qs.s: Tip (10 steps): 1) Settings. 2) Accessibility. 3) Touch. 4) Assistive Touch on. 5) Create New Gesture. 6) Grey field me screen tap karo. 7) Save karke naam do. 8) Assistive Touch button tap. 9) Custom Gesture select. 10) Banaya hua pointer select karke recording ke time use karo.
qs.b: I go to Settings > Accessibility > Touch, turn on AssistiveTouch, create a new gesture by tapping in the grey area and save it with a name. While recording, I open the AssistiveTouch button, choose Custom Gesture and use that pointer to show taps.
qs.t: AssistiveTouch custom gesture = iPhone ka pointer.

qs.q: What is AirServer and how is it used to record an iOS screen?
qs.s: AirServer computer ko iOS device ya mirroring-enabled computer se AirPlay stream receive aur display karne deta hai, aur high quality record karta hai bina extra software. Requirements: iOS 4.2.1+ device; Windows ya macOS computer. Prerequisites: WiFi network jisme PC/Mac aur iOS device same network par hon; iTunes ya Bonjour Print Services installed. Important: computer ke liye compatible version download karo; free trial 31 days. Mirroring steps: 1) Computer par AirServer download. 2) App kholo. 3) Settings me computer ko naam do, Apply. 4) iOS device par jao. 5) Swipe up, Screen Mirroring. 6) Computer ka naam tap. 7) ScreenPal jaise recording tool se mirrored screen capture karo. 8) Troubleshooting ke liye AirServer support section. Note: iOS 11 se neeche official recording tarika nahi, third-party app jaise Dr.Fone - iOS Screen Recorder.
qs.b: AirServer lets a Windows or macOS computer receive AirPlay mirroring from an iOS 4.2.1+ device on the same WiFi network, with iTunes or Bonjour Print Services installed. I name the computer in AirServer, start Screen Mirroring on the device, select the computer and record the mirrored screen with a tool like ScreenPal; it has a 31-day free trial. For devices below iOS 11, a third-party app such as Dr.Fone can be used.
qs.t: AirServer: same WiFi, mirror, 31 din trial.

qs.q: What is HandBrake and what are its five uses for the platform work?
qs.s: HandBrake powerful, open-source video transcoder hai, Windows, macOS, Linux par available. Bahut formats/codecs support karta hai; batch processing, customizable presets, advanced encoding options. The platform me 5 purposes: Changing File Format, Compressing Videos, Removing Background Noise, Adjusting the Video's Orientation, Fixing Anamorphic Video Issues. Note: kisi bhi app ke cloud me upload karke save/compress mat karo, Terms of Use violation.
qs.b: HandBrake is a free, open-source video transcoder for Windows, macOS and Linux. On the platform it is used to change the file format, compress videos, remove background noise, fix orientation and fix anamorphic video issues, always processing files locally rather than in the cloud.
qs.t: HandBrake 5: Format, Compress, Audio, Orientation, Anamorphic.

qs.q: How do you set HandBrake to output MP4 files?
qs.s: HandBrake kholke video file open karo. Default output change: Windows: Tools > Preferences, Output Files tab me Default Path ko Desktop ya jahan chaho; MP4 File Extension ko Always use MP4. macOS: Menu bar me Handbrake > Settings..., Output Files tab me Default MP4 Extension ko .mp4.
qs.b: On Windows I go to Tools > Preferences > Output Files, set the default path and set MP4 File Extension to Always use MP4. On macOS I go to HandBrake > Settings > Output Files and set the default MP4 extension to .mp4.
qs.t: Output Files tab = MP4 pakka.

qs.q: How and when should you compress a video in HandBrake?
qs.s: Preset menu se appropriate preset chuno. Yeh video, size aur cycle requirements par depend karta hai. Agar video already chhoti hai (5 MB se kam) to compress karne ki zaroorat nahi, jab tak cycle restrictions ki wajah se bug report ya test case me upload na ho paaye. Recommended presets: Very Fast 720p 30 ya Very Fast 1080p.
qs.b: I pick a preset from the Preset menu, typically Very Fast 720p 30 or Very Fast 1080p. If the video is already under 5 MB, I don't compress it unless the cycle's upload restrictions prevent attaching it.
qs.t: 5 MB se kam = compress mat karo.

qs.q: How do you remove audio from a video in HandBrake?
qs.s: Windows: Audio tab me jao aur audio track ke right side Clear button ya X icon click. macOS: Audio tab kholo, list me audio track click karo (e.g. 0: Unknown (AAC LC)), None select karo.
qs.b: On Windows I open the Audio tab and click Clear or the X next to the audio track. On macOS I open the Audio tab, click the listed track and select None.
qs.t: Audio tab: Clear/X ya None.

qs.q: How do you fix a video's orientation in HandBrake?
qs.s: Agar video galat orientation me record hui: 1) Dimensions tab kholo. 2) Rotation adjust karo taaki output sahi orientation me ho. Example: video upside down hai to 180 degrees rotate karo.
qs.b: I open the Dimensions tab and adjust the rotation so the output is upright, for example rotating 180 degrees if the video was recorded upside down.
qs.t: Ulta video = Dimensions me 180.

qs.q: What is an anamorphic video and how do you fix it in HandBrake?
qs.s: Anamorphic video wider aspect ratio wali video hai jo horizontally squeeze karke standard format me fit ki jaati hai, jaise rubber band ko horizontally stretch karke us stretched image ko record karna. Kuch iOS devices aur tools aisi video bana dete hain, isliye distortion theek karna zaroori hai. Fix: 1) Dimensions tab. 2) Resolutions & Scaling section me Anamorphic option None/Off. 3) Zaroorat ho to resolution adjust.
qs.b: An anamorphic video is a wider-aspect video squeezed horizontally into a standard format, which some iOS devices produce and which looks distorted. In HandBrake I open Dimensions, set Anamorphic to None or Off under Resolutions & Scaling, and adjust the resolution if needed.
qs.t: Stretched rubber band = Anamorphic Off.

qs.q: What happens during HandBrake encoding and what should you check afterwards?
qs.s: Encoding selected presets aur settings ke basis par file convert karta hai: compression, resolution, anamorphic removal, format compatibility. Steps: 1) Start/Start Encode. 2) Time file size, quality settings aur system performance par depend. 3) Video desktop ya Save As location par save. 4) Output check karo requirements ke hisaab se. 5) Video play karke compression, format, anamorphic removal aur quality confirm karo. 6) Zaroorat ho to adjusted settings se phir encode.
qs.b: Encoding converts the file using the chosen presets for compression, resolution, anamorphic removal and format. I click Start Encode, then play the output to confirm compression, format, anamorphic fix and quality, and re-encode with adjusted settings if needed.
qs.t: Encode ke baad play karke verify.

qs.q: What are HandBrake custom presets and how do you save one?
qs.s: Custom presets user ke pre-configured settings hain jo conversion automate karte hain; har baar options adjust nahi karne padte, preset select karo aur settings load. Regular settings ke liye preset banane se issue report ya test case ke liye encode me time bachta hai. Saving steps: 1) Handbrake kholo, video import karo. 2) Base preset chuno (e.g. Very Fast 720p 30 ya Very Fast 1080p 30). 3) Options change karo (audio remove, anamorphic fix, etc.). 4) Menu bar me Presets > Add preset/New Preset.... 5) Naam aur Description do, naam settings se match karo. 6) Preset se audio hatane ke liye: Audio field me Selection Behavior..., 'Audio encoder settings for each selected track' section me entry select karke remove (Windows: Clear button right side; macOS: - button), Save/Ok. 7) Add button se preset save. 8) Jitne chahiye utne presets ke liye repeat.
qs.b: A custom preset stores settings I use regularly so I don't reconfigure HandBrake for every video. I import a video, choose a base preset like Very Fast 720p 30, make changes such as removing audio or fixing anamorphic, then use Presets > New Preset, give it a descriptive name, remove the audio track under Selection Behavior and click Add.
qs.t: Ek baar preset banao, baar baar time bachao.

qs.q: How do you set a custom HandBrake preset as the default?
qs.s: Steps: 1) Handbrake kholke video import. 2) Preset section se custom preset select. 3) Menu bar me Presets > Make Default ya Set Current as Default. 4) Handbrake band karke dobara kholo. 5) Presets section me check karo ki woh default hai.
qs.b: I select my custom preset, choose Presets > Make Default or Set Current as Default, then restart HandBrake and confirm it is selected by default.
qs.t: Make Default, restart, confirm.

qs.q: Which HandBrake steps can be skipped?
qs.s: Notes: Compress step skip karo agar compression ki zaroorat nahi. Remove Audio step skip karo agar background noise nahi hai. Fix Video Orientation skip karo agar sahi orientation me record hui. Fix Anamorphic skip karo agar anamorphic issue nahi. Lekin hamesha ensure karo video ka format .mp4 ho.
qs.b: Compression, audio removal, orientation and anamorphic fixes are only needed when the video actually has those problems. The one thing that is always required is that the final video is in .mp4 format.
qs.t: Sab optional, sirf .mp4 compulsory.

topics.intro: Bug ka video kaise record karein har OS/device par, rules ke saath, aur HandBrake se video theek kaise karein.

topics.name: Browser Logs

qs.q: What are logs and which types does the Academy teach you to collect?
qs.s: Logs events ya entries hain jo websites ya software run hote waqt generate karte hain; developers debugging ke liye use karte hain. Academy me 3 types: (1) Browser console logs: web page ki info jaise network requests, JavaScript, CSS, security errors aur warnings; website test karte waqt required. (2) Mobile device logs: system aur device par chal rahe apps ke events; mobile app test karte waqt required. (3) Network logs: computer aur Internet ke beech HTTP(S) traffic, network issues diagnose karta hai; kuch test cycles me required.
qs.b: Logs are events or entries generated by websites or software as they run, and developers use them for debugging. The platform teaches three types: browser console logs for website testing, mobile device logs for mobile app testing, and network logs of HTTP(S) traffic, which some test cycles require.
qs.t: Website = console, App = device, kuch cycles = network.

qs.q: What are the key rules for collecting logs?
qs.s: 4 rules: (1) Clear old logs: naya log collect karne se pehle purane stored logs clear karo. (2) File format: logs hamesha .txt me save karo. (3) Recreate the bug while collecting: log collect karte waqt bug reproduce karo; log file me testing website/app ki activity aur traffic honi chahiye. (4) Timestamp: log me timestamps hone chahiye, har line ke shuru me dikhte hain. Examples: Browser console log: 23:24:11.174 Navigated to the platform website ; Mobile device log: 12-10 13:02:50.071 1901-4229/com.the platform.android.gms.
qs.b: Before collecting a log I clear old entries, then reproduce the bug while logging so the file contains the tested site or app's activity. Logs should be saved as .txt and must include timestamps at the start of each line, for example '23:24:11.174 Navigated to the platform website
qs.t: Clear, TXT, Reproduce, Timestamp.

qs.q: How do you collect browser console logs in Google Chrome or any Chromium-based browser?
qs.s: Desktop browsers sab OS par same kaam karte hain. Steps: 1) CTRL+Shift+I ya F12 ya three-dot > More Tools > Developer Tools. 2) Console > top right gear icon. 3) Console preferences me Show Timestamps aur Preserve Log Upon Navigation select. 4) Settings se bahar. 5) Clear Console icon ya right click > clear console. 6) Page refresh karke homepage se issue reproduce. 7) Logs par right click > Save As (ya copy karke text editor me paste). 8) .txt me save. 9) Log khol kar check: timestamps aur testing website ke saath 'Navigated to' string (e.g. 18:32:30.854 Navigated to the platform website Same steps Edge (new), Opera, Brave, Yandex par.
qs.b: I open DevTools with Ctrl+Shift+I or F12, enable Show Timestamps and Preserve Log Upon Navigation in Console settings, clear the console, refresh and reproduce from the homepage, then right-click and Save As a .txt file. I verify the log has timestamps and a 'Navigated to' line for the test site; the same steps work in Edge, Opera, Brave and Yandex.
qs.t: Chrome: Timestamps + Preserve, clear, reproduce, Save As txt.

qs.q: How do you collect browser console logs in Firefox?
qs.s: Steps: 1) CTRL+Shift+K ya F12 ya hamburger icon > Web Developer > Web Developer Tools. 2) Console me gear icon > Persist Logs aur Show Timestamps. 3) Trash icon se purane logs clear. 4) Page refresh karke homepage se reproduce. 5) Console par right click > Save all Messages to File. 6) .txt me save. 7) Timestamps aur 'Navigated to' string check. Note: timestamps na dikhein to console frame resize karo jab tak timestamps aa jaayein.
qs.b: In Firefox I open the console with Ctrl+Shift+K or F12, enable Persist Logs and Show Timestamps, clear with the trash icon, reproduce from the homepage and use Save all Messages to File as .txt. If timestamps don't appear, I resize the console frame.
qs.t: Firefox: Persist Logs, timestamps nahi to resize.

qs.q: How do you collect browser console logs in Safari?
qs.s: Steps: 1) Menu bar me Safari > Preferences. 2) Advanced gear icon > Show Develop menu in the menu bar check. 3) Develop dropdown > Show Web Inspector. 4) Console window me Preserve Log, trash icon se clear. 5) Homepage refresh karke wahi se reproduce. 6) Console tab click karke Command+S; save karte waqt pehle console click karna important hai. 7) .txt me save. Note: Safari ke logs me timestamps nahi hote.
qs.b: In Safari I enable the Develop menu from Advanced preferences, open Web Inspector, turn on Preserve Log and clear it, reproduce from the homepage, then click the Console tab and press Command+S to save as .txt. Safari console logs do not contain timestamps.
qs.t: Safari log me timestamp nahi hota.

qs.q: How do you show and change a file extension to .txt on Windows and macOS?
qs.s: Windows 10: 1) File Explorer ya koi folder kholo. 2) Upar View tab. 3) File name extensions option enable. 4) Log file par wapas jao. 5) File name par double click karke extension .txt karo, ya right click > Rename. macOS: 1) File par right click > Rename. 2) Extension .txt karke Enter ya bahar click. 3) Confirm.
qs.b: On Windows 10 I enable File name extensions from the View tab in File Explorer and rename the log to end in .txt. On macOS I right-click, choose Rename, change the extension to .txt and confirm.
qs.t: View > File name extensions, phir rename.

qs.q: What is a HAR log and which tools support the HAR format?
qs.s: HAR = HTTP Archive. Isme browser aur testing website ke beech interaction ki info hoti hai, jo developers ko troubleshooting aur root cause dhundne me help karti hai. HAR format support karne wale software: Charles Proxy, Fiddler, Firebug, Firefox, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, OWASP ZAP. Course me popular browsers se collect aur review karna sikhaya hai.
qs.b: HAR stands for HTTP Archive; it records the interaction between the browser and the website so developers can troubleshoot and find root causes. It is supported by Charles Proxy, Fiddler, Firebug, Firefox, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge and OWASP ZAP.
qs.t: HAR = HTTP ka archive (browser-site baatcheet).

qs.q: What must you remember before uploading a HAR log?
qs.s: 3 points: (1) HAR files me sensitive data hota hai; agar issue me Username, Password, PIN, CVV, Account numbers/IBAN, card numbers ya koi personal/sensitive info aati hai to upload se pehle HAR file se un sab instances ko hatao. (2) HAR capture shuru karte waqt browser ke baaki sab tabs close karo. (3) Yeh log sirf tab upload karo jab cycle ke TTL, TE ya TSM ne maanga ho.
qs.b: HAR files can contain sensitive data, so I remove usernames, passwords, PINs, CVVs, account or card numbers and any personal data before uploading. I close other tabs while capturing and only upload a HAR log when the TTL, TE or TSM of the cycle asks for it.
qs.t: HAR: sensitive data hatao, sirf TTL/TE/TSM maange tab.

qs.q: How do you collect a HAR log in Chrome and check status codes?
qs.s: Steps: 1) CTRL+Shift+I (Windows) / Option+Command+I (Mac) ya three-dot > More Tools > Developer Tools. 2) Network tab (na dikhe to >> icon ya window expand). 3) Preserve log checkbox. 4) Clear icon se traffic clear. 5) Testing website kholke issue reproduce. 6) Logs par right click (Mac par CTRL+click) > Save all as HAR with content; ya Network tab ke top par Export HAR (download icon). 7) .har me save. Same steps Edge, Opera, Brave, Yandex. Status code: entry par click, Headers tab > General section me Status code field (e.g. 200 OK, 400 Bad Request). Filter: Network tab top par funnel icon, textbox me keyword.
qs.b: In Chrome DevTools I open the Network tab, enable Preserve log, clear it, reproduce the issue and choose Save all as HAR with content or the Export HAR button, saving as .har. To check a status code I click the entry and read Status code under Headers > General, and I use the funnel filter to find specific entries.
qs.t: Chrome HAR: Network, Preserve, Save all as HAR with content.

qs.q: How do you collect a HAR log in Firefox?
qs.s: Steps: 1) CTRL+Shift+E (Windows) / Option+Command+I (Mac) ya Menu > More Tools > Web Developer Tools. 2) Network tab (na dikhe to >> ya window expand). 3) Gear icon > Persist Logs. 4) Trash icon se traffic clear. 5) Homepage refresh karke wahi se reproduce. 6) Logs par right click (Mac CTRL+click) > Save All As HAR; ya gear icon > Save All As HAR. 7) .har me save.
qs.b: In Firefox I open the Network tab with Ctrl+Shift+E, enable Persist Logs from the gear icon, clear with the trash icon, reproduce from the homepage and choose Save All As HAR, saving the file as .har.
qs.t: Firefox HAR: Ctrl+Shift+E, Persist Logs.

qs.q: How do you filter and verify status codes in HAR logs on Chrome?
qs.s: Kuch cycles me specific entries filter karke status code verify karna hota hai: 1) Console window kholke How to Collect HAR Logs ke hisaab se HAR collect karo. 2) Filter field me cycle overview ya test case me diya string/code daalo. 3) Filtered entry click. 4) Khule window me Headers tab. 5) General section me Status code check karo aur test cycle ke hisaab se sahi hai verify karo. Note: status code server response ke hisaab se vary ho sakta hai; requirement se match karo, alag ho to cycle/test case instructions follow karo.
qs.b: I collect the HAR log, type the string or code from the cycle overview or test case into the Filter field, open the matching entry and check the Status code in the Headers tab's General section against the cycle's expectation. If it differs, I follow the cycle or test case instructions, since status codes can vary with the server response.
qs.t: Filter -> entry -> Headers -> General -> Status code.

qs.q: How do you collect a HAR log in Safari and check status codes?
qs.s: Steps: 1) Safari > Settings. 2) Advanced tab > Show features for web developers. 3) Option+Command+I ya Develop > Show Web Inspector. 4) Network tab (na dikhe to >> ya expand). 5) Network tab ke top left hamburger menu se Preserve Log (na dikhe to window expand). 6) Trash icon se clear. 7) Homepage refresh karke wahi se reproduce. 8) Name column par CTRL+click ya right click > Export HAR; ya top right Export button. 9) .har me save. Status code: entry click, Headers tab > Summary section me Status field (e.g. 200 OK, 400 Bad Request). Filter: Network tab top par Filter Full URL textbox me keyword.
qs.b: In Safari I enable Show features for web developers, open Web Inspector's Network tab, turn on Preserve Log from the hamburger menu, clear it, reproduce from the homepage and use Export HAR to save a .har file. Status is shown under Headers > Summary, and I filter using the Filter Full URL box.
qs.t: Safari HAR: Summary section me Status.

qs.q: How do you remove sensitive data from a HAR log file?
qs.s: Windows 10: 1) HAR file Notepad ya Notepad++ me kholo. 2) Replace feature se info search karo, jaise full name, address, SSN, birthday, phone number, bank account number, card number, CCV ya testing ke time di gayi koi sensitive info. 3) **** ya koi placeholder se replace karo jo redacted dikhaye. 4) Save. 5) HAR sirf required ho to bug report/test case me upload. macOS: 1) Default TextEdit se kholo. 2) Find par hover karke Find and Replace. 3) Info search karke **** ya placeholder se replace. 4) Save. 5) Sirf required ho to upload. Notepad++ ya koi text editor bhi use kar sakte ho.
qs.b: I open the HAR file in a text editor such as Notepad, Notepad++ or TextEdit, use Find and Replace to locate sensitive values like my name, address, SSN, phone, bank or card numbers and CCV, and replace them with **** or another redaction placeholder. Then I save it and upload it only if it is required.
qs.t: Find & Replace -> ****.

qs.q: What is remote debugging and which mobile browsers support it for collecting logs?
qs.s: Mobile browser logs collect karna thoda complex hai aur computer use hota hai; process ko Remote Debugging kehte hain. Chromium-based browsers aur Firefox Android devices ke liye sirf USB ke through Remote Debugging support karte hain. iOS sirf Safari par Remote debugging support karta hai (lekin notes me iOS Chrome aur Firefox logs bhi Mac Safari ke Develop menu se collect karne ke steps hain). Table of contents: Android prerequisites, Chrome/Chromium remote debugging (Android only), Firefox remote debugging (Android only), iOS Safari via Mac, iOS Chrome via Mac, iOS Firefox via Mac.
qs.b: Collecting mobile browser logs uses a computer and is called remote debugging. Chromium-based browsers and Firefox support remote debugging over USB only for Android, while on iOS remote debugging works through Safari on a Mac.
qs.t: Mobile browser log = Remote Debugging via computer.

qs.q: What are the Android prerequisites for remote debugging?
qs.s: 10 steps: 1) Build Number 7 baar tap karke Developer Options enable (problem ho to linked help article). 2) Developer Options me USB Debugging on. 3) Android device ko USB cable se seedha computer se connect. 4) Computer par SDK platform-tools download. 5) Unzip karke folder kholo. 6) Command Prompt (Windows) ya Terminal (macOS/Linux) kholo. 7) cd aur space type karke unzipped platform-tools folder drag and drop, enter. 8) Ab platform-tools folder me ho, e.g. cd c:\users\john\desktop\platform-tools. 9) Windows: adb start-server; macOS/Linux: ./adb start-server. 10) Mobile par permission requests allow. Note: har baar log capture se pehle steps 7-10 se adb server start karo, warna browser device recognize nahi karega.
qs.b: I enable Developer Options and USB Debugging, connect the phone by USB, download and unzip the SDK platform-tools, cd into that folder and run adb start-server, or ./adb start-server on macOS or Linux, then accept the prompts on the phone. The adb server must be started this way every time before capturing logs or the browser may not detect the device.
qs.t: Har baar: cd platform-tools + adb start-server.

qs.q: How do you collect Android Chrome browser console logs via remote debugging?
qs.s: Steps: 1) Prerequisites pehle. 2) Computer par Chrome desktop me chrome://inspect#devices; Android par koi bhi Chromium browser ho, desktop Chrome se inspect ho jaata hai. 3) Discover USB devices checkbox enabled, device connected aur unlocked. 4) Device ka model name dikhe to DevTools ne connection bana liya; Offline dikhe to phone par Allow USB Debugging accept; detect na ho to troubleshooting. 5) Mobile ke sab open tabs desktop par dikhte hain, sab close karna recommended. 6) Android par testing website kholo. 7) Desktop par URL ke bagal Inspect, naya DevTools window; error aaye to Inspect fallback try. 8) Console tab me gear icon. 9) Console preferences me Show Timestamps aur Preserve Log Upon Navigation. 10) Settings se bahar. 11) Console clear. 12) Refresh karke homepage se reproduce. 13) Right click > Save As. 14) .txt me save. 15) Timestamps aur 'Navigated to' string check.
qs.b: After the adb prerequisites, I open chrome://inspect#devices in desktop Chrome with Discover USB devices enabled, confirm the phone model appears, open the test site on the phone and click Inspect. In that DevTools console I enable timestamps and Preserve Log, clear it, reproduce from the homepage and save the log as .txt, checking for timestamps and the 'Navigated to' line.
qs.t: chrome://inspect#devices -> Inspect -> same console steps.

qs.q: How do you collect Android Firefox browser logs via remote debugging?
qs.s: Steps: 1) Desktop Firefox me hamburger > Web Developer > Remote Debugging. 2) Enable USB devices button. 3) Android Firefox me 3 dots menu > settings me Remote debugging via USB on. 4) Desktop par device name dikhega, Connect. (Recognize na ho to troubleshooting.) 5) Device name click karke open tabs dekho, sab close karna recommended. 6) Android Firefox me testing website kholo. 7) Desktop par URL ke bagal Inspect. 8) Toolbox window me Console tab, gear icon > Persist Logs aur Show Timestamps. 9) Trash icon se clear. 10) Refresh, homepage se reproduce. 11) Console par right click > Export Visible Messages To > File. 12) .txt save. 13) Timestamps aur 'Navigated to' check.
qs.b: I open Remote Debugging in desktop Firefox and enable USB devices, turn on Remote debugging via USB in Firefox on the phone, then Connect and Inspect the test site's tab. In the console I enable Persist Logs and Show Timestamps, clear it, reproduce from the homepage and use Export Visible Messages To > File to save a .txt.
qs.t: Firefox Android: Export Visible Messages To File.

qs.q: How do you collect iOS Safari browser logs via a Mac?
qs.s: Steps: 1) iOS Settings > Apps > Safari > Advanced, Web Inspector on. 2) iOS device cable se seedha Mac se connect (macOS hi chahiye), Mac ko trust karo. 3) iOS Safari me ek tab open rakho. 4) Mac par Safari > Settings. 5) Advanced tab me Show features for web developers enable. 6) Develop > device name (jaise John's iPhone) > khula Safari tab. 7) Web inspector khulega, Console tab. 8) Console window me hamburger menu se Preserve Log; top right gear icon > Console tab > Show: Timestamps enable. 9) Console tab par wapas, trash icon se clear. 10) iOS par homepage refresh karke wahi se reproduce. 11) Command+S. 12) .txt save; ya Command+A, right click > Save Selected, .txt. 13) Timestamps aur 'Navigated to' string check.
qs.b: I enable Web Inspector in the iPhone's Safari advanced settings, connect it to a Mac and trust it, enable Show features for web developers in Mac Safari, then use Develop > device name > the open tab. In the console I enable Preserve Log and timestamps, clear, reproduce from the homepage and save with Command+S as a .txt file.
qs.t: iPhone Web Inspector ON, Mac Safari Develop menu.

qs.q: How do you collect iOS Chrome and iOS Firefox browser logs via a Mac?
qs.s: iOS Chrome: 1) iOS Chrome me 3 dots (bottom right) > Settings > Content Settings > Web Inspector on. 2) Cable se Mac (macOS) se connect, trust. 3) Chrome me ek tab open. 4) Mac Safari > Settings. 5) Advanced > Show features for web developers. 6) Develop > device name > khula Chrome tab. 7) Web inspector, Console tab. 8) Hamburger menu se Preserve Log, trash icon se clear. 9) iOS par homepage refresh karke reproduce. 10) Command+S. 11) .txt save (ya Command+A > Save Selected). Note: step 5 ke baad Chrome tab list me na dikhe to iPhone par Chrome band karke dobara kholo, session refresh hota hai. iOS Firefox: same flow bina Web Inspector setting step ke: 1) cable se connect aur trust. 2) Firefox me ek tab. 3) Mac Safari > Settings. 4) Advanced > Show features for web developers. 5) Develop > device name > khula Firefox tab. 6) Console tab. 7) Preserve Log, trash se clear. 8) Homepage se reproduce. 9) Command+S. 10) .txt (ya Command+A > Save Selected). Firefox section ka note bhi lesson me Chrome tab close/reopen ki baat karta hai (as shown).
qs.b: For iOS Chrome I first enable Web Inspector under Chrome's Content Settings, then, as with Firefox, connect the iPhone to a Mac, enable web developer features in Safari and open Develop > device > the open tab. I enable Preserve Log, clear, reproduce from the homepage and save the console with Command+S as .txt; if the tab doesn't appear, I close and reopen the browser on the phone.
qs.t: iOS par sab browsers ka log Mac Safari ke Develop se.

qs.q: How do you collect HAR logs from an Android browser?
qs.s: 4 parts: 1) Setup the Mobile Device: build number 7 baar tap karke Developer options (device ke hisaab se vary, online search kar sakte ho); Developer options kholo; USB debugging enable; popup me OK; phone USB se PC se connect; popup me koi bhi option select. 2) DevTools aur Network Logs: Chrome URL bar me chrome://inspect kholo; mobile par testing website kholo; Remote Target section ke neeche Inspect link (na dikhe to thoda wait); naye window me Network tab (na dikhe to >> icon); Preserve log enable; DevTools page ke screencast se ya mobile se issue reproduce. 3) Saving: Network tab me logs par right click > Save all as HAR with content > location select > file name > Save. 4) Excluding PII: HAR edit karke PII hatao, Desktop Browser HAR Logs lesson ke 'How to Edit the HAR Log File' steps follow karo.
qs.b: I enable USB debugging on the phone, connect it, open chrome://inspect in desktop Chrome and click Inspect under Remote Target for the test site. In the Network tab I enable Preserve log, reproduce the issue via the screencast or the phone, save with Save all as HAR with content, and then edit the file to remove any PII.
qs.t: Android HAR = chrome://inspect + Network + PII hatao.

topics.intro: Desktop aur mobile browser ke console logs aur HAR logs collect karna, timestamps aur PII ka dhyan rakhte hue.

topics.name: Mobile Device Logs

qs.q: Which tools should be used to collect Android device logs, and what are the prerequisites?
qs.s: Android logs Windows, macOS ya Linux kisi se bhi collect kar sakte ho. Hamesha adb ya Android Studio use karo, Syslog ya CatLog jaise apps kabhi nahi. Prerequisites: USB Debugging enable (Build number usually About device me, 7 baar tap karke Developer Options, phir USB Debugging on); device locked nahi, active aur PC se connected; mobile par connection allow alert aaye to Always allow from this computer check karke Allow; antivirus adb.exe ke baare me alert de to antivirus deactivate karo ya adb.exe ko exception list me daalo.
qs.b: Android device logs must be collected with adb or Android Studio, never with on-device apps like Syslog or CatLog. Before starting, USB debugging must be enabled, the device must be unlocked and connected, I tick Always allow from this computer, and adb.exe is allowed through the antivirus.
qs.t: adb/Android Studio haan, Syslog/CatLog na.

qs.q: How do you collect Android device logs with adb on Windows?
qs.s: Steps: 1) SDK Platform Tools for Windows download. 2) Unzip karke hard drive par save. 3) platform-tools folder kholo, address bar me cmd type karke enter. 4) Ya Command Prompt me cd aur space, folder drag and drop, enter. 5) Purane logs clear: adb logcat -c. 6) Bug shuru se end tak reproduce. 7) Log collect: adb logcat -d -v time >.\log.txt. 8) Folder me log.txt dikhega. 9) log.txt bug report me upload.
qs.b: I download and unzip SDK Platform Tools, open a command prompt in the platform-tools folder, clear old logs with adb logcat -c, reproduce the bug end to end and dump the log with adb logcat -d -v time >.\log.txt, then attach log.txt to the bug report.
qs.t: -c se clear, -d -v time se dump.

qs.q: What is the recommended alternative adb method for collecting Android logs?
qs.s: Recommended method (Windows): 1) Upar ke steps 1-4. 2) Command: adb logcat -v threadtime >.\log.txt. 3) Bug shuru se end tak reproduce. 4) Ctrl + C se process stop. 5) Folder me log.txt. 6) Upload. macOS par ./adb logcat -v threadtime >./log.txt aur stop Cmd + C (notes ke hisaab se). Linux par adb logcat -v threadtime >log.txt aur Ctrl + C. Yahan logging pehle start hoti hai, phir reproduce, phir stop.
qs.b: The recommended method starts streaming first with adb logcat -v threadtime > log.txt, then I reproduce the bug end to end and press Ctrl+C to stop capture, which leaves a complete log.txt to upload.
qs.t: Recommended: threadtime chalao, reproduce, Ctrl+C.

qs.q: What should you do if the adb log file is too large or adb commands fail?
qs.s: Notes: log file badi ho to sab other apps/web pages close karo aur app kholne se pehle adb logcat -c se log clear karo, phir issue ya task reproduce. adb commands me error aaye to adb kill-server chalao taaki current adb processes stop hon, phir steps dobara follow karke log capture karo.
qs.b: If the log is too large, I close other apps and pages and run adb logcat -c before opening the app, then reproduce. If adb commands error out, I run adb kill-server and repeat the steps.
qs.t: Bada log = -c; error = kill-server.

qs.q: How do you collect Android device logs with adb on macOS?
qs.s: Steps: 1) SDK Platform Tools for macOS download. 2) Unzip karke hard drive par save. 3) Terminal kholo (Cmd+Space, terminal, return). 4) cd aur space, platform-tools ko terminal me drag, Enter. 5) Clear: ./adb logcat -c. 6) Bug reproduce. 7) Collect: ./adb logcat -d -v time >./log.txt. 8) Folder me log.txt. 9) Bug report me upload. Recommended alternative: steps 1-4, phir ./adb logcat -v threadtime >./log.txt, reproduce, Cmd + C se stop, log.txt upload.
qs.b: On macOS the steps are the same as Windows but commands are prefixed with ./, for example ./adb logcat -c to clear and ./adb logcat -d -v time >./log.txt to collect, or the recommended ./adb logcat -v threadtime >./log.txt followed by stopping the process.
qs.t: Mac par adb se pehle ./ lagao.

qs.q: How do you collect Android device logs on Linux?
qs.s: Steps: 1) Terminal me distro ke hisaab se: Debian based (Ubuntu, Linux Mint etc): sudo apt-get install adb; Fedora/SUSE-based: sudo yum install android-tools. 2) Password do, install hone do. 3) Clear: adb logcat -c. 4) Reproduce. 5) Collect: adb logcat -d -v time >log.txt. 6) Folder me log.txt. 7) Upload. Recommended alternative: steps 1-3, adb logcat -v threadtime >log.txt, reproduce, Ctrl + C, upload. Note: platform-tools download karke Windows ke steps 2-4 bhi kar sakte ho.
qs.b: On Linux I install adb with sudo apt-get install adb on Debian-based systems or sudo yum install android-tools on Fedora or SUSE. Then I clear with adb logcat -c, reproduce and collect with adb logcat -d -v time >log.txt, or use the recommended threadtime streaming method.
qs.t: Debian apt-get adb, Fedora yum android-tools.

qs.q: How do you collect Android device logs using Android Studio?
qs.s: Preconditions pehle follow karo. Steps: 1) Android Studio download/install. 2) Kholo. 3) Setup Wizard me Next. 4) Settings Custom karo taaki unnecessary files install na hon. 5) Theme chuno. 6) Sab optional components uncheck, Next. 7) Welcome screen me New Project > Empty Activity. 8) Next, phir finish, kuch change nahi. 9) Sync complete hone do, phir View > Tool Windows > Logcat (ya neeche Logcat button). 10) Device connect. 11) Logcat window me device select (auto na ho to) aur Trash icon se purane logs clear. 12) Device par bug reproduce. 13) Computer par pause button se extra capture roko. 14) Ctrl+A, right click > Copy. 15) Text editor me new file, paste. 16) .txt me save. Note: log bada ho to other apps/pages band karo, Trash se clear karke reproduce.
qs.b: I install Android Studio with a custom setup, create an Empty Activity project, open Logcat from View > Tool Windows, connect and select the device and clear old logs with the trash icon. After reproducing the bug I pause Logcat, select all, copy the logs into a text editor and save them as .txt.
qs.t: Studio: Empty Activity -> Logcat -> Trash -> Pause -> Copy.

qs.q: How do you collect Android logs with wireless debugging in Android Studio?
qs.s: Sirf Android 11 aur upar. Steps: 1) Android Studio install. 2) Setup Wizard Next. 3) Custom settings. 4) Theme. 5) Optional components uncheck, Next. 6) New Project > Empty Activity. 7) Next, finish. 8) Sync ke baad No Device dropdown. 9) Pair device using Wifi, phir Pair using the pairing code tab. 10) Mobile par Settings > Developers options. 11) Wireless debugging on. 12) Pair device with Pairing code (ya Pair device with QR code se QR scan). 13) Studio me matching IP address ke bagal pair button. 14) WiFi Pairing Code daal kar pair. 15) Connect hone par neeche Logcat, auto-selected filters hatao. 16) Trash se clear. 17) Bug reproduce. 18) Pause button. 19) Ctrl+A, Copy. 20) Text editor me paste. 21) .txt save. Note: ek baar pair hone ke baad, har baar Android Studio kholne par device auto connect hoga agar wireless debugging on hai.
qs.b: On Android 11 and above I can pair the phone over WiFi from Android Studio's device dropdown using Pair device using Wifi and the pairing code from Wireless debugging in Developer options. Then I open Logcat, remove filters, clear, reproduce, pause, copy everything and save it as .txt; after pairing once, it reconnects automatically.
qs.t: Android 11+: WiFi pairing code se cable-free Logcat.

qs.q: How do you collect Android logs with wireless debugging from the command line?
qs.s: Sirf Android 11 aur upar. Pre-requisites: platform-tools download/extract karke folder kholo; Developer option on; computer aur device same WiFi par. Steps: 1) Settings > Developers Settings. 2) Wireless debugging allow popup me 'Always allow on this network' check karke allow. 3) Pair device with pairing code. 4) Computer par platform-tools folder ke address bar me cmd, enter. 5) adb pair <IP Address>:<Port> <Pairing Code>. 6) Pair ke baad connect: adb connect <IP address>:<New Port>. 7) Ab bina USB adb commands chalte hain. 8) Clear: adb logcat -c. 9) Reproduce. 10) Collect: adb logcat -d -v time >log.txt OR adb logcat -v threadtime >log.txt. 11) log.txt folder me. 12) Upload. Notes: pehli baar popup dekhne ke liye Revoke USB debugging authorizations tap karke purane authorizations hatao aur steps dobara; log bada ho to apps/pages band karke adb logcat -c pehle.
qs.b: On Android 11 and above, with the phone and computer on the same WiFi, I enable Wireless debugging, run adb pair <IP>:<port> <pairing code> and then adb connect <IP>:<new port>. After that I use the normal adb logcat commands, clearing with -c and collecting to log.txt, without a USB cable.
qs.t: adb pair, phir adb connect (new port).

qs.q: How do you collect iOS device logs with iMazing?
qs.s: iOS logs Windows ya macOS se collect ho sakte hain; iMazing dono par chalta hai. Steps: 1) https://imazing.com/download kholo. 2) OS ke hisaab se download/install. 3) iMazing kholke device connect. 4) Show Device Console click. 5) Console clear karke bug reproduce. 6) Pause, phir Save. 7) .txt extension me save. 8) Bug report me upload. License: personal/educational use free, commercial use free nahi; license purchase ki zaroorat ho sakti hai, EULA follow karna user ki zimmedari. Alternatives: 3uTools aur iTools, lekin sirf Windows ke liye. macOS ho aur pehla method na chale to Method 2.
qs.b: iMazing works on Windows and macOS: I connect the iPhone, open Show Device Console, clear it, reproduce the bug, pause and save the log as .txt. It is free for personal and educational use but may need a license for commercial use; 3uTools and iTools are Windows-only alternatives.
qs.t: iMazing: Show Device Console -> Pause -> Save txt.

qs.q: How do you collect iOS device logs with the macOS Console app?
qs.s: Method 2 (macOS only): 1) iOS device Mac se connect. 2) Console app kholo. 3) iOS device chuno. 4) All messages tab par ho, Clear button se purane logs clear. 5) Device par bug reproduce. 6) Command+A se select, Command+C se copy. 7) TextEdit kholo, preferences me format plain text karo. 8) New document me Command+V. 9) .txt me save karke upload.
qs.b: On a Mac I connect the iPhone, open Console, select the device on the All messages tab and clear it, reproduce the bug, then copy all logs into a plain-text TextEdit document and save it as .txt.
qs.t: Mac Console app + TextEdit plain text.

qs.q: How do you collect iOS device logs on Linux?
qs.s: Method 3 libimobiledevice (Linux only): 1) libimobiledevice download/install. 2) USB se iOS device connect. 3) Desktop directory par right click > Open terminal here. 4) tee se file me save: idevicesyslog | tee device_log.txt. 5) Device par bug shuru se end tak reproduce. 6) Ctrl + C se stop ya terminal band. 7) Log upload.
qs.b: On Linux I install libimobiledevice, connect the iPhone by USB and run idevicesyslog | tee device_log.txt, reproduce the bug end to end, then stop with Ctrl+C and upload the file.
qs.t: idevicesyslog | tee = Linux ka iOS log.

qs.q: What are iOS crash logs?
qs.s: Crash logs dikhate hain ki iOS testing app kaise terminate hua aur crash ke time har thread par kaunsa code chal raha tha. Developers crash issue diagnose karne aur app ki problems samajhne ke liye use karte hain. Collect karne ke 2 methods hain.
qs.b: iOS crash logs show how the app terminated and what code was running on each thread at the moment of the crash. Developers use them to diagnose crashing issues.
qs.t: Crash log = crash ke waqt har thread ka snapshot.

qs.q: How do you collect an iOS crash log directly from the iPhone or iPad?
qs.s: Method 1: 1) App launch se crash reproduce. 2) Phone Settings. 3) Privacy. 4) Scroll karke Analytics & Improvements. 5) Analytics Data. 6) Affected app ke naam aur timestamp wali report tap (list alphabetically sorted). 7) Kisi app se share (e.g. Gmail). 8) .ips log report me upload.
qs.b: I reproduce the crash from app launch, then go to Settings > Privacy > Analytics & Improvements > Analytics Data, open the report with the app's name and timestamp, share it out and upload the .ips file.
qs.t: Privacy > Analytics > .ips.

qs.q: How do you collect iOS crash logs through iTunes?
qs.s: Method 2 iTunes (Windows ya macOS Catalina se pehle): 1) iTunes download, install, open. 2) Device USB se connect (automatic sync start honi chahiye, na ho to manually). 3) App launch se crash reproduce. 4) Computer par Reports folder (show hidden items select): Mac OS X: ~/Library/Logs/CrashReporter/MobileDevice/<DEVICE_NAME>; Windows: C:\Users\<USERNAME>\AppData\Roaming\Apple Computer\Logs\CrashReporter\MobileDevice\<DEVICE_NAME>. 5) App name aur timestamp wali sahi .log, .crash ya .ips file dhundo. 6) Report me upload.
qs.b: With iTunes on Windows or pre-Catalina macOS, I sync the device, reproduce the crash from launch, then open the CrashReporter > MobileDevice > device name folder with hidden items shown and upload the .log, .crash or .ips file matching the app name and timestamp.
qs.t: iTunes sync -> CrashReporter folder -> .log/.crash/.ips.

topics.intro: Android aur iOS device logs aur iOS crash logs sahi tools aur commands se collect karna.

topics.name: Web Debugging Proxy

qs.q: What is a web debugging proxy and which tools does the Academy cover?
qs.s: Web debugging proxy ek program hai jo proxy server ki tarah kaam karta hai, user device aur internet par testing website/application ke beech saara HTTP/HTTPS traffic view aur capture karne deta hai. Yeh logs developers ko network related problems diagnose aur fix karne me help karte hain. Course me 2 sabse zyada use hone wale tools: Charles Proxy aur Fiddler. Dono computer aur Internet ke beech saara HTTP aur SSL/HTTPS traffic monitor karte hain, requests mock karte hain aur network issues diagnose karte hain.
qs.b: A web debugging proxy acts as a proxy server that lets you view and capture all HTTP and HTTPS traffic between your device and the site or app under test, which helps developers diagnose network problems. The Academy covers the two most used tools, Charles Proxy and Fiddler.
qs.t: Proxy = beech ka aadmi jo saara traffic dekhta hai.

qs.q: What are the requirements of a web debugging proxy log?
qs.s: 3 requirements: (1) Decrypted log: uploaded log me saara traffic decrypted hona chahiye. (2) Testing website/app: log me test ho rahi website/app ka traffic hona chahiye. (3) Correct file format: Charles Proxy: .chls ya .chlz; Fiddler: .saz.
qs.b: The log must be fully decrypted, must contain traffic to the website or app being tested, and must be saved in the right format: .chls or .chlz for Charles Proxy and .saz for Fiddler.
qs.t: Decrypted + Test site + Format (Charles chls/chlz, Fiddler saz).

qs.q: How do you set up Charles Proxy on Windows and collect a log?
qs.s: Steps: 1) VPN disable. 2) Firewall aur Antivirus me Charles allow karo; poora firewall/antivirus disable nahi, Charles ko exception me add karo. 3) Charles Proxy 64-bit install; 32-bit system ho to 32-bit version. Check: Start > Settings > System > About > Device specifications me System type; 64-bit par 32-bit install mat karo. 4) Charles kholo. 5) Root Certificate: Help > SSL Proxying > Install Charles Root Certificate; certificate window me Install Certificate, Next; 'Place all certificates in the following store', Browse; Trusted Root Certification Authorities folder, OK; Next, Finish. 6) Charles band karke computer restart. 7) Charles kholke Proxy me Windows Proxy enabled check. 8) SSL Proxy: Proxy > SSL Proxy Settings, Enable SSL Proxying check, Include ke neeche Add; Edit Location popup me Host * aur Port 443; * se saara traffic decrypt. 9) Broom button se stored logs clear, recording on. 10) Browser me homepage se bug reproduce. 11) File > Save Session, .chls ya .chlz.
qs.b: On Windows I disable VPNs, add Charles as a firewall and antivirus exception, install the matching 64-bit or 32-bit version and install the Charles root certificate into Trusted Root Certification Authorities, then restart. I enable Windows Proxy, turn on SSL proxying with Host * and Port 443, clear with the broom, reproduce from the homepage and save the session as .chls or .chlz.
qs.t: VPN off, cert trust, restart, SSL * : 443, broom, save chls.

qs.q: How does Charles Proxy setup differ on macOS?
qs.s: Steps 1-4 same: VPN disable, Firewall/Antivirus me Charles exception, install, open. 5) Root Certificate: Help > SSL Proxying > Install Charles Root Certificate; Keychain Access khulega, Charles search karke Charles Proxy CA certificate double click; Trust ke bagal arrow, 'When using this certificate' ko Always Trust; window band karo, Mac password daalo. 6) Charles band karke restart. 7) Proxy me macOS Proxy enabled. 8) SSL Proxy Settings: Enable SSL Proxying, Include me Add, Host * (ya empty) aur Port 443; * saara traffic decrypt karta hai. 9) Broom se clear, recording on. 10) Homepage se reproduce. 11) File > Save Session, .chls/.chlz.
qs.b: On macOS the flow is the same, but the root certificate is trusted in Keychain Access by setting Charles Proxy CA to Always Trust, and I make sure macOS Proxy is enabled. SSL proxying uses Host * or empty and Port 443, and the session is saved as .chls or .chlz.
qs.t: Mac: Keychain me Always Trust, macOS Proxy ON.

qs.q: What extra step is needed for Firefox on desktop when using Charles, and how do you decrypt only one site?
qs.s: Firefox Browser (upar ke steps ke baad): 1) Hamburger menu > Settings. 2) Network Settings tak scroll, Settings button. 3) Use system proxy settings. Important notes: specific website ka traffic decrypt karna ho to SSL proxy settings ke host field me domain do asterisks ke beech likho (e.g. *the platform*). Kabhi saara traffic decrypt karne ko kaha jayega, kabhi sirf specific; dono methods aane chahiye, aur hamesha test cycle overview ke instructions follow karo. License: har baar 30 minute se zyada use ke liye license purchase chahiye; EULA follow karna user ki zimmedari.
qs.b: In desktop Firefox I set Network Settings to Use system proxy settings so traffic goes through Charles. To decrypt only one site, I put the domain between asterisks, like *the platform*, in the SSL proxy host field, and I always follow the cycle overview on whether to decrypt all or specific traffic. Charles needs a license if used for more than 30 minutes at a time.
qs.t: *the platform* = sirf the platform decrypt; Firefox = system proxy.

qs.q: What are the preconditions for using Charles Proxy with a mobile device?
qs.s: Android aur iOS dono ke liye: computer aur mobile same WiFi network par; dono devices me koi VPN active nahi; Firewall aur Antivirus me Charles allow (exception add, poora disable nahi); computer me Charles Proxy running.
qs.b: Both the computer and the phone must be on the same WiFi with no VPN active on either, Charles must be allowed as a firewall and antivirus exception, and Charles must be running on the computer.
qs.t: Same WiFi, no VPN, Charles chalu.

qs.q: How do you connect an Android device to Charles Proxy and install the certificate?
qs.s: 1) Pehle computer par Charles setup (last course ke steps 1-8). 2) Charles me Help > Local IP Address se active network ka IP note karo (e.g. 192.168.8.111); Proxy > Proxy Settings me HTTP Proxy port 8888 ensure. 3) Android WiFi settings me connected network chuno, Advanced options me proxy Manual karke sirf yeh fields: Proxy hostname = computer IP; Proxy port = 8888; save. Mobile par koi site kholte hi Charles me connection allow request aayegi, allow karna zaroori. 4) Certificate: Android browser (Chrome preferred) me chls.pro/ssl ya charlesproxy.com/getssl; mobile security lock authenticate karke koi bhi certificate name do; VPN and apps selected karke OK.
qs.b: I note the computer's local IP from Help > Local IP Address in Charles and confirm the HTTP proxy port is 8888. On the Android WiFi network I set a manual proxy with that IP and port 8888, allow the connection prompt in Charles, then open chls.pro/ssl or charlesproxy.com/getssl to install the certificate with VPN and apps selected.
qs.t: Charles mobile port = 8888; cert = chls.pro/ssl.

qs.q: What additional certificate steps are needed on Android 11 and newer for Charles?
qs.s: Device ke hisaab se thoda alag ho sakta hai. Option A: 1) Device settings. 2) Security. 3) Encryption & Credentials. 4) Install a certificate. 5) CA Certificate. 6) Warning par 'Install anyway'. 7) Device par certificate file browse karke kholo. 8) Install confirm. Option B: 1) Device settings. 2) Biometrics and security. 3) Other security settings. 4) install from device storage. 5) CA Certificate. 6) 'Install anyway'. 7) Device lock authenticate agar maange. 8) Certificate file browse karke kholo. 9) Install confirm.
qs.b: On Android 11 and newer, the certificate must also be installed as a CA certificate, either via Settings > Security > Encryption & Credentials > Install a certificate > CA Certificate, or via Biometrics and security > Other security settings > Install from device storage > CA Certificate, accepting Install anyway and confirming.
qs.t: Android 11+: CA Certificate, Install anyway.

qs.q: After connecting a mobile device to Charles, how do you collect the log?
qs.s: Android steps aage: Charles me Proxy > Windows Proxy ya macOS Proxy off karo; isse computer ka traffic collect nahi hoga (computer par log lena ho to wapas on karna). Broom icon se stored logs clear, recording on. Android browser me homepage load karne se bug reproduce. File > Save Session, .chls ya .chlz. iOS me bhi yahi steps 5-8.
qs.b: I turn off Windows Proxy or macOS Proxy in Charles so the computer's own traffic is excluded, clear with the broom icon, reproduce the bug on the phone starting from loading the homepage, and save the session as .chls or .chlz.
qs.t: Mobile log ke time PC proxy OFF.

qs.q: How do you connect an iOS device to Charles Proxy and trust the certificate?
qs.s: 1) Computer par Charles setup (steps 1-8). 2) Help > Local IP Address note (e.g. 192.168.8.111), Proxy Settings me port 8888. 3) iOS Settings > WiFi, connected network ke bagal i button; Configure Proxy > Manual: Server = computer IP, Port = 8888; save; Charles me allow request accept. 4) Certificate: iOS Safari me chls.pro/ssl ya charlesproxy.com/getssl; Allow; Settings > General > VPN and Device Management (iOS 15+) ya Profiles and Device Management (older), Charles Proxy CA profile install; Settings > General > About > Certificate Trust Settings me Enable Full Trust For Root Certificates toggle on (Charles certificate ke liye). 5) Charles me Windows/macOS Proxy off. 6) Broom se clear, recording on. 7) iOS browser me homepage load se reproduce. 8) File > Save Session, .chls/.chlz.
qs.b: On iOS I set a manual proxy on the WiFi network with the computer's IP and port 8888, open chls.pro/ssl in Safari, install the Charles Proxy CA profile from VPN and Device Management, and enable full trust for it under About > Certificate Trust Settings. Then I turn off the desktop proxy in Charles, clear, reproduce from the homepage and save as .chls or .chlz.
qs.t: iOS: profile install + Full Trust toggle.

qs.q: What extra steps are needed for Firefox on a mobile device with Charles?
qs.s: Upar ke steps ke baad: 1) Settings. 2) About Firefox. 3) Firefox logo 5 baar tap. 4) Settings par wapas. 5) About Firefox ke neeche Secret Settings kholo. 6) Use third party CA certificates enable. Phir browser aur Charles dono restart karke testing website kholo.
qs.b: In mobile Firefox I tap the Firefox logo five times under About Firefox to unlock Secret Settings, enable Use third party CA certificates, then restart Firefox and Charles before opening the test site.
qs.t: Logo x5 -> Secret Settings -> third party CA.

qs.q: What is a Charles Proxy profile and how do you import one?
qs.s: Charles Proxy profile saari Charles settings/configurations ka collection hai, specifically sirf required traffic capture aur save karne ke liye set. Default me Charles saari settings default profile me save karta hai. Agar cycle me custom profile required hai to instructions aur .xml format ki profile configuration file cycle me di jaayegi. Custom profile se cycle ke liye exact info collect hoti hai aur customer ko jo info nahi chahiye woh hide hoti hai. Import steps: 1) Charles aur Certificate installed aur working ensure. 2) Tools > Import/Export Settings. 3) Import tab. 4) Choose File. 5) Cycle se downloaded configuration file kholo. 6) Sab options selected. 7) Import.
qs.b: A Charles profile is a saved set of Charles settings configured to capture only the traffic a cycle needs; by default everything is in the default profile. When a cycle requires a custom profile it provides an .xml configuration file, which I import via Tools > Import/Export Settings > Import, selecting all options.
qs.t: Profile = .xml settings pack, Tools > Import/Export.

qs.q: How do you switch between and delete Charles Proxy profiles?
qs.s: Multiple profiles install karke cycle ke hisaab se switch kar sakte ho. Hamesha cycle ke liye sahi profile use karo; agar koi profile ya setup instructions nahi diye to default profile bina modification use karo, usme saara traffic hona chahiye. Switch: 1) Tools > Profiles. 2) Profile locate. 3) Activate column me box check. 4) Profile window band. Delete: 1) Charles kholo. 2) Tools > Profiles. 3) Jo hatana hai usse alag profile par switch. 4) Hatane wale profile ke naam par click. 5) Remove. 6) OK se save. Note: Academy Charles proxy practice cycle me default profile use hoga.
qs.b: I switch profiles in Tools > Profiles by checking the Activate box, always using the profile the cycle specifies, or the unmodified default profile capturing all traffic if none is given. To delete one, I activate a different profile first, select the unwanted one and click Remove, then OK. The Academy practice cycle uses the default profile.
qs.t: Koi profile nahi diya = default profile, sab traffic.

qs.q: Why would you filter Charles traffic and what is the general rule?
qs.s: Kuch projects me unwanted hosts filter karke sirf issue/task se related info wala log maanga jaata hai, taaki customer aur developer team jaldi dhoondh sakein. Course me exclude, include ya specific traffic filter karna sikhaya hai. General rule: cycle ka diya Charles configuration profile use karo ya cycle instructions ke hisaab se set karo. Agar profile ya instructions nahi diye to TTL ya TE se confirm karo koi specific requirement hai kya; warna default profile use karke saara traffic collect karo bina include/exclude ke.
qs.b: Filtering keeps only the traffic relevant to the issue so the customer and developers can find what they need quickly. I use the cycle's configuration profile or instructions; if none exist I confirm with the TTL or TE, and otherwise use the default profile and capture all traffic without include or exclude rules.
qs.t: Instructions nahi = TTL/TE se poochho, warna sab traffic.

qs.q: How do you include only specific traffic in Charles logs?
qs.s: Include sirf specified domain ka traffic rakhta hai, baaki nahi. Steps: 1) Charles kholo. 2) Proxy > Recording Settings. 3) Include tab. 4) Add. 5) Host field me domain ** ke beech, e.g. *the platform* ya *the platform website*. Sirf naam (the platform) use karo to woh saare domains include honge jinke naam me the platform hai (the platform website, the platform.net, the platform.io, the platform.etc); full domain *the platform website* use karo to sirf wahi domain, the platform.net/the platform.io nahi. 6) Edit ke liye entry par double click. 7) OK, phir OK dobara.
qs.b: In Proxy > Recording Settings > Include, I add the domain between asterisks. Using just the name, like *the platform*, includes every domain containing the platform, while the full domain, like *the platform website*, includes only that exact domain.
qs.t: *the platform* = sab the platform; *the platform website* = sirf .com.

qs.q: How do you exclude specific traffic in Charles logs?
qs.s: Exclude specified domain ke alawa sab domains ka traffic rakhta hai. Steps: 1) Charles kholo. 2) Proxy > Recording Settings. 3) Exclude tab. 4) Add. 5) Host field me domain ** ke beech (notes example: the platform ya *the platform website*). Sirf naam *the platform* se saare the platform naam wale domains exclude (the platform website, the platform.net, the platform.io, the platform.etc); full domain *the platform website* se sirf wahi exclude. 6) Double click se edit. 7) OK, OK.
qs.b: In Proxy > Recording Settings > Exclude, I add a host pattern to drop that traffic while keeping everything else. *the platform* excludes every domain containing the platform, while *the platform website* excludes only that exact domain.
qs.t: Exclude = sab rakho, yeh hatao.

qs.q: How do you remove Include/Exclude entries and what are the important rules about them?
qs.s: Remove steps: 1) Charles kholo. 2) Proxy > Recording Settings. 3) Include ya Exclude tab. 4) Entry click. 5) Remove. 6) OK. Important notes: Exclude aur Include ek saath use ho sakte hain; same Host dono tabs me ho to Exclude Include ko override karta hai aur us Host ka saara traffic exclude hota hai; ensure karo saare locations/requests sahi enter hue aur logs settings se match karein; Charles projects par ho to har session se pehle aur baad yeh options update/remove karo.
qs.b: I remove entries from Proxy > Recording Settings by selecting them on the Include or Exclude tab and clicking Remove. Include and Exclude can be used together, but if the same host is in both, Exclude wins, and I update or clear these rules before and after each session.
qs.t: Same host dono me = Exclude jeetega.

qs.q: What is the Focused Hosts feature in Charles?
qs.s: Focused Hosts se customer ki interest ke bahar wala traffic jaldi filter out kar sakte ho. Steps: 1) Charles kholo. 2) View > Focused Hosts ya Ctrl + Shift + O. 3) Add. 4) Focus wala domain type karo, e.g. *academybugs* ya academybugs.com, port 443 (HTTPS port). 5) OK, phir OK. 6) Charles traffic ko 2 sections me baant deta hai: added host aur baaki 'Other Hosts'. 7) Host hatane ke liye select karke Remove, OK. Note: Academy Charles proxy practice cycle me poora Charles log upload karna hai, bina extract kiye ya include/exclude use kiye.
qs.b: Focused Hosts, opened from View > Focused Hosts or Ctrl+Shift+O, lets me add a domain with port 443 so Charles splits traffic into that host and Other Hosts. For the Academy Charles practice cycle, though, the entire log must be uploaded without extracting or include/exclude filtering.
qs.t: Ctrl+Shift+O = Focus; practice cycle = poora log.

qs.q: How can you collect Charles Proxy logs without a WiFi router?
qs.s: Secondary device ko mobile hotspot banake computer aur testing mobile ko connect karo. Requirements: Charles installed computer; primary mobile (testing); secondary mobile (hotspot). Steps: 1) Secondary device par hotspot: Android: Settings > Network and Internet > Mobile Hotspot ya Hotspot and tethering > Wifi hotspot/Mobile hotspot enable, Name aur Password note (naming version/device ke hisaab se alag). iOS: Settings > Mobile Data > Personal Hotspot > 'Allow Others to Join' enable, password note. Har carrier/data plan hotspot allow nahi karta; na ho to doosra carrier/plan try karo. 2) Computer ko us hotspot se connect. 3) Charles Proxy for Desktop course ke hisaab se install/configure. 4) Testing mobile ko same hotspot se connect. 5) Charles Proxy for Mobile course ke hisaab se connect karke logs collect.
qs.b: Without a router, I enable a mobile hotspot on a second phone and connect both the computer running Charles and the test phone to it. Then I follow the normal desktop and mobile Charles setup to capture logs; some carriers or plans may not allow hotspots, in which case another plan is needed.
qs.t: Router nahi = doosre phone ka hotspot.

qs.q: What is the difference between Fiddler Classic and Fiddler Everywhere?
qs.s: Fiddler Classic sirf Windows par chalta hai aur saare Fiddler features/options ke saath aata hai. Fiddler Everywhere cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux), modern intuitive UI aur web debugging aur performance testing ke advanced features. Fiddler Everywhere freeware nahi: sirf 10-day trial free; trial ke baad capture, inspect, edit ya compose HTTP/HTTPS nahi kar sakte. Commercial use ke liye license purchase; EULA user ki zimmedari. Kaunsa software use karna hai cycle overview me check karo; info na ho to project team se poochho; koi aur software maanga jaaye to wahi use karo.
qs.b: Fiddler Classic is Windows-only with the full Fiddler feature set, while Fiddler Everywhere is cross-platform with a modern UI but is not free beyond a 10-day trial. I check the cycle overview, or ask the project team, to know which tool to use.
qs.t: Classic = Windows only; Everywhere = 10 din trial.

qs.q: How do you enable HTTPS capture in Fiddler Everywhere and Fiddler Classic?
qs.s: Step 1: Fiddler Classic ya Everywhere download/install; Everywhere me Sign In ya Sign Up (ya cycle overview/test case ke credentials). Step 2 HTTPS capture: Fiddler Everywhere: top right Settings/Gear icon; HTTPS tab me Trust Fiddler CA; Windows: popup me Yes; macOS: admin credentials daalo; Capture HTTPS traffic enable; Save, phir X se Settings band. Fiddler Classic: Tools menu > Options; HTTPS tab me Decrypt HTTPS traffic enable; popup me Yes (Fiddler Classic Root certificate trust); agle windows me Yes se certificate install; Yes se PC ki Trusted Root List me add; Yes se changes allow aur OK se success window band; OK se Options window band.
qs.b: In Fiddler Everywhere I open Settings > HTTPS, click Trust Fiddler CA, confirm, enable Capture HTTPS traffic and save. In Fiddler Classic I go to Tools > Options > HTTPS, enable Decrypt HTTPS traffic and accept the prompts to install and trust the Fiddler root certificate.
qs.t: Everywhere: Trust Fiddler CA; Classic: Decrypt HTTPS traffic.

qs.q: What are the Fiddler log collection steps after enabling HTTPS?
qs.s: 3) Unnecessary browser tabs aur background apps band. 4) Stored logs clear: Everywhere: left bar me Traffic pane > Remove All; Classic: toolbar X icon > Remove all ya CTRL + X. 5) System capturing: Everywhere: Traffic pane me System Proxy switch ON; Classic: File menu me Capture Traffic enabled. 6) Web testing ke liye capture se pehle browser cache clear taaki saari requests send aur capture hon. 7) Test app/website par homepage se issue reproduce.
qs.b: I close unnecessary tabs and apps, clear stored sessions with Remove All, make sure system capture is on (System Proxy in Everywhere or Capture Traffic in Classic), clear the browser cache for web testing, and reproduce the issue from the homepage.
qs.t: Clear, System capture ON, cache clear, reproduce.

qs.q: How do you filter unwanted traffic in Fiddler?
qs.s: Step 8 (sirf jab unwanted traffic hatane ko kaha jaaye): Fiddler Everywhere: Traffic pane me Filters; Add Condition (jitni chahiye); URL/domain daalo (e.g. academybugs); Apply; disable karne ke liye Filters window me filter checkbox uncheck karke Apply. Fiddler Classic: Filters tab; Use Filters checkbox; instructions ke hisaab se filter; No Host Filter dropdown ko 'Show only the following Hosts'; host field me e.g. academybugs.com; Actions > Run Filterset now; disable ke liye Use Filters uncheck.
qs.b: When asked to remove unwanted traffic, in Fiddler Everywhere I add a filter condition with the domain, such as academybugs, and click Apply. In Fiddler Classic I enable Use Filters, choose Show only the following Hosts, enter the host and run Actions > Run Filterset now.
qs.t: Classic: Show only the following Hosts.

qs.q: How do you export a Fiddler session?
qs.s: Step 9: Fiddler Everywhere: sessions grid me ek entry click; CTRL + A se sab select; kisi entry par right click; Export; format Fiddler Archive (SAZ) > Next; three dots (...); location select aur rename; Save; Save dobara se export. Fiddler Classic: File menu > Save > All Sessions; location aur rename; Save.
qs.b: In Fiddler Everywhere I select all sessions with Ctrl+A, right-click, choose Export and pick Fiddler Archive (SAZ). In Fiddler Classic I use File > Save > All Sessions, and either way the result is a .saz file.
qs.t: Fiddler export = SAZ.

qs.q: What extra Firefox settings are needed when using Fiddler?
