qs.s: Upar ke steps ke baad: 1) Firefox me top right Hamburger (Application) menu. 2) Settings. 3) Network Settings search karke kholo. 4) Use system proxy settings select. 5) OK. 6) Logs ke baad setting wapas No proxy kar sakte ho. Fiddler Classic (Windows) ke liye Fiddler Root Certificate trust: 1) URL bar me about:config. 2) Accept the Risk and Continue. 3) security.enterprise_roots.enabled search: true ho to log collect karo; false ho to arrow/toggle se true karo.
qs.b: In Firefox I set Network Settings to Use system proxy settings while capturing and can switch back to No proxy afterwards. For Fiddler Classic, I also check about:config and set security.enterprise_roots.enabled to true so Firefox trusts the Fiddler root certificate.
qs.t: Firefox + Fiddler Classic = enterprise_roots true.

qs.q: What is Fiddler Cap and how is it used?
qs.s: Fiddler Cap Fiddler Classic ka simplified version hai sirf trace capture ke liye, complex setup nahi. Abhi sirf Windows par available. Sirf tab use karo jab cycle overview me instruct ho ya cycle ka TTL ya TE seedha bole. Steps: 1) Download/install. 2) FiddlerCap kholo. 3) Decrypt HTTPS traffic enable. 4) OK, phir Yes se certificate install. 5) Clear Cookies, phir Clear Cache. 6) '1. Start Capture'. 7) Test website par homepage kholne se reproduce. 8) '2. Stop Capture'. 9) '3. Save Capture'. 10) Location aur rename. 11) Save. App band karne par installed certificate delete karne ka prompt aata hai; Yes karke agli baar naya install kar sakte ho.
qs.b: Fiddler Cap is a simplified, Windows-only capture tool used only when the cycle overview or the TTL or TE asks for it. I enable Decrypt HTTPS traffic, install the certificate, clear cookies and cache, click Start Capture, reproduce from the homepage, then Stop Capture and Save Capture.
qs.t: FiddlerCap: 1 Start, 2 Stop, 3 Save; sirf TTL/TE bole tab.

qs.q: How do you set up Fiddler for an Android device?
qs.s: Preconditions: computer aur mobile same network; dono me VPN nahi; Firewall/Antivirus me Fiddler exception (poora disable nahi). Steps: 1) Computer par Fiddler setup (previous course steps 1-3). 2) Fiddler me Settings > Connections; Allow remote computers to connect enable; port 8866 ensure; Save. 3) Computer ka local IP: Windows: Command Prompt me ipconfig /all, Ethernet/WiFi adapter ka IPv4 (ya Settings > Network and Internet > Ethernet Properties); macOS: Network Utility > Info Tab, sahi interface ka IP4. 4) Android WiFi > connected network > Advanced > proxy Manual: Proxy hostname = computer IP; Proxy port = 8866; save. 5) Root cert: Android browser me http://ipv4.fiddler:8866/FiddlerRoot.cer; authenticate, VPN and apps selected, OK. 6) Computer ke browsers aur unnecessary programs band, Remove all se logs clear. 7) Live Traffic toggle off (computer traffic collect nahi hoga; computer log ke liye wapas on). 8) Android browser me homepage se reproduce. 9) File > Save Archive > All Sessions, .saz, koi encryption select mat karo.
qs.b: For Android with Fiddler, I enable Allow remote computers to connect with port 8866, note the computer's IPv4 address, and set a manual WiFi proxy on the phone with that IP and port 8866. I install the certificate from http://ipv4.fiddler:8866/FiddlerRoot.cer, clear sessions, turn off Live Traffic, reproduce from the homepage and save All Sessions as an unencrypted .saz.
qs.t: Fiddler mobile port = 8866 (Charles 8888).

qs.q: How does Fiddler setup for iOS differ from Android?
qs.s: Steps 1-3 same (Connections me remote computers allow, port 8866, local IP note). 4) iOS Settings > WiFi, connected network ke bagal i; Configure Proxy > Manual: Proxy hostname = computer IP; Proxy port = 8866; save. 5) Root cert: browser me http://ipv4.fiddler:8866/FiddlerRoot.cer; Allow; Settings > General > VPN and Device Management (iOS 15+) ya Profiles and Device Management (older), DO_NOT_TRUST_FiddlerRoot profile install; Settings > General > About > Certificate Trust Settings me Fiddler certificate ke liye Enable Full Trust For Root Certificates on. 6) Browsers/programs band, Remove all. 7) Live Traffic off. 8) iOS browser me homepage se reproduce. 9) File > Save Archive > All Sessions, .saz, encryption nahi.
qs.b: On iOS I set the manual proxy to the computer IP and port 8866, download the certificate from ipv4.fiddler:8866/FiddlerRoot.cer, install the DO_NOT_TRUST_FiddlerRoot profile and enable full trust for it in Certificate Trust Settings. Then I turn off Live Traffic, reproduce and save all sessions as .saz without encryption.
qs.t: iOS Fiddler profile ka naam: DO_NOT_TRUST_FiddlerRoot.

qs.q: What should you do if Charles Proxy or Fiddler fails to install?
qs.s: FAQ 1: computer par Admin permissions ho; 32-bit computer ho to Charles/Fiddler ka older version jo 32-bit support kare; JRE (Java Runtime Environment) install karo; Windows par Visual C++ install try karo.
qs.b: I make sure I have admin rights, use an older 32-bit-compatible version on 32-bit machines, install the Java Runtime Environment, and on Windows try installing Visual C++.
qs.t: Admin, 32-bit version, JRE, Visual C++.

qs.q: Why install the root certificate, and what format and scope should proxy logs have?
qs.s: FAQ 2: root certificate install karne se Charles ya Fiddler HTTPS traffic decrypt kar paate hain. FAQ 3: Charles ka sahi format .chls/chlz, Fiddler ka .saz; aur hamesha entire log upload karo (specific items select karke nahi).
qs.b: The root certificate lets Charles or Fiddler decrypt HTTPS traffic. Charles logs are uploaded as .chls or .chlz and Fiddler logs as .saz, and the entire log should always be uploaded.
qs.t: Cert = decrypt; poora log upload.

qs.q: How do you fix 'Installation failed, unable to read certificate' on Android?
qs.s: FAQ 4: 1) Settings > Security. 2) Credential Storage dhundo, Install a Certificate. 3) Downloaded certificate select karke install.
qs.b: I go to Settings > Security > Credential Storage > Install a Certificate and install the downloaded certificate file manually.
qs.t: Credential Storage se manual install.

qs.q: What do you check if 'Page not found' appears after setting the proxy on a mobile device?
qs.s: FAQ 5: manual proxy IP set karte waqt computer par Charles/Fiddler running ho; mobile aur computer same wireless network par; VPN disabled (dono par); Firewall/Antivirus me Charles exception (poora disable nahi); computer par WiFi connection option 'Public' ho, 'Private' nahi.
qs.b: I confirm Charles or Fiddler is running, both devices are on the same wireless network, VPN is off on both, Charles is allowed as a firewall and antivirus exception, and the computer's WiFi connection is set to Public rather than Private.
qs.t: Running, same WiFi, no VPN, exception, Public.

qs.q: What do you do if 'Your connection is not secure' appears when installing the certificate on mobile?
qs.s: FAQ 6 tips: Advanced tap karke Proceed, certificate sahi se install; chls.pro/ssl ya charlesproxy.com/getssl bina HTTP/HTTPS protocol ke type karo; mobile browser aur Charles band karke dobara try, ya computer aur mobile restart; agar pehle install hua tha to computer aur mobile se certificate hatao aur dono par dobara install.
qs.b: I tap Advanced and proceed, type chls.pro/ssl without http or https, restart the browser, Charles or both devices, and if an old certificate exists I remove it from both devices and install it again.
qs.t: Protocol mat likho, purana cert hatao.

qs.q: How do you verify that a Charles or Fiddler log is decrypted?
qs.s: FAQ 7 Charles icons: Blue circle icon: HTTP/1.1 websites ka decrypted traffic. Lightning icon: HTTP/2.0 websites ka decrypted traffic. Red cross icon: agar saari entries me yeh hai to certificate install nahi hua ya galat install hua. Lock icon: decrypt nahi hua, unreadable data (SSL settings sahi set nahi, Charles Proxy for Desktop course ka step 8 dekho). Agar log me sirf Lock aur Red cross icons hain to decrypted nahi. Fiddler: entries ke bagal closed lock icon dikhe to Fiddler ne HTTPS decrypt nahi kiya. FAQ 8: saari required traffic par lock logo aur info nahi to SSL proxy settings galat hain: Proxy > SSL Proxy Settings, Enable SSL Proxying, Include me Add, Host * aur Port 443 (* saara traffic decrypt).
qs.b: In Charles, a blue circle means decrypted HTTP/1.1 traffic and a lightning icon means decrypted HTTP/2 traffic, while a lock means undecrypted data and a red cross on all entries means the certificate is missing or wrong. In Fiddler, a closed lock next to entries means HTTPS was not decrypted. If everything shows locks, I fix SSL Proxy Settings by enabling SSL proxying with Host * and Port 443.
qs.t: Blue/Lightning = theek; Lock/Red cross = gadbad.

qs.q: What are the root certificate names and how do you remove them from each platform?
qs.s: FAQ 9 names: Charles: Charles Proxy CA; Fiddler: DO_NOT_TRUST_FiddlerRoot. Remove: Windows: Windows+R, certmgr.msc, Trusted Root Certification Authorities me naam se dhundo, right click > Delete. macOS: Keychain Access me naam se search, right click delete. Android 10+: Settings > Security & Lock Screen (ya Security) > Encryption & Credentials > Trusted credentials > User tab > certificate tap karke remove. Samsung Android 10+: Settings > Biometrics and security > Other security settings > Users certificates > Charles certificate > Remove. Xiaomi: Settings > Password & security > Privacy > Encryption & credentials > Trusted credentials > User tab > Charles certificate > Remove. Android old versions: Settings > Security Settings > View security certificates > Charles ya Fiddler certificate > Remove. Huawei: Settings > Security & Privacy > More > Trusted Credentials > User > Charles certificate > Remove. iOS 15+: Settings > General > VPN & Device Management, profile remove. iOS old: Settings > General > Profile & Device Management, profile remove.
qs.b: The Charles certificate is named Charles Proxy CA and the Fiddler one DO_NOT_TRUST_FiddlerRoot. On Windows I remove it via certmgr.msc under Trusted Root Certification Authorities, on macOS through Keychain Access, on Android through Trusted credentials or the vendor's equivalent security menu, and on iOS by removing the profile under VPN and Device Management or Profile and Device Management.
qs.t: Charles Proxy CA vs DO_NOT_TRUST_FiddlerRoot.

qs.q: What do you do if you see 'Secure Connection Failed' with a red-struck padlock while using Charles?
qs.s: FAQ 10: Charles root certificate expire ho gaya ho sakta hai. Check: Windows: Windows+R, certmgr.msc, Trusted Root Certification Authorities me certificate kholke 'Not valid after' date. macOS: Keychain Access me kholke 'Not valid after'. Expire ho to computer aur mobile se reset ya remove karo. Solution 1 Reset: Charles kholo; Help; SSL Proxying me 'Reset Charles Root Certificate'; 'Reset', phir Charles band karke kholo; phir Desktop aur Mobile courses ke hisaab se naya certificate install. Solution 2 Remove: FAQ 9 ke hisaab se hatao, phir naya install. Note: kisi bhi solution ke baad Charles aur mobile browser restart karna pad sakta hai; zaroorat ho to computer aur mobile restart.
qs.b: That usually means the Charles root certificate has expired, which I verify through the Not valid after date in certmgr.msc or Keychain Access. I then either use Help > SSL Proxying > Reset Charles Root Certificate or remove the old certificate, and reinstall the new one on both computer and phone, restarting as needed.
qs.t: Red padlock = cert expired, Reset karo.

qs.q: What if you cannot download the Charles certificate from chls.pro/ssl on the mobile device?
qs.s: FAQ 11: certificate computer par download karke mobile par transfer karo aur manually install: 1) Computer par Charles kholo. 2) Help > SSL Proxying > Save Charles Root Certificate. 3) File type default .pem se .cer karo, yaad rehne wali location me save. 4) .cer mobile par transfer (SD Card, USB Cable, Email yourself, ya Google Drive jaisa remote transfer). 5) Mobile par file kholo; iOS par pehle file download karo phir jahan download hui wahan se tap. 6) PIN confirm; PIN nahi hai to set karne ko kahega. 7) Certificate ka naam do, Okay. 8) Charles restart karke course ke Step-5 se aage follow.
qs.b: I save the certificate from Charles via Help > SSL Proxying > Save Charles Root Certificate, change the type from .pem to .cer, transfer it to the phone by SD card, USB, email or a remote transfer, open it, confirm or set a PIN, name it and install it, then restart Charles and continue setup.
qs.t: .pem ko .cer banao, phone par bhejo.

qs.q: How do you keep a Charles log small enough to upload, and what if there is no allow prompt?
qs.s: FAQ 12: reproduce se pehle traffic clear karo: 1) Charles kholo. 2) Broom icon se generated traffic clear. 3) Bug reproduce. 4) Stop Recording button. 5) Session save. FAQ 13 (mobile se site kholne par Charles me allow connection prompt nahi aaya): computer par WiFi connection 'Public' ho, 'Private' nahi; dono devices restart karke mobile ko Charles se connect karne ke baad koi website kholo.
qs.b: To keep the log small, I clear existing traffic with the broom icon, reproduce the bug, stop recording and save the session. If Charles never shows the allow-connection prompt, I set the computer's WiFi network to Public and restart both devices before trying again.
qs.t: Broom -> reproduce -> Stop -> Save.

qs.q: What if the phone cannot reach the internet after configuring Charles proxy?
qs.s: FAQ 14: phone ka IP Charles me add karo: 1) Charles kholo. 2) Proxy menu. 3) Access Control Settings. 4) Add. 5) Phone ka local IP (Wi-Fi settings me milega). 6) OK.
qs.b: I add the phone's local IP address under Proxy > Access Control Settings in Charles so it is allowed to connect.
qs.t: Access Control me phone IP.

qs.q: How do you resolve the 'This file is invalid for use as the following: Security certificate' error on Windows 11?
qs.s: FAQ 15: 1) Charles kholo, Windows Proxy enabled (Proxy >> Windows Proxy). 2) Charles open rakhte hue chls.pro/ssl se certificate download; browser warn kare to proceed anyway. 3) Win + R, certmgr.msc, Enter. 4) Trusted Root Certification Authorities par right click > All Tasks >> Import.... 5) Next, Browse karke downloaded certificate; na dikhe to file type All Files. 6) Select, Open, Next, Next, Finish. 7) Security Warning par Yes, success par OK. 8) Computer restart (crucial). 9) Phir Charles me SSL Proxy settings setup.
qs.b: With Charles running and Windows Proxy on, I download the certificate from chls.pro/ssl, then import it manually through certmgr.msc into Trusted Root Certification Authorities using All Tasks > Import, accept the security warning, restart the computer, and then configure SSL proxy settings.
qs.t: Win 11: certmgr.msc se manual Import, restart zaroori.

qs.q: How do you avoid irrelevant PC traffic when collecting mobile logs, or vice versa, in Charles?
qs.s: FAQ 16 table: Chrome ya Edge desktop ka traffic: Charles me Proxy > Windows Proxy enable. Safari on macOS: Proxy > macOS Proxy. Sirf mobile device: 1) mobile par Wi-Fi settings me manually proxy set; 2) Charles me Windows Proxy disable.
qs.b: To capture desktop Chrome or Edge traffic I enable Proxy > Windows Proxy, and for Safari on macOS I enable macOS Proxy. To capture only mobile traffic, I set the proxy manually on the phone's WiFi and disable Windows Proxy in Charles.
qs.t: Desktop = OS Proxy ON; sirf mobile = OS Proxy OFF.

topics.intro: Charles Proxy aur Fiddler se desktop aur mobile ka decrypted HTTP/HTTPS traffic log lena, profiles, filters aur FAQs ke saath.

topics.name: Personally Identifiable Information (PII)

qs.q: What is Personally Identifiable Information (PII)?
qs.s: PII matlab koi bhi information jo kisi specific insaan ke liye unique ho aur usse us insaan ko identify kiya ja sake. Examples: full name, telephone number, bank details, photos, etc. Dhyan rahe: PII sirf tumhara apna data nahi hai, kisi aur ka PII bhi count hota hai. Jaise ek address jahan kai log rehte ho, wo bhi PII maana ja sakta hai.
qs.b: PII is any piece of information that is unique to a specific person and can be used to identify them, such as full name, phone number, bank details or photos. It covers not only my own data but anyone else's too, for example an address shared by many residents can still be PII.
qs.t: Jo data bande tak pahunchaye, wahi PII.

qs.q: What is GDPR and how does it relate to PII?
qs.s: GDPR = General Data Protection Regulation. Ye European Union ka standardized data protection aur privacy law hai. Ye personal data ki processing ko regulate karta hai taaki data protect rahe. Personal data = koi bhi info jo person ko identifiable banaye (yahi PII hai). Processing = koi bhi operation jaise storing, sharing, collecting, etc. Zyada detail aur common GDPR violations ke liye GDPR Academy course dobara dekho.
qs.b: GDPR is the European Union's standardized law for data protection and privacy. It regulates the processing of personal data, meaning any information that makes a person identifiable, which is the same as PII. Processing means any operation on that data such as storing, sharing or collecting it.
qs.t: GDPR = EU ka data chowkidar; processing = store, share, collect.

qs.q: Which privacy laws should a tester consider, and why does the country matter?
qs.s: PII ki definition country ke privacy law pe depend karti hai. Jo Europe me PII hai, wo zaroori nahi US me bhi PII ho. Notes me di gayi laws: 1) European Union: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). 2) United States: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) (US me kai federal aur state laws hain, ye sirf example hai). 3) Canada: Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA). 4) Brasil: Lei Geral de Protecao de Dados (LGPD). 5) Australia: Consumer Data Right (CDR). 6) South Africa: Electronic Communications and Transactions Act. 7) Japan: Act on the Protection of Personal Information.
qs.b: What counts as PII depends on the privacy laws of the country you are testing for, so something that is PII in Europe may not be PII in the US. Examples are GDPR in the EU, CCPA in the US, PIPEDA in Canada, LGPD in Brazil, CDR in Australia, the Electronic Communications and Transactions Act in South Africa and the Act on the Protection of Personal Information in Japan.
qs.t: 7 desh, 7 law: EU-GDPR, US-CCPA, Canada-PIPEDA, Brasil-LGPD, Aus-CDR, SA-ECT Act, Japan-APPI.

qs.q: Why should a tester blur or block PII?
qs.s: 2 reasons: 1) Khud ko aur doosron ko protect karne ke liye. 2) Taaki the platform aur customers laws aur regulations ke andar logon ka data protect kar sake. Tarika: PII ko block, blur ya cut out karna.
qs.b: There are two reasons: to protect yourself and others, and so that the platform and its customers can protect people's data within laws and regulations. PII can be blocked, blurred or cut out.
qs.t: Do wajah: apni/doosron ki safety + law ka palan.

qs.q: What information should testers blur or block? List the PII examples.
qs.s: Notes ki list (examples hain, limited nahi): 1) Full Name 2) Telephone number 3) Home address 4) Owned properties (jaise VIN - Vehicle Identification Number) 5) Biometric data (jaise fingerprints) 6) Bank details (Full IBAN number, Account number, Credit card numbers) 7) Driver's license number 8) National identification number (jaise SSN - Social Security Number) 9) ID ya passport number 10) Photos 11) Race 12) Ethnic origin 13) Political opinions 14) Religious ya philosophical beliefs 15) Genetic data (jaise DNA) 16) Login details (jaise email address jisme full ya last name ho, aur password) 17) Media access control (MAC) 18) Internet Protocol (IP) address 19) Device IDs 20) Cookies 21) Keyboard jab koi PII type ho raha ho.
qs.b: Examples include full name, phone number, home address, owned properties like a VIN, biometric data, bank details such as IBAN, account and card numbers, driver's license, national ID like SSN, ID or passport numbers and photos. It also covers sensitive data like race, ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs and genetic data, plus login details, MAC address, IP address, device IDs, cookies and the keyboard while typing PII.
qs.t: Naam-number-ghar, bank-ID-photo, dharm-jaati-DNA, login-MAC-IP-cookie, aur typing wala keyboard.

qs.q: What should you remember about customer-specific PII redaction requirements?
qs.s: 1) Har customer ki redaction requirements alag ho sakti hain, ye data type, customer policies aur involved countries pe depend karta hai. 2) Example: partial redaction maanga ja sakta hai, jisme sirf last few letters/digits redact karne hain, ya fields ko background jaisi same color se redact karna hai. 3) Isliye test cycle overview poora padhna bahut zaroori hai taaki customer ke PII redaction instructions samjho. Agar doubt ho ki kya redact karna hai, TTL/TE se consult karo. 4) Note: kuch projects bolte hain ki poora flow apne real data (name, address, email, phone, credit/debit card, password, etc.) ke saath record karo. Us case me project ka TTL/TE videos review karke sensitive info hide karega, client ko dene se pehle. 5) Blocking presentable tareeke se honi chahiye kyunki customer ye documents, images, videos dekhega.
qs.b: Each customer may have different redaction requirements depending on the data, their policies and the countries involved, for example partial redaction of only the last few digits or using a background-colored box. So I always read the full test cycle overview and consult the TTL or TE if unsure. Some projects ask for recordings with real data, in which case the TTL or TE hides sensitive info before sharing with the client, and all blocking must look presentable because the customer sees it.
qs.t: Overview padho, doubt ho to TTL/TE; customer dekhega, isliye saaf-suthra block.

qs.q: How do you block PII in an image on Windows using MS Paint?
qs.s: Koi bhi image editing software chalega (MS Paint ya Mac Preview). Solid black box se sirf PII cover karo. Windows steps: 1) MS Paint kholo 2) CTRL+O dabao ya File > Open > file select karo 3) Shapes me Rectangle pe click karo 4) Fill > Solid color select karo 5) Color 1 aur Color 2 dono black set karo 6) Sirf PII redact karo 7) File save karo.
qs.b: I open MS Paint, open the file with Ctrl+O, choose the Rectangle shape, set Fill to Solid color and set both Color 1 and Color 2 to black. Then I cover only the PII with a solid black box and save the file.
qs.t: Paint me Rectangle + Solid fill + dono color kaale.

qs.q: How do you block PII in an image on macOS using Preview?
qs.s: macOS steps: 1) Preview software kholo 2) File select karke Open pe click karo 3) Show Markup Toolbar pe click karo 4) Fill Color pe click karke black select karo 5) Shapes pe click karke rectangle select karo 6) Rectangle ko resize karke PII ke upar le jao 7) File > Save.
qs.b: In Preview I open the file, click Show Markup Toolbar, set Fill Color to black and pick the rectangle shape. I resize and move the rectangle over the PII and then save via File > Save.
qs.t: Preview: Markup toolbar, kaala fill, rectangle, save.

qs.q: What are the rules to remember when redacting PII in images?
qs.s: 1) Blocking poore PII text ko cover kare, lekin field labels ya doosre fields ko overlap na kare. Redaction box aur baaki text ya line ke beech visible gap hona chahiye. 2) Single character fields me redaction box har field ke liye alag ho, poori series of values ke across ek box nahi. 3) Saari screens aur pop-ups jinme PII hai (emails, email alerts, chats, chat alerts, etc.) redact karne hain.
qs.b: The box must cover the PII text completely without overlapping labels or other fields, leaving a visible gap. For single-character fields, I use one box per field instead of one box across the whole series. Every screen and pop-up containing PII, such as emails, chats and their alerts, must be redacted.
qs.t: Poora dhako, label mat chhuo, gap rakho; har char-field ka alag dabba.

qs.q: How do you take a full web page capture in MS Edge and Firefox?
qs.s: MS Edge: 1) Upar right corner me three dots menu 2) Web Capture select karo 3) Capture full page 4) Save button 5) Screenshot se PII redact karo (Images course ke tarike se). Firefox: 1) Page ke empty section pe right-click 2) Take Screenshot select karo 3) Save full page option 4) Download button 5) Screenshot se PII redact karo.
qs.b: In Edge I use the three-dot menu, choose Web Capture, then Capture full page and Save. In Firefox I right-click an empty area, choose Take Screenshot, then Save full page and Download. In both cases I then redact the PII from the screenshot.
qs.t: Edge = Web Capture; Firefox = right-click Take Screenshot.

qs.q: How do you capture a full page in Chrome using the GoFullPage extension?
qs.s: Chrome me full page capture ka koi default method nahi hai. Normal screenshot (Academy Screenshots course jaisa) lekar PII redact kar sakte ho. Agar cycle strictly full page maange, to ye method use karo ya TE se poochho ki koi specific method prefer karte hain kya. GoFullPage steps: 1) GoFullPage - Full Page Screen Capture extension add karo (ya Chrome Web Store > search GoFullPage - Full Page Screen Capture > open) 2) Add to Chrome button 3) Popup me Add Extension button 4) GoFullPage icon top right corner me milega (na dikhe to puzzle icon pe click karke GoFullPage ke paas pin icon dabao) 5) Website page kholo 6) GoFullPage icon pe click 7) Download Image icon pe click 8) Permission pop-up pe Allow 9) Image khol ke PII redact karo.
qs.b: Chrome has no default full-page capture, so normally I take a regular screenshot and redact it, or ask the TE if they prefer a method. If a full page is strictly required, I can install the GoFullPage extension, pin it, open the page, click the icon, download the image, allow the permission and then redact the PII.
qs.t: Chrome me default nahi; GoFullPage pin karo, click, download.

qs.q: How do you capture a full page in Chrome using Print - Save as PDF?
qs.s: Steps: 1) Chrome me website page kholo 2) Upar right three dots > Print (CTRL+P) 3) Destination me Save as PDF select karo 4) Agar ek se zyada page ho, More Settings pe click karke Paper size dropdown se Tabloid select karo 5) Save 6) Location select karo aur file name type karo 7) Save 8) PDF kholo aur PII redact karo (PDF: How to blur/block PII? course ke hisaab se).
qs.b: I open the page in Chrome, press Ctrl+P, set the destination to Save as PDF and, if there are multiple pages, choose Tabloid paper size under More Settings. Then I save the file and redact the PII from the PDF following the PDF redaction steps.
qs.t: Ctrl+P, Save as PDF, lamba ho to Tabloid.

qs.q: How do you capture a full-size screenshot in Chrome through Developer Tools?
qs.s: Steps: 1) Chrome me page kholo 2) Upar right three dots 3) More Tools > Developer Tools (F12/Ctrl+Shift+I) 4) Developer Tools window ke top-right three dots > Run command, ya Windows pe Ctrl+Shift+P / Mac pe Command+Shift+P 5) Search box me Screenshot type karo aur Capture full-size screenshot select karo 6) Image kholo aur PII redact karo.
qs.b: I open Developer Tools with F12 or Ctrl+Shift+I, open the command menu with Ctrl+Shift+P or Command+Shift+P, type Screenshot and choose Capture full-size screenshot. Then I open the image and redact the PII.
qs.t: F12, phir Ctrl+Shift+P, type Screenshot, full-size.

qs.q: How do you capture a full page in Safari?
qs.s: Safari me bhi default full page method nahi hai. Normal screenshot lekar redact kar sakte ho; agar cycle strictly full page maange to ye method ya TE se poochho. Steps: 1) Safari me page kholo 2) File > Export as PDF 3) File save karo 4) PDF file pe right click 5) Preview se kholo 6) File > Export 7) Format me PNG ya JPEG select karo 8) Save 9) Image kholo aur PII redact karo.
qs.b: Safari has no default full-page capture, so I either take a normal screenshot or, if a full page is strictly required, use File > Export as PDF. I then open the PDF in Preview, export it as PNG or JPEG and redact the PII.
qs.t: Safari: PDF banao, Preview se PNG/JPEG nikalo.

qs.q: How do you capture a full page screenshot on iOS?
qs.s: Steps: 1) Website page kholo 2) Screenshot lo: old iPhone models me home + power/side button saath dabao; new iPhone models me power + volume up saath dabao 3) Screenshot pe tap karo 4) Full Page tab kholo 5) Done pe tap 6) Top right Share icon se computer pe bhejo 7) PDF se PII redact karo (PDF course ke hisaab se).
qs.b: I take a screenshot using home plus power on older iPhones or power plus volume up on newer ones, tap the screenshot and open the Full Page tab. Then I tap Done, share it to my computer and redact the PII from the PDF.
qs.t: iPhone: screenshot, Full Page tab, share, redact.

qs.q: How do you capture a full page screenshot on Android using the native feature?
qs.s: Steps: 1) Website page pe jao 2) Phone ke hisaab se screenshot lo: Power + Volume down kuch second saath dabake rakho; na chale to Power button kuch second dabake Screenshot tap karo; dono na chale to phone manufacturer ki support site dekho ya google karo 3) Phone ke hisaab se Scroll ya Capture more button tap karo. Scroll: neeche scroll karke page ke end tak area badhao aur screenshot kholo. Capture more: screenshot ka bottom edge page ke end tak extend karo aur Done ya Save tap karo 4) Screenshot gallery ke screenshots folder me milega 5) Kholo aur PII redact karo.
qs.b: I take a screenshot with Power plus Volume down, or long-press Power and tap Screenshot, then tap Scroll or Capture more to extend it to the end of the page. The image is saved in the gallery's screenshots folder, and I redact the PII before using it.
qs.t: Power + Vol down, phir Scroll/Capture more.

qs.q: How do you take a long screenshot in mobile Google Chrome?
qs.s: Steps: 1) Mobile pe Google Chrome version 96+ hona chahiye (Chrome Settings > About Chrome me check karo) 2) Chrome kholo 3) Page kholo 4) Upar right three dots 5) Share pe tap 6) Menu se Long Screenshot option 7) Neeche scroll karke bottom arrows se poora page select karo 8) Check icon tap 9) Next tap karke Save to device only select karo 10) Computer pe screenshot kholke PII redact karo.
qs.b: On mobile Chrome version 96 or later, I open the page, tap the three dots, choose Share and then Long Screenshot. I select the whole page with the bottom arrows, tap the check icon, choose Save to device only and then redact the PII on my computer.
qs.t: Chrome 96+: Share > Long Screenshot.

qs.q: How do you redact PII in a PDF using LibreOffice?
qs.s: LibreOffice Windows aur Mac dono ke liye. Steps: 1) LibreOffice download, install aur open karo 2) Open File pe click karke file select karo 3) Agar PDF editable hai, PII select karke placeholder value se replace karo ya hata do 4) Doosra tarika box se cover karna (editable ya non-editable dono PDF me): Tools > Redact > Rectangle; text ko block karo aur box sirf PII pe adjust karo; right panel (Properties section) me box ki position aur size adjust kar sakte ho; optional: Line transparency 100% kar do taaki export ke baad box line na dikhe 5) Check karo ki redaction guidelines follow hui hain 6) Tools > Redact > Export Redacted PDF (White) ya Export Redacted PDF (Black) 7) File rename karke Save 8) Final check ke liye file kholo.
qs.b: In LibreOffice I open the PDF; if it is editable I can replace the PII with a placeholder or remove it. Otherwise I use Tools > Redact > Rectangle to cover only the PII, adjusting position and size in the Properties panel. After checking the guidelines, I export with Export Redacted PDF (White) or (Black), save and open the file for a final check.
qs.t: Tools > Redact > Rectangle, phir Export Redacted (White/Black).

qs.q: What is the difference between the LibreOffice export options for redaction?
qs.s: Export Redacted PDF (White): redaction box white dikhega aur file non-editable ho jayegi. Export Redacted PDF (Black): redaction box black dikhega aur file non-editable ho jayegi. Export Preview PDF: document ki PDF copy banata hai, isme redacted areas ka PII abhi bhi review ho sakta hai aur file editable rehti hai (agar pehle editable thi). Isse check kar sakte ho ki saara PII cover hua ya nahi. Lekin final karna zaroori hai White ya Black export se.
qs.b: Export Redacted PDF (White) and (Black) both produce a non-editable file with white or black boxes respectively. Export Preview PDF only creates a reviewable copy where the PII is still visible and the file stays editable, so it is just for checking. The redaction must be finalized with the White or Black export.
qs.t: Preview = sirf check; White/Black = final lock.

qs.q: What should you remember when redacting PII in PDFs?
qs.s: 1) Blocking poore PII text ko cover kare bina field labels ya doosre fields ko overlap kiye; box aur baaki text/line ke beech appropriate gap ho 2) Single character fields me redaction box har field ka alag ho, poori series ke across nahi 3) Redaction ke baad text aur link copy-paste nahi hone chahiye 4) Hamesha verify karo ki PDF properly flattened hai, test karo ki link ab active nahi hai 5) Koi bhi redacting effects (jaise edit boxes) hata do.
qs.b: The box must fully cover the PII without overlapping labels, with a proper gap, and single-character fields need one box per field. After redaction the text and links must not be copyable, the PDF must be properly flattened, which I verify by checking that links are no longer active, and any redaction effects like edit boxes must be removed.
qs.t: Copy na ho, link mare, PDF flat ho.

qs.q: How do you blur PII in a video using VSDC Video Editor on Windows?
qs.s: Video blur ke liye aisa editing software chahiye jisme portions blur/block karne ka feature ho. VSDC (Windows) steps: 1) VSDC free video editor download aur install 2) Kholo aur Upgrade Now popup band karo 3) Import content pe click karke video select 4) Project title type karke Finish 5) Progress line drag karke us frame pe jao jahan PII blur karna hai 6) Video effects > Filters > DeLogo 7) Object position timeline me From manual position set karo, duration define karo, OK 8) Position aur size adjust karo taaki sirf PII block ho 9) DeLogo filter ki duration timeline window se ya Properties window se (Object creation time = start point, Object drawing duration) adjust kar sakte ho 10) Doosre timeline pe aur blur add kar sakte ho 11) Video review karo ki PII block hua 12) Export project pe jao 13) Media device Web > output format MP4 > Change name button se output location select 14) Export project aur Continue 15) Export ke baad output file final check ke liye kholo.
qs.b: In VSDC I import the video, move to the frame with PII and apply Video effects > Filters > DeLogo from manual position. I resize it to cover only the PII and adjust its duration using Object creation time and Object drawing duration, adding more blurs if needed. After reviewing, I export for Web as MP4 and do a final check of the output.
qs.t: VSDC = DeLogo filter, export Web MP4.

qs.q: How do you block PII in a video using iMovie on macOS?
qs.s: iMovie App Store se free milta hai. Steps: 1) iMovie kholo 2) Create New > Movie 3) Video ko neeche timeline me drag-drop karo (ya Import Media se import) 4) Timeline pe PII ka starting point dhoondo 5) Block image ko video block ke upar timeline me drag-drop karo (note: kisi image program me rectangle block bana lo ya blurred image download karo) 6) Block rectangle select karke upar right se Overlay menu 7) Picture in Picture choose karo aur Dissolve 0 set karo 8) Block ka size aur position adjust karke PII cover karo; agar scrolling ke time PII dikhe to Add a new keyframe at the playhead button dabao, arrow keys se timeline move karo aur block move karo 9) PII ka end point dhoondo aur image block wahan tak le jao 10) Aur blur chahiye to block image dobara drag karke steps 6 se 9 repeat 11) Review karo ki saara PII blur hua 12) Top menu se Projects, project name type karke OK 13) Project ke context menu (three dot icon) > Share Project > File 14) Resolution 720p, Compress Faster, Next 15) Location select karke Save 16) Output file final check ke liye kholo.
qs.b: In iMovie I create a new Movie, add the video to the timeline and place a black rectangle image above it where the PII starts. I set the overlay to Picture in Picture with Dissolve 0, position it over the PII, use keyframes if the PII moves while scrolling, and stretch it to the end point. Then I share the project as a File at 720p with Faster compression and check the output.
qs.t: iMovie = kaala block, Picture in Picture, Dissolve 0.

qs.q: How do you blur PII in a video using ScreenPal?
qs.s: ScreenPal (pehle ScreenCast-O-Matic) Windows aur Mac ke liye, paid version. Steps: 1) Download aur install 2) Kholo aur sign in 3) Upar right Import button 4) Video select karke Open 5) Imported video pe click karke Edit 6) Timeline pe PII start point dhoondo 7) Tools > Overlay > Blur 8) Box adjust karke PII cover karo 9) PII end point dhoondo aur blur wahan tak extend karo 10) Review karo ki PII shuru se end tak blur hai 11) Done > Save As 12) MP4 > Filename > Folder select > Publish 13) Publish hone ka wait 14) Output file final check. Note: free version me Edit feature nahi hai, subscription leni padti hai. Har user apne use ko end-user license agreement ke terms ke andar rakhne ka zimmedaar hai.
qs.b: ScreenPal, formerly ScreenCast-O-Matic, works on Windows and Mac, but editing needs the paid version. I import the video, choose Edit, apply Tools > Overlay > Blur from where the PII starts to where it ends, then Save As MP4, publish and check the output. Each user is responsible for using it within its license terms.
qs.t: ScreenPal = paid, Tools > Overlay > Blur.

qs.q: How do you blur PII in a video using Kdenlive?
qs.s: Kdenlive Windows, Mac aur Linux ke liye. Steps: 1) Download 2) Installable version ho to install 3) App kholo 4) Project Settings (optional): Project menu > Project Settings > HD 1080p 30 fps ya HD 720p 30 fps select karo file size kam karne ke liye > OK 5) Import: Project menu > Add Clip or Folder > video select > OK 6) Cut: video timeline pe drag karo, blur wala part locate karo, Razor icon ya X dabake Razor Tool, part cut karo, Cursor icon ya S dabake Selection Tool pe wapas 7) Blur: Full ke liye Effects tab > Square Blur (recommended, baaki blur bhi chalega) > video part pe drag; Kernel size se blur intensity kam/zyada. Specific Area ke liye Effects tab > Alpha, Mask and Keying expand > Obscure drag karke video pe apply > timeline me video click > project monitor me blur area PII pe adjust. Zarurat ho to aur blur add karo 8) Export: Project menu > Render > Render dialog me Presets ke Generic folder se MP4 > More options check > audio na chahiye to Audio uncheck > Output file field ke paas Document icon se directory aur name badlo > location aur name > Save > Render to File 9) Exported video recheck karo.
qs.b: In Kdenlive I import the clip, cut out the part with PII using the Razor tool, and apply Square Blur for the full frame or the Obscure effect from Alpha, Mask and Keying for a specific area. I can lower project settings to 720p or 1080p at 30 fps to reduce size, then render as MP4 from the Generic presets and recheck the exported video.
qs.t: Kdenlive: Razor se kaato, Square Blur ya Obscure, Render MP4.

qs.q: How do you blur PII in a video on mobile using InShot?
qs.s: InShot Android aur iOS ke liye (Play Store/App Store). Steps: 1) Download, install 2) App kholo 3) Import: Video icon > New > video select > Check icon 4) Blur: timeline swipe karke blur wali jagah pe jao > Sticker > Detail option > box adjust karke area cover karo (PII ya password type karte waqt keyboard cover/blur karna bhi samajhdari hai) > blur intensity aur size badhao > Check icon > timeline me Left ya Right arrow icon pakad ke blur duration adjust > zarurat ho to aur blur > Check icon 5) Export: upar right Save link > format select (file size kam karne ke liye recommended: Resolution 720p, Frame Rate 30 fps, Format MP4) > Save 6) Exported video recheck karo.
qs.b: In InShot I import the video, use Sticker > Detail to place a blur box over the PII, increase its intensity and size and adjust its duration on the timeline, also covering the keyboard when typing PII or passwords. I export at 720p, 30 fps, MP4 to keep the file small and then recheck the video.
qs.t: InShot: Sticker > Detail = blur; 720p, 30fps, MP4.

qs.q: What are the key rules to remember when redacting PII in videos?
qs.s: 1) PII ki poori appearance redact karo, shuru se end tak, lekin screen ka zyada hissa redact mat karo. Tip: PII static ho tab ek redaction, aur moving ho tab doosra redaction banao 2) Test case flow ke bahar ki cheezein hata do (jaise Apple Pay jaisa payment method setup karna test case ke liye zaroori ho sakta hai par customer ko dekhne ki zarurat nahi) 3) Video ke wo parts cut karo jahan platform ya testing sheets (testing forms, spreadsheets, testing documents, etc.) dikhte hain, ya unhe record hi mat karo, taaki customer info the platform platform ke bahar public na ho 4) Saari screens aur pop-ups jinme PII hai (emails, email alerts, chats, chat alerts, etc.) redact karo 5) Mobile device ka keyboard blur/block karo taaki personal info, passwords ya sensitive info reveal na ho.
qs.b: I redact the PII for its entire appearance from start to end without covering too much of the screen, using one redaction while it is static and another while it moves. I remove anything outside the test flow, such as setting up Apple Pay, cut or avoid recording the platform and testing sheets, redact all pop-ups like emails and chats, and blur the mobile keyboard.
qs.t: Shuru se ant tak dhako; extra flow, platform, sheets, keyboard sab bahar.

topics.intro: PII kya hai, kaunse laws, kya blur karna hai, aur images, full page, PDF aur videos me PII kaise redact karein.

topics.name: Functional Testing

qs.q: How is functional testing defined, and what does it evaluate?
qs.s: Functional testing ek testing type hai jo product ke features evaluate karta hai taaki wo intended tarike se kaam kare aur product requirements follow kare. Har feature aur function test hota hai aur results check hote hain ki wo intended design ya end user ki expectations se match karte hain ya nahi. Tarika: user jaise typical actions karke output generate karo, phir actual results ko expected results se compare karo. Agar deviate kare (expected result ya product design se), to feature not working as intended maana jata hai aur bug (issue) classify hota hai.
qs.b: Functional testing evaluates a product's features to make sure they work as intended and follow the requirements. I perform typical user actions, compare the actual results with the expected results, and if they deviate from the expected result or the design, I classify it as a bug.
qs.t: Feature kaam karta hai ya nahi: actual vs expected.

qs.q: What are the two main testing methodologies used in the platform functional testing cycles?
qs.s: Do main methodologies: Exploratory testing aur Test Case (Scripted) testing. Ek cycle me ek ya dono ho sakti hain; choice project requirements pe depend karti hai. Scripted: predetermined steps follow karo, har step me specific instructions aur expected results; actual = expected to Pass, koi deviation to Fail. Exploratory (Unscripted): bina predetermined steps ke product ko independently navigate aur examine karo; ye un areas me issues dhoondhne me bahut effective hai jo scripted testing me consider nahi hue.
qs.b: The platform functional cycles use Test Case or scripted testing and Exploratory or unscripted testing, either alone or combined depending on project requirements. In scripted testing I follow predefined steps and mark each step Pass or Fail against its expected result. In exploratory testing I explore freely without set steps, which is great for finding issues scripted tests did not consider.
qs.t: Script = Pass/Fail; Explore = azaad ghoomo.

qs.q: What is unit testing?
qs.s: Unit testing product ke individual units ya components (jaise ek function, object ya method) pe focus karta hai taaki wo intended kaam kare. Example: password validation function ka unit test check karega ki requirements follow karne wale passwords accept ho aur invalid reject ho.
qs.b: Unit testing focuses on individual units or components such as a function, object or method to verify they work as intended. For example, a unit test on a password validation function checks that valid passwords are accepted and invalid ones are rejected.
qs.t: Unit = sabse chhota tukda, ek function.

qs.q: What is component testing?
qs.s: Unit testing ke baad hota hai. Ek specific module (related functions ka group) ki functionality, usability aur behavior verify karta hai taaki wo sahi kaam kare aur requirements meet kare. Example: password validator ke unit test ke baad, component test poora login module check karega: valid credentials se access mile aur invalid pe appropriate error message aaye.
qs.b: Component testing is done after unit testing and verifies the functionality, usability and behavior of a specific module, which is a group of related functions. For example, after unit testing a password validator, a component test checks the whole login module so valid credentials grant access and invalid ones show the right error.
qs.t: Unit = function, Component = poora module.

qs.q: What is smoke testing?
qs.s: Naye build ya update release ke baad preliminary test, check karne ke liye ki system ke most critical functions sahi kaam kar rahe hain. Ye ensure karta hai ki system deeper, comprehensive testing ke liye stable hai. Example: e-commerce web app update ke baad smoke test check karega ki app khulti hai, user login kar sakta hai, cart me items add hote hain aur checkout page access hota hai.
qs.b: Smoke testing is a preliminary test after a new build or update that checks whether the most critical functions work, so the system is stable enough for deeper testing. For an e-commerce app, that means checking it opens, users can log in, add items to the cart and reach checkout.
qs.t: Smoke = naye build pe pehli nazar, critical cheezein chal rahi?

qs.q: What is sanity testing and how is it different from smoke testing?
qs.s: Smoke testing ke baad hota hai. Verify karta hai ki specific new features ya bug fixes sahi apply hue. Smoke test se zyada detailed aur recent changes pe targeted hota hai. Example: agar product cart me add na hone ka bug fix hua, sanity test specifically check karega ki cart function ab kaam karta hai aur product page ke existing features intact hain.
qs.b: Sanity testing is done after smoke testing to verify that specific new features or bug fixes were applied correctly. It is more detailed and more targeted at recent changes than a smoke test, for example confirming that a fixed add-to-cart bug now works and the product page features remain intact.
qs.t: Smoke = broad check, Sanity = naye fix pe targeted check.

qs.q: What is regression testing and how is it different from sanity testing?
qs.s: Comprehensive test jo verify karta hai ki new features ya bug fixes existing functionality ko negatively affect na kare. Sanity se alag: regression sirf impacted areas nahi, balki system ke wo doosre parts bhi cover karta hai jo update se potentially affect ho sakte hain. Example: search function ka bug fix hua, to regression test ensure karega ki unrelated features jaise user login, product details aur shopping cart abhi bhi theek chal rahe hain.
qs.b: Regression testing is a comprehensive test that verifies new features or fixes do not break existing functionality. Unlike sanity testing, it covers not only the impacted areas but also other parts of the system that could be affected, such as checking login, product details and the cart after a search bug fix.
qs.t: Regression = kuch purana toota to nahi? Poora ghar check.

qs.q: What is ad-hoc testing?
qs.s: Informal test, bina predefined test cases ya documentation ke. Random ya intuitive exploration se jaldi defects dhoondhna jo structured testing miss kar de; tester ke experience pe bahut depend karta hai. Exploratory testing ad-hoc testing ka prime example hai. Example: e-commerce app me search field me lambe keyword combinations daalna, cart me unusually high number of products add karna, ya same button rapidly tap karke dekhna ki app crash hoti hai ya nahi.
qs.b: Ad-hoc testing is informal testing without predefined test cases or documentation, aiming to quickly find defects that structured testing might miss through random or intuitive exploration. It relies heavily on the tester's experience, and exploratory testing is a prime example, such as rapidly tapping a button or adding an unusually large number of items to a cart.
qs.t: Ad-hoc = bina script, jugaad se todo.

qs.q: What is integration testing?
qs.s: Multiple units ya components combine hone ke baad wo saath me kaise kaam karte hain, ye verify karta hai. Ensure karta hai ki saare integrated parts sahi interact aur data exchange karein. Example: Add to Cart button me multiple backend components involved hain, integration test verify karega ki product data product catalog database se user ke active shopping cart session me sahi pass hota hai.
qs.b: Integration testing verifies how multiple units or components work together once combined, making sure they interact and exchange data correctly. For example, it checks that product data passes correctly from the product catalog database into the user's active cart session when Add to Cart is clicked.
qs.t: Integration = tukde jode, data sahi bahe.

qs.q: What is system testing?
qs.s: Integration testing ke baad hota hai. Ensure karta hai ki poora system specified requirements meet kare aur complete entity ki tarah kaam kare. Integration specific module interactions dekhta hai, system testing poori application ko as a whole cover karta hai. Example: poora end-to-end user journey: login, product search, cart me add, payment method select, aur successfully checkout.
qs.b: System testing is done after integration testing and checks that the entire system meets the requirements and works as a complete entity. While integration testing looks at specific module interactions, system testing covers the whole application, such as the full journey from login to search, cart, payment and checkout.
qs.t: System = poori gaadi chala ke dekho, end to end.

qs.q: What is User Acceptance Testing (UAT)?
qs.s: Typically software development lifecycle ke end me hota hai. Real users ya clients system test karte hain ki wo unki daily needs aur business requirements meet karta hai, official release se pehle. Example: hotel booking app me actual hotel staff ya customers verify karenge ki wo aasani se booking schedule kar sakte hain, guest ki tarah checkout kar sakte hain aur sahi confirmation emails milte hain.
qs.b: UAT is typically performed at the end of the development lifecycle, where real users or clients verify the system meets their daily needs and business requirements before release. For a hotel booking app, actual staff or customers would check they can book, check out as a guest and receive correct confirmation emails.
qs.t: UAT = asli user bole 'haan, chalega'.

qs.q: What is interface testing?
qs.s: Do interfacing systems ya components ke beech interactions verify karta hai taaki wo communicate karein, data exchange karein aur responses aur errors sahi handle karein. Interface = medium jo systems ko communicate karne deta hai, jaise APIs ya external services. Example: e-commerce app third-party payment gateway use karti hai, interface test verify karega ki transaction details gateway ko sahi bheje gaye aur app Success ya Failure response sahi interpret karti hai.
qs.b: Interface testing verifies interactions between two interfacing systems, such as APIs or external services, so they communicate, exchange data and handle responses and errors correctly. For example, it checks that transaction details reach a third-party payment gateway and that the app correctly interprets its Success or Failure response.
qs.t: Interface = do systems ki baat-cheet, jaise API/payment gateway.

qs.q: What is User Interface (UI) testing?
qs.s: Application ke visual aur graphical elements evaluate karta hai taaki wo design specifications meet karein aur seamless user experience dein. Isme screen layouts, typography, colors, spacing check hote hain, aur visual controls (buttons, dropdowns, text fields) alag-alag devices aur screen sizes pe sahi display hote hain. Example: e-commerce mobile app me Checkout button poora visible ho aur doosre elements se blocked na ho, product descriptions screen ke edge se bahar na jaayein, brand colors aur fonts official design guidelines se match karein.
qs.b: UI testing evaluates the visual and graphical elements of an application against design specifications, including layouts, typography, colors, spacing and how controls like buttons, dropdowns and text fields display across devices and screen sizes. For example, it checks that the Checkout button is fully visible and that brand colors and fonts match the guidelines.
qs.t: UI = dikhne me sahi? Layout, font, color, button.

qs.q: What is the SDLC and what are its phases?
qs.s: SDLC = Software Development Life Cycle. Structured framework jo software ko initial conception se final deployment aur maintenance tak guide karta hai; defined phases ki series, har phase ke specific objectives aur activities. Phases: 1) Planning: scope aur objectives define, requirements identify, project plan; feasibility analysis, risk assessment, resource allocation. 2) Analysis: planning me gathered requirements detail me analyze; use cases, data flow diagrams, functional specification documents. 3) Design: requirements ko detailed technical design me translate; user interface, database schema, system architecture, component interfaces. 4) Implementation: design specs ke basis pe actual code; programming languages, frameworks, tools. 5) Testing: software defects-free ho aur requirements meet kare; unit, integration, system, user acceptance testing. 6) Deployment: software release aur users ke liye available; servers pe install, configure, user training. 7) Maintenance: ongoing monitoring, updating, enhancing; bug fixing, new features, user feedback address.
qs.b: The SDLC is a structured framework that guides software from initial conception through deployment and maintenance. Its phases are Planning, Analysis, Design, Implementation, Testing, Deployment and Maintenance, each with its own objectives, for example feasibility and risk assessment in Planning and unit, integration, system and acceptance testing in the Testing phase.
qs.t: P-A-D-I-T-D-M: Plan, Analyse, Design, Implement, Test, Deploy, Maintain.

qs.q: Why is functional testing important in the SDLC?
qs.s: Functional testing ensure karta hai ki software expected behave kare aur saari requirements meet kare, consumer ko release se pehle. Reasons (8): 1) Verifies Software Functionality: saare features intended kaam karein, har function ka output given input ke liye sahi ho. 2) Enhances Software Quality: defects early identify aur fix, reliable aur robust product. 3) Improves User Experience: software user-friendly ho, system user actions pe sahi respond kare, navigation expected behave kare. 4) Reduces Development Costs: early defects fix karna sasta; testing phase me bug fix karna release ke baad se kaafi sasta. 5) Ensures Compliance with Requirements: design aur business requirements meet ho, stakeholders/clients ki needs. 6) Facilitates Interoperability: specifically integration aur interface testing, doosre systems se sahi interact aur data exchange. 7) Builds Confidence: developers, stakeholders, clients aur end-users ka confidence. 8) Supports Other Testing Types: non-functional testing (performance, security) ka foundation.
qs.b: Functional testing verifies that every feature works and gives correct output, which improves quality and user experience. It reduces cost because bugs found early are much cheaper to fix than after release, ensures compliance with design and business requirements, supports interoperability through integration and interface testing, builds stakeholder confidence and is the foundation for non-functional testing like performance and security.
qs.t: 8 fayde: Functionality, Quality, UX, Cost, Compliance, Interop, Confidence, Support.

qs.q: What is manual testing and what are its strengths?
qs.s: Manual testing me tester bina automated tools ya scripts ke product se manually interact karke quality aur functionality check karta hai, bilkul end user ki tarah, taaki user experience me friction wale bugs mile. Strengths: subjective aspects evaluate kar sakta hai, jaise user-friendliness, aesthetic appeal, overall user experience. Interface, error messages ki clarity aur user journeys ke flow pe valuable feedback. Exploratory testing ke liye crucial, jahan tester creativity se unforeseen edge cases dhoondhta hai. Frequently changing requirements ya evolving UI ke liye highly adaptable, complex automation scripts rewrite karne ki zarurat nahi.
qs.b: Manual testing means interacting with the product exactly like an end user, without automation tools or scripts, to find bugs that create friction. Its strength is evaluating subjective aspects like usability, look and overall experience, giving feedback on error message clarity and user flows. It is essential for exploratory testing and adapts quickly to changing requirements without rewriting scripts.
qs.t: Manual = insaan ki aankh, feel aur creativity.

qs.q: What are the challenges of manual testing?
qs.s: 10 challenges: 1) Time-Consuming: complex products me test cases ya exploration me bahut time, release cycle slow. 2) Prone to Human Error: human observation pe depend, inconsistencies, repetitive tasks me defects miss. 3) Limited Scope: complex apps me comprehensive coverage mushkil. 4) Not Suitable for Repetitive Tasks: regression manually tedious, inefficient, demoralizing. 5) Scalability Issues: project bade hone pe zyada testers hire karne padte hain. 6) Difficulty in Simulating Real-World Conditions: high user traffic, thousands of concurrent logins, specific hardware strain manually replicate karna nearly impossible. 7) Lack of Documentation: tester ki understanding pe depend, documentation na ho to bugs reproduce karna aur team me consistent testing mushkil. 8) Cost: long run me human resources aur time ki wajah se expensive. 9) Limited Test Environment: diverse environments (devices, OS versions, browsers) setup aur maintain karna complex aur costly. 10) Difficult to Perform Certain Types of Testing: performance, stress, load testing manually practically impossible. Fir bhi manual testing exploratory, usability aur human insight wale areas me essential hai.
qs.b: Manual testing is time-consuming, prone to human error, limited in coverage and unsuitable for repetitive work like regression. It struggles to scale, cannot simulate conditions like thousands of concurrent users, depends on documentation, gets costly over time, needs many test environments and makes performance, stress and load testing practically impossible. Still, it remains essential for exploratory and usability testing.
qs.t: Time, galti, scope, repeat, scale, real-world, docs, cost, env, load test.

qs.q: What role does the platform play in manual testing?
qs.s: The platform ki vast aur diverse global testers community customers ko alag-alag demographics aur skill sets tak pahunch deti hai, jisse comprehensive test coverage milti hai. The platform numerous real-world devices aur OS versions pe testing ki flexibility deta hai, jo end users ke varied environments replicate karta hai.
qs.b: The platform's large, diverse global community lets customers reach a wide range of demographics and skill sets for comprehensive coverage. It also allows testing on many real-world devices and OS versions, replicating the varied environments end users have.
qs.t: the platform = duniya bhar ke tester + asli devices.

qs.q: What is automation testing and how is it implemented?
qs.s: Automation testing specialized tools use karke tests execute karwata hai aur actual vs expected results compare karta hai. Manual repetition kam, process efficient aur fast. Scripts baar-baar, consistently aur high speed pe chal sakte hain. Repetitive tasks, regression testing aur data-intensive tests ke liye beneficial jahan human error results affect kar sakta hai. Implementation: pehle automation ke liye suitable test cases identify karo; har test case ideal nahi. Stable, repetitive aur product ki core functionality ke critical test cases prioritize hote hain. Phir automation frameworks/tools se scripts banti hain, jaise Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, ya Appium. Scripts execute hoti hain aur results analyze karke discrepancies/defects identify hote hain.
qs.b: Automation testing uses specialized tools to execute tests and compare actual with expected results, so scripts can run repeatedly, consistently and fast. It suits repetitive tasks, regression and data-heavy tests. Implementation starts by picking suitable cases, usually stable, repetitive and critical ones, then writing scripts with tools like Selenium, Cypress, Playwright or Appium, running them and analyzing the results.
qs.t: Automate wahi jo stable, repeat aur critical ho.

qs.q: What skills does automation testing need, and what are its limitations?
qs.s: Skills: manual testing se aage specialized skill set. Programming languages (Python, Java, JavaScript) me proficiency taaki complex scripts likh aur maintain kar sako; automation tools aur frameworks me expertise; software architecture, data structures aur continuous integration ki strong understanding taaki automated tests development workflow me integrate ho. Limitations: subjective evaluations me struggle karta hai jaise user experience, visual aesthetics (color, font size) aur exploratory testing, jahan human intuition aur critical thinking chahiye. Tools aur frameworks ka initial setup cost aur product evolve hone pe ongoing script maintenance substantial ho sakta hai. Isliye rapidly changing ya short-term projects ke liye manual se kam suitable.
qs.b: Automation needs programming skills in languages like Python, Java or JavaScript, expertise in tools and frameworks and an understanding of architecture, data structures and continuous integration. Its limits are subjective areas like user experience, visual aesthetics and exploratory testing, plus high setup cost and ongoing script maintenance, which make it less suitable for rapidly changing or short-term projects.
qs.t: Automation = code chahiye; feel aur jaldi badalne wale project me kamzor.

qs.q: What are the advantages of manual testing over automation testing?
qs.s: 7 advantages: 1) Human Intuition and Exploratory Testing: creativity, experience, intuition se unexpected bugs aur edge cases jo automation miss kare; live observations pe tests design aur execute. 2) Usability and UX Evaluation: ease of use, aesthetic appeal, responsiveness, overall satisfaction; user journey aur accessibility pe feedback jo tools measure nahi kar sakte. 3) Ad-hoc and Unscripted Testing: flexible, sudden requirement changes pe adapt; anomalies ya naye ideas pe turant deviate; early-stage development ke liye ideal. 4) Lower Initial Investment: chhote projects ya limited budget me automation framework (tools, scripts, specialized training) se kam upfront cost. 5) Handling Complex and Dynamic Scenarios: frequently changing UI jahan scripts toot jaayein; visual changes, unexpected pop-ups, intricate workflows pe seamlessly adapt. 6) Immediate Feedback and Faster Early Results: initial stages me critical functionalities pe quick feedback; rapidly changing early builds pe automation setup kam efficient. 7) No Coding Skills Required: programming knowledge zaroori nahi, varied technical background wale strong critical thinkers ke liye accessible.
qs.b: Manual testing brings human intuition for exploratory testing and edge cases, and can judge usability and user experience in ways tools cannot. It is flexible for ad-hoc testing, needs lower initial investment, handles complex or frequently changing UIs, gives fast feedback on early builds and does not require coding skills.
qs.t: Intuition, UX, Ad-hoc, Sasta, Dynamic, Fast feedback, No code.

qs.q: Are the platform community testers involved in automation testing?
qs.s: The platform automation testing ek specialized internal team se karwata hai. Community tester ke roop me tum typically automation testing me involved nahi hoge jab tak project explicitly mention na kare. Community testers mainly manual functional testing projects me invite hote hain, jahan human insight, creativity aur adaptability customers ke liye sabse valuable hai.
qs.b: The platform handles automation testing through a specialized internal team, so community testers are typically not involved unless a project explicitly mentions it. Community testers are mainly invited to manual functional testing projects, where human insight, creativity and adaptability add the most value.
qs.t: the platform me automation = internal team; community = manual.

qs.q: What is test case (scripted) testing and how is a step marked Pass or Fail?
qs.s: Test Case testing (scripted testing) structured aur systematic approach hai. Tester predefined sequence of steps follow karta hai jisme instructions hain; har step me expected result hota hai jo intended behavior/output batata hai. Tester har step carefully execute karke actual results observe karta hai aur expected se compare karta hai. Match = Pass (product intended behave kar raha). Deviation = Fail. Fail matlab product me issue/bug hai jo test cycle me report hona chahiye, jab tak wo pehle se reported na ho ya known issue list me na ho.
qs.b: Test case testing, or scripted testing, is a structured approach where I follow predefined steps, each with an expected result. If the actual result matches, the step is a Pass; if it deviates, it is a Fail, and that bug should be reported in the cycle unless it is already reported or listed as a known issue.
qs.t: Match = Pass, farak = Fail + bug report (agar naya ho).

qs.q: What are the advantages of test case testing over exploratory testing?
qs.s: 6 advantages: 1) Clarity and Reproducibility: clear step-by-step instructions aur expected results, koi bhi tester consistent outcome le sake. 2) Comprehensive Coverage: systematically design karne se saare features cover karna aasan. 3) Progress and Reporting: steps aur test cases ka Pass/Fail status metrics deta hai, cycle ki progress, coverage aur issues ki clear reporting. 4) Easier for New Testers: limited product knowledge ke saath bhi predefined steps follow karke contribute. 5) Reduced Human Error: explicit expected results se ambiguity aur errors kam. 6) Facilitates Knowledge Transfer: test cases product functionality ki living documentation, team me knowledge transfer.
qs.b: Test case testing gives clarity and reproducibility, makes comprehensive coverage easier and provides Pass/Fail metrics for progress reporting. It helps new testers contribute quickly, reduces human error through explicit expected results, and the test cases act as living documentation for knowledge transfer.
qs.t: CCP-ERK: Clarity, Coverage, Progress, Easy, Reduced error, Knowledge.

qs.q: How do you prepare before executing a test case?
qs.s: Step 1 Understand the Test Case: Read Thoroughly: product kholne se pehle poora test case start se end tak padho; har step, objective, feature aur overall flow samjho. Identify Prerequisites: Preconditions ya Setup steps dekho, jaise specific login credentials ya environment setup. Clarify Ambiguities: koi step ya expected result unclear ho to guess mat karo, Test Team Lead (TTL) se clarification lo. Step 2 Prepare Your Environment: Access the Product: required environment me (jo slot me specified hai) app/website kholo aur check karo ki chalti hai; note: agar test case bole ki kisi step tak app/website mat kholo, to pehle mat kholo. Gather Information/Data: jaise new/unique email address ya specific payment method pehle se ready rakho. Clear Caches: zarurat ho to browser cache clear, logout ya app data reset taaki clean execution ho. Prepare to Capture Evidence: har step ke liye attachments (screenshots ya screen recordings) chahiye, capture tools pehle ready rakho.
qs.b: First I read the whole test case, identify preconditions such as credentials, and ask the TTL instead of guessing if anything is unclear. Then I prepare the environment specified in my slot, opening the app only when the case allows, gather data like a unique email or payment method, clear caches or reset app data if needed and get my capture tools ready for evidence.
qs.t: Pehle padho, phir taiyari: env, data, cache, capture tool.

qs.q: How do you execute and complete a test case, and how do you handle failed steps?
qs.s: Step 3 Execute Step by Step: Follow Instructions Precisely: har step exactly jaisa likha hai, koi step skip nahi, koi extra action nahi. Observe Carefully: button click hua? page load hua? error aaya? Compare Actual vs Expected: ye test case testing ka core hai; align = pass, nahi = fail. Report Bugs for Failed Steps: har failed step ke liye issue report hona chahiye. Workflow: Check for Duplicates: pehle dekho ki kisi aur tester ne report kiya hai ya Known Issue me listed hai. Add a +1: agar pehle reported hai to us report pe +1 karo aur us Issue ID ko apne failed step ke comment box me paste karo. Report a New Issue: agar report nahi hua to test case step ke andar Fail & Report Issue feature se naya bug report karo. Step 4 Complete: Review and Submit: double-check karo ki saare steps complete aur saare required evidence instructions ke hisaab se attached hain, phir submit. Goal: systematic product validation; attention to detail se high-quality results aur zyada test cycles ke invites.
qs.b: I follow each step exactly, without skipping or adding actions, and compare actual and expected results. For every failed step there must be an issue: if it is already reported or a known issue, I add a +1 and paste that Issue ID in the step comment; otherwise I use Fail and Report Issue to file a new bug. Finally I check all steps and evidence are complete and submit the test case.
qs.t: Fail step = duplicate check, +1 + ID comment, warna Fail & Report Issue.

qs.q: What is the traditional scripted testing approach used as a reference for exploratory testing?
qs.s: Scripted Testing (ST) two-step approach hai: 1) Tests plan, design aur likhe jaate hain. 2) Tests execute hote hain. Ye dono activities ek doosre se independently hoti hain. Kai cases me test likhne wala aur execute karne wala alag insaan hota hai. Generally execute karne wale tester ko product ka kuch knowledge hota hai, ya tests me saari zaroori info hoti hai. Ye important hai kyunki uske bina tester test execute nahi kar payega ya results accurately interpret nahi kar payega.
qs.b: Scripted testing is a two-step approach where tests are first planned, designed and written, and then executed. The two activities happen independently and often by different people, so the executor needs product knowledge or the test must contain all the information needed to run it and interpret the results.
qs.t: ST = pehle likho, baad me chalao, alag-alag.

qs.q: What is exploratory testing?
qs.s: Exploratory Testing (ET) learning, test design aur test execution ki simultaneous activity hai. Tester tests ek hi time pe design aur execute karta hai. Agla action (agla test) pichhle actions, product behavior ke observations aur apne critical thought process se influence hota hai. ET ka key aspect test technique ya product nahi, balki individual tester ki skills, intuition aur experience hai. ET maanta hai ki testing time ka significant hissa product seekhne me jayega; jaise-jaise explore karte ho, product ka function aur expected behavior samajh aata hai, aur us knowledge se naye aur better tests on the fly design hote hain; ye continuous learning results analyze karne ki ability bhi badhati hai. Compensation note: exploratory cycles me typically approved bug reports aur work ke liye pay milta hai, app explore karne ke time ke hourly rate se nahi.
qs.b: Exploratory testing is simultaneous learning, test design and test execution, where each next test is shaped by previous actions, observations and critical thinking. Its key element is the tester's skill, intuition and experience, and a big part of the time goes into learning the product to design better tests on the fly. In the platform exploratory cycles, testers are typically paid for approved bug reports and work, not hourly.
qs.t: ET = seekho + socho + chalao ek saath; pay approved bug pe, ghante pe nahi.

qs.q: What are the steps of the exploratory testing workflow?
qs.s: 6 steps: 1) Prepare to Document: notebook ya digital word processor lo, detailed notes lo. 2) Initial Exploration: app aise explore karo jaise abhi download ki ho aur khud use karna ho; abhi bugs dhoondhne ki tension nahi, layout aur logic samjho; jo baad me explore karna ho note karo. 3) Target Vulnerabilities: un areas pe wapas jao jo interesting lage ya vulnerable lage; ye experience se aata hai. 4) Execute Scenarios: har identified area ek-ek karke, us section ka har function explore; real end-user kya karega socho, use cases/scenarios banao aur execute karo; phir unusual variations; results se naye ideas. 5) Follow the Trail: ek time pe ek bug pe focus, par doosre bugs ya suspicious behavior ke hints dekhte raho, note karo aur baad me wapas aao; ek issue se 4-5 alag bugs bhi mil sakte hain. 6) Iterate: ek area exhaust hone pe agle point of interest pe jao; seekhi hui cheezein aage ke tests me use karo. Core pillars: simultaneously learning, designing tests aur executing.
qs.b: I prepare to take detailed notes, do an initial exploration like a real user to learn the layout, then target areas that seem vulnerable. I execute real-user scenarios and unusual variations in each area, follow the trail of one bug while noting other suspicious behavior, since one issue can lead to four or five bugs, and then iterate to the next area using what I learned.
qs.t: Note, Explore, Target, Execute, Trail, Iterate.

qs.q: What are the pros and cons of scripted testing?
qs.s: Pros: 1) Har test design karte waqt careful, deliberate thinking. 2) Execution se pehle project managers aur stakeholders review kar sakte hain. 3) Regression ke liye high reusability. 4) Test coverage ki known comprehensiveness. 5) Progress metric me calculate (jaise 80% test cases passed). 6) High-risk, strict compliance wali applications (banking, healthcare) ke liye suited. 7) Automated scripts me aasani se translate. 8) Naye testers jinke paas domain knowledge kam hai unke liye helpful. Cons: 1) Exploratory ke mukable kam unexpected ya edge-case bugs. 2) Highly rigid; test same rehta hai jabki requirements program ke saath badalti hain. 3) Tester ka focus script tak limited, test steps ke bahar ke issues nahi dikhte. 4) Detailed test plans aur cases ke liye substantial upfront preparation aur time.
qs.b: Scripted testing allows deliberate design, stakeholder review before execution, high reusability for regression, known coverage and easy metrics like 80 percent passed, and it suits high-risk domains like banking or healthcare, converts easily to automation and helps new testers. Its downsides are finding fewer edge-case bugs, rigidity as requirements change, narrowing the tester's focus to the script and needing heavy upfront preparation.
qs.t: Script: plan, review, reuse, metric, compliance; par rigid aur edge bug kam.

qs.q: What are the pros and cons of exploratory testing?
qs.s: Pros: 1) Rapid changes ke liye highly adaptable, Agile ke liye perfect. 2) Testing shuru karne se pehle kaafi kam upfront preparation. 3) Bahut tight deadline ke liye ideal. 4) Critical bugs jaldi milte hain kyunki testers naturally major functionalities aur workflows pe pehle jaate hain. 5) Jahan automation struggle karta hai (UI/UX evaluation, complex user journeys) wahan effective. 6) Tester ki creativity, experience aur skill ka massive impact. 7) Live feedback ke basis pe learning, designing aur executing ke beech kabhi bhi pivot. Cons: 1) Fully automate nahi ho sakta; lekin ET me mile bugs aur scenarios baad me automated scripts ban sakte hain. 2) Strict documentation nahi, compliance ya exact coverage prove karna mushkil. 3) Bilkul naye testers ke liye overwhelming jinke paas domain knowledge ya app familiarity nahi. 4) Agar tester detailed notes na le to bugs reproduce karna bahut mushkil.
qs.b: Exploratory testing adapts well to change and Agile, needs little upfront preparation, fits tight deadlines, finds critical bugs early and works where automation struggles, like UI/UX and complex journeys, while leveraging the tester's creativity. Its downsides are that it cannot be fully automated, lacks strict documentation for compliance or coverage, can overwhelm brand new testers and makes bugs hard to reproduce without detailed notes.
qs.t: ET: Agile, kam prep, jaldi critical bug; par notes nahi to repro mushkil.

qs.q: What are the common misconceptions about exploratory testing?
qs.s: 3 misconceptions: 1) ET is Unprepared Testing. Reality: scripts na use karna unprepared hona nahi hai; ye choice enable karna hai, constrain karna nahi. ET me aksar detailed documentation, charters aur notes use hote hain. 2) Test Cases are Never Used in ET. Reality: exploratory approach wale testers existing test cases ko guide ya starting point ki tarah use kar sakte hain. Scripts ka hona ya na hona akela ET define nahi karta; koi bhi testing activity jahan pichhle test ki learning agle test ko influence kare, kuch degree tak exploratory hai. 3) Only an Experienced Tester Can Do ET. Reality: seniority strict prerequisite nahi. Koi bhi tester jo seekhne, closely observe karne aur investigation practice karne ko ready ho, ET kar sakta hai. Key requirement: testing steps aur findings clearly articulate aur document karne ki ability.
qs.b: Exploratory testing is not unprepared testing, since it often uses documentation, charters and notes. Test cases can be used in ET as a guide or starting point, because any testing where learning from one test shapes the next is exploratory to some degree. And it is not only for experienced testers; anyone willing to learn and observe can do it, as long as they can clearly document their steps and findings.
qs.t: 3 myth: bina tayari, kabhi test case nahi, sirf senior. Teeno galat.

qs.q: What is Equivalence Class Partitioning?
qs.s: Testing techniques = methods jo check karte hain ki software alag conditions me expected behave kare; cycle ke focus ke hisaab se ek technique pe focus ya switch kar sakte ho. ECP: input data ko groups (classes) me divide karo jo similar results dene chahiye. Har group se sirf ek input test karna kaafi, kyunki group ke saare inputs same behave karne chahiye. Agar ek input pe error aaye to us group ke baaki inputs pe bhi highly likely same error. Example: quantity field 1 se 100 accept karta hai. Valid Class: 1 through 100. Invalid Class 1: 1 se kam (<1). Invalid Class 2: 100 se zyada (>100). Inputs: -25 (invalid), 50 (valid), 125 (invalid). Ye teen tests har group cover karte hain, saare 100 valid numbers test karne ki zarurat nahi.
qs.b: Equivalence class partitioning divides input data into classes expected to behave the same, so testing one value per class is enough. For a quantity field that accepts 1 to 100, the classes are valid 1 to 100, invalid below 1 and invalid above 100, so testing -25, 50 and 125 covers all three without testing every number.
qs.t: Har group se ek: -25, 50, 125.

qs.q: What is Boundary Value Analysis?
