qs.t: Ek hi active address, ek hi baar order complete.

qs.q: When and how can you do performance testing on an API?
qs.s: Sirf tab jab allowed ho, yaani customer performance testing prohibit na kare. Tab test kar sakte ho: same request ko short period me multiple baar bhejne par kya hota hai, khaaskar bade requests; aur doosre performance-related items.
qs.b: Only if the customer does not prohibit it. Then I check what happens when the same request, especially a large one, is sent many times in a short period, along with other performance items.
qs.t: Performance = permission pehle.

qs.q: How do you check that an API works according to its specification?
qs.s: API ki documentation ke saath verify karo ki saari requests specified tareeke se kaam karti hain.
qs.b: I compare every request against the API documentation and verify that each one works as specified.
qs.t: Docs = contract; har request contract se match karo.

qs.q: What is the difference between an API protocol, an architectural style, a description language and a language?
qs.s: Web services ke "types" me ye terms confuse hote hain: Protocol (jaise SOAP ya XML-RPC) API requests aur responses ka valid syntax describe karta hai. Architectural style ya paradigm (jaise REST) API ke rules aur goals set karta hai lekin zaroori nahi ki communication ka exact syntax ya details cover kare. Description languages (jaise RESTful web services ke liye WADL, SOAP-based ke liye WSDL) API ko standardized tareeke se sirf describe karte hain: saare API-methods, parameters, aur requests/responses ka format list karte hain; aksar markup language XML use karte hain. Languages (jaise GraphQL, JSON, XML) API calls (requests aur responses) ya API description ka format aur syntax define karte hain. Matlab jis API ki documentation XML me likhi hai wo actual API-calls ke liye JSON ya simple query-strings use kar sakti hai; XML hi use karna zaroori nahi.
qs.b: A protocol such as SOAP or XML-RPC defines the valid syntax of requests and responses. An architectural style such as REST sets rules and goals without fixing the exact syntax. A description language such as WADL for REST or WSDL for SOAP describes the API's methods, parameters and formats in a standard way, often in XML. A language such as GraphQL, JSON or XML defines the format of the calls or the description, and the docs and the calls do not have to use the same one.
qs.t: Protocol = syntax, Style = rules, Description = docs, Language = format.

qs.q: What is SOAP?
qs.s: Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP) ek "lightweight protocol intended for exchanging structured information in a decentralized, distributed environment" hai (w3.org SOAP 1.2 spec ke hisaab se), aur XML-RPC ka successor hai. Iske API-calls standardized communication ke liye XML markup language ka ek variant use karte hain. SOAP APIs typically WSDL se describe hoti hain. Data encapsulation concept: messages me ek envelope hota hai, jisme SOAP header aur SOAP body hote hain.
qs.b: SOAP, the Simple Object Access Protocol, is a lightweight protocol for exchanging structured information in a decentralized, distributed environment and the successor of XML-RPC. Its calls use a variant of XML, it is typically described with WSDL, and each message is an envelope containing a SOAP header and a SOAP body.
qs.t: SOAP = Envelope ke andar Header + Body, XML me, WSDL se described.

qs.q: Walk through the course's SOAP request and response example.
qs.s: Raw request (text/xml) SOAP POST call: soap:Envelope (xmlns:soap aur xmlns:sam namespaces ke saath), andar soap:Header (khaali), soap:Body, uske andar sam:search, aur uske andar searchstring tag me "Alice". Submit karne par API endpoint un persons ko search karta hai jinka first name searchstring tag ke value ke barabar hai. Response bhi XML hota hai. SOAP response request jaise hi rules aur syntax follow karta hai, lekin sam:search object ki jagah sam:searchResponse use karta hai search result serve karne ke liye. Kuch na mile to search-result error message dikhata hai.
qs.b: The SOAP POST body is an Envelope with an empty Header and a Body containing a sam:search element whose searchstring is Alice. The endpoint searches for people with that first name. The XML response follows the same rules but uses sam:searchResponse to return the result, and returns an error message if nothing is found.
qs.t: Request me search, response me searchResponse.

qs.q: What is WADL and what does a WADL file contain?
qs.s: Web Application Description Language HTTP-based web applications ko describe karne ka standardized method hai. Ise application modelling aur visualization, code generation, aur client aur server ki configuration support karne ke liye design kiya gaya. WADL XML par based hai, bilkul SOAP ki tarah. WADL description file me required root element "application", "resources" elements, aur kuch optional elements hote hain. Highlighted namespace attribute xmlns="http://wadl.dev.java.net/2009/02" bhi required hai.
qs.b: WADL, the Web Application Description Language, is a standard way to describe HTTP-based web applications, designed for modelling, visualization, code generation and client and server configuration. It is XML-based, and a WADL file needs the root element application, resources elements and the WADL namespace attribute, plus optional elements.
qs.t: WADL = REST ka description, root 'application' + 'resources'.

qs.q: How do you import a WADL file into Postman?
qs.s: Postman valid WADL directly import kar sakta hai aur usse nayi collection generate karta hai (example official WADL specification w3.org/Submission/wadl se liya gaya). Steps: left sidebar ke top par Import button click karo, phir ya to "Import File" dialog se WADL file kholo, ya "Raw text" tab me code copy-paste karo. Note: import se pehle code se line numbers hata do. Agar WADL ka syntax sahi hai to Postman documentation ki saari requests ek nayi collection me store kar deta hai. Note: imported example ki request required nahi hai; ye sirf import process dikhata hai, aur bhejne par ye request 404 error page return karti hai.
qs.b: Click Import at the top of the left sidebar and either open the WADL file through Import File or paste the code in the Raw text tab, after removing any line numbers. If the syntax is valid, Postman creates a new collection with all the requests from the description.
qs.t: Import > File ya Raw text; line numbers hatao.

qs.q: What is JSON and what are its advantages?
qs.s: JSON = "JavaScript Object Notation". Naam ki tarah, JSON ka har piece actually ek valid javascript object hota hai. Advantages: doosri languages me aasani se convert ho jaata hai; overhead bahut kam hai, actual payload (API ko ya API se bheja gaya data) ke alawa bahut kam characters hote hain; isliye readability bhi great hai, simple syntax seekhne ke baad. Example: { "name": "John", age: 31, "city": "New York" }.
qs.b: JSON stands for JavaScript Object Notation, and every JSON object is a valid JavaScript object. It converts easily into other languages and has very little overhead beyond the payload, which also makes it very readable.
qs.t: JSON = kam overhead, zyada readable.

qs.q: What are the syntax rules of JSON?
qs.s: Poora JSON object curly brackets me enclosed hota hai. Individual parameters commas se separate hote hain. Key-value pairs colon se separate hote hain, jaise "key": "value". Text (strings) quotes me hone chahiye: "New York". Multiple data types allowed hain, jaise strings, numbers, arrays, aur doosre JSON objects (curly brackets me). Example: gigs naam ka array jisme do objects: name "pop concert" description "a wonderful evening", aur name "festival" description "a weekend full of fun". Spacing ya padding ki koi requirement nahi, lekin readability ke liye indentation aur har object ko apni line me rakhna recommended hai. Jo white space kisi value (quotes ke andar) ka part nahi hai, wo usually server crop karke drop kar deta hai.
qs.b: A JSON object is wrapped in curly brackets, parameters are separated by commas, keys and values are separated by colons, and strings must be in quotes. It supports strings, numbers, arrays and nested objects. Spacing is optional, but indentation helps readability, and the server usually drops whitespace outside quoted values.
qs.t: Curly bahar, comma beech me, colon key-value me, quotes string pe.

qs.q: How do you send a JSON request in Postman?
qs.s: Wahi request jaisi pehle (persons ko first name se search karna) lekin is baar JSON ke saath. Result bhi JSON object hota hai: {"Alice Xiang"}. Request ke liye sahi Content-Type: application/json select karna zaroori hai. Searchstring ka koi valid result na ho to "not found" response milta hai.
qs.b: Send the request body as JSON and make sure the Content-Type is application/json. In the course example, searching for Alice returned a JSON result with Alice Xiang, and a search with no match returned a not found response.
qs.t: JSON bhejo to header bolo: application/json.

qs.q: What is SoapUI?
qs.s: SoapUI REST APIs aur SOAP APIs dono ke liye testing application hai. Basic version open source aur free hai. Main use automated tests ka design aur execution hai, lekin manual testing ke liye bhi use ho sakta hai.
qs.b: SoapUI is a testing tool for both REST and SOAP APIs. The basic version is open source and free, and it is mainly used to design and run automated tests, though it also supports manual testing.
qs.t: SoapUI = SOAP + REST, mainly automation.

qs.q: What is GraphQL?
qs.s: Originally Facebook ne aur Facebook ke liye design kiya, GraphQL jaldi hi web services ke liye popular language ban gaya. Ye open source technology non-profit Linux Foundation host karta hai. Iski apni GraphQL Schema Definition Language hai, jo kuch had tak JSON jaisi dikhti hai. Lekin sirf data transmission ka format hone ke alawa, iski apni bahut powerful query aur data-modification language hai.
qs.b: GraphQL was originally designed by and for Facebook and is now an open source technology hosted by the non-profit Linux Foundation. It has its own Schema Definition Language that looks similar to JSON, and beyond being a data format it provides a powerful query and data-modification language.
qs.t: GraphQL = Facebook ka banaya, Linux Foundation ka paala.

qs.q: What is Swagger UI?
qs.s: Ek aur open source project jo web services documentation render karne me help karta hai. Ye HTML, Javascript aur CSS assets ka collection hai, aur kisi bhi compliant API se automatically browsable web documentation generate kar sakta hai. Course ki requests me use hui script files: github.com/MartinRJ/testtraining.
qs.b: Swagger UI is an open source project made of HTML, JavaScript and CSS assets that renders web service documentation. It can automatically generate browsable web documentation from any compliant API.
qs.t: Swagger = API docs ka showroom.

topics.name: Certification Practice Cycles
topics.intro: Academy Certification Program ke chaar practice cycles - Computer, Mobile, Charles Proxy aur Academy Challenge - unki requirements, rules, passing aur quiz map ek jagah.

qs.q: What are the four certification practice cycles covered here, and what does each one require you to have passed first?
qs.s: Academy Certification Program ke course pages me ye four practice cycles isi order me hain: 1) Computer Testing, 2) Mobile Device Testing, 3) Charles Proxy Testing, 4) Academy Challenge. Computer Testing ke liye Introduction to Testing cycle pass hona chahiye. Mobile Device Testing ke liye Computer Testing cycle pass hona chahiye (page pe likha hai: practice cycle locked until preceding cycles are passed). Academy Challenge ke liye Charles Proxy cycle pass hona chahiye. Charles Proxy page pe sirf FAQs aur quiz map diya hai, uski requirements notes me nahi likhi, aur wo cycle bhi locked dikh raha tha. Har cycle se pehle ek quiz hai: Computer 15, Mobile 20, Charles 25, Academy Challenge 30 questions sahi karne hote hain.
qs.b: The certification track has four practice cycles in sequence: Computer Testing, Mobile Device Testing, Charles Proxy Testing and the Academy Challenge. Computer Testing needs the Introduction to Testing cycle passed, Mobile Device Testing needs Computer Testing passed, and the Academy Challenge needs the Charles Proxy cycle passed. Each cycle has a quiz before sign-up, needing 15, 20, 25 and 30 correct answers respectively.
qs.t: Computer -> Mobile -> Charles -> Challenge; quiz 15-20-25-30, har step pe +5.

qs.q: What are the steps to follow after reading a certification cycle page, and how are grades assigned?
qs.s: What to do next (Computer aur Mobile same; Academy Challenge me bhi same pattern): 1) FAQ padho aur previous courses review karo. 2) Quiz complete karo (Reference Links use karo). 3) Quiz ke baad blue Sign Up button se sign up karo. 4) Overview padho, invitation accept karo, cycle instructions follow karo. 5) Pass hone ke baad next cycle pe jao. 6) Grades: active ya locked cycle ke dauran Pass grade sirf tab milta hai jab approved issue AUR approved test case dono ho; ye dono approvals ke 12 se 24 hours ke andar assign hota hai. Pass hone ke baad tester next practice cycle ke liye sign up kar sakta hai, cycle close hone ka wait nahi karna. Cycle close hone pe baaki sab ko Pass/Fail grade milta hai: Pass = aage badho, Fail = same level ke liye dobara sign up karo.
qs.b: Read the FAQ and earlier courses, pass the quiz using the Reference Links, sign up with the blue Sign Up button, then read the overview, accept the invitation and follow the instructions. During an active or locked cycle a Pass is given only once both an issue and a test case are approved, within 12 to 24 hours of both approvals, and you can sign up for the next cycle right away. When the cycle closes everyone else gets Pass or Fail, and a Fail means signing up again for the same level.
qs.t: FAQ -> Quiz -> Sign Up -> Accept -> Pass; Pass 12-24 ghante me, Fail = same level repeat.

qs.q: How do the cycles differ in issue limits and duplicate handling?
qs.s: Computer Testing aur Mobile Device Testing: maximum three issue reports, aur dusre testers ke issues hidden hote hain, isliye duplicates ki tension nahi. Invalid reports reject hote hain. Academy Challenge: any number of issue reports allowed, lekin duplicates (invalid) reject hote hain, isliye dusre testers ke issues check karne padte hain, known issues list check karni padti hai, aur already reported issue pe +1 ya reproduce karna hota hai. Saath me bug limit: rated ya unrated testers ke paas ek time pe max 5 new issues ho sakte hain. Computer FAQ: 2 approved + 1 rejected ho to ek aur issue report kar sakte ho, kul 3 approved issues ho sakte hain.
qs.b: In Computer and Mobile Device Testing you may submit at most three issue reports, and other testers' issues are hidden, so duplicates are not a concern. In the Academy Challenge there is no limit on the number of reports, but duplicates are rejected, so you must check other testers' issues and the known issues list and +1 existing ones. There is also a cap of 5 new, unreviewed issues at a time in the Challenge.
qs.t: Computer/Mobile = 3 max, duplicates hidden; Challenge = unlimited but 5 new at a time, duplicates check karo.

qs.q: What do you need before joining the Computer Testing cycle, and what new skills does it make you practise?
qs.s: Requirements: 1) Introduction to Testing cycle pass kiya ho. 2) Computer ho. 3) Computer pe screen recording banana aata ho. 4) Browser console logs collect karna aata ho. New things you will practise: 1) Live cycles me computer se testing. 2) Computer pe screen recordings banana. 3) Desktop browser logs collect karna. 4) Review likhna.
qs.b: To join Computer Testing you must have passed the Introduction to Testing cycle, have a computer, and know how to make screen recordings and collect browser console logs on it. The cycle lets you practise testing in live cycles on a computer, making screen recordings, collecting desktop browser logs and writing a review.
qs.t: Intro pass + computer + recording + console log; practise = live test, recording, desktop log, review.

qs.q: What are the rules specific to the Computer Testing cycle and what do you need to pass it?
qs.s: Cycle specific info: 1) Testing sirf computers pe (Windows, macOS ya Linux). 2) Invalid issue reports reject honge. 3) Maximum three issue reports. 4) Dusre testers ke reported issues hidden hain, isliye duplicates ki fikar nahi. Passing ke liye: kam se kam ek approved issue report aur ek approved test case.
qs.b: Computer Testing is done only on Windows, macOS or Linux computers, invalid reports are rejected, and you can submit at most three issue reports. Other testers' issues are hidden, so duplicates are not a concern. To pass you need at least one approved issue report and one approved test case.
qs.t: Win/Mac/Linux, 3 max, duplicate hidden; pass = 1 issue + 1 test case.

qs.q: Which course areas does the Computer Testing quiz draw from?
qs.s: Sign up se pehle 15 questions sahi karne hain. Course area wise summary: Screen recording (5 questions) - Basics of Screen Recording 3 baar, Handbrake 1, Screen Recording on Windows 1. Issues and rejections (4) - What is an Issue 1, Bug Rejections 3. Testing process and test cases (4) - Best Practices (Testing) 1, Test Cycle Process 1, Test Case 1, Best Practices (Test Cases) 1. Logs (1) - Browser Console Logs (Desktop). Cycle course (1) - Computer Testing. Sabse zyada weight screen recording aur Bug Rejections ka hai.
qs.b: The Computer Testing quiz needs 15 correct answers. Most questions come from screen recording (Basics of Screen Recording, Handbrake, Screen Recording on Windows) and from issues and Bug Rejections, followed by test-cycle process and test-case best practices, desktop browser console logs and the Computer Testing course itself.
qs.t: Computer quiz = Recording + Rejections heavy; 15 pass.

qs.q: In the Computer Testing cycle, do I need to write a test case after claiming a slot?
qs.s: Nahi. Testers test cases nahi likhte. Slot claim karne (invitation accept karne) ke baad apna test case open karo aur use execute karo. Execute karna seekhne ke liye course: What is a test case.
qs.b: No, testers do not write test cases. After claiming a slot you open your assigned test case and execute it.
qs.t: Test case likhna nahi, chalana hai.

qs.q: What is the difference between a bug report and a test case?
qs.s: Bug report kisi bug ya issue ka written summary hai. Test case kisi product ko test karne ke required steps ki series hai. Cycle pass karne ke liye dono chahiye: approved bug report aur approved test case. Courses: Bug Reports, Slots and Test Cases.
qs.b: A bug report is a written summary of a bug or issue, while a test case is a series of required steps to test a product. Passing a practice cycle needs one of each approved.
qs.t: Bug report = kya toota; test case = kaise test karna.

qs.q: Do I have to upload attachments to test case steps that show Result Attachments and Pass/Fail/Done options?
qs.s: Agar Result Attachments section ke neeche koi minimum number nahi dikhta, to attachment upload karna zaroori nahi. Agar minimum number dikhe (jaise MINIMUM 1), to attachment upload karna hai. Course: Attachments in a Test Case.
qs.b: Only if a minimum is shown. If the Result Attachments section shows a minimum such as MINIMUM 1 you must upload that many attachments; if no minimum is shown, no attachment is required.
qs.t: MINIMUM likha hai to upload, warna nahi.

qs.q: How do you add or replace attachments on an issue report you already submitted?
qs.s: Steps: 1) Apna bug report open karo. 2) Attachments section tak scroll karo (naye attachments ke liye Edit Issue click karne ki zaroorat nahi). 3) Choose Files button se upload karo ya drag and drop karo. 4) Upload Complete message aane tak wait karo. 5) Purana galat attachment delete karo.
qs.b: Open the bug report and scroll to the attachments section; you do not need Edit Issue for this. Upload with Choose Files or drag and drop, wait for the Upload Complete message, then delete the old incorrect attachment.
qs.t: Open -> scroll -> upload -> Upload Complete -> purana delete; Edit Issue nahi.

qs.q: You enabled timestamps and Preserve Log, but the TTL says the 'Navigated' string is missing from your console log. What went wrong?
qs.s: Sabse likely: console open karne ke baad testing website ka homepage refresh karna bhool gaye. Dobara karo aur homepage refresh karo. Saath me, agar issue reproduce karte waqt naye tab pe redirect hote ho, to browser console settings me Auto-open DevTools for popups enable karo (Chrome aur new MS Edge ke liye). Phir dono console logs combine karke issue report me upload karo.
qs.b: You most likely did not refresh the testing website's homepage after opening the console, so retry and refresh. If reproducing the issue opens a new tab, also enable Auto-open DevTools for popups in the console settings (Chrome and new Edge), then combine both console logs and upload them.
qs.t: Console kholo, phir refresh - tabhi 'Navigated' aayega; popup ho to Auto-open DevTools.

qs.q: What are field validation issues and usability issues, which are out of scope in the Computer Testing cycle?
qs.s: Field validation issue: jab aap fields me aisi values daalte ho jo rules ke hisaab se invalid hain aur field unhe accept kar leta hai. Example: registration me name ya surname field numeric values accept kare. Usability issue: system ka koi aspect ya user pe koi demand jo typical usage me user ke goals achieve karna unpleasant ya inefficient bana de. Ye basically site ko improve karne ya use easier banane ke suggestions hote hain.
qs.b: A field validation issue is when a field accepts input that its rules should reject, for example a name or surname field accepting numbers at registration. A usability issue is something that makes reaching the user's goals unpleasant or inefficient in typical use; these are essentially suggestions to improve the site or make it easier to use.
qs.t: Validation = galat input accept; usability = suggestion.

qs.q: Can you test the mobile version of the testing website on a computer during the Computer Testing cycle?
qs.s: Nahi, mobile version test nahi kar sakte. Issues desktop view aur full screen me report karo.
qs.b: No. In the Computer Testing cycle you report issues in the desktop view on full screen, not the mobile version.
qs.t: Computer cycle = desktop view, full screen.

qs.q: Your issue was approved but you forgot to submit the test case. Did you pass, and what should you do?
qs.s: Nahi, approved test case nahi hai to cycle pass nahi hua. Cycle lock hone ke baad test case submit nahi kar sakte, jab tak test case pe more info request na hua ho. Isliye same cycle ke liye dobara sign up karo. Next time instructions, chat room aur announcements dhyan se follow karo; cycle chat me apna experience share karna dusre testers ki bhi help karta hai.
qs.b: No, without an approved test case you have not passed. A test case cannot be submitted after the cycle is locked unless it was requested for more info, so you sign up for the same cycle again and follow the instructions, chat and announcements closely next time.
qs.t: Issue + test case dono; lock ke baad test case nahi (sirf more info pe).

qs.q: You have two approved issues and one rejected issue in the Computer Testing cycle. Can you submit another?
qs.s: Haan, ek aur issue report kar sakte ho. Kul 3 approved issues ho sakte hain.
qs.b: Yes, you can report one more issue, because you can have up to three approved issues in total.
qs.t: Rejected count nahi hota; 3 approved tak.

qs.q: Do you need to list the login or registration steps in the Action Performed field every time?
qs.s: Nahi, poora sign-in process likhne ki zaroorat nahi. Actions performed me precondition daal do ki user already logged in hai. Example: Precondition: User should be logged in and there should be some products in the cart. 1) Go to https://www.academybugs.com 2) Click on Cart icon.
qs.b: No. You can add a precondition in Actions Performed stating the user is already logged in, for example 'User should be logged in and there should be some products in the cart', and then list only the remaining steps.
qs.t: Login steps ki jagah ek Precondition line.

qs.q: You claimed a slot with the wrong device. What should you do?
qs.s: Agar cycle abhi active hai: test case open karo aur Unclaim button click karke galat test case unclaim karo, phir sahi device ke saath naya slot claim karo. Agar cycle locked hai: device change nahi kar sakte; TTL ke request ka wait karo.
qs.b: If the cycle is still active, open the test case, click Unclaim and claim a new slot with the correct device. If the cycle is locked you cannot change the device and should wait for the TTL's request.
qs.t: Active = Unclaim + reclaim; locked = TTL ka wait.

qs.q: What do you need before joining the Mobile Device Testing cycle, and what new skills does it make you practise?
qs.s: Requirements: 1) Computer Testing cycle pass kiya ho. 2) Mobile device ho. 3) Mobile pe screen recordings bana sako. 4) Mobile device logs aur mobile browser console logs collect kar sako (mobile device logs collect karne ke liye computer chahiye). New things: 1) Live cycles me mobile devices se testing. 2) Mobile pe screen recordings. 3) Mobile device console logs aur mobile browser console logs collect karna.
qs.b: You must have passed Computer Testing, own a mobile device, and be able to record the screen and collect both mobile device logs and mobile browser console logs; a computer is needed for the device logs. The cycle lets you practise live testing on mobile, mobile screen recordings and collecting both kinds of mobile logs.
qs.t: Computer pass + phone + recording + device log + browser log (device log ke liye computer).

qs.q: What are the rules and passing criteria of the Mobile Device Testing cycle?
qs.s: Cycle info: 1) Testing sirf mobile device pe (Android ya iOS). 2) Invalid reports reject. 3) Maximum three issues. 4) Dusre testers ke issues hidden. Passing: kam se kam ek approved issue report aur ek approved test case. What to do next aur grading rules Computer Testing jaise hi hain (12 se 24 hours me Pass, close pe Pass/Fail).
qs.b: Mobile Device Testing is done only on Android or iOS devices, invalid reports are rejected, the limit is three issues and other testers' issues are hidden. To pass you need at least one approved issue report and one approved test case, with the same next steps and grading rules as Computer Testing.
qs.t: Android/iOS only, 3 max, pass = 1 + 1.

qs.q: Which course areas does the Mobile Device Testing quiz draw from?
qs.s: Sign up se pehle 20 questions sahi karne hain. Area wise: Issues and reporting (6) - What is an Issue, What is a Valid Issue (Bug), Bug Rejections, Severity vs Value, How to write an Issue Report 2 baar. Testing and cycles (6) - Testing Types, Mobile App, Best Practices (Testing), Test Cycle Terms, Test Cycle Process, Test Case. Tester basics and policies (5) - Tester Selection, Tester Payments, Tester Ratings, GDPR, Terms of Use. Logs (3) - Android Device Logs, Browser Logs (Mobile), Browser Logs (Desktop).
qs.b: The Mobile Device Testing quiz needs 20 correct answers. It covers issues and reporting (valid issues, rejections, severity vs value, writing reports), testing and cycle topics (testing types, mobile app, test cycle terms and process, test cases), tester basics and policies (selection, payments, ratings, GDPR, Terms of Use) and logs (Android device logs plus mobile and desktop browser logs).
qs.t: Mobile quiz 20 = Issues 6 + Cycles 6 + Tester/policy 5 + Logs 3.

qs.q: The app under test is not available in your country. What should you do?
qs.s: Agar overview me website ka mention hai to website test karo. Warna sirf app hi in scope hai: chat me likho ki app available nahi hai, aur aapko kisi dusre cycle me invite kiya ja sakta hai.
qs.b: If the overview mentions the website, test the website. Otherwise only the app is in scope, so post in the chat that the app is not available; you may be invited to another cycle.
qs.t: Website in scope? test karo; warna chat me batao.

qs.q: You completed your test case but it has not been reviewed yet. Why?
qs.s: Test cases cycle lock hone ke baad check aur approve kiye jaate hain.
qs.b: Test cases are checked and approved after the cycle is locked, so a pending review before that is normal.
qs.t: Test case review = lock ke baad.

qs.q: Which courses should you review if you have trouble collecting Android or iOS device logs?
qs.s: Android logs ADB se collect karne me problem ho to Android Device Logs course review karo. iOS logs ke liye iOS Device Logs course review karo.
qs.b: For Android log problems with ADB, review the Android Device Logs course; for iOS logs, review the iOS Device Logs course.
qs.t: Android = Android Device Logs; iOS = iOS Device Logs.

qs.q: Your video is too large to upload, or you need help with screenshots and markup. What do the FAQs say?
qs.s: Video bahut bada ho to compress karo, jaise HandBrake se. Screenshot aur markup ke liye Basics of Screenshots course review karo.
qs.b: Compress a large video, for example with HandBrake, and review the Basics of Screenshots course for screenshot and markup questions.
qs.t: Bada video = HandBrake; screenshot = Basics of Screenshots.

qs.q: Can you use a VPN while testing in the Mobile Device Testing cycle?
qs.s: Nahi, VPN allowed nahi hai. Ye Terms of Use ke against hai.
qs.b: No. Using a VPN while testing is not allowed because it is against the Terms of Use.
qs.t: VPN = Terms of Use violation.

qs.q: ADB shows 'waiting for device'. How do you fix it?
qs.s: Computer pe USB drivers aur device ka driver install karo. Phir bhi fail ho to dusra USB cable try karo.
qs.b: Install the USB drivers and the device driver on the computer, and if it still fails, try another USB cable.
qs.t: Waiting for device = driver, phir cable.

qs.q: Your Android log file is too large. What should you do?
qs.s: Dusre apps/pages close karo, aur app open karne se pehle adb logcat -c se log clear karo, phir issue reproduce karo.
qs.b: Close other apps and pages, clear the log with adb logcat -c before opening the app, then reproduce the issue so the log stays small.
qs.t: logcat -c = clear, phir reproduce.

qs.q: What does the Charles Proxy Testing course page show, and how many quiz answers do you need?
qs.s: Notes me Charles Proxy Testing page pe Quiz Completed dikh raha tha aur practice cycle locked tha. Page pe FAQs (6) aur Reference Links quiz map diya hai. Sign up se pehle 25 questions sahi karne hain. Is cycle ki requirements, practise items aur passing criteria notes me nahi likhe. Academy Challenge ke liye Charles Proxy cycle pass hona zaroori hai.
qs.b: The Charles Proxy Testing page in the notes shows the quiz as completed and the practice cycle as locked, with six FAQs and a quiz reference map. You must answer 25 quiz questions correctly before signing up, and passing this cycle is the requirement for the Academy Challenge.
qs.t: Charles = 25 sahi, aur Challenge ka darwaza.

qs.q: Which course areas does the Charles Proxy Testing quiz draw from?
qs.s: 25 questions. Area wise: Cycle, communication and platform rules (10) - Test Cycle Information, Communication 2 baar, Tester Selection 2 baar, Terms of Use, What is a slot, Tester Ratings, Tester Payments, Practice Test Cycles. Web debugging proxy and Charles (8) - What is a Web Debugging Proxy 3 baar, Charles Proxy for Desktop 2 baar, Charles Proxy for Mobile, Charles Proxy Testing, FAQ and Troubleshooting (Web Debugging Proxy). Issues and reporting (7) - How to edit an Issue Report, Bug Rejections 2 baar, Best Practices (Testing), What is an Issue, How to write an Issue Report 2 baar.
qs.b: The Charles Proxy quiz needs 25 correct answers. It draws from cycle, communication and platform rules (cycle information, communication, tester selection, Terms of Use, slots, ratings, payments, practice cycles), from web debugging proxy and Charles courses for desktop and mobile including troubleshooting, and from issue topics such as editing and writing reports and bug rejections.
qs.t: Charles quiz 25 = Platform 10 + Proxy 8 + Issues 7.

qs.q: You cannot collect a Charles log from your mobile device. What should you do?
qs.s: Charles Proxy for Desktop, Charles Proxy for Mobile aur Web Debugging FAQ courses dobara check karo. Phir bhi stuck ho to cycle chat me poochho.
qs.b: Re-check the Charles Proxy for Desktop, Charles Proxy for Mobile and Web Debugging FAQ courses, and if still stuck, ask in the cycle chat.
qs.t: Teen courses, phir chat.

qs.q: What Host and Port values go in the Charles SSL proxying settings?
qs.s: Host = * (ya khali chhod do). Port = 443.
qs.b: In the SSL proxying settings, set Host to * or leave it empty, and set Port to 443.
qs.t: Star aur 443.

qs.q: How do you get a Charles log for Firefox, and what if you have no WiFi?
qs.s: Firefox aur Charles log ke liye Charles Proxy for Desktop course follow karo. WiFi nahi hai to is case me kam se kam 2 mobile phones chahiye jinme internet ho (ek external guide link diya gaya hai).
qs.b: For Firefox, follow the Charles Proxy for Desktop course. Without WiFi you need at least two mobile phones with internet, as described in the linked external guide.
qs.t: Firefox = Desktop course; no WiFi = 2 phones.

qs.q: How do you remove the Charles certificate from Android or iOS?
qs.s: Web Debugging FAQ course dekho.
qs.b: The Web Debugging FAQ course explains how to remove the Charles certificate from Android and iOS devices.
qs.t: Certificate hatana = Web Debugging FAQ.

qs.q: Your Charles log is too large. How do you capture a smaller one?
qs.s: Steps: 1) Charles open karo. 2) Broom icon click karke traffic clear karo. 3) Bug reproduce karo. 4) Stop Recording click karo. 5) Session save karo.
qs.b: Open Charles, click the Broom icon to clear traffic, reproduce the bug, click Stop Recording and save the session.
qs.t: Jhaadu, reproduce, stop, save.

qs.q: What is required to join the Academy Challenge, and what does it make you practise?
qs.s: Requirement: Charles Proxy cycle pass kiya ho. New things to practise: 1) Kisi bhi paid cycle jaisa live cycle me testing. 2) Scope ke hisaab se slot claim karna, test case execute aur complete karna. 3) Bina mistakes ke well-written issue reports submit karna. 4) Duplicates avoid karne ke liye dusre testers ke issues check karna. 5) Known issues list: overview padho aur agar list hai to testing se pehle check karo. 6) Dusron ke reported issues reproduce karna ya +1 karna.
qs.b: You must have passed the Charles Proxy cycle. The Challenge simulates a paid cycle: you claim a slot and execute and complete a test case by scope, submit mistake-free issue reports, check other testers' issues and any known issues list to avoid duplicates, and reproduce or +1 issues reported by others.
qs.t: Challenge = paid cycle ki rehearsal; slot, clean report, duplicate check, +1.

qs.q: What are the Academy Challenge cycle rules and passing criteria?
qs.s: Cycle info: 1) Mistakes wale issue reports reject. 2) Invalid reports, duplicates samet, reject. 3) Minor visual aur content issues jo end user ko block nahi karte, reject. 4) Kitne bhi issue reports allowed. 5) Academy Challenge cycle me 10 baar participate kar sakte ho. Passing: kam se kam ek approved issue report aur ek approved test case.
qs.b: In the Academy Challenge, reports with mistakes, invalid reports including duplicates, and minor visual or content issues that do not block the end user are rejected. There is no limit on the number of reports and you can take part up to 10 times. To pass you need at least one approved issue report and one approved test case.
qs.t: Mistake/duplicate/minor visual = reject; unlimited reports; 10 attempts.

qs.q: Why would you take part in the Academy Challenge more than once, and what is the Academy All Stars cycle?
qs.s: What to do next: FAQ aur previous courses padho, quiz complete karo (Reference Links), blue Sign Up button se sign up karo, overview padho, invitation accept karo, instructions follow karo. Up to 10 baar participate kar sakte ho skills aur tester rating improve karne ke liye. Is cycle aur preceding cycles me performance ke basis pe Academy team Academy All Stars cycle ke liye testers select karti hai, jo next week invite hote hain. 10 baar tak practise karne se chance badhta hai.
qs.b: You can join the Challenge up to 10 times to build skills and improve your tester rating. Based on performance in it and the earlier cycles, the Academy team selects testers for the Academy All Stars cycle and invites them the following week, so practising more raises your chances.
qs.t: 10 baar khelo, rating badhao, All Stars ka invite pao.

qs.q: Which course areas does the Academy Challenge quiz draw from?
qs.s: 30 questions sahi karne hain. Area wise: Issues and reporting (9) - How to edit an Issue Report 2 baar, Bug Rejections 2 baar, Reporting, What is an Issue?, How to write an Issue Report, Best Practices (Issue Reports), FAQ (Academy Challenge). Platform and tester basics (9) - Welcome, Tester Ratings, Tester Selection, Accepting an Invitation, Communication, Community, Helpful Acronyms and Definitions, Practice Test Cycles, Slots. Evidence and tools (7) - Basics of Screenshots, Basics of Screen Recordings 2 baar, Basics of Logs, Android Device Logs, Charles Proxy for Desktop, Web Debugging Proxy. Best practices for testing and test cases (5) - Best Practices (Test Cases) 3 baar, Best Practices (Testing) 2 baar.
qs.b: The Academy Challenge quiz needs 30 correct answers and spans almost the whole Academy: issue reporting, editing and rejections, platform basics such as ratings, selection, invitations, communication, community, acronyms and slots, evidence tools like screenshots, recordings, logs and Charles, and best practices for testing and test cases.
qs.t: Challenge quiz 30 = Issues 9 + Platform 9 + Tools 7 + Best practices 5.

qs.q: In the Academy Challenge, what do you do when you find an issue while completing a test case step?
qs.s: Fail click karo, phir Fail & Report, saare fields bharo aur submit karo.
qs.b: Click Fail on the step, then Fail & Report, fill in all the fields and submit the issue.
qs.t: Fail -> Fail & Report -> fields -> submit.

qs.q: What if the issue you hit in a test case step was already reported by another tester?
qs.s: Step fail karo, comment field me original issue id mention karo, aur already reported issue pe +1 karo.
qs.b: Fail the step, mention the original issue ID in the comment field and add a +1 to the already reported issue.
qs.t: Fail + original id + plus one.

qs.q: What if you find no issue while completing the test case?
qs.s: Test case submit karo aur website pe exploratory testing shuru karo.
qs.b: Submit the test case and start exploratory testing on the website.
qs.t: Kuch nahi mila? submit karo, explore karo.

qs.q: Can you report issues on footer links, career pages or about pages in the Academy Challenge?
qs.s: Haan, jab tak page URL ka domain scope me hai. Report karte waqt confirm karo ki site scope me hai.
qs.b: Yes, as long as the page's URL domain is in scope; confirm the site is in scope when reporting.
qs.t: Domain in scope = page allowed.

qs.q: After a TTL announcement you cannot access the Test Cases or Issues tab. What should you do?
qs.s: Blue acknowledge button se announcement acknowledge karo.
qs.b: Acknowledge the announcement with the blue acknowledge button to regain access.
qs.t: Announcement acknowledge karo, tab khul jayenge.

qs.q: You hit the bug limit in the Academy Challenge. What does that mean?
qs.s: Rated ya unrated, sab testers ke paas ek time pe sirf 5 new issues ho sakte hain. Previous issues review hone tak wait karo.
qs.b: Both rated and unrated testers can have only up to 5 new issues at a time, so wait until your previous issues are reviewed.
qs.t: 5 new at a time; review ka wait.

qs.q: How many issues should you report in the Academy Challenge, and how many do you need to pass?
qs.s: Koi limit nahi. Jo bhi issue mile report karo, lekin duplicates, WAD ya out of scope nahi. Mistakes wale issues reject hote hain. High-quality, valuable issues pe focus karo. (Passing ke liye cycle info: kam se kam ek approved issue report aur ek approved test case.)
qs.b: There is no limit; report any valid issue you find, but not duplicates, WAD or out-of-scope items, since reports with mistakes are rejected. Aim for high-quality, valuable issues; passing still needs at least one approved issue and one approved test case.
qs.t: Quantity nahi, quality; duplicate/WAD/out of scope mat bhejo.

quiz.q: Which phase of STLC comes right after Test Planning?
quiz.w: Order: Requirement Analysis, Test Planning, Test Case Development, Environment Setup, Execution, Closure.

quiz.q: A developer's human mistake is called:
quiz.w: Error = insaan ki galti. Uski wajah se code me Defect, aur chalne pe Failure.

quiz.q: 'Are we building the right product?' describes:
quiz.w: Validation = right product (chala ke). Verification = product right (bina chalaye).

quiz.q: A typo in the company name on the homepage is usually:
quiz.w: Impact chhota (low severity) par brand ke liye turant fix (high priority).

quiz.q: Checking that a fixed bug is actually fixed is called:
quiz.w: Retesting = wahi bug dobara. Regression = baaki features toote to nahi.

quiz.q: For an age field that accepts 18 to 60, which set is boundary value analysis?
quiz.w: Har boundary ke neeche, upar aur ON value test karo.

quiz.q: 'Running the same tests again and again stops finding new bugs' is which principle?
quiz.w: Pesticide paradox: tests ko update karte raho.

quiz.q: Most defects found in a few modules is called:
quiz.w: Defect clustering: 80% bugs aksar 20% modules me.

quiz.q: A quick, broad check that a new build is stable enough to test is:
quiz.w: Smoke = broad aur shallow. Sanity = narrow aur deep.

quiz.q: Testing done by the customer to confirm business needs are met is:
quiz.w: UAT = User Acceptance Testing, customer karta hai.

quiz.q: Which is a non-functional test?
quiz.w: Speed = performance = non-functional.

quiz.q: Testing without seeing the code, using only inputs and outputs, is:
quiz.w: Black box: code nahi dikhta. Crowdtesters yahi karte hain.

quiz.q: A document that maps requirements to test cases is:
quiz.w: Requirement Traceability Matrix.

quiz.q: Simultaneous learning, test design and execution with a charter is:
quiz.w: Exploratory me goal, time-box aur notes hote hain. Ad hoc me nahi.

quiz.q: Reviewing a requirements document without running the app is:
quiz.w: Static = bina chalaye.

quiz.q: Which bug life cycle status means the fix did not work?
quiz.w: Retest fail = Reopened.

quiz.q: Who usually sets severity?
quiz.w: Severity tester (technical impact), priority business/manager.

quiz.q: Pushing a system beyond its normal load to find the breaking point is:
quiz.w: Stress = limit se zyada.

quiz.q: Testing an item with one value from each group of similar inputs is:
quiz.w: Har partition se ek value.

quiz.q: An account locking after 3 wrong PINs is best tested with:
quiz.w: State badalti hai (active → locked).

quiz.q: A bug that escapes testing and is found by customers is:
quiz.w: Leakage = deewar ke bahar nikal gaya.

quiz.q: Which statement is a testing principle?
quiz.w: Testing absence prove nahi karti, aur sab test karna possible nahi.

quiz.q: Who is the testers' main point of contact in a the platform cycle and triages bug reports?
quiz.w: TTL triage karta hai aur testers ki help. TE cycle banata hai.

quiz.q: Who builds the test cycle and assembles the team?
quiz.w: Test Engineer.

quiz.q: Who makes the final approve or reject decision on a bug?
quiz.w: TTL recommend karta hai, customer final decide.

quiz.q: What should you check before reporting to avoid duplicates?
o: The cycle bug list and known issues
quiz.w: Bug list + known issues dono.

quiz.q: A bug rejected as WAD means:
quiz.w: Ye intended behaviour hai, bug nahi.

quiz.q: Which is NOT a the platform bug value level?
quiz.w: Value levels: Somewhat, Very, Exceptionally Valuable.

quiz.q: You get an Info Request on your bug. Best action?
o: Reply quickly with exactly what was asked
quiz.w: IR ka jawab nahi diya to reject ho sakta hai.

quiz.q: You found a real bug in a feature listed as out of scope. What do you do?
quiz.w: Out-of-scope bug reject hota hai. Shak ho to TTL se poochho.

quiz.q: Which order of the platform tester rating levels is correct?
o: Unrated, Rated, Proven, Bronze, Silver, Gold
quiz.w: Unrated se shuru, Gold sabse upar.

quiz.q: While executing a test case, a step fails. You should:
o: Change the steps so it passes
Mark it failed and link a bug report
quiz.w: Har failed step ke saath bug linked hona chahiye.

quiz.q: Academy practice cycles are:
quiz.w: Practice cycles unpaid hote hain.

quiz.q: Which helps you get more paid invitations?
quiz.w: Sahi profile + quality = zyada invites.

quiz.q: Bug fix verification means:
o: Retesting a fixed bug and reporting if it is fixed
quiz.w: BFV = retesting.

quiz.q: What is the first thing to read after accepting a cycle?
quiz.w: Overview: scope, known issues, environment, payout, timeline.

quiz.q: Which is the best bug title?
o: Login: blank screen after tapping Sign In with valid credentials on Android 16
quiz.w: Where-What-When, aur jo ho raha hai wo.

quiz.q: The last step in Action Performed should be:
o: The action that triggers the bug
quiz.w: Last step = trigger.

quiz.q: Actual result should be:
o: An exact description of what happened, including error text
quiz.w: Actual specific ho, sirf ulta ya title copy nahi.

quiz.q: When is a video most needed?
o: A bug that needs several steps to appear
quiz.w: Steps se aane wala bug = video. Static issue = screenshot.

quiz.q: An app crashes when you tap Checkout. Severity is most likely:
quiz.w: Crash + core flow block = Critical.

quiz.q: Text overlapping a button is which bug type?
quiz.w: Shakal ki problem = visual.

quiz.q: A spelling mistake in a heading is which bug type?
quiz.w: Shabd galat = content.

quiz.q: A Save button that does nothing when clicked is:
quiz.w: Kaam nahi karta = functional.

quiz.q: A bug appears 3 out of 5 tries. On the platform, frequency is best set to:
quiz.w: Options: Every time, Occasionally, Hardly ever, Once. Ratio bhi likho 3/5.

quiz.q: You found two different issues on one page. You should:
o: Report only the bigger one forever
Ask other testers to report one
quiz.w: Ek report, ek bug.

quiz.q: Submitting an incomplete report early to claim a bug is called:
quiz.w: Placeholder allowed nahi, reject hota hai.

quiz.q: How should you decide severity quickly?
o: By how much you like the app
quiz.w: Workaround nahi + zyada users = upar.

quiz.q: A screenshot attached to a bug should:
o: Show the whole desktop with personal tabs
quiz.w: Bug mark karo, personal cheez nahi.

quiz.q: Which is a mobile-specific test?
quiz.w: Interruptions mobile ka khaas hissa.

quiz.q: Where should you start bug hunting for highest value?
o: Core flows in the test focus
quiz.w: Core flow ke bug = zyada value.

quiz.q: Which input is a negative test for an email field?
quiz.w: Galat format = negative test.

quiz.q: Clicking Submit twice quickly tests for:
quiz.w: Double submit se duplicate order/record ban sakta hai.

quiz.q: Functional testing is mainly:
quiz.w: Input-output, bina code.

quiz.q: The first 10 minutes of a cycle are best used for:
o: A smoke check of main flows
Checking the payment page out of scope
quiz.w: Build testable hai ya nahi, pehle ye.

quiz.q: Windows 11 shortcut for an area screenshot:
quiz.w: Snipping Tool khulta hai.

quiz.q: Android screenshot on most phones:
quiz.w: Power + Volume Down.

quiz.q: Which DevTools tab shows failed API requests with status codes?

quiz.q: A HAR file may contain:
quiz.w: Isliye sirf platform pe aur maangne pe share.

quiz.q: Command to capture Android logs:

quiz.q: How do you enable Developer options on Android?
o: Tap Build number 7 times in About phone
quiz.w: About phone → Build number 7 tap.

quiz.q: Why turn on 'Show taps' before recording?
o: So reviewers see where you tapped
quiz.w: Tap dikhenge to steps clear.

quiz.q: Where do you find the exact Chrome version?

quiz.q: You may share a cycle screenshot:

In a WhatsApp group of testers
quiz.w: Confidentiality: sab platform ke andar.

quiz.q: Which is PII?

quiz.q: A cycle needs payment testing. You should use:

quiz.w: Real card sirf likhit instruction pe.

quiz.q: You find a security hole that exposes other users' data. You:
o: Explore it further to see more data
Report it through the platform only

quiz.q: After the cycle ends, beta builds should be:
quiz.w: Cycle khatam = app aur files hatao.

quiz.q: An email that looks like the platform asks for your password via a link. You:

quiz.q: The D-E-M answer formula stands for:
quiz.w: Seedha jawab, chhota example, apna real kaam.

quiz.q: Best way to describe a bug you found in an interview:
o: Give big numbers you can't explain
Use STAR with a real example you can explain

quiz.q: Your bug was rejected and you think it is valid. You:
o: Reply politely with evidence and accept the final decision
quiz.w: Politely, evidence ke saath.

quiz.q: Which is a security test case for a login page?

quiz.w: Brute force se bachaav = security.

quiz.q: For an age field 18-60, which value is NOT a boundary test?
quiz.w: 35 beech ka (equivalence) hai, boundary nahi.

quiz.q: Forgot password with an unregistered email should:

quiz.w: Account hai ya nahi, ye nahi batana (security).

quiz.q: Double clicking 'Place order' should:
quiz.w: Duplicate order bug pakadne ka classic test.

quiz.q: When time is short, test first:
quiz.w: Risk based.

quiz.q: Testing every pair of parameter values at least once is:
quiz.w: Har jodi ek baar.

quiz.q: Predicting likely defects from experience is:
quiz.w: Experience ka andaza.

quiz.q: A valid date test you must include:
quiz.w: Leap year valid case. 31 April invalid case alag.

quiz.q: Which method sends only the fields to change?
quiz.w: PATCH partial, PUT poora.

quiz.q: Logged in but not allowed to access a resource:

quiz.q: A successful POST that created a record usually returns:

quiz.q: 5xx status codes mean:

quiz.q: Too many requests in a short time returns:

SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = NULL

quiz.w: Left poora.

quiz.q: How do you check for missing values?

quiz.q: Which removes the whole table including structure?
quiz.w: DROP = almaari gayab.

quiz.q: LIKE 'Ra%' matches:
quiz.w: % = baad me kuch bhi.

quiz.q: A primary key must be:

quiz.q: A column referencing another table's primary key is a:

quiz.q: UNION vs UNION ALL: which keeps duplicates?
quiz.w: ALL = sab rakho.

quiz.w: MongoDB document store.

quiz.q: Atomicity in ACID means:
quiz.w: Sab ya kuch nahi.

quiz.q: In pytest, shared fixtures usually live in:

quiz.q: Running one test with many data sets uses:

quiz.q: The test pyramid says you should have the MOST:

quiz.q: On production you should normally:

quiz.w: Accessibility guidelines.

quiz.q: Who owns and prioritises the product backlog?

quiz.q: 'Given, When, Then' is used in:

quiz.w: Retro.

quiz.q: Finding the underlying cause of a defect is:
quiz.w: Root Cause Analysis, 5 whys.

quiz.q: Testing earlier in the life cycle is called:
quiz.w: Left = shuru.

quiz.q: Story points estimate:

quiz.q: Kanban mainly uses:
o: A continuous flow board with WIP limits
quiz.w: Conveyor belt.

quiz.q: Which file prevents secrets like .env being committed?

quiz.q: Two people changed the same line differently. This is a:

quiz.q: CI means:

quiz.q: p95 response time of 800 ms means:

o: Check error events and session replays for that user
Ask the customer to stop using it
quiz.w: Data se pattern dhundho, jaise PostHog.

quiz.q: In an interview, claims about your work should be:
o: Only what you can explain and defend
quiz.w: Sirf defend karne layak.

quiz.q: Requirements are unclear. You:
o: Ask, confirm in writing, test the clear parts
quiz.w: Poochho, likhwao.

quiz.q: Asked why you're leaving, you should:
o: Talk about growth and the new role
quiz.w: Burai nahi, growth.

quiz.q: A good 'weakness' answer:
o: A real weakness plus what you do to improve it
quiz.w: Kamzori + sudhaar.

quiz.q: Which rejection type applies when the reported bug is already a Known Issue added to the cycle?
quiz.w: Notes me DUP ka matlab: dusre tester ne report kiya ho ya cycle me added Known Issue ho.

quiz.q: Who is the testers' primary point of contact and reviews all submitted bug reports and test cases?
quiz.w: TTL testers ka primary point of contact hai aur saare bug reports aur test cases review karta hai.

quiz.q: How many times can a tester complete the Academy Challenge level?
quiz.w: Baaki levels sirf ek baar, lekin Academy Challenge 10 baar tak.

quiz.q: Which bug approval type means the bug is valid and approved but the customer does not plan to fix it?
quiz.w: WNF = valid aur approved, par customer fix nahi karega; WAD to rejection hai.

quiz.q: In the Test Cycle Chat, which room should testers read but never post in?
quiz.w: Announcements room TTLs aur TEs ke liye hai; testers sirf padhte hain.

quiz.q: A tester signs up for an Academy practice cycle on a Friday. What happens?
o: They join this week's cycle immediately
They are added to a pending cycle activated next Monday
They must sign up again on Monday
They wait until the current cycle closes
quiz.w: Thursday-Sunday sign up = pending cycle, jo agle Monday activate hota hai.

quiz.q: What is needed to receive a Pass grade during an active Academy practice cycle?
o: Both an approved issue and an approved test case
quiz.w: Pass grade tabhi jab approved issue aur approved test case dono hon, 12-24 ghante me assign.

quiz.q: In a Locked test cycle, what can a tester still do?
o: Edit their bug reports and test cases and use chat
quiz.w: Locked me naye bugs/test cases nahi, par apne reports edit aur chat kar sakte ho.

quiz.q: Which rejection does NOT negatively impact a tester's rating?
quiz.w: Notes: WAD rejections tester rating ko negatively impact nahi karte.

quiz.q: What premium does a Silver tester receive on approved reports?
quiz.w: Gold 10%, Silver 5%, Bronze 2.5%.

quiz.q: On which dates are the platform testers paid?
o: 15th and the last day of the month
Last day of the month only
quiz.w: Mahine me do baar: 15th aur last day; weekend/US holiday pe next business day.

quiz.q: What extra payout does a Favorite Tester get on that company's future issues?
quiz.w: Favorite tester ko us company ke future issues pe 5% payout uplift milta hai.

quiz.q: Which five issue types does the platform use to categorize issues?
quiz.w: Notes me likha hai: Functional, Visual, Content, Performance, Crash - yahi 5 types.

quiz.q: An application freezes or becomes unresponsive for more than how long to count as a Performance issue example?
quiz.w: Performance example: freezes or becomes unresponsive for more than 10 seconds; 60 seconds wala Bug Hunt example hai.

quiz.q: What effect does a rejection as Working as Designed (WAD) have on your rating?
o: It has no effect on the rating
It blocks you from the next cycle
quiz.w: Notes: rejections due to WAD do not have any effect on your ratings.

quiz.q: During test case execution, a step fails and the bug is new. What should you do next?
o: Stop the test case and submit it immediately
Report the bug, then continue the subsequent steps
Mark the step as Blocked and skip the rest
Mark it PASS and add a comment
quiz.w: FAIL pe: duplicate/known check, report karo, phir aage ke steps continue; dependent aur workaround na ho tab TTL/TE se guidance.

quiz.q: In which test cycle status can a tester claim a slot but not yet test the product?
quiz.w: Pending Activation me overview padh sakte ho aur slot claim kar sakte ho, par test/report nahi.

quiz.q: Within how many days after a cycle locks are submissions reviewed?
quiz.w: Notes: reviewed within 15 days after the test cycle has locked.

quiz.q: Which role builds the test cycle and assembles the testing team?
quiz.w: TE builds the test cycle, assembles the team, overall execution ka responsible; TTL primary contact aur reviewer hai.

quiz.q: Your issue was rejected and you think it is valid. What should you do?
o: Discuss it in the cycle chat
Ask the customer in the Messages tab to approve it
quiz.w: Rejection pe explanation ya disagreement ke liye Dispute Rejection; chat, email ya Messages tab se dispute mana hai.

quiz.q: In the slots table, how can you identify an Exploratory slot?
o: The Test Case column shows 'Exploratory' and the Payout column shows 'Per Bug'
The Deadline column is empty and the Effort column shows 0
The slot row is highlighted in blue
The Payout column shows a fixed amount and the Test Case column shows 1
quiz.w: Notes ke hisaab se Exploratory slot me Test Case column me 'Exploratory' (ya '0 Exploratory') aur Payout me 'Per Bug' dikhta hai.

quiz.q: A claimed BFV test case is automatically unclaimed if it is not submitted within how long?
quiz.w: BFV test cases 2 hours me submit nahi hue to auto unclaim ho jaate hain.

quiz.q: Which test case result means the test case was submitted and all steps were marked Done?
quiz.w: Completed tab hota hai jab saare steps Done hon, yaani kisi step me expected results nahi the.

quiz.q: Which TestRail status is used when a test cannot be executed due to external reasons such as a broken feature?
quiz.w: Blocked = external reason (jaise broken feature) ki wajah se test run nahi ho sakta.

quiz.q: Which rejection reason does NOT affect the tester rating?
quiz.w: WAD ke alawa har rejection rating ko negatively affect karta hai; DNFI ka to double negative impact hai.

quiz.q: According to the notes, bug payout rates depend on which factor?
o: The severity selected by the tester
The value of the bug as determined by the customer
quiz.w: Payout value pe depend karta hai, severity pe nahi, aur value customer decide karta hai.

quiz.q: What does the Issue Quality Review feature do when a report has only a few mistakes?
o: Sends an info request to the tester
Automatically corrects the mistakes, keeps the status New, and does not notify the tester
quiz.w: Few mistakes = auto adjust, status New, koi notification nahi; multiple mistakes pe info request aata hai.

quiz.q: How many unapproved issues per test cycle can Unrated and Rated testers have at the start?
quiz.w: Unrated aur Rated testers 5 unapproved issues per cycle se shuru karte hain; higher rating pe ye limit hat jati hai.

quiz.q: In which year did the platform release its official mobile app?
quiz.w: Notes: 'In 2020 the platform released its official mobile app for Android and iOS devices.'

quiz.q: When executing a test case in the platform app, when is a comment mandatory?
o: When a step is marked Done
quiz.w: Pass pe comment optional hai, Fail pe mandatory.

quiz.q: What are the two default rooms in a cycle chat in the platform app?
quiz.w: Cycle chat ke do default rooms Announcements aur Questions hain.

quiz.q: How many bugs are planted in the practice bug site Find Bugs practice site?
quiz.w: Find Bugs site me 25 bugs planted hain; target kam se kam 20 dhoondna hai.

quiz.q: How many tabs does the Report Bugs page on the practice bug site contain?
quiz.w: Report Bugs page me 5 tabs hain, har tab me ek bug report banane ki practice.

quiz.q: According to the glossary, what does WNF (Won't Fix) mean?
o: The issue is valid and approved but the customer is not planning to fix it
The issue is expected behavior of the product design
The tester did not follow the cycle instructions
The issue falls into the Out of Scope section
quiz.w: Notes: WNF = issue valid aur approved, lekin customer interested nahi ya fix ka plan nahi; design wala WAD hai.

quiz.q: If the TTL does not answer within the stated time frame, who should the tester contact next?
quiz.w: Escalation path TTL -> TE -> TSM -> Tester Support hai; TE ka email Team Contact Information me hota hai.

quiz.q: If issues are still not approved or rejected after the cycle locks, what happens?
o: They stay pending until the tester disputes them
They are all rejected after 7 days
Within up to 15 days the cycle closes automatically and they are approved or rejected based on the TTL recommendation
They are all automatically approved after 30 days
quiz.w: Notes: lock ke baad 15 din tak wait; cycle auto close hoke TTL recommendation par approve/reject karta hai.

quiz.q: In Academy cycles, which attachment formats are required?
o: Any format as long as it opens
quiz.w: Lesson 5: Academy me screenshot jpg/png, screen recording mp4, console/device logs txt; log aur m4v galat format ke examples hain.

quiz.q: What is the maximum number of screenshots you should upload in a single bug report?
quiz.w: Notes kehte hain: Do not upload more than two screenshots in a bug report.

quiz.q: Which formats are allowed for screenshots?
quiz.w: Rule hai: screenshots hamesha .jpg ya .png format me save karo.

quiz.q: In the Windows + Shift + S snipping bar, which option captures the whole screen?
quiz.w: Fullscreen Snip 4th icon hai; Window Snip (3rd) taskbar exclude karta hai.

quiz.q: Which highlighting approach violates the screenshot rules?
o: Freehand mouse drawing around the bug
Red arrow pointing at the bug
quiz.w: Hand drawing tool use karna mana hai; proper shape jaise rectangle/circle chahiye.

quiz.q: In which format must all screen recordings be saved and uploaded?
quiz.w: Rule: Only mp4 format, koi aur format upload nahi karna.

quiz.q: Below what size does the HandBrake lesson say there is no need to compress a video (unless cycle restrictions block upload)?
quiz.w: Notes: video already small (less than 5 MB) ho to compress ki zaroorat nahi.

quiz.q: Where does the Xbox Game Bar save screen recordings by default?
quiz.w: Recording automatic Videos > Captures folder me save hoti hai.

quiz.q: Which action violates the platform Terms of Use when recording?
o: Selecting upload to ScreenPal to save the video
quiz.w: Cloud me upload/store karna Terms of Use violation hai, isliye upload to ScreenPal mat chuno.

quiz.q: In which file format should browser console logs be saved?
quiz.w: Rule: logs hamesha .txt format me save karo (HAR alag hai, woh .har).

quiz.q: Who can ask you to upload a HAR log in a cycle?
o: The TTL, TE or TSM of the cycle
quiz.w: Notes: Only upload this log if you have been asked by the TTL, TE or TSM of the cycle.

quiz.q: Which browser's console logs do not contain timestamps?
quiz.w: Note: Logs generated by Safari do not contain timestamps in them.

quiz.q: Which command starts the adb server on macOS or Linux from the platform-tools folder?
quiz.w: Windows par adb start-server, macOS/Linux par ./adb start-server.

quiz.q: Which tool must NOT be used to collect Android device logs?
quiz.w: Notes: Always use adb or Android Studio, never use any app like Syslog or CatLog.

quiz.q: Which command clears the Android device log stored so far?
quiz.w: adb logcat -c purane stored logs clear karta hai.

quiz.q: Wireless debugging for Android log collection is supported on which versions?
quiz.w: Dono wireless methods 'Only Android 11 and above' likhe hain.

quiz.q: Which file type is uploaded when collecting an iOS crash log directly from the iPhone's Analytics Data?
quiz.w: Method 1 ke last step me .ips log upload karna hai.

quiz.q: What is the correct file format for a Fiddler log?
quiz.w: Charles = .chls/.chlz, Fiddler = .saz.

quiz.q: Which proxy port is used when connecting a mobile device to Charles Proxy?
quiz.w: Charles HTTP Proxy port 8888 hai; 8866 Fiddler ka hai, 443 SSL host setting me.

quiz.q: If the same host is added to both Include and Exclude in Charles Recording Settings, what happens?
o: Exclude overrides Include and the host's traffic is excluded
quiz.w: Notes: Exclude will override the Include aur us host ka saara traffic exclude hota hai.

quiz.q: In a Charles log, which icon indicates data that has NOT been decrypted?
quiz.w: Lock icon = undecrypted, unreadable data; blue circle aur lightning decrypted traffic dikhate hain.

quiz.q: Which LibreOffice option creates a reviewable PDF copy where the PII can still be seen and the file stays editable?
quiz.w: Export Preview PDF sirf check ke liye hai; final karna White ya Black export se hota hai.

quiz.q: Which tool and feature is used to blur PII in a video with VSDC Video Editor?
quiz.w: VSDC me Video effects > Filters > DeLogo use hota hai; Overlay > Blur ScreenPal ka hai.

quiz.q: For single-character fields, how should redaction boxes be applied?
o: One box across the entire series of values
One box per field, without crossing the whole series
quiz.w: Notes kehte hain redaction box per field ho, poori series ke across nahi.

quiz.q: Which privacy law is listed for Canada in the notes?
quiz.w: Canada = PIPEDA; LGPD Brasil, CCPA US, CDR Australia.

quiz.q: Using Boundary Value Analysis for a valid range of 1 to 100, which inputs cover the lower boundary?
quiz.w: Lower boundary = just below, at, just above minimum: 0, 1, 2.

quiz.q: Which testing type is done after smoke testing to verify that specific new features or bug fixes were applied correctly?
quiz.w: Sanity smoke ke baad hota hai aur recent changes pe targeted hota hai.

quiz.q: In test case testing, a step fails and the bug is already reported. What should you do?
o: Add a +1 to the existing report and paste its Issue ID in the failed step's comment box
quiz.w: Duplicate ho to +1 karo aur Issue ID failed step ke comment me daalo.

quiz.q: In the ATM state transition example, after how many consecutive failed PIN attempts is the card blocked?
quiz.w: Do failed attempts allowed; teesre consecutive fail pe Blocked State.

quiz.q: A tester signs up for an Academy practice cycle on a Friday. What happens?
o: Added to the current cycle immediately
Added to a pending cycle that activates the next Monday
Must wait for an invitation from the Academy team
Sign up is not allowed on Fridays
quiz.w: Thursday se Sunday sign up = pending cycle, agle Monday activate.

quiz.q: What is required to pass the Introduction to Testing cycle?
o: One approved issue report and one approved test case
quiz.w: Pass ke liye ek approved issue report aur ek approved test case.

quiz.q: Your issue report status is Info Requested and you have fixed the mistakes. What changes it back to New?
o: Clicking the Confirm all request is added link
quiz.w: Confirm all request is added link click karne se status Info Requested se New hota hai.

quiz.q: A filter on a category page does not work. What is the correct area in the bug title?
quiz.w: Area = page jahan bug hua (PLP); Filter function ka naam hai.

quiz.q: What does L10N stand for?
quiz.w: L10N = Localization, L aur N ke beech 10 letters.

quiz.q: What does T9N stand for?
quiz.w: T9N = Translation.

quiz.q: Which type focuses on designing a product so it is easy to localize?
quiz.w: I18N = internationalization, localize karna easy banana.

quiz.q: Which companies created the term Globalization (G11N) according to the notes?
quiz.w: Notes: Microsoft, IBM aur Sun Microsystems.

quiz.q: Globalization is often also known as which acronym?
quiz.w: NLS = National/Native Language Support.

quiz.q: According to the notes, what is one of the most common ways to know a product is ready to be localized?
quiz.w: Unicode use = localization-ready ka common sign.

quiz.q: Which languages do the notes list as written left to right?
quiz.w: LTR: German, English, French; RTL: Arabic.

quiz.q: What do internationalized products usually use for time?
quiz.w: Notes: internationalized products usually UTC use karte hain.

quiz.q: Which of these is listed under Culture in the key points?
quiz.w: Paper sizes Culture me hai (not very common bola gaya).

quiz.q: Which of these is listed under Writing conventions?
quiz.w: Writing conventions = date/time, time zones, number format.

quiz.q: Which government-assigned number is given as the Canadian example?
quiz.w: USA me SSN, Canada me SIN.

quiz.q: According to the notes, adding a new language to a product is usually what for testers?
quiz.w: Nayi language = bugs ki gold mine.

quiz.q: What is the commercial downside of localization mentioned in the notes?
quiz.w: Downfall = management ke budgetary commitments, focus English pe.

quiz.q: Showing $ instead of the euro symbol for prices in European countries is which L10N bug example?
quiz.w: Galat currency symbol = Wrong Currency Symbols.

quiz.q: Translating a brand name that should stay in the original language is called?
quiz.w: Brand name ya technical term translate = over-localization.

quiz.q: Text embedded directly in code instead of external resource files is which I18N bug?
quiz.w: Code me chipka text = Hard-coded Text.

quiz.q: Using the wrong character encoding results in what, per the notes?
quiz.w: Incorrect Encoding = garbled text.

quiz.q: Slow loading of localized content due to inefficient resource handling is which G11N bug?
quiz.w: Slow = Poor Performance.

quiz.q: Missing or incomplete translation files fall under which G11N bug?
quiz.w: Translation files ka poor management = Inadequate Resource Management.

quiz.q: According to the notes, how are G11N and I18N related?
o: G11N is a subset of L10N
I18N is a subset of G11N focused on technical preparation
quiz.w: G11N broader hai; I18N uska technical subset.

quiz.q: In the summary table, what does G11N require?
quiz.w: G11N = I18N + L10N.

quiz.q: Which example does the summary table give for T9N?
quiz.w: Welcome -> Bienvenue (French) = T9N.

quiz.q: Which example does the summary table give for I18N?
o: Using UTF-8 encoding and resource files for text
quiz.w: UTF-8 + resource files = I18N.

quiz.q: Which icon next to the test cycle ID denotes a localization cycle?
quiz.w: Lc icon = Localization cycle.

quiz.q: How many issue types do localization cycles have?
quiz.w: 6 issue types, har ek ka payout alag ho sakta hai.

quiz.q: Which of these is NOT one of the localization cycle issue types?
quiz.w: 6 types me Wrong Date Format nahi hai.

quiz.q: A disputed border on a map would be reported under which issue type?
quiz.w: Disputed borders map = Other/General example.

quiz.q: What opens when you click Accept on a localization cycle?
quiz.w: Accept = Specified Language popup, language select karo.

quiz.q: What happens if the cycle language is not in your tester profile?
o: You can join but not report
The TE adds it for you
quiz.w: Profile me language nahi = join nahi kar sakte.

quiz.q: Selecting Missing or Poor Translation adds which fields?
quiz.w: Translation types = Recommended String + Actual String.

quiz.q: When reporting, what should you do before filling any other fields?
quiz.w: Pehle Type classify karo, fields uske hisaab se badalte hain.

quiz.q: Who reviews bugs in a localization cycle?
quiz.w: LNE = Localization Expert review karta hai.

quiz.q: Which approval levels are mentioned for localization bugs?
quiz.w: Approve as Somewhat, Very ya Exceptional.

quiz.q: Which tool use is forbidden when providing localization bug information?
o: Google Translate or any translator app
quiz.w: No guessing, no translator app, Google Translate bhi nahi.

quiz.q: If your question might violate the Terms of Use, what should you do?
o: Email the TE of the cycle
quiz.w: Terms of Use wala sawal = TE ko email.

quiz.q: In the Issues tab, where is the language column when a cycle has multiple languages?
quiz.w: Language column far right pe.

quiz.q: A Japanese food delivery app showing a burger emoji instead of a rice bowl is classified as which bug type?
quiz.w: Incorrect cultural reference = L10N.

quiz.q: "Check Out" translated as "Verificación" in a hotel app is which bug type?
quiz.w: Galat/misleading translation = T9N.

quiz.q: A banking app not mirroring its layout for Arabic users is listed under which bug type?
quiz.w: Lesson 9 me ye I18N bugs ke under hai.

quiz.q: A UK user sees 12/06/2025 but the system reads it as December 6. Which type does the lesson list it under?
quiz.w: Ye G11N bugs ke examples me hai.

quiz.q: Payment testing is defined as any test that requires what to complete?
o: A video call with the customer
quiz.w: Notes: payment testing = koi bhi test jisme PI use karna pade.

quiz.q: Which local payment method is linked to India in the notes?
quiz.w: Klarna Sweden, PayTM India, Alipay China.

quiz.q: In the tester profile, which tab do you open to add payment methods?
quiz.w: Tester Profile me Payment Testing tab pe jaana hai.

quiz.q: What payment-method data is collected in the tester profile?
o: Identifying items like issuing country and bank names
quiz.w: Confidential data nahi, sirf issuing country aur bank names.

quiz.q: In which payment testing type does the tester NOT make the purchase?
quiz.w: Passive me tester PI data deta hai aur account monitor karta hai.

quiz.q: Split testing is best described as:
o: A live variation of active testing done on a conference call
Splitting the payment across two cards
Testing half the flow online and half in store
A passive test with two testers
quiz.w: Split = active ka live version, call pe payment.

quiz.q: In a passive test, what must the tester monitor?
o: Their PI accounts to ensure purchases and refunds are correct
quiz.w: Passive me apna account dekhna - purchases aur refunds sahi hain ya nahi.

quiz.q: Which is NOT one of the three common payment testing targets?
quiz.w: Teen targets: in-store, ATM, online.

quiz.q: How long do credit card funds typically take to be reflected in the account balance?
quiz.w: Credit me merchant settlement ke baad typically 2-3 din.

quiz.q: Debit card transactions are based on:
quiz.w: Notes: debit card transactions 4-digit PIN based.

quiz.q: Approximately how long is a credit card billing cycle according to the notes?
quiz.w: Billing cycle around 30 days, phir small grace period.

quiz.q: Which statement about interest is correct?
o: Debit cards charge interest on the daily balance
Debit cards have no interest charges
quiz.w: Debit me koi interest nahi; credit me poora balance na bharo to interest.

quiz.q: What does a magnetic stripe use to communicate data with the terminal?
quiz.w: Stripe me modified iron-based magnetic particles hote hain.

quiz.q: With a magnetic stripe credit card, who keeps the signed receipt?
quiz.w: Signed receipt merchant rakhta hai, second receipt aap lete ho.

quiz.q: How is a chip card used at the terminal?
o: Inserted with the chip facing up
quiz.w: Chip card insert karo, chip upar ki taraf.

quiz.q: When does a contactless card payment require a PIN?
quiz.w: Normally PIN nahi, limit exceed hone pe PIN.

quiz.q: What technology do mobile e-wallets like Google Pay and Apple Pay use in store?
quiz.w: E-wallets contactless cards wali same NFC use karte hain.

quiz.q: When adding a card in Android Pay, which two details are entered per the notes?
quiz.w: Android me card number aur CVC dalna hai.

quiz.q: When testing a card in store, which receipt must you always take?
o: Only the product receipt when approved
No receipt is needed if declined
The terminal receipt with card info, whether accepted, declined or error
quiz.w: Terminal receipt har case me - accepted, declined, error.

quiz.q: Which of these is NOT listed as a common e-commerce payment method?
quiz.w: Chaar methods: cards, internet banking, e-commerce payment system, mobile wallet - COD list me nahi.

quiz.q: In exchange for a fee, e-commerce payment systems like PayPal offer which benefits?
quiz.w: Fee ke badle one-click transactions aur password memory.

quiz.q: Which is NOT on the online-transaction evidence checklist?
o: Screenshot of success or error message
Checking the transaction on the card/bank/e-wallet page
quiz.w: Storefront photo in-store evidence hai, online wala nahi.

quiz.q: Before starting an in-store test, what must happen?
o: The TTL must concur with the plan (store, card, device)
quiz.w: Testing tabhi jab TTL plan pe concur kare.

quiz.q: Why should you not contact bank or store customer care without PM/TTL consent?
o: They may not know the new process and the issue may escalate to the customer
quiz.w: Customer care ko naya process nahi pata, escalation ho sakta hai.

quiz.q: Per the notes, if you planned five store visits, when should you stop and check with the TTL?
o: If the first two store visits fail
Only if the card is lost
quiz.w: Example: 5 me se pehle 2 fail = ruko aur TTL se poocho.

quiz.q: Ideally, how soon after a store visit should results be reported?
o: By the end of the cycle
quiz.w: Ideally store visit ke 2-3 ghante me report.

quiz.q: If store staff object to your photos and ask you to delete them, you should:
o: Delete them, follow their instruction and report to TE/TTL
quiz.w: Oblige karo aur TE/TTL ko report karo.

quiz.q: Which item should you always choose to stay within the spending limit?
o: Any item under the card limit
quiz.w: Hamesha lowest priced items lo.

quiz.q: On a terminal receipt, what is STAN/RRN?
o: A number generated by the cardholder bank to identify a transaction
quiz.w: STAN/RRN = cardholder bank ka transaction identify karne wala number.

quiz.q: On a receipt, the 'Acquirer' is:
o: The financial institution (bank) processing the transaction
quiz.w: Acquirer = transaction process karne wala bank.

quiz.q: Which in-store evidence is described as not mandatory because it is sometimes impossible to capture?
quiz.w: Terminal photo mandatory nahi.

quiz.q: Which app is used to take the GPS image at the point of sale or ATM?
quiz.w: Notes: GPS image Google Maps se.

quiz.q: In open banking, how is financial data shared with third-party services?
o: Through secure APIs, with access revocable at any time
quiz.w: Secure APIs se, customer kabhi bhi revoke kar sakta hai.

quiz.q: Which is NOT listed among common open banking testing types?
quiz.w: Paanch types: payment, functional, usability, regression, accessibility.

quiz.q: Which card detail is OK to share in screenshots per the open banking advice?
quiz.w: Pehle 6 digits BIN share karna ok; CVV aur expiry nahi.

quiz.q: If a test requires giving consent to the customer product, what must you do after testing?
o: Keep it active for future cycles
quiz.w: Testing ke baad consent revoke karo.

quiz.q: Which video tool is recommended because it allows blurring when editing?
quiz.w: ScreenPal Pro - editing me blur allow karta hai.

quiz.q: If your question might violate the Terms of Use or is personal, you should:
o: Post it in the cycle chat
Email the TE of the cycle
quiz.w: Personal ya ToU wala sawal TE ko email.

quiz.q: What should you tell a merchant if the testing card lacks the necessary information?
o: That it is a business card
That it is a gift card
That the bank issued it by mistake
quiz.w: Notes: bolo ki business card hai.

quiz.q: What fee do businesses typically pay per card transaction according to the FAQ?
quiz.w: Typically around 2-3% ya zyada per transaction.

quiz.q: How many card digits at most may a receipt reveal?
o: The last five digits, with no expiration date
quiz.w: Receipt pe last five digits se zyada nahi aur expiry date nahi.

Only after the first maintenance release
After the product has been sold

quiz.q: Complex usability issues found late can be deferred to:

In real time by phone or screen sharing

How many bugs can you log?
Can you navigate the pages with ease?
What recommendations would you give to improve it?

quiz.q: Which scenario do companies want to avoid, according to the notes?
