quiz.q: The most important usability innovation for desktop applications was:
quiz.w: Notes: sabse important innovation painless installation via Wizard.

quiz.q: Early desktop applications followed which development paradigm?

quiz.w: One entry, one exit - isliye one size fits all.

quiz.q: Which is NOT listed as a goal of desktop usability?

quiz.w: Goals: easy use, shortest time, kam support calls.

o: Empowering the user to perform their task with minimal effort
Giving users as many features as possible

quiz.q: In corporate (private industry) desktop applications, customization is often limited by:

quiz.q: Software suites minimize the user's learning curve mainly by:

quiz.w: Notes: most important aspect Accessibility hai.

quiz.q: ALT tags on images help:

quiz.q: Website accessibility for people with disabilities should follow which standards?
quiz.w: Notes: W3C standards follow karne ke liye.

quiz.q: Linking the company logo to the home page is an example under:

quiz.w: Customers criteria define karte hain, match karna mandatory.

Survey finished within the expected time

quiz.w: Direct link se new tab, profile visible nahi (GDPR bhi).

quiz.q: Which button do you click to submit the survey once finished?
quiz.w: Survey khatam hone par 'Study Complete' button.

quiz.q: Where do you upload required screenshots or videos?
quiz.w: Attachments 'Uploads' tab me upload hote hain.

quiz.q: Who goes through the survey before a cycle to set the reference time?

quiz.w: UX engineer ya TTL survey karke reference time set karta hai.

Use a translation tool and rush

quiz.q: A video slot should only be claimed if:

quiz.q: Using a second device to record your first device's screen leads to:

Check your voice is recorded clearly before starting

quiz.q: If you are blocked from performing an action during a video task, you should:

quiz.w: Blocker issues customer ke liye extremely valuable hain.

quiz.q: The Think Aloud Protocol applies to:
quiz.w: Notes: moderated aur unmoderated dono par apply hota hai.

Rate the price of the product
quiz.w: Purpose clear hai ya nahi aur kis liye use hota hai.

quiz.q: 'Contract' on one page and 'documents' on another referring to the same thing is a concern under:
quiz.w: Content flow me terminology match check hota hai.

quiz.q: Usability cycles differ from functional cycles because they are primarily:

quiz.w: Test cases jaisa flat rate; payout cycle ke hisaab se vary.

The device switches to dictation only

Neither sends content to the server
quiz.w: Notes: POST web pages pe zyada common, PUT APIs me zyada common.

The server does not recognize the method
The request has a syntax error

Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux

Only one shipping address can be active at a time

quiz.q: How do the notes define software testing?

Measuring how fast a product loads on one device
Evaluating a product's features and functionalities with the intent of locating all defects and errors
Writing code that is free of defects before release

Automated scripts running on many virtual machines

You get a guaranteed monthly salary
You are more likely to be invited to paid test cycles for real clients

A slot reserved only for TTLs
quiz.w: Jo slot kisi test case se linked nahi hota use Exploratory slot kehte hain, isme free testing in-scope areas me hoti hai.

quiz.q: How can you recognise a Known Issue on the issues page?
o: By a blue bookmark tag next to the issue in the title column
By the word KNOWN in the issue ID
By a green tick next to the tester name
quiz.w: Known Issue ke title ke paas blue bookmark tag dikhta hai, isse duplicate report se bach sakte ho.

quiz.q: What is BFV (Bug Fix Verification)?
o: Verifying whether a reported bug has been fixed once a fix or new build is released
Finding brand new bugs in a fresh build
Writing a fix for a bug as a tester
Reviewing a tester's bug before approval
quiz.w: BFV me naya build aane pe check karte hain ki pehle report hua bug actually fix hua ya nahi.

quiz.q: A slot has a turnaround time of 6 hours. What does that mean?
o: The work must be submitted within 6 hours after claiming the slot
You must wait 6 hours before claiming it
The TTL reviews it within 6 hours
quiz.w: Turnaround time submission ki time limit hai, claim karne ke baad 6 hours ke andar submit karna hai.

quiz.q: What is a placeholder report?
o: A bug report submitted without complete info or attachments just to reserve its position and finish or change it later
A report saved as a draft and never submitted
A test case that has not started yet
A known issue added by the customer
quiz.w: Placeholder matlab incomplete report jo sirf position reserve karne ke liye submit kiya gaya, baad me edit karne ke irade se.

quiz.q: Which rejection type is used when the tester did not add the requested information after an info request was sent?
quiz.w: Info request ka jawab na dene pe INF (Need more info) rejection lagta hai.

quiz.q: In the chat window, how is the number of unread messages for a cycle shown?
o: In bold text in the footer
quiz.w: Active, Locked, Pending cycle chats ki list me unread count green icon ke andar dikhta hai.

quiz.q: In the chat text field, how do you add a new line without sending the message?
quiz.w: Enter se message send hota hai, Shift + Enter se new line aati hai.

quiz.q: Who can create additional chat rooms in a test cycle chat besides Announcements and Questions?
quiz.w: Other rooms TTLs aur TEs create kar sakte hain, purpose room ke naam me ya unke explanation me hota hai.

quiz.q: When will the Projects Chat section not be shown in the chat window?
o: When you are not invited to any project chat channel
When you have no active test cycles
quiz.w: Projects Chat section tabhi dikhta hai jab tum kisi project chat channel me invited ho.

quiz.q: Which page from the Account pop-up lets you update your password and configure or reset MFA?
quiz.w: Access & Security page pe password update aur MFA configure ya reset hota hai.

quiz.q: From the Knowledge Base (Tester Support) page, which of these can you request?
o: A payout increase for a cycle
Support to add a missing device or environment
quiz.w: Knowledge Base se articles browse kar sakte ho aur missing device ya environment add karwane ka support request kar sakte ho.

quiz.q: If you close the AI Support Agent window, how do you reopen it?
o: Click the question mark button at the bottom right
Log out and log back in
quiz.w: Agent window band karne ke baad bottom right ke question mark button se dobara khol sakte ho.

quiz.q: How many languages can a tester select in the Language & Voice section?
quiz.w: Language & Voice me maximum 5 languages select kar sakte ho, unme se max 2 Native ho sakti hain.

quiz.q: Which proficiency level means general writing and grammar knowledge but some difficulty speaking and writing?
quiz.w: Proficient me general writing/grammar aati hai par bolne likhne me thodi difficulty hoti hai; Fluent usse upar hai.

quiz.q: Why should the devices in your profile be your own and not borrowed?
o: So you can provide information immediately if your report or test case gets an info request
Because borrowed devices cannot install apps
Because the platform checks device receipts
quiz.w: Device apna ho to info request aane pe turant extra info de sakte ho, isliye borrowed device add mat karo.

quiz.q: In the Tester Profile, which section asks whether you are willing to test gambling or casino related products?
quiz.w: Interests section me hobbies, fitness and sports aur gambling/casino testing ki willingness confirm karte ho.

quiz.q: Where do you find your referral link?
o: At the top of the Community Profile page
quiz.w: Community Profile ke top pe avatar, banner, stats ke saath referral link bhi milta hai.

quiz.q: In the My Activity section on Home, what does the Projects tab show?
o: Paid projects you can apply for
Your 5 Active and Pending test cycles that will lock the soonest
quiz.w: Projects tab dynamic view hai jo soonest lock hone wale 5 Active/Pending cycles dikhata hai.

quiz.q: When is the New Joiner Checklist removed from the Home page?
o: After 30 days, or earlier if you complete it
quiz.w: Checklist 30 din baad hat jaati hai, aur agar pehle complete kar lo to tabhi hat jaati hai.

quiz.q: How often is the Profile Completion card shown to you?
o: The first time you log in each month
Only when a cycle invite arrives
quiz.w: Profile Completion card har mahine ke pehle login pe dikhta hai.

quiz.q: After you finish an Academy course, what does the course button change to?
quiz.w: Start Course se shuru, beech me Resume Course, aur complete hone ke baad Review Course ban jaata hai.

quiz.q: When does the Take the Quiz button become available on a course page?
o: As soon as you open the course
After you sign up for the practice cycle
After all lessons of the course are completed
quiz.w: Quiz tab tak locked rehta hai jab tak saare lessons complete na ho jaayein.

quiz.q: Within what time is an Academy Pass grade assigned once both your issue and test case are approved in an active cycle?
quiz.w: Issue aur test case approve hone ke 12 se 24 hours ke andar Pass grade mil jaata hai.

quiz.q: A tester fails an Academy practice test cycle. What can they do?
o: Ask the AI agent to change the grade
Sign up again for the same Academy level
Move on to the next level anyway
quiz.w: Fail hone wale testers usi Academy level ke liye dobara sign up kar sakte hain.

quiz.q: In the Pending tab of the Projects page, what can a tester do?
o: Read all available information but not submit issues or test cases
Submit issues but not test cases
quiz.w: Pending Activation me info padh sakte ho par Issues/Test Cases submit nahi kar sakte.

quiz.q: By default, which projects does the Projects Board show you?
o: The projects best appropriate for you as per your tester profile
quiz.w: Default view me profile ke hisaab se best matching projects dikhte hain; urgent ya all tab se filter kar sakte ho.

quiz.q: What should you do before creating a new forum topic?
o: Search to see whether a similar topic has already been discussed
Message a Community Manager for approval
quiz.w: Naya topic banane se pehle search karo ki similar topic pehle se discuss hua hai ya nahi.

quiz.q: What is the AI Guidelines page in the footer about?
o: How to train your own AI model
Acceptable use of third-party Generative AI tools by the community
How the platform's AI rates testers
Which AI tools pay the most
quiz.w: AI Guidelines page batata hai ki community third-party Generative AI tools ko kaise acceptable tarike se use kare.

quiz.q: Where is the AI Support Agent currently available?
o: On the website in desktop and mobile browsers, but not in the mobile app
quiz.w: Support Agent abhi sirf website pe hai, desktop aur mobile browser dono me; mobile app me nahi.

quiz.q: For an Academy-specific issue, which request category should you pick in the contact support form?
quiz.w: Academy issues ke liye support form me Academy On-boarding & Training category select karni hai.

quiz.q: What is the primary working language for community posts and project work?
quiz.w: Rule hai ki English primary working language hai, posts aur work dono English me.

quiz.q: What may happen to your account while a Terms of Use violation is being investigated?
o: It may be suspended while the investigation is underway
Your rating is reset to Gold
quiz.w: Platform violations seriously leta hai aur investigation ke dauraan account suspend karne ka right rakhta hai.

quiz.q: Which statement about accounts follows the Terms of Use?
o: Payment accounts can be shared with family testers
Do not create more than one account, and do not share payment accounts
You may use a friend's account when yours is locked
Two accounts are fine if one is for mobile
quiz.w: Ek se zyada account ya kisi aur ka account use karna mana hai, payment account share karna bhi.

quiz.q: Can you use emulators, simulators or jailbroken devices for testing?
o: No, unless otherwise instructed by a platform employee
Yes, but only for mobile cycles
Only if the TTL is offline
quiz.w: Emulators, simulators, remote machines, beta software ya jailbroken device mana hai jab tak employee specifically na bole.

quiz.q: What must you do with third-party VPNs, SSH tunnels and proxy connections while working on a project?
o: Use them only for payment testing
Share their settings with the TTL
Keep them on for extra security
Completely disable them or remove them from the testing device
quiz.w: Testing ke time saare third-party VPN, SSH tunnel, proxy disable ya remove hone chahiye taaki sensitive info track na ho.

quiz.q: A project shipped you a device for testing. What should you do after testing?
o: Return it immediately unless you got express permission to keep it
Sell it and report the amount
quiz.w: Shipped hardware testing ke baad turant return karna hai, jab tak express permission na mile.

quiz.q: Which of these is a common manual tester selection criterion?
quiz.w: Common criteria: device/software, location, characteristics/demographics, aur payment instruments & subscriptions.

quiz.q: For requirements not captured in the tester profile, which two methods are used to recruit testers?
o: Projects Board and Special Requirement Surveys
quiz.w: Profile se bahar ki requirements ke liye Projects Board pe post aur SRS emails use hote hain.

quiz.q: Once you have submitted an SRS, can you take it again?
o: No, a submitted survey cannot be taken again
Yes, as many times as you like
quiz.w: SRS ek baar submit karne ke baad dobara nahi le sakte, isliye dhyan se bharo.

quiz.q: Why are your name, birthdate, phone number and street address verified through a trusted third party?
o: It protects the platform when it sends you hardware to test
quiz.w: Verification se platform protected rehta hai jab tester ko hardware bheja jaata hai.

quiz.q: When are testers paid for referrals?
o: Only for valid referrals when a referral program is announced
For every person who visits their link
quiz.w: Referral earning sirf tab jab referral program announce ho aur referral valid ho.

quiz.q: Which three things affect how much a tester earns?
o: Payout rate, value of the issue, and testing tier
Time of day, weather, and browser
Number of chat messages, likes, and articles
quiz.w: Earning payout rate (project complexity), issue ki value aur testing tier pe depend karti hai.

quiz.q: The 15th of the month falls on a weekend. When are testers paid?
o: On the last day of the month instead
quiz.w: 15th ya last day weekend ya US holiday pe pade to payment next business day hota hai.

quiz.q: What is special about Direct To Bank Transfer (powered by Wise)?
o: You get earnings in your local currency without needing to create a Wise account
It works only for US testers
It pays only in US dollars
You must open a Wise account first
quiz.w: Is method me local currency me direct bank me paisa aata hai, Wise account banane ki zaroorat nahi.

quiz.q: If your profile country is India, what might the Wise form ask for instead of a SWIFT code?
quiz.w: Country ke hisaab se fields badalte hain, India ke liye SWIFT ki jagah IFSC code maanga ja sakta hai.

quiz.q: Which banking details does the platform itself store for Wise payments?
o: Everything you type in the form
Only your full name, currency and country
quiz.w: Platform sirf full name, currency aur country store karta hai; baaki sensitive info securely Wise ko jaati hai.

quiz.q: Does the platform withdraw taxes from your earnings?
o: No, you are responsible for reporting earnings under your local laws
quiz.w: Platform tax nahi kaatta; har jagah tester khud local law ke hisaab se earnings report aur tax pay karta hai.

quiz.q: A new tester is Unrated. How many activity points do they need to become Rated?
quiz.w: Unrated testers ke 25 points se kam hote hain; 25 points ke baad Rated tier milta hai, usually 2-3 cycles me.

quiz.q: Which tier covers testers ranking within the top 50-74.99% of all testers?
quiz.w: Tier table: Rated 0-49.99%, Proven 50-74.99%, Bronze 75-84.99%, Silver 85-92.99%, Gold top 7%.

quiz.q: Which action increases your rating points?
o: Accepting a cycle and then not participating
Declining a test cycle invitation early when you cannot participate
quiz.w: Early decline good practice hai kyunki slot block nahi hota, isliye ye rating badhata hai.

quiz.q: Your rating shows 74.2643%. What does that indicate?
o: You are exactly in the middle of Gold
You were penalised for a rejection
Your quality score qualifies for a higher tier but you lack the minimum activity points
quiz.w: Rating .2643% pe khatam ho to quality higher tier ke laayak hai par minimum activity points abhi collect nahi hue.

quiz.q: What premium do Gold testers receive on approved reports?
quiz.w: Gold ko 10%, Silver ko 5% aur Bronze ko 2.5% premium milta hai approved reports pe.

quiz.q: How do you reveal the real domain of a suspicious email's sender?
o: Click every link in the email
Hover your cursor over the From email address
quiz.w: From address pe hover karne se domain dikhta hai, yaani at sign ke baad wala part.

quiz.q: Which statement about Favorite Tester designations is correct?
o: A tester can be a favorite of only one customer
Each customer has a limited allotment, but a tester can receive unlimited favorite designations
Favorite status is permanent once given
quiz.w: Customer ke paas limited favorites hote hain par tester ke favorite designations ki koi limit nahi; customer kabhi bhi hata sakta hai.

quiz.q: Under GDPR, which of these counts as personal data?
quiz.w: GDPR personal data me name, bank details, IP-address, photos, biometric data jaise items aate hain.

quiz.q: According to the notes, the product being tested can be:
o: Software, hardware or a physical service
quiz.w: Notes kehte hain product sirf software nahi, hardware ya physical service bhi ho sakta hai.

quiz.q: Which testing benefit is about finding issues early so they cost less time and money to fix?
quiz.w: Cost-Effectiveness: early issues fix karna sasta, later stages me bahut mehenga padta hai.

quiz.q: How do smoke testing and regression testing differ?
o: Smoke tests all features; regression tests only the login
Smoke is done by customers, regression by testers
Smoke runs a few basic tests on core functions; regression tests all features in depth after changes
quiz.w: Smoke core functions ko few basic tests se check karta hai, regression zyada in-depth hota hai.

quiz.q: Which of these is given as an example of a bug hunt cycle?
o: Visiting a store to rate the service
Finding whether an app freezes for more than 60 seconds on launch after first install or update
Translating a website into a new language
Writing new test cases for a checkout flow
quiz.w: Bug hunt specific bug dhundhne ke liye hota hai, jaise install/update ke baad launch pe 60 seconds se zyada freeze.

quiz.q: In a bug hunt cycle, what happens if you report issues outside the specific requirement?
o: They are approved as bonus bugs
They get rejected as OOS or DNFI with a big negative impact on your rating
They are moved to another cycle
quiz.w: Bug hunt me customer sirf ek cheez chahta hai, bahar ki reporting OOS ya DNFI reject hoti hai aur rating ko bada nuksaan.

quiz.q: Inconsistent colours on a button or menu fall under which issue type?
quiz.w: Layout aur UI distortion wale issues, jaise inconsistent colors, Visual type ke hain.

quiz.q: Incorrectly used punctuation in page text is which issue type?
quiz.w: Text se related spelling, grammar, punctuation aur localization errors Content issues hain.

quiz.q: A shop sorts low-to-high by actual price instead of discounted price. Why is reporting this invalid?
o: It must be reported as a Crash
Sorting is always out of scope
The sorting is working as designed, so it is a suggestion rather than an issue
quiz.w: Ye WAD example hai; discounted price se sort karna achha suggestion hai par issue nahi.

quiz.q: Where can you find a cycle's known issues, if it has any?
o: In the cycle overview or the Issues tab
quiz.w: Known issues overview me ya Issues tab me milte hain; report se pehle unhe check karo.

quiz.q: A search engine does not return 'Bryant' when a user types 'Bryan'. How do the notes classify this?
o: A clear defect that is always approved
A gray area: poor design but functional, approved only if the client values such feedback
quiz.w: Search specification ke hisaab se kaam kar raha hai, design improve ho sakta hai; approval client ki priority pe depend karta hai.

quiz.q: A cycle asks you to test 'as a regular user'. Why is a report about entering hundreds of characters into a form likely rejected?
o: Character limits are always known issues
It is negative testing that does not match the regular-user goal unless it causes a significant malfunction
It must be filed as a Content issue
quiz.w: Customer ne regular user testing maanga hai, isliye aisi negative testing finding usually reject hoti hai.

quiz.q: You saw an issue only once. What should you do before submitting it?
o: Clear browser cache, restart the browser and try to reproduce it
Report it as a Crash to be safe
Ask the customer to confirm it
Submit it immediately as a placeholder
quiz.w: Once upon a time issue ke liye pehle cache clear, browser restart aur reproduce karo; persist kare aur impact ho tabhi report.

quiz.q: Which testing concept is about exhaustive testing of one particular feature?
quiz.w: Depth ek feature ka exhaustive test hai, breadth poori application me coverage.

quiz.q: Multiple testers use the same OS and browser in a cycle. What may help when naming test case files?
o: Adding each tester's last name to the file name
quiz.w: Good practice: test case name + OS + browser, aur same OS/browser wale testers ho to last name bhi add karo.

quiz.q: When installing an APK, Android blocks unknown apps. What do you do?
o: Install it from the Play Store instead
Tap Settings in the pop-up and enable Allow from this source
quiz.w: Android by default unknown apps block karta hai, Settings me jaake Allow from this source toggle on karo.

quiz.q: How long does a test cycle usually run?
quiz.w: Testing & Reporting phase usually 2-3 din chalta hai.

quiz.q: In a Locked cycle, when can bug reports and test cases be edited?
o: When they are in Info Requested status
Only if the customer allows it
quiz.w: Locked status me reports/test cases tab edit ho sakte hain jab wo Info Requested status me ho.

quiz.q: If you have not enabled MFA, what happens with an invitation to a cycle that requires MFA?
o: Its details are redacted and you cannot accept it until you enable MFA
You can accept but not report bugs
quiz.w: MFA ke bina invite redacted dikhta hai aur MFA enable kiye bina accept nahi kar sakte.

quiz.q: While enabling MFA, which button do you click after Enable MFA?
quiz.w: Steps: Account Security, Enable MFA, phir Enable MFA and Sign Out, phir dobara Sign In karke setup.

quiz.q: When adding a setup key in Google Authenticator, which Type of Key do you choose?
quiz.w: Setup Key wale flow me Type of Key field me Time based select karna hai.

quiz.q: How should the OTP be entered on the website after signing in?
o: With a space after every digit
Without spaces, quickly before the code expires
quiz.w: OTP bina spaces ke daalna hai aur jaldi, kyunki code time-sensitive hai, jaise har 30 seconds badalta hai.

quiz.q: Once MFA is enabled on a tester account, can it be disabled?
quiz.w: MFA ek baar enable hua to disable nahi hota, kyunki projects me participate karne ke liye zaroori hai.

quiz.q: A cycle you already accepted turns on the MFA requirement and you have no MFA. What happens?
o: You are paid for the cycle anyway
You lose access to the cycle and your submissions until you enable MFA
quiz.w: Accepted cycle me MFA requirement aaye aur MFA na ho to cycle, issue reports aur test cases ka access chala jaata hai jab tak enable na karo.

quiz.q: Why might you be unable to accept a cycle NDA?
o: No address is listed in your tester profile
You joined less than a week ago
quiz.w: Profile me address na ho to NDA accept nahi hota, pehle address add karna padta hai.

quiz.q: What happens if you join a slot waitlist for a full Test Case slot?
o: You get the slot's payout immediately
You are automatically accepted into the cycle
It does not mean you have officially accepted the cycle invitation
quiz.w: Waitlist join karna cycle accept karna nahi hai; tum waitlist chhod ke invite decline bhi kar sakte ho.

quiz.q: Some announcements must be acknowledged. What happens if you do not?
quiz.w: Kuch announcements pe Acknowledge button dabana zaroori hai, warna testing continue nahi kar sakte.

quiz.q: While submitting a test case, a failed step's bug was already reported by another tester. What do you do?
o: Report it again as a new bug
Put that bug's ID in the Actual Result field and click Fail
quiz.w: Bug pehle se reported ho to uski id Actual Result me daalo aur Fail click karo; naya ho to Fail & Report Issue.

quiz.q: Which of these should NOT be done in the cycle chat?
quiz.w: Cycle chat me payouts, approve karne ki request, disputes aur rejected issues discuss karna mana hai.

quiz.q: Who can use @all in the chat room to mention all users?
quiz.w: @all sirf TTL use kar sakta hai; tester @testername ya @ttl use kar sakta hai.

quiz.q: Your question in the cycle chat has not been answered for a long time. After how long may you contact the TE or TSM?
o: Never, wait for the cycle to close
quiz.w: Chat me sawal 24 hours se zyada unanswered ho to TE/TSM se contact karne ki situation hai.

quiz.q: According to the notes, what are the three types of slots?
o: Test Case slots, Exploratory slots and Usability Studies
Test Case slots, BFV slots and Review slots
Paid slots, Academy slots and Waitlist slots
Exploratory slots, Live slots and Regression slots
quiz.w: Notes me teen types hain: Test Case slots (1 ya multiple TC linked), Exploratory slots aur Usability Studies.

quiz.q: You claimed a slot linked to 4 test cases and submitted 3 of them on time but not the 4th. What happens?
o: The 3 submitted test cases are approved and paid
The slot is not approved, so none of the test cases are approved
Only the missing test case is rejected
The TTL automatically submits the 4th test case for you
quiz.w: Multi-TC slot me sab TC time pe submit karne hote hain, ek bhi miss hua to slot approve nahi hoga aur koi TC approve nahi hoga.

quiz.q: You opened the Slots tab of a new cycle but cannot claim any slot. What is the most likely reason?
o: Slots can only be claimed from the mobile app
You must first join the slot waitlist
Slots open only after the TTL sends an announcement
You have not accepted the cycle invitation yet from the cycle overview
quiz.w: Pehle overview padho, neeche Accept Cycle & Claim a Slot button dabao, tabhi slot claim ho payega.

quiz.q: On the slots table, what does the Effort column show?
o: The payout sum across all test cases in the slot
The time limit for submitting the slot
The time required to complete all the test cases linked to the slot
How many free claims are left for the slot
quiz.w: Effort = kaam me kitna time lagega; Deadline = submit ki time limit; Payout = paisa; Slots Remaining = bache claims.

quiz.q: You want to unclaim a slot, but one of its linked test cases is already submitted. What must you do first?
o: Ask the TTL to reject the submitted test case
Just click Unclaim; submitted test cases are kept
Unsubmit all submitted test cases linked to the slot, then unclaim the slot
Leave it; the slot can never be unclaimed after any submission
quiz.w: Koi bhi linked TC submitted ho to unclaim possible nahi, pehle saare submitted TC unsubmit karo phir Slots tab se Unclaim.

quiz.q: A test case step has no expected result. Which status should you select after following its instructions?
quiz.w: Expected result nahi hai to Pass/Fail ka sawal hi nahi, step ko Done mark karte hain.

quiz.q: While executing a step you hit a bug that is already reported by another tester. What is the correct action?
o: Use Fail & Report Issue to report it again as a new issue
Confirm (+1) the existing issue, add its issue ID in the Actual Result field and select Fail Step
Mark the step as Pass since the bug is already known
Mark the step as Done and mention the bug in comments only
quiz.w: Already reported bug ko +1 karo, issue ID Actual Result me daalo aur Fail Step choose karo; naya report nahi.

quiz.q: What does the test case result Closed By TestCycle mean?
o: The TTL closed the test case after approving it
The tester unclaimed it with the Blocked reason
The system unclaimed the test case because it was not submitted and the cycle was closed
The customer rejected the test case at cycle end
quiz.w: Closed By TestCycle = submit nahi hua aur cycle close ho gayi, isliye system ne unclaim kar diya.

quiz.q: Which of these test cases can the tester NOT edit?
o: A submitted test case that the TTL has not reviewed yet
A test case that is Unclaimed
A test case in Info Requested status
A submitted test case where you noticed a wrong attachment before any TTL review
quiz.w: Edit sirf Pending (TTL ne review nahi kiya) aur Info Requested me hota hai; Unclaimed, pended, Approved, Rejected me nahi.

quiz.q: You are on two slot waitlists and then claim a test case slot in the cycle. What happens to your waitlists?
o: You stay on the waitlists until the cycle locks
Only the waitlist of the same slot is removed
Nothing changes; waitlists are independent of claims
You are removed from all the waitlists you joined
quiz.w: Waitlist sirf unke liye hai jinke paas test case slot nahi; TC slot claim kiya to saari waitlists se bahar.

quiz.q: A tester does not meet a slot's claim criteria. What does that tester see?
o: The slot does not appear in their Available Slots section
The slot appears with a disabled Claim button
The slot appears but claiming sends an approval request to the TTL
The slot appears only in the Unclaimed Slots section
quiz.w: Slot claim criteria match nahi to slot Available Slots me dikhega hi nahi, isliye profile sahi aur updated rakho.

quiz.q: The cycle is locked, but a test case linked to your slot is now info requested. Can you see the slot credentials?
o: No, credentials are hidden forever once the cycle locks
Only the TTL can see them after the cycle locks
Only if you claim the slot again
Yes, credentials become visible again when a linked test case is info requested, even if the cycle is locked
quiz.w: Normally credentials claim ke baad aur cycle active hone tak dikhte hain, lekin info request aaye to locked cycle me bhi wapas dikhte hain.

quiz.q: What is required before you can submit a failed BFV test case?
o: A new issue report for the same bug
A second tester confirming the failure
quiz.w: Failed BFV bina comment ke submit nahi hota, taaki TTL/TE ko failure ka reason samajh aaye.

quiz.q: What happens to Tester Reviews once the cycle is locked?
o: Reviews can still be submitted until the cycle is closed
Testers can no longer write or submit a review, and submitted reviews cannot be edited
Submitted reviews can be edited but new ones cannot be written
The TTL converts reviews into issue reports
quiz.w: Cycle lock hote hi review likhna, submit karna aur edit karna sab band.

quiz.q: In TestRail, which status is used when a test case failed due to a bug and the bug has now been fixed?
quiz.w: Retest tab jab TC dobara test karna ho, jaise bug fix ho gaya to retest.

quiz.q: A bug was found while executing test case steps. Which Source should be selected?
quiz.w: Test case steps se mila bug = Structured; test case se unrelated bug = Exploratory.

quiz.q: What happens to the Source field when you report a bug using the Fail & Report Issue feature from a test case step?
o: It is set to Exploratory by default
It is left empty for the TTL to fill
You must choose it manually every time
It is set to Structured by default and cannot be changed to Exploratory
quiz.w: Fail & Report Issue se report kiya to Source Structured fix ho jata hai aur issue us step se link hota hai.

quiz.q: Which last step is NOT allowed in Actions Performed?
o: 4. Enter a valid email in the Email field
quiz.w: Steps me Observe, Check, View results, Find, See, Pay attention jaise words nahi likhne.

quiz.q: No error message appeared when reproducing the bug. What should you write in the Error Messages field?
quiz.w: Error message nahi hai to field khali chhodo; None, N/A ya - likhna mana hai.

quiz.q: What is the maximum number of screenshots you should upload per issue report?
quiz.w: Rule: 2 se zyada screenshots nahi, aur video sirf ek.

quiz.q: With the Attachment Visibility feature, what can a cycle TTL do with a tester's attachment?
o: Hide it, but not unhide it
Unhide it, but not hide it
Nothing; only the tester controls visibility
quiz.w: TTL hide kar sakta hai par unhide nahi; TE, TSM aur CM Private/Visible dono taraf change kar sakte hain.

quiz.q: A tester hid an attachment from other testers. Who can still see it?
o: Only the tester who uploaded it
All testers who have +1'd the issue
TTL, TE, TSM, CM and Customers in the cycle
quiz.w: Hidden attachment sirf baaki testers se chhupta hai; TTL, TE, TSM, CM aur Customer ko dikhta rehta hai.

quiz.q: You click Configure Template but have never saved a template in this cycle. What happens?
o: An error message says no template exists
It loads the template from your previous cycle
It works the same as the Save as Template button
It clears all fields of the current report
quiz.w: Template pehle save nahi kiya to Configure Template bhi Save as Template jaisa hi kaam karta hai.

quiz.q: In which issue status can the tester NOT edit the report?
quiz.w: Edit New, Info Requested aur dispute ke liye Rejected me hota hai; Pending aur Approved me nahi.

quiz.q: Your report is in New status, but the TTL already sent it an info request earlier. Can you discard it?
o: Yes, any report in New status can be discarded
Yes, but only from the mobile app
No, a report that the TTL already reviewed cannot be discarded even if its status is New
quiz.w: Discard sirf tab jab TTL ne check na kiya ho; pended ya info request ho chuka to New status me bhi error aayega.

quiz.q: Which example fits Medium severity?
o: A service is unavailable for a subset of customers
quiz.w: Medium = workaround ke saath minor/medium impact jaise noticeable performance degradation; crash = Critical, misalignment = Low, service down for subset = High.

quiz.q: Which bug value means the bug is valid but the customer is not interested in it or not planning to fix it?
quiz.w: Four values me sabse neeche Somewhat Valuable (Won't Fix): valid bug par customer fix nahi karega. WAD to rejection reason hai.

quiz.q: Which rejection reason has a double negative impact on the tester rating?
quiz.w: DNFI ka rating pe double negative impact hota hai, isliye overview ke instructions follow karo.

quiz.q: When can you dispute a rejected bug?
o: Only after the cycle is closed
Only when the cycle is active or locked
Any time, even months after cycle close
Only within the first hour after rejection
quiz.w: Notes: dispute sirf active ya locked cycle me possible hai.

quiz.q: How many dispute opportunities does a tester get per bug?
o: Unlimited, until the monthly limit is reached
quiz.w: Har bug par sirf ek dispute chance; aur monthly total disputes bhi limited hain.

quiz.q: You want to +1 another tester's Functional bug that cannot be shown with only a screenshot. What attachment should you upload?
quiz.w: Visual bug ke +1 me screenshot chal jata hai, baaki bugs jo screenshot se clear nahi hote unme video chahiye.

quiz.q: The Issue Quality Review sent an info request to your report and you ignore it. What happens?
o: The report is automatically approved at cycle close
The feature fixes the report itself after 24 hours
The report is automatically rejected once the cycle is closed
The report stays in Info Requested forever with no effect
quiz.w: IQR ka info request address nahi kiya to cycle close hote hi report auto reject ho jati hai.

quiz.q: How is a Known Issue reported in a previous cycle shown in the Issues tab of the cycle?
o: With a red bar on the left of the issue
With the word KI in the issue ID
With a blue flag on the right of the issue title
It is hidden from the Issues tab
quiz.w: Previous cycle ke Known Issues Issues list me blue flag ke saath dikhte hain; inhe dobara report mat karo.

quiz.q: What is the default Bug Report Integrity value for all bugs?
quiz.w: Integrity ke 3 types: High, Low aur Unrated; default Unrated jab tak TTL/TE/TSM high ya low na kare.

quiz.q: In which file extension should a Charles proxy log be uploaded?
quiz.w: Charles log .chls ya .chlz me; browser/device logs .txt ya .log me.

quiz.q: After logging in, which four main sections is the mobile app divided into?
quiz.w: App ke 4 main sections: Home, Projects, Chat, Profile.

quiz.q: On the Home section, accepted test cycles or test cases are listed as ending soon when they end within how long?
quiz.w: Home par invites aur 24 ghante me khatam hone wale accepted cycles/test cases dikhte hain.

quiz.q: In the Projects tab, accepted test cycles are organized into which three tabs?
quiz.w: Projects tab me cycles Active, Pending aur Locked tabs me hoti hain; chat rooms bhi isi tarah classify hote hain.

quiz.q: Which of these can you NOT do from the mobile app?
quiz.w: Notes clearly: mobile app se community access nahi hota, baaki sab features hain.

quiz.q: You open a cycle in the app that you have not accepted yet. Which tabs can you access?
o: All tabs including Issues and Chat
quiz.w: Accept se pehle sirf Overview aur Slots; accept karne ke baad baaki tabs horizontal scroll me aate hain.

quiz.q: In a cycle's Issues tab in the app, how do you start reporting a new issue?
o: Tap the bell icon at the top left
Open the Chat tab and tap Report
Tap the green bug icon at the bottom right corner
quiz.w: Issues tab me neeche right corner ka green bug icon (Report Bug) se issue report form khulta hai.

quiz.q: The Accept Cycle button is disabled in the app. What is the likely reason according to the notes?
o: You have too many active cycles
The cycle has special requirements, and you must tick the checkbox confirming you meet them
quiz.w: Special requirements wali cycle me pehle checkbox se confirm karo ki requirements meet karte ho, phir Accept enable hota hai.

quiz.q: In a cycle with mandatory slotting enabled, what does tapping Accept & Claim Slot do?
o: Takes you to the Slots tab, where you must claim a slot to join the cycle
Automatically assigns you a random slot
Accepts the cycle without any slot
Adds you to every slot waitlist
quiz.w: Mandatory slotting me slot claim karna hi cycle join karna hai; button Slots tab pe le jata hai.

quiz.q: You joined a slot waitlist from the app. Have you officially accepted the cycle invitation?
o: Yes, joining a waitlist counts as accepting
No, to join the cycle you would need to claim a slot such as an Exploratory slot if applicable
No, you must reinstall the app and accept again
quiz.w: Waitlist join karna = cycle accept nahi; abhi bhi leave karke decline kar sakte ho. Join karne ke liye Exploratory slot claim karo.

quiz.q: Reporting an issue in the app is divided into how many steps?
o: 4-5 steps, with the cycle possibly requiring additional info in step 5
quiz.w: App me issue report 4-5 steps me hota hai; step 5 me cycle extra info maang sakti hai.

quiz.q: In the app, after fixing a report or test case for an info request, which button confirms you provided the info?
quiz.w: App me notifications se request kholo, fix karo, phir Send Confirmation dabao.

quiz.q: While executing a test case in the app, how can you move between steps?
quiz.w: Step kholke Done/Pass/Fail mark karo, aur steps ke beech horizontal swipe karke jao.

quiz.q: You fail a step in the app and are asked to report an issue, but the issue is already reported. What should you do on the pop-up?
quiz.w: Fail par report ka pop-up aata hai; existing issues check karo, already reported ho to Cancel.

quiz.q: What happens when you tap Decline on an SRS in the app?
o: A confirmation dialog asks you to confirm
It moves to a Declined folder that you can undo
It is declined immediately without asking for confirmation
The TTL must approve the decline
quiz.w: SRS Decline par koi confirmation nahi aata, isliye galti se tap mat karna.

quiz.q: Where do you open an SRS in the app?
o: In the Chat tab under Contacts
On the Home tab, from the Requirement Survey Requested section
In the Profile tab under Settings
quiz.w: SRS Home tab ke Requirement Survey Requested section se kholo, phir Take Survey.

quiz.q: When a tester mentions @ttl in a cycle chat, who sees the highlight and gets a push notification?
o: All users in the chat room
Only the TE of the cycle
Only the TTLs assigned to that cycle
quiz.w: @ttl sirf us cycle ke assigned TTLs ke liye highlight hota hai aur unhe push milta hai.

quiz.q: Who can use the @all mention in the chat room?
quiz.w: @all TTL use karta hai sab ka attention lene ke liye; tester @testername ya @ttl use kar sakta hai.

quiz.q: How do you enable chat @ mention notifications in the app?
o: Profile tab > Settings > Push notifications > enable Chat @ Mentions
Projects tab > Cycle > Announcements > Notify me
quiz.w: Path yaad rakho: Profile, Settings, Push notifications, Chat @ Mentions toggle on.

quiz.q: Where is the settings button located in the app?
o: At the top left corner of the Profile tab
At the bottom of the Home tab
At the top right of the Chat tab
quiz.w: Profile tab ke top left corner pe settings button; wahan push notifications, legal pages aur Log Out milte hain.

quiz.q: In the app, when can you claim test cases directly from the Test Cases tab?
o: For BFV test cases in the cycle, or when the slot feature is disabled
Never; test cases are only claimed through chat
quiz.w: Normally slot se TC milta hai; Test Cases tab se claim tab jab BFV ho ya slots disabled hon.

quiz.q: How many sections does the practice bug site have?
quiz.w: Site ke 4 sections: Examples of Bugs, Types of Bugs, Find Bugs, Report Bugs.

quiz.q: How many tiles are on the Examples of Bugs page?
quiz.w: Examples of Bugs me 6 tiles, har tile ek bug example dikhata hai.

quiz.q: How many tiles are on the Types of Bugs page?
quiz.w: Types of Bugs me 5 tiles, har tile alag type ka bug dikhata hai.

quiz.q: On the Find Bugs practice site, how many bugs should you try to find at minimum?
quiz.w: 25 bugs planted hain, target kam se kam 20 dhoondhna; practice ke liye saare 25.

quiz.q: How do you open the Tutorial on the practice bug site?
o: Click the Help link in the footer
Click the bug icon at the bottom right
Open the Report Bugs page first
Click the ? icon in the top right corner
quiz.w: Navigation mushkil lage to top right ka question mark ? icon Tutorial kholta hai.

quiz.q: According to the notes, when should you attempt the quiz?
o: Before opening the Find Bugs page
After you have found at least 20 bugs
After creating the first bug report only
quiz.w: Notes: kam se kam 20 bugs mil jaayein tab quiz attempt karo.

quiz.q: On the Report Bugs page, what do you click after creating a bug report to see your results?
quiz.w: Har report ke sahi choices select karke Submit Issue dabao, results dikhte hain; phir aage ke reports.

quiz.q: What is the recommended order for using the practice bug site?
o: Examples of Bugs and Types of Bugs first, then Find Bugs, then Report Bugs
Report Bugs first, then Find Bugs, then Examples
Find Bugs first, then Types of Bugs, then Examples
Any order; the sections are unrelated
quiz.w: Pehle bugs aur types samjho, phir khud dhoondo, phir report likhna practice karo.

quiz.q: According to the glossary, a slot with a turnaround time of 6 hours must be submitted when?
o: Within 6 hours after the cycle starts
Within 6 hours after claiming the slot or test case
Within 6 hours after the cycle locks
Within 6 hours after the TTL reviews it
quiz.w: Turnaround Time = claim ke baad submit karne ki time limit.

quiz.q: Which HTTP error code means the server was acting as a gateway or proxy and did not get a timely response from the upstream server?
quiz.w: 504 = gateway/proxy ko upstream se time pe response nahi mila; 503 = server overloaded ya maintenance.

quiz.q: What is the difference between Docked View and Picture in Picture (PiP)?
o: Docked view stays in a fixed position, while PiP can be repositioned on the screen
PiP stays fixed, while docked view can be moved anywhere
Docked view is full screen, PiP is a small window
There is no difference; both are names for full-screen mode
quiz.w: Docked fixed jagah rehta hai, PiP floating window hai jise move kar sakte ho.

quiz.q: How are Open Captions different from Closed Captions?
o: Open captions are always in a different language from the audio
Open captions can be turned on and off by the viewer
Open captions are embedded in the video and cannot be turned off by the viewer
Open captions appear only on Connected TVs
quiz.w: Open captions video ka part hote hain, band nahi hote; closed captions toggle ho sakte hain.

quiz.q: In which type of cycle can you see the Test Case Instructions section?
quiz.w: Notes: Test Case Instructions section Exploratory with Test Cases cycles me dikhta hai.

quiz.q: A tester has a question about payouts. Whom should they ask?
o: The TE or TSM, not the TTL
The TTL in the cycle chat
Other testers in the chat room
quiz.w: Payout related sawaal TTL se nahi, TE ya TSM se puchne hain.

quiz.q: Which of these is listed under What Testers Should Not Do?
o: Helping fellow testers in the chat room
Reporting blocking issues to the TTL
Providing feedback thoroughly in the review
quiz.w: Not-do list me VPN use karna, multiple accounts banana, info falsify karna wagaira aate hain.

quiz.q: Reviews in a cycle were never checked before the cycle closed. What happens to them?
quiz.w: Issues aur test cases TTL recommendation pe auto approve/reject hote hain, lekin unchecked reviews sab accept ho jaate hain.

quiz.q: The app crashed once while you were recording, and you could not reproduce it again. What do the notes say?
o: Never report an issue you cannot reproduce
You can report it if you have proof such as video and logs, after checking that one-time issues are not listed as OOS
Report it only after reproducing it 3 times
Report it without attachments and explain in chat
quiz.w: One-time issue ka video aur logs proof ho to report kar sakte ho, bas pehle OOS check karo aur doubt ho to TTL se confirm.

quiz.q: According to the notes, what are the three specific things you can do to build a positive reputation?
o: Pay attention to details, be reliable and submit quality work
Report the most bugs, claim the most slots and reply fastest in chat
Dispute every rejection, ask for approvals and stay active in chat
Use AI for reviews, report quickly and skip the overview
quiz.w: Reputation ke 3 pillar: details pe dhyan, reliable rehna, quality kaam.

quiz.q: You searched for different keywords and each showed the same incorrect results bug. How should these be treated?
o: As separate valid bugs, one per keyword
As duplicates, because issues with the same root cause are considered duplicates
quiz.w: Same root cause = duplicate, chahe alag keywords se ho; isliye ek hi report.

quiz.q: When emailing the TE about a problem, which practice is correct?
o: CC all TSMs so the issue gets solved faster
Use any TE email from your older cycles
Mention the cycle ID in the subject and do not CC or BCC other TEs or TSMs
Start a new email thread for each reply
quiz.w: Subject me cycle ID, polite aur clear content, doosre TEs/TSMs ko CC/BCC nahi, aur ek hi thread me reply.

quiz.q: When should the TSM be contacted according to the notes?
o: For a payout issue, an emergency, or when the TE has not replied after the expected reply time
For any question about the test case steps
quiz.w: TSM sirf payout issue, emergency ya TE ke expected time me reply na karne par.

quiz.q: According to the Effective Written Communication lesson, which phrase should you avoid because it is vague?
o: The homepage is reloaded after clicking on the search suggestions
An error page opens after tapping on the sign-up button
An infinite loading occurs after tapping on the checkout button
quiz.w: Can't, unable, not working jaise vague words problem clearly nahi batate; exactly kya hota hai woh likho.

quiz.q: Which consequences of using AI-written feedback are named in the notes?
o: Automatic Gold rating and more invitations
No consequence as long as the review is grammatically correct
Damaged credibility, reduced opportunities and possible account termination under the Terms of Use
quiz.w: AI feedback se credibility damage, kam opportunities aur Terms of Use/AI Guidelines violation pe account termination tak ho sakta hai.

quiz.q: When testing a website, what must a screenshot include?
o: The entire device screen, including the browser URL bar
Only the cropped area where the bug appears
Only the web page content, without the URL bar
Only the bug area plus the taskbar clock
quiz.w: Rule hai complete screen capture karo, website testing me browser URL bar bhi dikhna chahiye.

quiz.q: Which colors are recommended for the shapes used to highlight a bug in a screenshot?
o: Any color that matches the website theme
quiz.w: Notes me clearly likha hai red ya yellow rectangle, circle ya arrow se highlight karo.

quiz.q: The rule to close or hide unrelated browser tabs applies in which situation?
o: Only when testing on a computer browser
Only when testing a mobile app
quiz.w: Close unnecessary tabs wala rule sirf computer browser testing pe apply hota hai.

quiz.q: In which orientation must every screenshot be?
o: Whatever orientation the device was in when the bug happened
Portrait on mobile and landscape on desktop
quiz.w: Har screenshot upright orientation me hona chahiye, ye screenshot rule hai.

quiz.q: On Windows, what happens when you press only the PrintScreen key?
o: The screenshot is saved to the Pictures folder
The screenshot is copied to the clipboard instead of creating a new file
quiz.w: Sirf PrintScreen dabane se image clipboard me copy hoti hai, phir Paint me Ctrl+V karke paste karte hain.

quiz.q: By default, where are screenshots taken with Windows + PrintScreen saved?
o: In the Screenshots folder inside Pictures
In the ShareX\Screenshots folder inside Documents
quiz.w: Windows + PrintScreen wale screenshots default Pictures ke andar Screenshots folder me jaate hain.

quiz.q: In the Windows + Shift + S snipping bar, which mode should you choose if you want to exclude the taskbar?
o: Rectangular Snip with the taskbar selected
quiz.w: Taskbar exclude karna ho to Window Snip (3rd icon) select karo aur window pe click karo.

quiz.q: In ShareX After capture tasks, which option must be deselected?
quiz.w: ShareX me Upload image to host off rakhna zaroori hai, aur Open in image editor select karna hai.

quiz.q: By default, where does ShareX store screenshots?
o: In the ShareX\Screenshots folder inside Documents
In the Screenshots folder inside Pictures
quiz.w: ShareX default me Documents ke andar ShareX\Screenshots folder me save karta hai.

quiz.q: After drawing the highlight shape in the ShareX image editor, how do you save the screenshot?
quiz.w: ShareX editor me rectangle/circle draw karke Enter dabao, screenshot save ho jata hai.

quiz.q: Which shortcut takes a screenshot with the Xbox Game Bar without opening the Game Bar?
quiz.w: Windows + Alt + PrintScreen se Game Bar khole bina seedha screenshot le sakte ho.

quiz.q: Which settings path can be used to enable the Xbox Game Bar?
o: Settings > System > Display > Xbox Game Bar
Settings > Apps > Startup > Xbox Game Bar
quiz.w: Xbox Game Bar enable karne ke liye Settings > Gaming > Xbox Game Bar me toggle on karo.

quiz.q: What is true about screenshots taken with the Xbox Game Bar?
o: They are uploaded to the cloud automatically
They are only copied to the clipboard
They are saved as a file and exclude the taskbar
quiz.w: Game Bar method screenshot ko file ki tarah save karta hai aur taskbar ko exclude karta hai.

quiz.q: Which keys take a screenshot on macOS according to the lesson?
quiz.w: macOS pe Shift, Command aur 3 ek saath press karke screenshot lete hain.

quiz.q: By default, where does macOS save screenshots?
quiz.w: macOS default me screenshots desktop pe save karta hai.

quiz.q: Which tool is suggested for taking and highlighting screenshots on Linux?
quiz.w: Linux ke liye Flameshot suggest kiya gaya hai, install command sudo apt-get install flameshot hai.

quiz.q: On most Android phones, which buttons take a screenshot first?
o: Power and Volume Down held together for a few seconds
Power and Volume Up pressed together
Volume Up and Volume Down together
quiz.w: Android pe pehla option Power + Volume Down ek saath kuch seconds hold karna hai.

quiz.q: Which Android app does the lesson suggest for highlighting screenshots?
quiz.w: Android pe highlight ke liye iMarkup app try karne ka option diya gaya hai.

quiz.q: How do you take a screenshot on a new iPhone model?
o: Press the Home and power/side buttons together
Triple-tap the back of the phone
Press the Power and Volume Up buttons together
Press the Power and Volume Down buttons together
quiz.w: New iPhone me Power + Volume Up, old iPhone me Home + power/side button.

quiz.q: When highlighting a screenshot with the iOS Markup tool, which Fill and Stroke should you choose?
o: Fill: No Fill, Stroke: Red or Yellow
quiz.w: iOS Markup me shape ka Fill No Fill rakhna hai aur Stroke Red ya Yellow.

quiz.q: When should you record your own voice in a screen recording?
o: Whenever the bug is hard to understand
Only when the video is longer than 1 minute
Only if it is specifically asked by the test cycle
quiz.w: No noise rule: mic mute rakho, voice tabhi record karo jab test cycle specifically bole.

quiz.q: What is the guidance on the length of a screen recording?
o: It must never be longer than 30 seconds
It must always be exactly 1 minute
Length does not matter at all
Try to keep it under 1 minute, but it can be longer if it only shows the required steps
quiz.w: Short rakho, 1 minute se kam try karo, par zaroori steps hi dikh rahe hon to lamba bhi chalega.

quiz.q: From where must a screen recording begin?
o: From the bug report form on the platform
From the moment the bug appears
From the testing website or from opening the app, matching the actions performed
From the device home screen after unlocking
quiz.w: Video actions performed se match hona chahiye aur testing website ya app open karne se start hona chahiye.

quiz.q: How many screen recordings should you upload in one bug report?
quiz.w: One recording per bug report, jab tak zyada zaroori na ho.

quiz.q: When may you use an external camera or a second mobile device to record the screen?
o: Only if the test cycle requests it or software recording is not possible
Whenever the external camera gives better quality
quiz.w: External device sirf tab jab cycle specifically maange ya software se recording possible na ho.

quiz.q: After uploading a recording, what should you always confirm?
o: That it has been shared on a cloud drive
That it includes your microphone audio
That the video can be played inside the platform
quiz.w: Upload ke baad check karo ki video platform ke andar play ho raha hai.

quiz.q: ScreenPal was formerly known as what?
quiz.w: ScreenPal ka purana naam ScreenCast-O-Matic tha.

quiz.q: Before recording with ScreenPal, what should you make sure of?
o: Upload to ScreenPal cloud is selected
Narration (microphone) is off unless narrating, and Size is set to Fullscreen
Narration is on and Size is set to Active Window
quiz.w: ScreenPal me narration off aur Size > Fullscreen confirm karke hi Rec dabao.

quiz.q: In BandiCam's Video tab, which options should be checked?
o: Show mouse cursor and Add mouse click effects
Upload after recording and Show FPS
Hide mouse cursor and Record sound
quiz.w: BandiCam Video tab me Show mouse cursor aur Add mouse click effects check karne hain, Record sound uncheck.

quiz.q: Which is a listed downside of recording with the Xbox Game Bar?
o: It can only save in .avi format
There is no pause button to pause and resume the recording
quiz.w: Game Bar me pause button nahi hota, file badi hoti hai, aur desktop record nahi hota.

quiz.q: What happens if you switch to the desktop while recording with the Xbox Game Bar?
o: The recording pauses until you return
The recording continues and captures the desktop
The recording ends automatically, because Game Bar records only active application windows
The recording switches to audio only
quiz.w: Game Bar sirf active app window record karta hai, desktop pe jaoge to recording khud end ho jaati hai.

quiz.q: In QuickTime Player screen recording Options, what should be selected under Microphone?
quiz.w: QuickTime Options me Microphone None, Show Mouse Clicks on, aur Save to Desktop.

quiz.q: After recording with QuickTime Player, what extension change is required?
quiz.w: QuickTime .mov me save karta hai, file rename karke extension .mp4 karna hai.

quiz.q: Which tool is suggested for screen recording on Linux?
quiz.w: Linux pe Kazam suggest hai, install command sudo apt install kazam -y.

quiz.q: In Kazam, which settings should be in place before capturing?
o: Mouse cursor unselected and Window mode selected
Speaker and microphone sound selected, Fullscreen unselected
Speaker and microphone sound unselected, Mouse cursor and Fullscreen selected
quiz.w: Kazam me dono sound options off, Mouse cursor aur Fullscreen on hone chahiye.

quiz.q: From which Android version is a built-in screen recorder included?
quiz.w: Notes ke hisaab se Android 11 aur uske baad built-in screen recorder aata hai.

quiz.q: In AZ Screen Recorder, which setting should be turned off?
quiz.w: AZ Screen Recorder ki settings me Record audio off karna hai.

quiz.q: How do you enable Developer Options on Android to turn on Show Taps?
o: Long press the Build number for 10 seconds
quiz.w: Build number pe 7 baar tap karo, phir Developer Options me Show Taps on karo.

quiz.q: iOS built-in screen recording is available on devices with which iOS version?
quiz.w: iOS 11 ya usse upar ke devices me built-in screen recording hai.

quiz.q: For how many days is the AirServer free trial available?
quiz.w: AirServer ka free trial 31 din ka hai.

quiz.q: Which is NOT one of the five purposes HandBrake is used for in the lesson?
quiz.w: HandBrake ke 5 purposes: format change, compress, noise remove, orientation, anamorphic fix. Subtitles list me nahi hai.

quiz.q: In HandBrake, where do you fix an anamorphic video?
o: Video tab > set Framerate to Anamorphic
Dimensions tab > Resolutions & Scaling > set Anamorphic to None/Off
Audio tab > set Anamorphic to Auto
quiz.w: Anamorphic fix ke liye Dimensions tab me Resolutions & Scaling ke andar Anamorphic None/Off karo.

quiz.q: Which type of log contains HTTP(S) traffic between your computer and the Internet?
quiz.w: Network logs me computer aur Internet ke beech ka HTTP(S) traffic hota hai, kuch cycles me required.

quiz.q: What do browser console logs contain?
o: Events sent by the system and apps running on a phone
Only the screenshots of each page
Information like network requests, JavaScript, CSS, security errors and warnings
Only the cookies saved by the website
quiz.w: Console logs me web page se related network requests, JS, CSS, security errors aur warnings hote hain.

quiz.q: Where are timestamps visible in a log file?
o: Only at the end of the file
At the beginning of each line or entry
Only in the first line of the file
quiz.w: Timestamp har line ya entry ke shuru me dikhta hai.

quiz.q: In Chrome console preferences, which two options must be selected?
o: Log XMLHttpRequests and Selected Context Only
Show Timestamps and Preserve Log Upon Navigation
Show CORS errors and Autocomplete from history
quiz.w: Chrome console gear me Show Timestamps aur Preserve Log Upon Navigation select karte hain.

quiz.q: After saving a Chrome console log, what should you check inside the file?
o: That it contains only error lines
That it has timestamps and a 'Navigated to' string with the testing website
That it has the HAR header
quiz.w: Log open karke dekho timestamps hain aur 'Navigated to' + testing website wali line hai.

quiz.q: Which shortcut opens the Firefox console in the console logs lesson?
quiz.w: Firefox console ke liye CTRL+Shift+K ya F12.

quiz.q: How do you save console logs in Firefox desktop?
o: Right-click on the console and choose Save all Messages to File
Press Command+S after clicking the console
Right-click and choose Save all as HAR with content
quiz.w: Firefox me console pe right-click karke Save all Messages to File, phir .txt save.

quiz.q: In Firefox, you do not see any timestamps in the console. What should you try?
o: Resize the console frame until timestamps appear
quiz.w: Firefox me timestamps na dikhe to console frame resize karo.

quiz.q: When saving a console log in Safari, what is important?
o: Click the console first before pressing Command+S
Press Command+S before opening Web Inspector
quiz.w: Safari me pehle console pe click karo, phir Command+S, warna sahi save nahi hota.

quiz.q: On Windows 10, how do you show file extensions to rename a log to .txt?
o: File Explorer > View tab > enable File name extensions
quiz.w: File Explorer ke View tab me File name extensions on karo, phir rename karke .txt karo.

quiz.q: What does HAR stand for?
quiz.w: HAR matlab HTTP Archive, browser aur website ka interaction record hota hai.

quiz.q: Which of these is listed as software that supports the HAR format?
quiz.w: HAR support list: Charles, Fiddler, Firebug, Firefox, Chrome, Edge, OWASP ZAP.

quiz.q: Before uploading a HAR file, what must you do if the flow included a password or card number?
o: Remove all instances of that sensitive data from the HAR file
Upload it as a screenshot instead
quiz.w: HAR me sensitive data hota hai, upload se pehle sab instances remove karne hain.

quiz.q: When collecting a HAR log in Chrome, which checkbox should be selected in the Network tab?
quiz.w: Chrome Network tab me Preserve log select karo, phir Clear karke issue reproduce karo.

quiz.q: In Chrome, which option saves the HAR log from the Network tab?
o: Save all as HAR with content
quiz.w: Chrome me logs pe right-click karke Save all as HAR with content, file .har.

quiz.q: In Chrome DevTools, where do you check the Status code of a log entry?
o: Headers tab > General section > Status code
quiz.w: Entry pe click karke Headers tab ke General section me Status code dekho.

quiz.q: In Safari's Network tab, where do you check the status of a log entry?
o: Headers tab > General section > Status code
quiz.w: Safari me Headers tab ke Summary section me Status field hota hai.

quiz.q: When editing a HAR file to remove sensitive data, what should you replace it with?
o: **** or another placeholder text that shows it was redacted
Nothing, delete the whole HAR line
Random fake data that looks real
quiz.w: Sensitive info ko **** ya kisi placeholder se replace karo taaki redacted dikhe.

quiz.q: Which remote debugging support is stated for mobile browsers?
o: Chrome supports it on iOS over USB
Chromium browsers and Firefox support it over USB only for Android; iOS supports it only on Safari
Only Firefox supports it on iOS
All mobile browsers support it over Wi-Fi
quiz.w: Chromium aur Firefox sirf Android pe USB se, iOS pe remote debugging sirf Safari pe.

quiz.q: While collecting iOS Chrome logs via Mac, the open Chrome tab is not listed under your device in the Develop menu. What should you try?
o: Switch the iPhone to airplane mode
Run adb start-server on the Mac
Close and reopen Chrome on the iPhone to refresh the session
quiz.w: Chrome tab Develop menu me na dikhe to iPhone pe Chrome band karke dobara kholo, session refresh hota hai.

quiz.q: Which address do you open in desktop Chrome to remote debug an Android device?
quiz.w: Desktop Chrome me chrome://inspect#devices kholo aur Discover USB devices enabled rakho.

quiz.q: During Chrome remote debugging, your Android device shows as Offline. What should you do?
o: Clear the Chrome cache on the computer
Accept the Allow USB Debugging permission prompt on the Android device
quiz.w: Device Offline dikhe to phone pe Allow USB Debugging prompt accept karo.

quiz.q: If the new DevTools window shows an error after clicking Inspect, what should you try?
o: Click the Inspect fallback option instead
Close desktop Chrome and use Safari
quiz.w: Inspect pe error aaye to Inspect fallback option try karo.

quiz.q: When remote debugging Firefox for Android, how do you save the console log?
o: Right-click the console and choose Export Visible Messages To > File
Right-click and choose Save all as HAR with content
quiz.w: Firefox remote Toolbox me console pe right-click karke Export Visible Messages To > File.

quiz.q: To collect iOS Chrome logs via Mac, where do you turn on Web Inspector on the iPhone?
o: In iOS Settings > Privacy > Analytics Data
In iOS Settings > Apps > Safari > Advanced
In Chrome: Settings > Privacy > Developer Mode
In Chrome: Settings > Content Settings > Web Inspector
quiz.w: iOS Chrome ke liye Chrome ki Settings > Content Settings > Web Inspector on karna hai.

quiz.q: Which tools should always be used to collect Android device logs?
quiz.w: Android logs hamesha adb ya Android Studio se, Syslog/CatLog jaise apps kabhi nahi.

quiz.q: When the device shows an alert to allow the computer connection, what should you do?
o: Check Always allow from this computer and tap Allow
Tap Allow once without checking anything
quiz.w: Alert me Always allow from this computer check karke Allow tap karo.

quiz.q: Your antivirus shows an alert about adb.exe. What should you do?
o: Deactivate the antivirus or add adb.exe to the antivirus exception list
Delete adb.exe and download Android Studio
quiz.w: adb.exe pe antivirus alert aaye to antivirus off karo ya adb.exe ko exception list me daalo.

quiz.q: Which command collects the Android log on Windows in the first method?
quiz.w: Windows pe log collect: adb logcat -d -v time >.\log.txt.

quiz.q: Which command is used in the recommended alternative method on Windows?
o: adb logcat -c, then Ctrl + Z to stop
adb logcat -d -v time, then Ctrl + V
adb logcat -v threadtime >.\log.txt, then Ctrl + C to stop
quiz.w: Recommended method me adb logcat -v threadtime chalao, bug reproduce karo, phir Ctrl + C.

quiz.q: What should you do if you get errors while running adb commands?
o: Run adb kill-server and follow the steps again
quiz.w: adb error aaye to adb kill-server se current processes stop karo aur steps dobara karo.

quiz.q: The Android log file is too large. What does the lesson suggest?
o: Upload only the first half of the file
Close other apps and pages, clear the log with adb logcat -c before opening the app, then reproduce
quiz.w: Bada log ho to baaki apps band karo, adb logcat -c se clear karo, phir app khol ke reproduce.

quiz.q: On macOS, how do the adb commands differ from Windows?
o: They use adb.exe instead of adb
They start with sudo such as sudo adb logcat -c
They start with ./ such as ./adb logcat -c
quiz.w: macOS pe platform-tools folder se commands ./adb se start hoti hain.

quiz.q: Which command installs adb on Fedora/SUSE-based Linux?
quiz.w: Fedora/SUSE pe sudo yum install android-tools, Debian based pe sudo apt-get install adb.

quiz.q: On Windows, a quick way to open Command Prompt inside the platform-tools folder is what?
o: Right-click and choose Open with Notepad
Type cmd in the folder's address bar and hit enter
Press Windows + G inside the folder
quiz.w: platform-tools folder ke address bar me cmd type karke enter karo.

quiz.q: In Android Studio, which project template is selected to get to Logcat?
o: New Project > Basic Views Activity with Logcat
quiz.w: Android Studio me New Project me Empty Activity select karo, Next aur Finish.

quiz.q: In Android Studio, after reproducing the bug, what stops it from capturing extra logs?
quiz.w: Bug reproduce ke baad pause button dabao taaki extra logs capture na hon.

quiz.q: In Android Studio wireless debugging, where do you start pairing?
o: No Device dropdown > Pair device using Wifi > Pair using pairing code tab
quiz.w: Sync ke baad No Device dropdown me Pair device using Wifi, phir pairing code tab.

quiz.q: Which command pairs an Android device over Wi-Fi using CMD?
quiz.w: Pehle adb pair IP:Port PairingCode, phir adb connect IP:NewPort.

quiz.q: You do not see the popup to allow wireless debugging for the first time. What should you do?
o: Tap Revoke USB debugging authorizations and follow all the steps again
quiz.w: Pehli baar popup na aaye to Revoke USB debugging authorizations karke steps phir se karo.

quiz.q: Which tool for iOS device logs works on both Windows and macOS?
quiz.w: iMazing Windows aur macOS dono pe chalta hai, Show Device Console se logs.

quiz.q: 3uTools and iTools are alternatives to iMazing, but they are available on what?
quiz.w: 3uTools aur iTools sirf Windows ke liye available hain.

quiz.q: In the macOS Console App method, what must you do in TextEdit before pasting logs?
o: Change the format to plain text in its preferences
Change the format to rich text
quiz.w: TextEdit preferences me format plain text karo, phir paste karke .txt save.

quiz.q: Which command saves iOS logs to a file on Linux with libimobiledevice?
quiz.w: Linux pe idevicesyslog ko tee ke saath use karke log file me save karte hain.

quiz.q: When collecting iOS crash logs with iTunes, which file types can you upload?
quiz.w: iTunes method me Reports folder se app name aur timestamp wali .log, .crash ya .ips file upload karo.

quiz.q: What are the correct file formats for a Charles Proxy log?
quiz.w: Charles ka log .chls ya .chlz, Fiddler ka .saz.

quiz.q: On Windows, in which certificate store should the Charles Root Certificate be placed?
quiz.w: Install Certificate me Place all certificates in the following store choose karke Trusted Root Certification Authorities select karo.

quiz.q: In Charles SSL Proxy Settings, what should you enter in the Edit Location popup to decrypt all traffic?
quiz.w: Host me * aur Port 443 daalo, * saara traffic decrypt karta hai.

quiz.q: If the firewall or antivirus blocks Charles, what does the lesson recommend?
o: Add Charles as an exception instead of disabling the entire firewall and antivirus
Use a VPN to bypass the firewall
Disable the firewall and antivirus completely
quiz.w: Pura firewall/antivirus band nahi karna, Charles ko exception me add karna hai.

quiz.q: Charles Proxy requires a license purchase if used for more than how long each time?
quiz.w: Charles har baar 30 minute se zyada use karna ho to license chahiye.

quiz.q: Which port should Fiddler show in the Connections tab when connecting a mobile device?
quiz.w: Fiddler mobile setup me port 8866, Charles me 8888.

quiz.q: What is true about Fiddler Everywhere compared to Fiddler Classic?
o: Fiddler Everywhere works only on Linux
Fiddler Everywhere is cross-platform with a 10-day free trial; Fiddler Classic works only on Windows
Fiddler Classic is cross-platform; Fiddler Everywhere works only on Windows
quiz.w: Classic sirf Windows, Everywhere Windows/macOS/Linux pe aur sirf 10 din free trial.

quiz.q: What is the name of the installed Fiddler root certificate?
quiz.w: Fiddler cert ka naam DO_NOT_TRUST_FiddlerRoot, Charles ka Charles Proxy CA.

quiz.q: In which file format is a custom Charles Proxy profile configuration provided in a cycle?
quiz.w: Custom profile ki configuration file .xml format me cycle me di jaati hai, Tools > Import/Export Settings se import.

quiz.q: How do you open Focused Hosts in Charles?
o: View > Focused Hosts or press Ctrl + Shift + O
quiz.w: Focused Hosts ke liye View > Focused Hosts ya Ctrl + Shift + O.

quiz.q: In a Charles log, what does the lightning icon mean?
o: Data that has not been decrypted
Decrypted traffic from websites using HTTP/2.0
Decrypted traffic from websites using HTTP/1.1
quiz.w: Lightning icon matlab HTTP/2.0 ka decrypted traffic, blue circle HTTP/1.1.

quiz.q: Without a Wi-Fi router, how can you collect Charles logs from a mobile device?
o: Connect the phone with a USB cable only
Use a secondary mobile device as a hotspot and connect both the computer and test phone to it
Use a VPN on both devices
Collect logs without a network connection
quiz.w: Router na ho to secondary device ka mobile hotspot use karo, computer aur testing phone dono usi pe.

quiz.q: When using Firefox on a mobile device with Charles, which hidden setting must be enabled?
o: Enable Full Trust For Root Certificates in Firefox
Use third party CA certificates in Secret Settings
quiz.w: About Firefox me logo 5 baar tap karo, Secret Settings me Use third party CA certificates enable karo.

quiz.q: You cannot connect to the internet after setting up Charles on your phone. What does the FAQ suggest?
o: Reset the phone to factory settings
Add the phone's local IP address in Proxy > Access Control Settings
quiz.w: Proxy > Access Control Settings me Add karke phone ka local IP daalo.

quiz.q: You did not get any allow connection prompt in Charles when opening a site on your phone. What should you check first?
o: That the computer's Wi-Fi connection option is set to Public, not Private
That Charles is set to port 8866
That the log is saved as .saz
That the phone's battery saver is on
quiz.w: Allow prompt na aaye to computer ka WiFi Public pe set hai ya nahi check karo, phir dono devices restart.

quiz.q: According to the lesson, which statement about PII is correct?
o: PII includes other people's information too, such as an address shared by many residents
PII only means your own personal information
An address is never PII if many people live there
quiz.w: PII sirf apni info nahi, kisi aur ki bhi ho sakti hai, jaise shared address.

quiz.q: Under GDPR, what does 'processing' personal data mean?
o: Any operation such as storing, sharing or collecting that data
quiz.w: GDPR me processing matlab storing, sharing, collecting jaisa koi bhi operation.

quiz.q: Which privacy law is listed for Brazil?
o: Act on the Protection of Personal Information
Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD)
quiz.w: Brazil ke liye LGPD listed hai.

quiz.q: Which privacy law is listed for Australia?
quiz.w: Australia ke liye Consumer Data Right (CDR).

quiz.q: Which is one of the two reasons given for blurring PII?
o: To hide bugs from the developers
To make screenshots look more colorful
To make the video file smaller
quiz.w: Do reasons: khud aur doosron ko protect karna, aur platform aur customers laws ke andar data protect kar sakein.

quiz.q: Which of these is listed as PII that testers may need to redact?
quiz.w: PII list me MAC, IP address, device IDs, cookies jaise items bhi hain.

quiz.q: Which item in the PII list is often forgotten on mobile recordings?
o: The keyboard while typing any PII
quiz.w: Typing karte waqt keyboard bhi PII list me hai, use bhi blur karna hai.

quiz.q: A cycle asks for partial redaction. What might that mean?
o: Redact only the last few letters or digits, or redact with a color the same as the background
Redact only the video, not the screenshots
Redact only half of the screenshots
quiz.w: Partial redaction me sirf last kuch letters/digits ya background jaisa color use hota hai.

quiz.q: You are unsure what PII to redact in a cycle. What should you do?
o: Ask another tester in a private message
Read the cycle overview and consult a TTL/TE
quiz.w: Doubt ho to overview padho aur TTL/TE se confirm karo.

quiz.q: Some projects ask you to record the whole flow with real data. Who hides the sensitive info then?
o: Nobody, real data is sent as is
The client after receiving the video
The TTL/TE of the project, before the videos go to the client
quiz.w: Aise projects me TTL/TE videos client ko dene se pehle sensitive info hide karte hain.

quiz.q: In MS Paint, how should the rectangle be set to block PII?
o: Fill > Solid color, with Color 1 and Color 2 set to black
Fill > No fill, with Color 1 set to red
quiz.w: Paint me Rectangle, Fill > Solid color, aur Color 1 aur Color 2 dono black.

quiz.q: What spacing rule applies to a redaction box?
o: The box should cover the whole row of fields
There should be a visible gap between the box and other text or lines, without overlapping labels
The box should touch the nearby text
The box should cover the field label too
quiz.w: Box poora PII cover kare par labels/fields overlap na kare, beech me visible gap ho.

quiz.q: How do you capture a full page in Microsoft Edge?
o: Right-click > Take Screenshot > Save full page
F12 > Run command > Capture full-size screenshot
Three dots menu > Web Capture > Capture full page
quiz.w: Edge me three dots > Web Capture > Capture full page > Save.

quiz.q: How do you capture a full page in Firefox?
o: Three dots > Web Capture > Capture full page
Right-click an empty area > Take Screenshot > Save full page
quiz.w: Firefox me empty area pe right-click > Take Screenshot > Save full page > Download.

quiz.q: Using Chrome Print to PDF for a page with more than one page, which paper size is selected under More Settings?
quiz.w: Print > Save as PDF me ek se zyada page ho to More Settings me Tabloid paper size.

quiz.q: Which Chrome DevTools command captures a full-size page screenshot?
o: Network tab > Save all as HAR
Run command (Ctrl+Shift+P), type Screenshot, select Capture full-size screenshot
quiz.w: DevTools me Ctrl+Shift+P, Screenshot type karke Capture full-size screenshot.

quiz.q: Mobile Chrome Long Screenshot needs which minimum Chrome version?
quiz.w: Mobile Chrome me Long Screenshot ke liye Chrome 96+ chahiye.

quiz.q: In LibreOffice, which option exports the redacted PDF with black boxes?
quiz.w: Export Redacted PDF (Black) se box black dikhta hai aur file non-editable ho jaati hai.

quiz.q: How do you confirm a redacted PDF is properly flattened?
o: Open it in a video editor
Check that the file name ends with _redacted
Check that the file size increased
Test that links are no longer active and text cannot be copied and pasted
quiz.w: Flattened PDF me link active nahi hona chahiye aur text copy-paste nahi hona chahiye.

quiz.q: What tip is given for redacting PII that moves in a video?
o: Speed up the video so PII is unreadable
Redact the PII when static, then create a second redaction for when it is moving
Blur the entire video from start to end
quiz.w: Static PII pe ek redaction, moving PII ke liye doosra redaction, poora screen blur mat karo.

quiz.q: What are the two main testing methodologies used in functional testing cycles?
o: Exploratory testing and Test Case (Scripted) testing
quiz.w: Do main methodologies: Exploratory aur Test Case (Scripted), cycle me ek ya dono ho sakte hain.

quiz.q: Which testing type is performed after unit testing and checks a broader module, like the full login module?
quiz.w: Unit ke baad Component testing, jaise password validator ke baad poora login module.

quiz.q: What is the main purpose of smoke testing?
o: To have real users approve the release
To check that the most critical functions work after a new build, so deeper testing can start
To test every feature in full detail
To test the system under heavy load
quiz.w: Smoke test new build ke baad critical functions check karta hai ki system stable hai ya nahi.

quiz.q: How does regression testing differ from sanity testing?
o: Regression only checks the changed area
Regression also covers other parts of the system that could be affected, not just the changed area
Regression is done before smoke testing
