quiz.w: Regression impacted area ke saath doosre affected parts bhi cover karta hai, sanity sirf recent change.

quiz.q: An e-commerce app sends payment details to a third-party gateway and reads its Success or Failure reply. Which testing type checks this?
quiz.w: Do systems ke beech communication jaise API ya payment gateway, ye Interface testing hai.

quiz.q: Which testing type is typically performed at the end of the SDLC by real users or clients?
quiz.w: UAT end me hota hai, real users/clients verify karte hain ki business needs meet ho rahi hain.

quiz.q: In which SDLC phase are use cases, data flow diagrams and functional specification documents created?
quiz.w: Analysis phase me requirements detail me analyze hoti hain, use cases aur DFD bante hain.

quiz.q: Feasibility analysis, risk assessment and resource allocation happen in which SDLC phase?
quiz.w: Planning phase me scope, feasibility, risk assessment aur resource allocation hota hai.

quiz.q: Which challenge of manual testing is stated in the lesson?
o: Performance, stress and load testing are practically impossible to do manually
Manual testing always needs coding skills
Manual testing cannot find any UI bugs
Manual testing cannot judge user experience
quiz.w: Performance, stress, load testing manually karna practically impossible hai, ye manual challenge hai.

quiz.q: Using Equivalence Class Partitioning for a field that accepts 1 to 100, which set of inputs covers each class?
quiz.w: Har class se ek value: invalid (<1) -25, valid 50, invalid (>100) 125.

quiz.q: A streaming site gives discounts based on plan length and whether the user is new or existing. Which technique ensures every combination is tested?
quiz.w: Conditions ke combinations ko table me map karna Decision Table testing hai.

quiz.q: Functional testing primarily relies on which kind of techniques?
quiz.w: Functional testing mostly Black Box hai, internal code ki knowledge zaroori nahi.

quiz.q: In exploratory testing cycles, how are testers typically paid?
o: For approved bug reports and work, not an hourly rate
A fixed amount per cycle joined
quiz.w: Exploratory cycles me payment approved bugs aur work ke liye hota hai, hourly nahi.

quiz.q: Which is listed as a pro of Scripted Testing?
o: It finds more unexpected edge-case bugs than exploratory testing
It needs almost no upfront preparation
It is well-suited for high-risk applications needing strict compliance, like banking or healthcare
It adapts instantly to changing requirements
quiz.w: Scripted testing banking/healthcare jaise high-risk compliance apps ke liye suited hai.

quiz.q: Which misconception about exploratory testing does the lesson correct?
o: That exploratory testers design and execute tests at the same time
That notes help reproduce exploratory bugs
That only an experienced tester can do exploratory testing
That exploratory testing involves learning about the product
quiz.w: Myth hai ki sirf experienced tester ET kar sakta hai, actually koi bhi seekhne wala tester kar sakta hai.

quiz.q: Which is the first Academy practice test cycle in the list?
quiz.w: List me pehla Introduction to Testing hai, phir Computer, Mobile Device, Charles Proxy, Challenge, All Stars.

quiz.q: How does a tester join the Academy All Stars cycle?
o: By clicking the blue sign up button
The Academy team selects and invites qualifying testers; testers cannot sign up
By requesting it in the test cycle chat
By passing only the Introduction to Testing cycle
quiz.w: All Stars ke liye sign up nahi hota, Academy team qualifying testers ko invite karti hai.

quiz.q: What must a tester do to qualify for the All Stars cycle?
o: Pass all 5 prior Academy practice cycles with valuable, well-written, nearly error-free issue reports
Report at least 10 bugs in one cycle
Complete the quiz with 10 correct answers only
quiz.w: All Stars ke liye pehle ke 5 cycles pass aur reports valuable, well-written, nearly error-free.

quiz.q: How does approved work in practice cycles help a tester?
o: It raises the tester rating over time, giving more chances of paid test cycles
It is paid at the same rate as paid cycles
It allows skipping the next practice cycle
It removes the need to take quizzes
quiz.w: Approved work se tester rating badhti hai, aur high rating se paid cycles ke chances badhte hain.

quiz.q: When is the blue sign up button for a practice cycle activated?
o: Once the tester passes the quiz
As soon as the tester creates an account
quiz.w: Blue sign up button quiz pass karne ke baad active hota hai.

quiz.q: Can a tester sign up again for a practice cycle they have already completed?
o: No, they cannot sign up for a cycle they already completed
Only after the All Stars cycle
quiz.w: Already completed cycle ke liye dobara sign up nahi kar sakte, next course pe jao.

quiz.q: Within how long after the issue and test case are approved is the Pass grade assigned during active cycles?
quiz.w: Issue aur test case approve hone ke 12 se 24 ghante me Pass grade mil jata hai.

quiz.q: For testers who did not get an early Pass grade, when are Pass or Fail grades assigned?
o: Immediately after the first bug is reported
When the tester asks in chat
After the test cycle is closed
quiz.w: Baaki testers ko Pass/Fail grade cycle close hone ke baad milta hai.

quiz.q: A tester fails an Academy level. What can they do?
o: Ask the TTL to change the grade
Sign up again for the same Academy level
Wait one month before any sign up
Move on to the next level anyway
quiz.w: Fail hone pe same Academy level ke liye dobara sign up kar sakte ho.

quiz.q: What happens after a tester completes all five Academy practice cycles?
o: They are removed from the Academy
They receive an Academy graduation email
They must repeat the Introduction cycle
They get paid for all five cycles
quiz.w: Paancho practice cycles complete karne pe Academy graduation ka email aata hai.

quiz.q: How many issue reports can a tester submit in the Introduction to Testing cycle?
quiz.w: Is cycle me sirf ek issue report allowed hai.

quiz.q: Your issue report in the Introduction to Testing cycle is found invalid. What happens?
o: You are removed from the cycle
You are asked to discard it, and you can then report another valid issue
You must wait for the next cycle to report again
quiz.w: Invalid report discard karne ko bola jata hai, phir aap ek naya valid issue report kar sakte ho.

quiz.q: What happens to issue reports that the tester does not fix after an info request?
o: They are moved to the next cycle
quiz.w: Info request ke baad fix nahi kiya to report reject ho jaati hai.

quiz.q: Why do testers not need to worry about duplicates in the Introduction to Testing cycle?
o: Only one tester joins each cycle
Issues reported by other testers are hidden from view
quiz.w: Is cycle me doosre testers ke issues hidden hote hain, isliye duplicates ki tension nahi.

quiz.q: You passed the Introduction to Testing cycle before and signed up again, but got no invitation. Why?
o: A tester who passed it once cannot join the same course again and should continue with the next one
The sign up button was not blue
The quiz must be retaken first
Invitations are only sent on Fridays
quiz.w: Ek baar pass ho gaye to same course dobara join nahi kar sakte, next course pe jao.

quiz.q: If you have not passed yet but still get no invitation, which request category should you select when contacting support?
quiz.w: Support contact karte waqt Academy (on-boarding & training) category select karo.

quiz.q: Can you add a video to your issue report in the Introduction to Testing cycle?
o: Yes, and then no screenshot is needed
Only if the TTL approves it first
Yes, but a labeled screenshot is still mandatory
quiz.w: Video add kar sakte ho, par labeled screenshot is cycle me mandatory hai.

quiz.q: A Store Locator link on the Homepage leads to a not found error page. What is the correct area in the title?
quiz.w: Area wo page hai jahan bug hota hai, yahan Homepage, error page nahi.

quiz.q: You could not report a valid bug before the cycle locked. What should you do?
o: Sign up for the Introduction to Testing cycle again
Skip to the Computer Testing cycle
Ask another tester to report it for you
quiz.w: Cycle lock hone se pehle complete nahi hua to Introduction to Testing ke liye dobara sign up karo.

quiz.q: How many questions must be answered correctly in the quiz before signing up for the cycle?
quiz.w: Reference Links ke hisaab se 10 questions sahi answer karne hote hain.

quiz.q: Which STLC phase produces the test summary report and lessons learned?
quiz.w: Test Closure STLC ka last phase hai, yahan report aur learnings banti hain.

quiz.q: Which activity is an example of verification?
quiz.w: Verification bina app chalaye hoti hai (documents, design, code review), isliye design review verification hai.

quiz.q: The absence-of-errors fallacy means:
o: If no bugs are found, the product is ready
A bug-free product that does not meet user needs is still a failure
Errors are absent when testing is exhaustive
quiz.w: Bug-free ho par user ki zaroorat poori na kare to product bekaar hai, yahi fallacy hai.

quiz.q: 'Testing shows the presence of defects' means:
o: Testing proves the software is bug-free
Testing can show bugs exist but cannot prove there are none
Every defect will be found if you test enough
quiz.w: Testing bug dikha sakti hai, par ye prove nahi kar sakti ki koi bug bacha hi nahi.

quiz.q: A narrow, focused check of one area right after a small fix is:
quiz.w: Sanity = narrow but deep, sirf us changed area ka jaldi check.

quiz.q: Checking that a new change did not break features that already worked is:
quiz.w: Regression check karta hai ki purana chalta hua feature naye change se toota to nahi.

quiz.q: A crash in a rarely used legacy report is usually:
quiz.w: Crash ka impact bada (high severity), par kam use hota hai to fix ki jaldi kam (low priority).

quiz.q: Who usually decides the priority of a bug?
o: The business side, such as the product manager or client
quiz.w: Priority business ke hisaab se tay hoti hai, isliye manager ya client decide karta hai.

quiz.q: Testing that the PO and Invoice modules exchange data correctly is:
quiz.w: Integration testing check karti hai ki modules aapas me sahi baat kar rahe hain.

quiz.q: Testing that uses knowledge of the internal code and logic is:
quiz.w: White box me code ke andar ka logic jaan ke test karte hain, jaise unit tests.

quiz.q: Testing through the UI while also checking API responses and logs is:
quiz.w: Grey box me thoda andar ka pata hota hai (API, logs) aur test UI se hota hai.

quiz.q: Alpha testing is:
o: Testing after the product is live
Internal testing by the company before release
Testing only the first module built
Testing by real users in their own environment
quiz.w: Alpha ghar ke andar hota hai (internal team), beta bahar ke real users karte hain.

quiz.q: Which is an entry criterion for testing?
o: A stable build is deployed and the environment is ready
The test summary report is signed off
All planned test cases have been executed
quiz.w: Entry criteria = testing shuru karne ki shart, jaise build aur environment ready. Baaki options exit criteria hain.

quiz.q: A detailed document for one release with scope, schedule, resources and entry/exit criteria is:
quiz.w: Test plan ek specific release ka detailed document hai; strategy high-level approach hai.

quiz.q: A one-line statement of what to test, like 'Verify login', is a:
quiz.w: Scenario = KYA test karna hai ek line me; test case me detailed steps hote hain.

quiz.q: What are the four statuses of a test cycle on the platform?
quiz.w: Cycle ke 4 status: Pending Activation, Active, Locked, Closed.

quiz.q: Once a cycle is Locked, what can a tester still edit?
o: Only items in Info Requested status
Nothing at all, including info requests
quiz.w: Locked cycle me sirf Info Requested wale items edit ho sakte hain.

quiz.q: After adding the information asked in an Info Request, what should you click?
quiz.w: Info add karke 'Confirm all requested info is added' click karo, tab status wapas New hota hai.

quiz.q: Which rejection type does NOT lower the tester rating?
quiz.w: WAD ke alawa har rejection rating giraata hai.

quiz.q: Which rejection type has a double negative impact on rating?
quiz.w: DNFI ka double negative asar hota hai, isliye instructions dhyan se follow karo.

quiz.q: A report is rejected as INF. What does that mean?
o: The bug is a known issue
The report is out of scope
The requested information was not provided
quiz.w: INF tab lagta hai jab maangi gayi info nahi di gayi.

quiz.q: A bug report waiting for the TE or customer to finalise it has which status?
quiz.w: Pending status me TE ya customer final decision lete hain.

quiz.q: In which bug report statuses can a tester edit the report?
quiz.w: Edit sirf New aur Info Requested me hota hai; Pending aur Approved me nahi.

quiz.q: You find a bug that is already reported in the cycle. What should you do?
o: Add a +1 on that report with reproduction and an attachment
Report it in the cycle chat as a new bug
File a new report with better steps
quiz.w: Duplicate report mat banao, existing report pe +1 do; approve hone pe rating me chhota boost milta hai.

quiz.q: An approved bug marked Won't Fix (WNF) means:
o: The bug was rejected as invalid
The tester must retest it later
The bug is valid and approved, but the customer does not plan to fix it
quiz.w: WNF = bug sahi aur approved hai, bas customer fix nahi karna chahta.

quiz.q: According to the Academy, the payout for an approved bug depends on its:
quiz.w: Academy rule: payout bug ki VALUE pe depend karta hai, severity pe nahi.

quiz.q: What rating premium does a Gold tester get on approved reports?
quiz.w: Gold 10%, Silver 5%, Bronze 2.5% premium milta hai.

quiz.q: How often is the tester rating recalculated?
quiz.w: Rating har raat recalculate hoti hai aur baaki testers se compare hoti hai.

quiz.q: Unrated and Rated testers can have at most how many unapproved issues in one cycle?
quiz.w: Unrated aur Rated testers ke liye ek cycle me max 5 unapproved issues.

quiz.q: Which is NOT a test case step status on the platform?
quiz.w: Step status: Pass, Fail, Blocked, Not Executed, Skipped. Deferred inme nahi hai.

quiz.q: A bug fix verification (BFV) test case is not submitted within 2 hours. What happens?
quiz.w: BFV test case 2 ghante me submit na ho to auto-unclaim ho jata hai.

quiz.q: On which dates are testers paid?
o: The 15th and the last day of the month
quiz.w: Payment mahine me do baar: 15 tareekh aur aakhri tareekh.

quiz.q: Where should you ask a question about your payout?
o: The TE or TSM, not the cycle chat
The cycle chat, so everyone sees it
quiz.w: Paise ki baat TE ya TSM se karo; cycle chat me payout ki baat nahi.

quiz.q: How many fields does the Academy issue report have?
quiz.w: Academy ke issue report me 12 fields hain, Title se Attachments tak.

quiz.q: On the platform's issue form, the 'Priority' field actually represents:
o: How fast the tester submitted it
quiz.w: Form me field ka naam Priority hai, par ye severity hi hai.

quiz.q: What are the options for the Source field?
quiz.w: Source do tarah ka: Exploratory ya Structured (test case se).

quiz.q: Using 'Fail & Report Issue' from a test case automatically sets the Source to:
quiz.w: Test case se 'Fail & Report Issue' karne pe Source khud Structured ho jata hai.

quiz.q: If you have nothing to add in Additional Environment Info, you should:
quiz.w: Academy rule: kuch na ho to Additional Environment Info khali chhodo.

quiz.q: What title format did the Academy Intro cycle use?
quiz.w: Intro cycle format: Device - Area - Description, jaise 'Windows 10 - Homepage - ...'.

quiz.q: Which is NOT allowed in a bug title per the Academy rules?
o: Writing the whole title in ALL CAPS
Starting each sentence with a capital letter
Naming the correct area, like Cart
quiz.w: Title me ALL CAPS mana hai; area aur overview ka format follow karna zaroori hai.

quiz.q: When should you put the browser name in the title?
o: Only when the cycle overview asks for it
quiz.w: Browser ka naam title me tabhi jab overview bole.

quiz.q: Which screenshot formats are accepted?
quiz.w: Screenshot .jpg ya .png me hona chahiye.

quiz.q: How should you mark the defect on a screenshot?
o: No marking, the reviewer will find it
A blue blur over the bug
A red or yellow rectangle, circle or arrow
quiz.w: Red ya yellow rectangle/circle/arrow use karo, haath se drawing nahi.

quiz.q: What is the maximum number of screenshots per report?
quiz.w: Ek report me 2 se zyada screenshot nahi.

quiz.q: Which video format is accepted for bug reports?
quiz.w: Video sirf .mp4 me.

quiz.q: How long should a bug video ideally be?
o: Under 1 minute, showing only the needed steps
Exactly 30 seconds of the home screen
quiz.w: Video chhota, 1 min se kam, sirf zaroori steps.

quiz.q: How many videos can be attached to one report?
quiz.w: Ek report me ek hi video.

quiz.q: Logs should be attached as:
quiz.w: Logs .txt me, timestamps ke saath.

quiz.q: A Charles proxy log should be attached as:
quiz.w: Charles log poora .chls/.chlz upload karo.

quiz.q: Storing bug attachments in a personal cloud drive is:
quiz.w: Attachments cloud me store karna Terms of Use ka violation hai.

quiz.q: The app freezes and does not respond for more than 10 seconds. Issue type?
quiz.w: Academy me 10 second se zyada freeze/unresponsive = Performance issue.

quiz.q: Which is NOT one of the five Academy issue types?
quiz.w: 5 types: Functional, Visual, Content, Performance, Crash. Usability inme nahi.

quiz.q: Which is a valid frequency option on the issue form?
quiz.w: Frequency options: Every time, Occasionally, Hardly ever, Once.

quiz.q: Where should you note the ratio for an intermittent bug, like 3/5?
quiz.w: Kitne try me kitni baar aaya, ye Additional Environment Info me likho.

quiz.q: Actions Performed should start from:
o: The step where the bug appears
quiz.w: Steps numbered hon aur site/app kholne se shuru hon.

quiz.q: Per the Academy, which is an example of a Critical issue?
quiz.w: Academy example: crash, freeze ya privacy breach = Critical.

quiz.q: Expected: the order confirmation page opens. Which actual result is best?
o: The confirmation page does not open
A blank page appears with the message 'Something went wrong (500)'
quiz.w: Actual exactly batata hai kya hua, error text ke saath; sirf expected ka ulta nahi.

quiz.q: In functional testing, the actual output is compared with:
o: The expected result from the requirements
quiz.w: Functional testing me input do, output dekho aur requirement ke expected se match karo.

quiz.q: After placing an order, the user presses the browser Back button. What should happen?
o: The order is not submitted again
The app logs the user out of every device
quiz.w: Back button se duplicate order nahi banna chahiye, ye navigation ka important check hai.

quiz.q: A user fills half a form, switches to another app and returns. Good expected behaviour?
o: The entered data is still there
The app opens the login screen every time
quiz.w: Background-foreground switch pe data bana rehna chahiye.

quiz.q: Rotating the phone from portrait to landscape while filling a form should:
o: Keep the entered data and adjust the layout
quiz.w: Rotation pe layout adjust ho, par data na jaye.

quiz.q: The user denies camera permission. What is the expected behaviour?
o: The app opens the camera anyway
The app handles it gracefully with a clear message
quiz.w: Permission deny karne pe app gracefully handle kare, crash nahi.

quiz.q: Switching from Wi-Fi to mobile data in the middle of an upload tests:
quiz.w: Network badalna mobile ka important test hai: upload toot to nahi gaya, message sahi hai?

quiz.q: Which is a negative test for a phone number field?
o: Entering the number with the country code if allowed
Copying a valid number from contacts
quiz.w: Phone me letters dena galat input hai, yani negative test.

quiz.q: A required Name field receives only spaces. The expected result is:
o: The spaces are converted to the user's email
It is saved as a valid name
It is rejected as empty with a validation message
quiz.w: Sirf spaces wala input khali maana jaana chahiye aur error dikhna chahiye.

quiz.q: A quantity field accepts 1 to 100. Entering -5 is:
quiz.w: Range ke bahar ki galat value = negative test.

quiz.q: The cart shows the wrong total amount. Which bug type?
quiz.w: Galat result = kaam galat = Functional.

quiz.q: Button text is cut off at the edge of the button. Which bug type?
quiz.w: Dikhne ki problem (cut text, overlap) = Visual.

quiz.q: The French version shows a wrong translation. Which bug type?
quiz.w: Text khud galat (translation, spelling) = Content.

quiz.q: Which is a good exploratory testing charter?
o: Explore checkout with different payment options and network changes
quiz.w: Charter ek clear goal deta hai, jaise checkout ko payment options aur network changes ke saath explore karna.

quiz.q: Why do you take notes during an exploratory session?
o: To record what you tried and found and plan the next area
Notes are not needed in exploratory testing
quiz.w: Exploratory = Charter + Timer + Notes; notes se next area decide hota hai.

quiz.q: During your smoke check, login is completely broken. What do you do?
o: Wait for another tester to report it
Skip it because it is too obvious
Keep testing other areas and report it at the end
Report it immediately and inform the TTL
quiz.w: Block mila to turant report karo aur TTL ko batao, sabka time bachta hai.

quiz.q: Which accounts and test data should you use in a cycle?
o: Random accounts you create without instructions
Only those provided by the cycle
quiz.w: Sirf cycle ka diya hua data aur accounts use karo.

quiz.q: Why write the test data you used in the bug report?
o: So the bug can be reproduced
quiz.w: Test data report me likho taaki koi bhi bug reproduce kar sake.

quiz.q: Thinking like a careless user mainly leads you to try:
o: Negative inputs, edge cases and interruptions
quiz.w: Shaitaan user jaisa socho: galat input, kinare ke cases, interruptions.

quiz.q: When should cosmetic checks be done in a cycle?
o: Only on the last day after lock
After core flows and edge cases
quiz.w: Pehle paisa wala raasta, phir kinare, phir sajawat.

quiz.q: Which of these is NOT a functional test?
o: Applying a valid coupon at checkout
Measuring page load time with 1,000 users
Searching for a product by name
quiz.w: Load ke saath time measure karna non-functional (performance) hai.

quiz.q: Creating an invoice from a PO and checking the values carry over correctly tests:
quiz.w: Do modules (PO aur invoice) ka saath kaam karna = integration.

quiz.q: Why test pasting text into a field that blocks letters while typing?
o: Pasted input may bypass keystroke validation
Paste is always blocked by browsers
quiz.w: Copy-paste se kabhi typing wali validation bypass ho jaati hai.

quiz.q: A field allows up to 50 characters. You enter 51. The expected result is:
o: The extra character is saved silently
Input is limited or a validation error appears
quiz.w: Max length se zyada input block ho ya error dikhe.

quiz.q: The user stays idle past the session timeout and then clicks Save. Expected:
o: The save works with no session
The data of another user loads
The session expires and the user is asked to log in again
quiz.w: Session timeout ke baad action pe dobara login maangna chahiye.

quiz.q: Tapping a push notification should usually:
o: Open the relevant screen in the app
quiz.w: Push notification tap karne pe sahi screen khulni chahiye.

quiz.q: Which shortcut starts recording with Xbox Game Bar on Windows?
quiz.w: Xbox Game Bar se record ke liye Win+Alt+R.

quiz.q: On Android, where is the built-in screen recorder usually found?
quiz.w: Android me Screen Record Quick Settings me hota hai.

quiz.q: A video is larger than the upload limit. Which tool can compress it?
quiz.w: Bada video ho to HandBrake se compress karo.

quiz.q: Which DevTools tab shows JavaScript errors in red?
quiz.w: Console tab me red errors dikhte hain.

quiz.q: In the Network tab, which status codes point to failed requests?
quiz.w: Failed requests 4xx (client) ya 5xx (server) status ke hote hain.

quiz.q: A request returns status 500. This is a:
o: Client typo in the URL only
quiz.w: 5xx = server side error, 500 Internal Server Error.

quiz.q: A request returns status 404. This means:
quiz.w: 404 = Not Found, ek 4xx client error.

quiz.q: Which command captures only the Android crash buffer?
quiz.w: Crash ke liye adb logcat -b crash.

quiz.q: How do you save Android logs to a text file?
quiz.w: adb logcat ka output > se file me save hota hai.

quiz.q: What must be installed on the laptop to use adb?
quiz.w: adb Android platform-tools ka hissa hai.

quiz.q: Besides Developer options, which phone setting is needed for adb?
quiz.w: Developer options ke baad USB debugging on karna padta hai.

quiz.q: Which command shows the Windows version?
quiz.w: Windows version ke liye winver command.

quiz.q: Where do you find the Android model and version?
quiz.w: Android details Settings → About phone me milte hain.

quiz.q: How do you simulate a slow network in the browser?
quiz.w: DevTools → Network → throttling se slow net simulate hota hai.

quiz.q: On a phone, an easy way to test offline behaviour mid-flow is:
o: Turn on airplane mode during the flow
quiz.w: Beech flow me airplane mode on karo aur dekho app crash to nahi hota.

quiz.q: Can you use an emulator for platform testing?
o: No, only real devices listed in your profile
quiz.w: Platform rule: emulators, simulators mana hain; sirf profile wale asli device.

quiz.q: Which of these is allowed for platform testing?
o: A real phone listed in your profile
quiz.w: Jailbroken, remote machine, beta software sab mana; real profile device hi chalega.

quiz.q: DevTools device mode can be used for:
o: Your own understanding only, not platform testing
quiz.w: Device mode sirf apni samajh ke liye, testing real device pe.

quiz.q: Per the Academy, a screenshot should capture:
o: Only the bug area cropped tightly
A photo of the monitor from your phone
The full screen with the URL bar and unnecessary tabs closed
quiz.w: Poori screen URL bar ke saath capture karo, faltu tabs band.

quiz.q: Where should bug recordings be saved before upload?
quiz.w: Recording sirf local machine pe; cloud me rakhna Terms of Use violation.

quiz.q: Can you add a cycle's bug screenshots to your personal portfolio?
o: Yes, if you blur the logo
Yes, if the bug was approved
No, cycle material stays inside the platform
quiz.w: Confidentiality: screenshots aur bugs platform ke bahar kabhi nahi, portfolio me bhi nahi.

quiz.q: Which of these is covered by confidentiality?
o: The customer's name, features and bugs from a cycle
quiz.w: Cycle, customer ka naam, features, bugs sab confidential hain.

quiz.q: Which of these is NOT PII?
quiz.w: Browser version kisi insaan ko identify nahi karta, baaki sab PII hain.

quiz.q: Your screenshot shows a real customer's email address. What do you do?
o: Blur or mask it before attaching
Write the email in the title
Send it to the TTL by personal email
quiz.w: PII dikha = blur karo.

quiz.q: When can you use your own real personal data in a cycle?
o: Only when the cycle explicitly requires it
quiz.w: Real data sirf tab jab cycle saaf bole.

quiz.q: When should a password appear in a bug report?
o: Only if the cycle instructs it
quiz.w: Credentials report me sirf instruct kiye jaane pe.

quiz.q: Reusing your personal password for test accounts is:
o: Fine if the password is strong
Not allowed, never reuse personal passwords
quiz.w: Apna personal password kabhi reuse nahi karna.

quiz.q: Why turn on MFA for your tester account?
o: It removes the need for a password
It adds a second check beyond the password
quiz.w: MFA password ke upar extra layer deta hai, account safe rehta hai.

quiz.q: Should card details ever appear in a screenshot or report?
o: Yes, the last 4 digits and CVV
Yes, if it is a real card
quiz.w: Card details kabhi screenshot ya report me nahi.

quiz.q: Your bug video is uploaded to the platform. What about the local copy?
o: Keep it forever in a personal folder
Upload it to cloud as backup
quiz.w: Upload ke baad local files delete karo, kuch personal folder me na rahe.

quiz.q: You are on public Wi-Fi at a cafe. What should you avoid?
quiz.w: Public Wi-Fi pe sensitive testing avoid karo.

quiz.q: Which is a common sign of a phishing email?
o: The sender domain does not match the real platform
quiz.w: Sender domain check karo; nakli domain = phishing.

quiz.q: You find a vulnerability that exposes data. Is it OK to explore further to see how much data you can get?
o: Yes, if you delete it later
Yes, more data makes a better report
No, do not exploit it or access more data
quiz.w: Report karo, chhedo mat; aage exploit ya data nikalna mana hai.

quiz.q: Security testing is not mentioned in scope and you find a security issue. You should:
quiz.w: Security scope me na ho to TTL se poochho.

quiz.q: Before attaching logs, what should you remove or mask?
quiz.w: Logs me tokens, cookies, passwords mask karo; timestamps to chahiye.

quiz.q: Your screenshot shows a personal chat notification. What do you do?
o: Retake or mask it so only the bug is visible
Mention the chat in the report
quiz.w: Proof me sirf bug dikhe, tumhari personal cheez nahi.

quiz.q: Why does a data leak by a tester matter?
o: It only affects the tester's rating slightly
It has no effect on unreleased apps
It only matters for paid cycles
It harms the customer, the platform's trust and can close the tester's account
quiz.w: Leak = customer ka nuksaan, trust khatam, account band ho sakta hai.

quiz.q: Why keep your OS and browser updated?
quiz.w: Updates me security fixes aate hain, isliye OS aur browser updated rakho.

quiz.q: Discussing an active cycle's features in a public online forum is:
o: Allowed if you do not name the customer
quiz.w: Cycle ki baat cycle me hi; forum, social media sab mana.

quiz.q: Where can you share a HAR file from a cycle?
o: Only through the platform, when the cycle requests it
quiz.w: HAR me cookies, tokens hote hain, isliye sirf platform pe aur maangne pe.

quiz.q: How long should your 'Tell me about yourself' answer be?
quiz.w: Intro 60-90 second ka rakho, crisp aur clear.

quiz.q: Which order fits a good 'Tell me about yourself'?
o: Who you are, current work, tools, what you are learning, why this role
quiz.w: Kaun → Kahan → Kya test → Kya tools → Kyun yahan.

quiz.q: Which numbers should you state in an interview?
quiz.w: Wahi number bolo jo defend kar sako.

quiz.q: In STAR, what does the 'A' stand for?
quiz.w: STAR = Situation, Task, Action, Result.

quiz.q: You must test an app with no documentation. What is the first step?
o: Explore it as a user to learn the main flows
quiz.w: Pehle user ki tarah explore karo, phir map, core flows, edges, aur sawaal.

quiz.q: You cannot reproduce a bug you saw once. Best approach?
o: Retrace steps, retry under different conditions and report it as intermittent with evidence
quiz.w: Retrace, Retry, Record, Ratio: video/logs ho to do aur ratio likho.

quiz.q: Which three questions help decide severity?
o: Who found it, when, which browser
How long the title is, how many steps, which tester
How many users, how serious the damage, is there a workaround
Who will fix it, how fast, which sprint
quiz.w: Users, Damage, Workaround: yahi teen sawaal severity tay karte hain.

quiz.q: What is a key difference between crowdtesting and in-house QA?
o: Crowdtesting covers only one product deeply
In crowdtesting the report must stand alone because the reviewer cannot talk to you
quiz.w: Crowd me report hi tumhari pehchaan hai; in-house me ek product ki gehrai.

quiz.q: When asked about your devices, what should you say?
o: Only the devices and environments actually in your profile
quiz.w: Jhooth nahi; cycle me environment match karna padta hai.

quiz.q: Which phone and OS does Ritik list as his test device?
quiz.w: Card ke hisaab se phone: Moto G85, Android 16, Airtel network.

quiz.q: Which is a good question to ask the interviewer at the end?
o: How many holidays do I get before joining?
What does success look like in the first three months?
quiz.w: Process, tools, 3 mahine me success: aise sawaal interest dikhate hain.

quiz.q: Which module does Ritik say he owns quality for at Merlin?
quiz.w: Intro me bolte hain: purchase order module ki quality meri zimmedaari.

quiz.q: After logout, the user presses Back. The expected result is:
o: The user is logged back in
The last page loads with full data
quiz.w: Logout ke baad back button se wapas andar nahi aana chahiye.

quiz.q: Searching 'Pen', 'pen' and 'PEN' and expecting the same results tests:
quiz.w: Pen/pen/PEN = case insensitive search check.

quiz.q: A search returns no matches. What should the user see?
quiz.w: No result pe clear message dikhna chahiye.

quiz.q: Asked 'How would you test a pen?', what should you do first?
o: Ask about the requirements and who will use it
quiz.w: Pehle sawaal poochho: kaun sa pen, kiske liye.

quiz.q: A person stands in the lift doorway as the doors close. Expected:
o: The alarm rings and the lift stops working
The lift moves to the top floor
The sensor stops the doors and they reopen
quiz.w: Door me koi ho to sensor se door band nahi hona chahiye.

quiz.q: Entering quantity 0 or a value above stock in a cart is testing:
o: Quantity limits with boundary and negative values
quiz.w: Qty 0, negative, stock se zyada = boundary/negative cases.

quiz.q: An expired coupon is applied at checkout. Expected:
o: The order is placed for free
It is rejected with a clear message
quiz.w: Expired coupon reject ho aur clear message aaye.

quiz.q: A file upload allows only PDF and JPG. You upload an .exe file. Expected:
o: The file is uploaded and run
quiz.w: Allowed types ke alawa file reject honi chahiye.

quiz.q: Uploading a 0 KB file is an example of:
quiz.w: Empty (0 KB) file ek edge case hai.

quiz.q: A password reset link is used once and then clicked again. Expected:
o: It logs into a different account
The second use fails because the link works only once
quiz.w: Reset link ek baar hi kaam kare.

quiz.q: After a successful password reset, other existing sessions should:
o: Get the new password by email
quiz.w: Reset ke baad purane sessions logout hone chahiye.

quiz.q: Entering 31 April in a date field tests:
quiz.w: April me 30 din hote hain, 31 April invalid date hai.

quiz.q: A booking form has a start date later than the end date. Expected:
o: The form blocks it with a validation message
quiz.w: Start date end date ke baad nahi ho sakti.

quiz.q: Signing up with an email that is already registered should:
o: Log in to the old account silently
quiz.w: Duplicate email se naya account nahi banna chahiye.

quiz.q: The ATM did not dispense cash but the account was debited. What must be tested?
o: The amount is reversed to the account
quiz.w: Cash nahi nikla par paisa kata = reversal hona chahiye.

quiz.q: Changing the country in a country-state dropdown pair should:
o: Update the state list for that country
quiz.w: Dependent dropdown sahi badalna chahiye.

On the customer's live system without telling anyone

Start with the maximum possible load

quiz.q: Which server resources are commonly monitored during performance tests?
quiz.w: Server ka CPU aur memory usage dekhna zaroori hai.

The number of testers who made mistakes
The share of requests that failed

quiz.q: A developer says your bug is not reproducible. Best response:
o: Share exact environment, data and steps with video or API response, and offer to reproduce together
quiz.w: Evidence + exact steps + saath baith ke dikhao.

quiz.q: For an intermittent bug, your report should also mention:
o: How often it occurs and under which conditions
Only that it might be a fluke
The developer's name as the cause
quiz.w: Intermittent ho to frequency aur conditions likho.

quiz.q: With a tight deadline, a good QA approach is:
o: Silently skip testing and sign off
Ask to cancel the release without data
Prioritise by risk and tell the lead clearly what will and will not be covered
quiz.w: Risk-based priority, aur coverage ka gap documented: decision known risk ke saath.

quiz.q: Asked about a bug you missed that reached production, the best answer:
o: Admit it honestly and explain the root cause and what you changed, like a new test case
Say you have never missed a bug
Say it was the customer's fault
quiz.w: Imaandaari + RCA + learning; blame nahi.

quiz.q: When you disagree with a developer, you should:
o: Stay factual, refer to the requirement and user impact, and let the PO or lead decide if needed
Escalate publicly in a large channel first
quiz.w: Facts aur user impact pe baat; agree na ho to PO/lead decide.

quiz.q: Why are session replays useful when investigating a customer issue?
o: They show exactly what the user did before the error
quiz.w: Replay se user ke exact steps dikhte, reproduce karna aasaan.

quiz.q: To decide what to regression test, look first at:
o: What changed, the flows that depend on it, and critical business flows
quiz.w: Change area + dependent flows + critical flows + fragile areas.

quiz.q: When describing AI-assisted work in an interview, the best framing is:
o: AI drafts, and you verify every output, with code going through developer review
Claim deep AI expertise you do not have
Hide that you used AI at all
Say AI tests everything without review
quiz.w: "AI drafts, engineer verifies": sach bolo, expertise ka dava nahi.

quiz.q: A strong "What are your strengths?" answer:
o: A long list of ten adjectives
Two or three strengths, each backed by a short real example
quiz.w: 2-3 strengths + chhota example, bas.

quiz.q: A good "Why should we hire you?" answer:
o: Says you need the job urgently
Links your hands-on skills to the role with concrete evidence
Repeats your resume line by line
quiz.w: Role se relevant skills + evidence, short me.

quiz.q: A good "Where do you see yourself in five years?" answer:
o: A growth path that fits the role, like a senior SDET owning automation and mentoring
quiz.w: Growth role ke saath align karo: senior SDET, automation ownership, mentoring.

quiz.q: When asked how you handle pressure, best approach:
o: Say you work all night every night
Break work down, prioritise by impact, keep people updated, with an example
quiz.w: Priority list + ek ek kaam + update, aur ek real example.

quiz.q: A good answer about teamwork:
o: A general statement with no example
A concrete example of working with developers, product and support
quiz.w: Example do: dev ke saath reproduce, PM se requirement clear.

quiz.q: When asked about your notice period, you should:
o: State your actual notice period and mention openness to an early release
Say zero days if it is not true
Promise to leave without serving notice
quiz.w: Asli notice bolo; early release ke liye open raho.

quiz.q: Best way to handle salary expectations:
o: Research the market and give a range while staying flexible
Say any amount is fine without research
Quote an unrealistically high fixed number
Refuse to discuss salary at all
quiz.w: Research karke range bolo, flexible raho; current CTC sachcha.

quiz.q: At the end, the interviewer asks "Any questions for us?" You should:
o: Ask one or two genuine questions, e.g. about the automation stack or first three months
Ask when you can get a promotion
quiz.w: Hamesha 1-2 sawaal: team, automation stack, first 3 months success.

quiz.q: The STAR method for behavioural answers stands for:
quiz.w: STAR: situation batao, task, kya action liya, kya result aaya.

quiz.q: When should you bring up long-term plans like relocating abroad?
o: In every interview at the start
Only when it is relevant, such as with a global company
quiz.w: Abroad wali baat tabhi jab company global ho aur context ho.

quiz.q: How many quiz questions must you answer correctly before signing up for the Computer Testing cycle?
quiz.w: Computer Testing quiz me 15 sahi chahiye.

quiz.q: How many quiz questions must you answer correctly before signing up for the Mobile Device Testing cycle?
quiz.w: Mobile ka quiz 20 sahi maangta hai.

quiz.q: How many quiz questions must you answer correctly before signing up for the Charles Proxy Testing cycle?
quiz.w: Charles Proxy quiz = 25 sahi.

quiz.q: How many quiz questions must you answer correctly before signing up for the Academy Challenge?
quiz.w: Academy Challenge quiz = 30 sahi.

quiz.q: Which cycle must be passed before joining Computer Testing?
quiz.w: Computer Testing ki requirement Introduction to Testing pass hai.

quiz.q: Which cycle must be passed before joining the Academy Challenge?
quiz.w: Challenge ke liye Charles Proxy cycle pass chahiye.

quiz.q: What is needed to pass Computer Testing?
o: At least one approved issue report and one approved test case
One approved test case and a written review
quiz.w: Pass = 1 approved issue + 1 approved test case.

quiz.q: Within what time is a Pass grade assigned during an active or locked cycle?
o: 12 to 24 hours after both the issue and test case are approved
quiz.w: Dono approvals ke 12-24 ghante me Pass milta hai.

quiz.q: What happens to a tester who gets a Fail when the cycle closes?
o: They sign up again for the same level
They move to the next cycle anyway
They must redo the Introduction to Testing cycle
They are removed from the program
quiz.w: Fail = same level dobara sign up.

quiz.q: Which operating systems are allowed in the Computer Testing cycle?
quiz.w: Computer cycle: Windows, macOS ya Linux.

quiz.q: What is the maximum number of issue reports in the Computer Testing cycle?
quiz.w: Computer aur Mobile me max three issues.

quiz.q: Why don't you need to worry about duplicates in Computer Testing?
o: Only one tester joins each cycle
quiz.w: Dusron ke issues hidden hote hain.

quiz.q: Which is NOT listed as a new thing practised in Computer Testing?
quiz.w: Charles log Computer cycle ka part nahi; review, desktop log, recording hai.

quiz.q: Which course appears three times in the Computer Testing quiz map, together with Basics of Screen Recording?
quiz.w: Bug Rejections Q3, Q13, Q14 - teen baar.

quiz.q: After claiming a slot in Computer Testing, what do you do with the test case?
o: Send it to the TTL for approval first
Copy it into a bug report
quiz.w: Testers test case likhte nahi, execute karte hain.

quiz.q: A test case step shows 'MINIMUM 1' under Result Attachments. What does that mean?
o: You may upload at most one attachment
Only a screenshot of step 1 is required
You must upload at least one attachment
quiz.w: Minimum dikhe to upload zaroori.

quiz.q: To add a new attachment to a submitted bug report, which statement is correct?
o: You do not need to click Edit Issue; use the attachments section
You must click Edit Issue first
You must resubmit the bug report
Only the TTL can add attachments
quiz.w: Attachments section me seedha upload, Edit Issue nahi.

quiz.q: What should you wait for before deleting the old incorrect attachment?
quiz.w: Upload Complete aane ke baad purana delete karo.

quiz.q: The TTL says the 'Navigated' string is missing from your console log. What did you most likely miss?
o: Refreshing the homepage after opening the console
quiz.w: Console kholne ke baad homepage refresh karna tha.

quiz.q: If reproducing the issue opens a new tab, which console setting should you enable in Chrome or new Edge?
quiz.w: Popup tab ke liye Auto-open DevTools for popups.

quiz.q: A registration name field accepts numeric values. What kind of issue is this?
quiz.w: Galat input accept = field validation.

quiz.q: Can you test the mobile version of the site in the Computer Testing cycle?
o: No, report issues in desktop view on full screen
Yes, if you resize the window
quiz.w: Computer cycle = desktop view, full screen.

quiz.q: Your issue is approved but you forgot the test case and the cycle is locked. When can you still submit it?
o: Only if the test case was requested for more info
quiz.w: Lock ke baad sirf more info request pe.

quiz.q: You have two approved issues and one rejected issue in Computer Testing. Can you report another?
o: No, three reports are the hard limit
Only if the TTL allows it
Yes, up to three approved issues in total
quiz.w: FAQ: ek aur kar sakte ho, total 3 approved.

quiz.q: You claimed a slot with the wrong device and the cycle is locked. What should you do?
o: Edit the device in your profile
quiz.w: Locked = device change nahi, TTL ka wait.

quiz.q: Which is required for Mobile Device Testing in addition to a mobile device?
o: A computer to collect mobile device logs
quiz.w: Mobile device logs ke liye computer chahiye.

quiz.q: When are test cases checked and approved in Mobile Device Testing?
o: As soon as you submit them
quiz.w: Test case review lock ke baad.

quiz.q: Is VPN use allowed while testing?
o: Yes, if the app is unavailable in your country
No, it is against the Terms of Use
quiz.w: VPN Terms of Use ke against.

quiz.q: ADB keeps showing 'waiting for device'. What is the first fix?
o: Install USB drivers and the device driver on the computer
quiz.w: Pehle drivers, phir dusra cable.

quiz.q: Which command clears the Android log before reproducing an issue?
quiz.w: logcat -c log clear karta hai.

quiz.q: What should you set as Host and Port in Charles SSL proxying settings?
quiz.w: Host = *, Port = 443.

quiz.q: Your Charles log is too large. What do you click first after opening Charles?
o: The Broom icon to clear traffic
quiz.w: Pehle Broom se traffic clear, phir reproduce.

quiz.q: Without WiFi, what do you need to collect Charles logs on mobile?
o: At least 2 mobile phones with internet
quiz.w: No WiFi = kam se kam 2 phones with internet.

quiz.q: How many times can a tester participate in the Academy Challenge cycle?
quiz.w: Challenge me 10 baar tak.

quiz.q: Which issue type is rejected in the Academy Challenge even if it is real?
o: Minor visual and content issues that do not block the end user
quiz.w: Non-blocking minor visual/content issues reject.

quiz.q: In the Academy Challenge, what do you do if a test case step fails on an issue already reported by someone else?
o: Report it again as a new issue
Fail the step, mention the original issue ID in the comment and +1 it
quiz.w: Fail + original id comment + plus one.

quiz.q: You cannot open the Test Cases or Issues tab after a TTL announcement. What should you do?
o: Click the blue acknowledge button on the announcement
quiz.w: Announcement acknowledge karna padta hai.

quiz.q: How many new issues can a tester have at a time in the Academy Challenge?
quiz.w: Rated ya unrated, ek time pe 5 new.

quiz.q: Who selects testers for the Academy All Stars cycle and when are they invited?
o: The TTL, invited the same day
Other testers by vote, next month
The Academy team, invited the next week
quiz.w: Academy team chunti hai, next week invite.

quiz.q: Which course appears three times in the Academy Challenge quiz map?
quiz.w: Best Practices (Test Cases) Q3, Q19, Q28.
